===== /scripts/e2e/live_lab_common.sh =====

   1: #!/usr/bin/env bash
   2: 
   3: live_lab_require_command() {
   4:   local cmd="$1"
   5:   if ! command -v "$cmd" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   6:     echo "missing required command: $cmd" >&2
   7:     exit 1
   8:   fi
   9: }
  10: 
  11: live_lab_require_file() {
  12:   local path="$1"
  13:   local label="$2"
  14:   if [[ ! -f "$path" ]]; then
  15:     echo "missing ${label}: ${path}" >&2
  16:     exit 1
  17:   fi
  18: }
  19: 
  20: live_lab_init() {
  21:   if [[ $# -lt 2 || $# -gt 3 ]]; then
  22:     echo "usage: live_lab_init <prefix> <ssh-identity-file> [deprecated-auth-file]" >&2
  23:     exit 2
  24:   fi
  25: 
  26:   local prefix="$1"
  27:   LIVE_LAB_SSH_IDENTITY_FILE="$2"
  28:   export LIVE_LAB_SSH_IDENTITY_FILE
  29: 
  30:   live_lab_require_file "$LIVE_LAB_SSH_IDENTITY_FILE" "ssh identity file"
  31:   if [[ -L "$LIVE_LAB_SSH_IDENTITY_FILE" ]]; then
  32:     echo "ssh identity file must not be a symlink: $LIVE_LAB_SSH_IDENTITY_FILE" >&2
  33:     exit 1
  34:   fi
  35:   if ! cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops check-local-file-mode \
  36:     --path "$LIVE_LAB_SSH_IDENTITY_FILE" \
  37:     --policy owner-only \
  38:     --label 'ssh identity file' >/dev/null
  39:   then
  40:     exit 1
  41:   fi
  42: 
  43:   for cmd in ssh scp ssh-keygen awk sed openssl xxd mktemp chmod tr; do
  44:     live_lab_require_command "$cmd"
  45:   done
  46: 
  47:   LIVE_LAB_UTMCTL_PATH="${LIVE_LAB_UTMCTL_PATH:-/Applications/UTM.app/Contents/MacOS/utmctl}"
  48:   export LIVE_LAB_UTMCTL_PATH
  49:   if live_lab_has_utm_transport; then
  50:     live_lab_require_utmctl
  51:   fi
  52: 
  53:   LIVE_LAB_PINNED_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE="${LIVE_LAB_PINNED_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE:-${HOME}/.ssh/known_hosts}"
  54:   export LIVE_LAB_PINNED_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE
  55:   live_lab_require_known_hosts_file "$LIVE_LAB_PINNED_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE"
  56: 
  57:   LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/${prefix}.XXXXXX")"
  58:   LIVE_LAB_KNOWN_HOSTS="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/known_hosts"
  59:   LIVE_LAB_REMOTE_CLEANUP_TARGETS=()
  60:   export LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR LIVE_LAB_KNOWN_HOSTS
  61: 
  62:   live_lab_seed_known_hosts_file "$LIVE_LAB_KNOWN_HOSTS"
  63: }
  64: 
  65: live_lab_cleanup() {
  66:   if [[ -n "${LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR:-}" && -d "${LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR}" ]]; then
  67:     rm -rf "$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR"
  68:   fi
  69: }
  70: 
  71: live_lab_require_known_hosts_file() {
  72:   local path="$1"
  73:   if [[ -z "$path" ]]; then
  74:     echo "pinned known_hosts file path is required" >&2
  75:     exit 1
  76:   fi
  77:   if [[ ! -f "$path" ]]; then
  78:     echo "missing pinned known_hosts file: $path" >&2
  79:     exit 1
  80:   fi
  81:   if [[ -L "$path" ]]; then
  82:     echo "pinned known_hosts file must not be a symlink: $path" >&2
  83:     exit 1
  84:   fi
  85:   if ! cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops check-local-file-mode \
  86:     --path "$path" \
  87:     --policy no-group-world-write \
  88:     --label 'pinned known_hosts file' >/dev/null
  89:   then
  90:     exit 1
  91:   fi
  92: }
  93: 
  94: live_lab_seed_known_hosts_file() {
  95:   local destination="$1"
  96:   cat "$LIVE_LAB_PINNED_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE" > "$destination"
  97:   chmod 600 "$destination"
  98: }
  99: 
 100: live_lab_known_hosts_lookup_host() {
 101:   local host="$1"
 102:   local port="$2"
 103:   if [[ -z "$host" ]]; then
 104:     return 1
 105:   fi
 106:   if [[ -z "$port" || "$port" == "22" ]]; then
 107:     printf '%s' "$host"
 108:     return 0
 109:   fi
 110:   printf '[%s]:%s' "$host" "$port"
 111: }
 112: 
 113: live_lab_join_by_delimiter() {
 114:   local delimiter="$1"
 115:   shift || true
 116:   local first=1
 117:   local item
 118:   for item in "$@"; do
 119:     if [[ "$first" -eq 1 ]]; then
 120:       printf '%s' "$item"
 121:       first=0
 122:     else
 123:       printf '%s%s' "$delimiter" "$item"
 124:     fi
 125:   done
 126: }
 127: 
 128: live_lab_extract_inline_field() {
 129:   local line="$1"
 130:   local key="$2"
 131:   local token prefix
 132:   prefix="${key}="
 133:   for token in $line; do
 134:     if [[ "$token" == "$prefix"* ]]; then
 135:       printf '%s' "${token#"$prefix"}"
 136:       return 0
 137:     fi
 138:   done
 139:   return 1
 140: }
 141: 
 142: live_lab_known_hosts_lookup_candidates() {
 143:   local target="$1"
 144:   local resolved raw_host port hostkeyalias hostname lookup_host
 145:   local -a lookup_candidates=()
 146:   raw_host="$(live_lab_target_address "$target")"
 147:   resolved="$(ssh -G "$target" 2>/dev/null)" || {
 148:     echo "failed resolving SSH target for host-key verification: ${target}" >&2
 149:     return 1
 150:   }
 151:   port="$(awk '$1=="port"{print $2; exit}' <<<"$resolved")"
 152:   hostkeyalias="$(awk '$1=="hostkeyalias"{print $2; exit}' <<<"$resolved")"
 153:   hostname="$(awk '$1=="hostname"{print $2; exit}' <<<"$resolved")"
 154: 
 155:   if [[ -n "$hostkeyalias" && "$hostkeyalias" != "none" ]]; then
 156:     lookup_host="$(live_lab_known_hosts_lookup_host "$hostkeyalias" "$port")" || {
 157:       echo "failed rendering hostkeyalias known_hosts lookup for ${target}" >&2
 158:       return 1
 159:     }
 160:     lookup_candidates+=("$lookup_host")
 161:   fi
 162: 
 163:   lookup_host="$(live_lab_known_hosts_lookup_host "$raw_host" "$port")" || {
 164:     echo "failed rendering raw host known_hosts lookup for ${target}" >&2
 165:     return 1
 166:   }
 167:   lookup_candidates+=("$lookup_host")
 168: 
 169:   if [[ -n "$hostname" ]]; then
 170:     lookup_host="$(live_lab_known_hosts_lookup_host "$hostname" "$port")" || {
 171:       echo "failed rendering resolved host known_hosts lookup for ${target}" >&2
 172:       return 1
 173:     }
 174:     if [[ " ${lookup_candidates[*]} " != *" ${lookup_host} "* ]]; then
 175:       lookup_candidates+=("$lookup_host")
 176:     fi
 177:   fi
 178: 
 179:   if [[ "${#lookup_candidates[@]}" -eq 0 ]]; then
 180:     echo "pinned known_hosts verification resolved no lookup candidates for ${target}" >&2
 181:     return 1
 182:   fi
 183:   printf '%s\n' "${lookup_candidates[@]}"
 184: }
 185: 
 186: live_lab_find_pinned_host_entry() {
 187:   local target="$1"
 188:   local lookup_candidates_output line
 189:   local lookup_host
 190:   local -a lookup_candidates=()
 191: 
 192:   lookup_candidates_output="$(live_lab_known_hosts_lookup_candidates "$target")" || return 1
 193:   if [[ -n "$lookup_candidates_output" ]]; then
 194:     while IFS= read -r line; do
 195:       lookup_candidates+=("$line")
 196:     done <<<"$lookup_candidates_output"
 197:   fi
 198:   for lookup_host in "${lookup_candidates[@]}"; do
 199:     if ssh-keygen -F "$lookup_host" -f "$LIVE_LAB_PINNED_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 200:       printf '%s' "$lookup_host"
 201:       return 0
 202:     fi
 203:   done
 204:   return 1
 205: }
 206: 
 207: live_lab_target_configured_transport() {
 208:   local target="$1"
 209:   if live_lab_target_uses_utm_transport "$target"; then
 210:     printf 'utm'
 211:     return 0
 212:   fi
 213:   printf 'ssh'
 214: }
 215: 
 216: live_lab_require_pinned_host_entry() {
 217:   local target="$1"
 218:   local matched lookup_host lookup_candidates_output line
 219:   local -a lookup_candidates=()
 220: 
 221:   lookup_candidates_output="$(live_lab_known_hosts_lookup_candidates "$target")" || return 1
 222:   if [[ -n "$lookup_candidates_output" ]]; then
 223:     while IFS= read -r line; do
 224:       lookup_candidates+=("$line")
 225:     done <<<"$lookup_candidates_output"
 226:   fi
 227:   matched="$(live_lab_find_pinned_host_entry "$target")" || {
 228:     if [[ "${#lookup_candidates[@]}" -eq 0 ]]; then
 229:       echo "pinned known_hosts verification resolved no lookup candidates for ${target}" >&2
 230:     else
 231:       echo "pinned known_hosts file lacks host key for ${target}; checked ${lookup_candidates[*]} in ${LIVE_LAB_PINNED_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE}" >&2
 232:     fi
 233:     return 1
 234:   }
 235:   [[ -n "$matched" ]] || return 1
 236: }
 237: 
 238: live_lab_write_ssh_trust_summary() {
 239:   local output_path="$1"
 240:   shift || true
 241:   local target_count="$#"
 242:   local output_dir pinned_known_hosts_sha256
 243:   local all_targets_pinned=true
 244:   local all_targets_passwordless_sudo=true
 245:   local idx=0
 246:   local target matched_candidate configured_transport checked_candidates_csv
 247:   local host_key_status passwordless_sudo_status
 248:   local -a lookup_candidates=()
 249: 
 250:   output_dir="$(dirname "$output_path")"
 251:   mkdir -p "$output_dir"
 252:   pinned_known_hosts_sha256="$(shasum -a 256 "$LIVE_LAB_PINNED_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE" | awk '{print $1}')" || {
 253:     echo "failed to hash pinned known_hosts file: $LIVE_LAB_PINNED_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE" >&2
 254:     return 1
 255:   }
 256: 
 257:   {
 258:     printf 'schema_version=1\n'
 259:     printf 'generated_at_unix=%s\n' "$(date +%s)"
 260:     printf 'pinned_known_hosts_file=%s\n' "$LIVE_LAB_PINNED_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE"
 261:     printf 'pinned_known_hosts_sha256=%s\n' "$pinned_known_hosts_sha256"
 262:     printf 'target_count=%s\n' "$target_count"
 263:   } > "$output_path"
 264: 
 265:   for target in "$@"; do
 266:     lookup_candidates=()
 267:     lookup_candidates_output="$(live_lab_known_hosts_lookup_candidates "$target")" || return 1
 268:     if [[ -n "$lookup_candidates_output" ]]; then
 269:       while IFS= read -r line; do
 270:         lookup_candidates+=("$line")
 271:       done <<<"$lookup_candidates_output"
 272:     fi
 273:     checked_candidates_csv="$(live_lab_join_by_delimiter "," "${lookup_candidates[@]}")"
 274:     if matched_candidate="$(live_lab_find_pinned_host_entry "$target")"; then
 275:       host_key_status="pass"
 276:     else
 277:       matched_candidate=""
 278:       host_key_status="fail"
 279:       all_targets_pinned=false
 280:     fi
 281: 
 282:     if live_lab_verify_sudo "$target" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 283:       passwordless_sudo_status="pass"
 284:     else
 285:       passwordless_sudo_status="fail"
 286:       all_targets_passwordless_sudo=false
 287:     fi
 288: 
 289:     configured_transport="$(live_lab_target_configured_transport "$target")"
 290:     {
 291:       printf 'target[%s].target=%s\n' "$idx" "$target"
 292:       printf 'target[%s].configured_transport=%s\n' "$idx" "$configured_transport"
 293:       printf 'target[%s].checked_candidates=%s\n' "$idx" "$checked_candidates_csv"
 294:       printf 'target[%s].matched_candidate=%s\n' "$idx" "$matched_candidate"
 295:       printf 'target[%s].host_key_status=%s\n' "$idx" "$host_key_status"
 296:       printf 'target[%s].passwordless_sudo_status=%s\n' "$idx" "$passwordless_sudo_status"
 297:     } >> "$output_path"
 298:     idx=$((idx + 1))
 299:   done
 300: 
 301:   {
 302:     printf 'all_targets_pinned=%s\n' "$all_targets_pinned"
 303:     printf 'all_targets_passwordless_sudo=%s\n' "$all_targets_passwordless_sudo"
 304:   } >> "$output_path"
 305: 
 306:   if [[ "$all_targets_pinned" != "true" || "$all_targets_passwordless_sudo" != "true" ]]; then
 307:     echo "SSH trust summary verification failed; inspect $output_path" >&2
 308:     return 1
 309:   fi
 310: }
 311:

 316:   export LIVE_LAB_KNOWN_HOSTS="$worker_known_hosts"

 343: live_lab_target_utm_name() {
 344:   local target="$1"
 345:   if [[ -n "${EXIT_TARGET:-}" && "$target" == "$EXIT_TARGET" ]]; then
 346:     printf '%s' "${EXIT_UTM_NAME:-}"
 347:     return 0
 348:   fi
 349:   if [[ -n "${CLIENT_TARGET:-}" && "$target" == "$CLIENT_TARGET" ]]; then
 350:     printf '%s' "${CLIENT_UTM_NAME:-}"
 351:     return 0
 352:   fi
 353:   if [[ -n "${ENTRY_TARGET:-}" && "$target" == "$ENTRY_TARGET" ]]; then
 354:     printf '%s' "${ENTRY_UTM_NAME:-}"
 355:     return 0
 356:   fi
 357:   if [[ -n "${AUX_TARGET:-}" && "$target" == "$AUX_TARGET" ]]; then
 358:     printf '%s' "${AUX_UTM_NAME:-}"
 359:     return 0
 360:   fi
 361:   if [[ -n "${EXTRA_TARGET:-}" && "$target" == "$EXTRA_TARGET" ]]; then
 362:     printf '%s' "${EXTRA_UTM_NAME:-}"
 363:     return 0
 364:   fi
 365:   if [[ -n "${FIFTH_CLIENT_TARGET:-}" && "$target" == "$FIFTH_CLIENT_TARGET" ]]; then
 366:     printf '%s' "${FIFTH_CLIENT_UTM_NAME:-}"
 367:     return 0
 368:   fi
 369:   return 1
 370: }

 372: live_lab_target_uses_utm_transport() {

 375:   fi
 376:   local utm_name
 377:   utm_name="$(live_lab_target_utm_name "$1" 2>/dev/null || true)"
 378:   [[ -n "$utm_name" ]]
 379: }

 383: }

 386:   [[ -n "${LIVE_LAB_SSH_IDENTITY_FILE:-}" && -f "${LIVE_LAB_SSH_IDENTITY_FILE}" ]] || return 1
 387:   [[ -n "${LIVE_LAB_KNOWN_HOSTS:-}" && -f "${LIVE_LAB_KNOWN_HOSTS}" ]] || return 1

 391: live_lab_require_utmctl() {
 392:   if [[ ! -x "$LIVE_LAB_UTMCTL_PATH" ]]; then
 393:     echo "missing executable UTM control tool: $LIVE_LAB_UTMCTL_PATH" >&2
 394:     exit 1
 395:   fi
 396: }
 397: 
 398: # UTM guest-agent operations abort under concurrent host-side calls on this Mac,
 399: # so serialize every utmctl file/exec invocation across live-lab workers.
 400: live_lab_utm_lock_dir() {
 401:   printf '%s/utmctl.lock' "$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR"
 402: }
 403: 
 404: live_lab_utm_lock_acquire() {
 405:   local wait_secs="${1:-10800}"
 406:   local lock_dir pid_file owner_pid waited_secs=0
 407:   lock_dir="$(live_lab_utm_lock_dir)"
 408:   pid_file="${lock_dir}/pid"
 409:   while ! mkdir "$lock_dir" 2>/dev/null; do
 410:     owner_pid=""
 411:     if [[ -f "$pid_file" ]]; then
 412:       owner_pid="$(cat "$pid_file" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]' || true)"
 413:     fi
 414:     if [[ "$owner_pid" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && ! kill -0 "$owner_pid" 2>/dev/null; then
 415:       rm -rf "$lock_dir" 2>/dev/null || true
 416:       continue
 417:     fi
 418:     if (( waited_secs >= wait_secs )); then
 419:       echo "timed out waiting for serialized utmctl access" >&2
 420:       return 1
 421:     fi
 422:     sleep 1
 423:     waited_secs=$((waited_secs + 1))
 424:   done
 425:   printf '%s\n' "$$" > "$pid_file"
 426: }
 427: 
 428: live_lab_utm_lock_release() {
 429:   local lock_dir
 430:   lock_dir="$(live_lab_utm_lock_dir)"
 431:   rm -rf "$lock_dir" 2>/dev/null || true
 432: }
 433: 
 434: live_lab_utm_run_locked() {
 435:   local lock_wait_secs="${1:-10800}"
 436:   shift
 437:   local rc
 438:   live_lab_utm_lock_acquire "$lock_wait_secs" || return 1
 439:   if "$@"; then
 440:     rc=0
 441:   else
 442:     rc=$?
 443:   fi
 444:   live_lab_utm_lock_release
 445:   return "$rc"
 446: }
 447: 
 448: live_lab_utm_run_locked_stdin() {
 449:   local stdin_file="$1"
 450:   local lock_wait_secs="${2:-10800}"
 451:   shift 2
 452:   local rc
 453:   live_lab_utm_lock_acquire "$lock_wait_secs" || return 1
 454:   if "$@" < "$stdin_file"; then
 455:     rc=0
 456:   else
 457:     rc=$?
 458:   fi
 459:   live_lab_utm_lock_release
 460:   return "$rc"
 461: }
 462: 
 463: live_lab_wait_for_background_command() {
 464:   local pid="$1"
 465:   local timeout_secs="${2:-60}"
 466:   local waited_secs=0
 467:   local rc
 468:   if [[ ! "$timeout_secs" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || (( timeout_secs < 1 )); then
 469:     timeout_secs=1
 470:   fi
 471:   while kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; do
 472:     if (( waited_secs >= timeout_secs )); then
 473:       kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
 474:       sleep 1
 475:       kill -9 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
 476:       wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
 477:       return 124
 478:     fi
 479:     sleep 1
 480:     waited_secs=$((waited_secs + 1))
 481:   done
 482:   if wait "$pid"; then
 483:     rc=0
 484:   else
 485:     rc=$?
 486:   fi
 487:   return "$rc"
 488: }
 489: 
 490: live_lab_utm_run_locked_timeout() {
 491:   local lock_wait_secs="${1:-10800}"
 492:   local command_timeout_secs="${2:-60}"
 493:   shift 2
 494:   local rc pid
 495:   live_lab_utm_lock_acquire "$lock_wait_secs" || return 1
 496:   "$@" &
 497:   pid=$!
 498:   if live_lab_wait_for_background_command "$pid" "$command_timeout_secs"; then
 499:     rc=0
 500:   else
 501:     rc=$?
 502:   fi
 503:   live_lab_utm_lock_release
 504:   return "$rc"
 505: }
 506: 
 507: live_lab_utm_run_locked_stdin_timeout() {
 508:   local stdin_file="$1"
 509:   local lock_wait_secs="${2:-10800}"
 510:   local command_timeout_secs="${3:-60}"
 511:   shift 3
 512:   local rc pid
 513:   live_lab_utm_lock_acquire "$lock_wait_secs" || return 1
 514:   "$@" < "$stdin_file" &
 515:   pid=$!
 516:   if live_lab_wait_for_background_command "$pid" "$command_timeout_secs"; then
 517:     rc=0
 518:   else
 519:     rc=$?
 520:   fi
 521:   live_lab_utm_lock_release
 522:   return "$rc"
 523: }
 524: 
 525: live_lab_utm_cleanup_exec_files() {
 526:   local utm_name="$1"
 527:   local remote_script="$2"
 528:   local remote_wrapper="$3"
 529:   local remote_output="$4"
 530:   local remote_rc="$5"
 531:   live_lab_utm_run_locked_timeout 10800 20 \
 532:     "$LIVE_LAB_UTMCTL_PATH" exec "$utm_name" --cmd /bin/bash -lc "rm -f $(printf '%q' "$remote_script") $(printf '%q' "$remote_wrapper") $(printf '%q' "$remote_output") $(printf '%q' "$remote_rc")" \
 533:     >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 534: }
 535: 
 536: live_lab_utm_cleanup_run_files() {
 537:   local utm_name="$1"
 538:   local remote_script="$2"
 539:   local remote_wrapper="$3"
 540:   live_lab_utm_run_locked_timeout 10800 20 \
 541:     "$LIVE_LAB_UTMCTL_PATH" exec "$utm_name" --cmd /bin/bash -lc "rm -f $(printf '%q' "$remote_script") $(printf '%q' "$remote_wrapper")" \
 542:     >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 543: }
 544: 
 545: live_lab_utm_push_raw() {
 546:   local src="$1"
 547:   local target="$2"
 548:   local dst="$3"
 549:   local timeout_secs="${4:-60}"
 550:   local utm_name attempt rc
 551:   utm_name="$(live_lab_target_utm_name "$target")" || {
 552:     echo "missing UTM mapping for target: $target" >&2
 553:     return 1
 554:   }
 555:   local push_args=(
 556:     "$LIVE_LAB_UTMCTL_PATH"
 557:     file
 558:     push
 559:     "$utm_name"
 560:     "$dst"
 561:   )
 562:   for attempt in 1 2 3; do
 563:     if live_lab_utm_run_locked_stdin_timeout "$src" 10800 "$timeout_secs" "${push_args[@]}"; then
 564:       return 0
 565:     else
 566:       rc=$?
 567:     fi
 568:     if [[ "$attempt" -lt 3 ]]; then
 569:       sleep 2
 570:     fi
 571:   done
 572:   live_lab_utm_run_locked_stdin_timeout "$src" 10800 "$timeout_secs" "${push_args[@]}"
 573: }
 574: 
 575: live_lab_resolved_target_address() {
 576:   local target="$1"
 577:   local resolved hostname
 578:   resolved="$(ssh -G "$target" 2>/dev/null)" || {
 579:     live_lab_target_address "$target"
 580:     return 0
 581:   }
 582:   hostname="$(awk '$1=="hostname"{print $2; exit}' <<<"$resolved")"
 583:   if [[ -n "$hostname" ]]; then
 584:     printf '%s' "$hostname"
 585:     return 0
 586:   fi
 587:   live_lab_target_address "$target"
 588: }
 589: 
 590: live_lab_utm_exec_as_user() {
 591:   local target="$1"
 592:   local user="$2"
 593:   local home="$3"
 594:   local command="$4"
 595:   local timeout_secs="${5:-10800}"
 596:   local utm_name attempt rc local_script local_wrapper
 597:   local remote_base remote_script remote_wrapper remote_output remote_rc
 598:   local local_output_capture local_rc_capture wrapper_rc
 599:   local pull_attempt rc_contents output_attempt max_rc_attempts
 600:   utm_name="$(live_lab_target_utm_name "$target")" || {
 601:     echo "missing UTM mapping for target: $target" >&2
 602:     return 1
 603:   }
 604:   local_script="$(mktemp "${LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR}/utm-exec.XXXXXX")" || return 1
 605:   local_wrapper="$(mktemp "${LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR}/utm-wrapper.XXXXXX")" || {
 606:     rm -f "$local_script"
 607:     return 1
 608:   }
 609:   local_output_capture="$(mktemp "${LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR}/utm-output.XXXXXX")" || {
 610:     rm -f "$local_script" "$local_wrapper"
 611:     return 1
 612:   }
 613:   local_rc_capture="$(mktemp "${LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR}/utm-rc.XXXXXX")" || {
 614:     rm -f "$local_script" "$local_wrapper" "$local_output_capture"
 615:     return 1
 616:   }
 617:   {
 618:     printf '%s\n' '#!/usr/bin/env bash'
 619:     printf '%s\n' 'set -euo pipefail'
 620:     printf '%s\n' "$command"
 621:   } > "$local_script"
 622:   chmod 700 "$local_script"
 623: cat > "$local_wrapper" <<'EOF'
 624: #!/usr/bin/env bash
 625: set -euo pipefail
 626: 
 627: if [[ $# -ne 5 ]]; then
 628:   echo "usage: rn-utm-wrapper.sh <user> <home> <command-script> <output-path> <rc-path>" >&2
 629:   exit 2
 630: fi
 631: 
 632: user="$1"
 633: home="$2"
 634: command_script="$3"
 635: output_path="$4"
 636: rc_path="$5"
 637: rc=0
 638: 
 639: if [[ "$user" == "root" ]]; then
 640:   chmod 700 "$command_script"
 641:   if /usr/bin/env HOME="$home" USER=root LOGNAME=root PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin \
 642:     /bin/bash "$command_script" >"$output_path" 2>&1
 643:   then
 644:     rc=0
 645:   else
 646:     rc=$?
 647:   fi
 648: else
 649:   chmod 755 "$command_script"
 650:   if runuser -u "$user" -- env HOME="$home" USER="$user" LOGNAME="$user" PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin \
 651:     /bin/bash "$command_script" >"$output_path" 2>&1
 652:   then
 653:     rc=0
 654:   else
 655:     rc=$?
 656:   fi
 657: fi
 658: 
 659: printf '%s\n' "$rc" > "$rc_path"
 660: sync "$output_path" "$rc_path" >/dev/null 2>&1 || sync >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 661: exit 0
 662: EOF
 663:   chmod 700 "$local_wrapper"
 664:   remote_base="/var/tmp/rn-utm-exec.$$.${RANDOM}"
 665:   remote_script="${remote_base}.sh"
 666:   remote_wrapper="${remote_base}.wrapper.sh"
 667:   remote_output="${remote_base}.out"
 668:   remote_rc="${remote_base}.rc"
 669:   if ! live_lab_utm_push_raw "$local_script" "$target" "$remote_script" 60; then
 670:     rm -f "$local_script" "$local_wrapper" "$local_output_capture" "$local_rc_capture"
 671:     return 1
 672:   fi
 673:   if ! live_lab_utm_push_raw "$local_wrapper" "$target" "$remote_wrapper" 60; then
 674:     rm -f "$local_script" "$local_wrapper" "$local_output_capture" "$local_rc_capture"
 675:     live_lab_utm_cleanup_exec_files "$utm_name" "$remote_script" "$remote_wrapper" "$remote_output" "$remote_rc"
 676:     return 1
 677:   fi
 678:   local -a exec_args
 679:   exec_args=(
 680:     "$LIVE_LAB_UTMCTL_PATH"
 681:     exec
 682:     "$utm_name"
 683:     --cmd
 684:     /bin/bash
 685:     "$remote_wrapper"
 686:     "$user"
 687:     "$home"
 688:     "$remote_script"
 689:     "$remote_output"
 690:     "$remote_rc"
 691:   )
 692:   wrapper_rc=1
 693:   for attempt in 1 2 3; do
 694:     if live_lab_utm_run_locked_timeout 10800 "$((timeout_secs + 30))" "${exec_args[@]}"; then
 695:       wrapper_rc=0
 696:       break
 697:     else
 698:       rc=$?
 699:     fi
 700:     if [[ "$attempt" -lt 3 ]]; then
 701:       live_lab_utm_cleanup_exec_files "$utm_name" "$remote_script" "$remote_wrapper" "$remote_output" "$remote_rc"
 702:       sleep 2
 703:       if ! live_lab_utm_push_raw "$local_script" "$target" "$remote_script" 60; then
 704:         rm -f "$local_script" "$local_wrapper" "$local_output_capture" "$local_rc_capture"
 705:         return "$rc"
 706:       fi
 707:       if ! live_lab_utm_push_raw "$local_wrapper" "$target" "$remote_wrapper" 60; then
 708:         rm -f "$local_script" "$local_wrapper" "$local_output_capture" "$local_rc_capture"
 709:         return "$rc"
 710:       fi
 711:     fi
 712:   done
 713:   if [[ "$wrapper_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
 714:     live_lab_utm_cleanup_exec_files "$utm_name" "$remote_script" "$remote_wrapper" "$remote_output" "$remote_rc"
 715:     rm -f "$local_script" "$local_wrapper" "$local_output_capture" "$local_rc_capture"
 716:     return "$rc"
 717:   fi
 718:   max_rc_attempts="$timeout_secs"
 719:   if [[ ! "$max_rc_attempts" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || (( max_rc_attempts < 10 )); then
 720:     max_rc_attempts=10
 721:   fi
 722:   rc_contents=""
 723:   for ((pull_attempt=1; pull_attempt<=max_rc_attempts; pull_attempt++)); do
 724:     : > "$local_rc_capture"
 725:     live_lab_utm_pull "$target" "$remote_rc" "$local_rc_capture" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 726:     rc_contents="$(tr -d '\r\n' < "$local_rc_capture" 2>/dev/null || true)"
 727:     if [[ "$rc_contents" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
 728:       break
 729:     fi
 730:     if (( pull_attempt < max_rc_attempts )); then
 731:       sleep 1
 732:     fi
 733:   done
 734:   if [[ ! "$rc_contents" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
 735:     echo "invalid UTM command exit status for ${target}" >&2
 736:     if [[ -n "$rc_contents" ]]; then
 737:       printf '%s\n' "$rc_contents" >&2
 738:     fi
 739:     live_lab_utm_cleanup_exec_files "$utm_name" "$remote_script" "$remote_wrapper" "$remote_output" "$remote_rc"
 740:     rm -f "$local_script" "$local_wrapper" "$local_output_capture" "$local_rc_capture"
 741:     return 1
 742:   fi
 743:   for output_attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
 744:     : > "$local_output_capture"
 745:     live_lab_utm_pull "$target" "$remote_output" "$local_output_capture" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 746:     if ! grep -q '^Error from event:' "$local_output_capture" 2>/dev/null; then
 747:       break
 748:     fi
 749:     if [[ "$output_attempt" -lt 5 ]]; then
 750:       sleep 1
 751:     fi
 752:   done
 753:   cat "$local_output_capture"
 754:   rc="$rc_contents"
 755:   live_lab_utm_cleanup_exec_files "$utm_name" "$remote_script" "$remote_wrapper" "$remote_output" "$remote_rc"
 756:   rm -f "$local_script" "$local_wrapper" "$local_output_capture" "$local_rc_capture"
 757:   return "$rc"
 758: }
 759: 
 760: live_lab_utm_run_as_user() {
 761:   local target="$1"
 762:   local user="$2"
 763:   local home="$3"
 764:   local command="$4"
 765:   local utm_name attempt rc local_script local_wrapper
 766:   local remote_base remote_script remote_wrapper
 767:   utm_name="$(live_lab_target_utm_name "$target")" || {
 768:     echo "missing UTM mapping for target: $target" >&2
 769:     return 1
 770:   }
 771:   local_script="$(mktemp "${LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR}/utm-run.XXXXXX")" || return 1
 772:   local_wrapper="$(mktemp "${LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR}/utm-run-wrapper.XXXXXX")" || {
 773:     rm -f "$local_script"
 774:     return 1
 775:   }
 776:   {
 777:     printf '%s\n' '#!/usr/bin/env bash'
 778:     printf '%s\n' 'set -euo pipefail'
 779:     printf '%s\n' "$command"
 780:   } > "$local_script"
 781:   chmod 700 "$local_script"
 782:   cat > "$local_wrapper" <<'EOF'
 783: #!/usr/bin/env bash
 784: set -euo pipefail
 785: 
 786: if [[ $# -ne 3 ]]; then
 787:   echo "usage: rn-utm-run-wrapper.sh <user> <home> <command-script>" >&2
 788:   exit 2
 789: fi
 790: 
 791: user="$1"
 792: home="$2"
 793: command_script="$3"
 794: 
 795: if [[ "$user" == "root" ]]; then
 796:   chmod 700 "$command_script"
 797: exec /usr/bin/env HOME="$home" USER=root LOGNAME=root PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin \
 798:   /bin/bash "$command_script"
 799: fi
 800: 
 801: chmod 755 "$command_script"
 802: exec runuser -u "$user" -- env HOME="$home" USER="$user" LOGNAME="$user" PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin \
 803:   /bin/bash "$command_script"
 804: EOF
 805:   chmod 700 "$local_wrapper"
 806:   remote_base="/var/tmp/rn-utm-run.$$.${RANDOM}"
 807:   remote_script="${remote_base}.sh"
 808:   remote_wrapper="${remote_base}.wrapper.sh"
 809:   if ! live_lab_utm_push_raw "$local_script" "$target" "$remote_script" 60; then
 810:     rm -f "$local_script" "$local_wrapper"
 811:     return 1
 812:   fi
 813:   if ! live_lab_utm_push_raw "$local_wrapper" "$target" "$remote_wrapper" 60; then
 814:     rm -f "$local_script" "$local_wrapper"
 815:     live_lab_utm_cleanup_run_files "$utm_name" "$remote_script" "$remote_wrapper"
 816:     return 1
 817:   fi
 818:   local -a exec_args
 819:   exec_args=(
 820:     "$LIVE_LAB_UTMCTL_PATH"
 821:     exec
 822:     "$utm_name"
 823:     --cmd
 824:     /bin/bash
 825:     "$remote_wrapper"
 826:     "$user"
 827:     "$home"
 828:     "$remote_script"
 829:   )
 830:   rc=1
 831:   for attempt in 1 2 3; do
 832:     if live_lab_utm_run_locked_timeout 10800 90 "${exec_args[@]}"; then
 833:       rc=0
 834:       break
 835:     else
 836:       rc=$?
 837:     fi
 838:     if [[ "$attempt" -lt 3 ]]; then
 839:       live_lab_utm_cleanup_run_files "$utm_name" "$remote_script" "$remote_wrapper"
 840:       sleep 1
 841:       if ! live_lab_utm_push_raw "$local_script" "$target" "$remote_script" 60; then
 842:         rm -f "$local_script" "$local_wrapper"
 843:         return "$rc"
 844:       fi
 845:       if ! live_lab_utm_push_raw "$local_wrapper" "$target" "$remote_wrapper" 60; then
 846:         rm -f "$local_script" "$local_wrapper"
 847:         return "$rc"
 848:       fi
 849:     fi
 850:   done
 851:   live_lab_utm_cleanup_run_files "$utm_name" "$remote_script" "$remote_wrapper"
 852:   rm -f "$local_script" "$local_wrapper"
 853:   return "$rc"
 854: }
 855: 
 856: live_lab_utm_exec() {
 857:   local target="$1"
 858:   local command="$2"
 859:   local timeout_secs="${3:-10800}"
 860:   local user home
 861:   user="$(live_lab_target_user "$target")"
 862:   home="$(live_lab_target_home "$target")"
 863:   live_lab_utm_exec_as_user "$target" "$user" "$home" "$command" "$timeout_secs"
 864: }
 865: 
 866: live_lab_utm_exec_root() {
 867:   local target="$1"
 868:   local command="$2"
 869:   local timeout_secs="${3:-10800}"
 870:   live_lab_utm_exec_as_user "$target" "root" "/root" "$command" "$timeout_secs"
 871: }
 872: 
 873: live_lab_utm_run() {
 874:   local target="$1"
 875:   local command="$2"
 876:   local user home
 877:   user="$(live_lab_target_user "$target")"
 878:   home="$(live_lab_target_home "$target")"
 879:   live_lab_utm_run_as_user "$target" "$user" "$home" "$command"
 880: }
 881: 
 882: live_lab_utm_run_root() {
 883:   local target="$1"
 884:   local command="$2"
 885:   live_lab_utm_run_as_user "$target" "root" "/root" "$command"
 886: }
 887: 
 888: live_lab_utm_push() {
 889:   local src="$1"
 890:   local target="$2"
 891:   local dst="$3"
 892:   local utm_name attempt rc user quoted_user quoted_dst
 893:   utm_name="$(live_lab_target_utm_name "$target")" || {
 894:     echo "missing UTM mapping for target: $target" >&2
 895:     return 1
 896:   }
 897:   user="$(live_lab_target_user "$target")"
 898:   quoted_user="$(printf '%q' "$user")"
 899:   quoted_dst="$(printf '%q' "$dst")"
 900:   local push_args=(
 901:     "$LIVE_LAB_UTMCTL_PATH"
 902:     file
 903:     push
 904:     "$utm_name"
 905:     "$dst"
 906:   )
 907:   for attempt in 1 2 3; do
 908:     if live_lab_utm_run_locked_stdin "$src" 10800 "${push_args[@]}"; then
 909:       if [[ "$user" != "root" ]]; then
 910:         live_lab_utm_run_locked_timeout 10800 20 \
 911:           "$LIVE_LAB_UTMCTL_PATH" exec "$utm_name" --cmd /bin/bash -lc "chown ${quoted_user}:${quoted_user} ${quoted_dst}" \
 912:           >/dev/null || return 1
 913:       fi
 914:       return 0
 915:     else
 916:       rc=$?
 917:     fi
 918:     if [[ "$attempt" -lt 3 ]]; then
 919:       sleep 2
 920:     fi
 921:   done
 922:   if ! live_lab_utm_run_locked_stdin "$src" 10800 "${push_args[@]}"; then
 923:     return $?
 924:   fi
 925:   if [[ "$user" != "root" ]]; then
 926:     live_lab_utm_run_locked_timeout 10800 20 \
 927:       "$LIVE_LAB_UTMCTL_PATH" exec "$utm_name" --cmd /bin/bash -lc "chown ${quoted_user}:${quoted_user} ${quoted_dst}" \
 928:       >/dev/null || return 1
 929:   fi
 930: }
 931: 
 932: live_lab_utm_pull() {
 933:   local target="$1"
 934:   local src="$2"
 935:   local dst="$3"
 936:   local utm_name attempt rc
 937:   utm_name="$(live_lab_target_utm_name "$target")" || {
 938:     echo "missing UTM mapping for target: $target" >&2
 939:     return 1
 940:   }
 941:   local pull_args=(
 942:     "$LIVE_LAB_UTMCTL_PATH"
 943:     file
 944:     pull
 945:     "$utm_name"
 946:     "$src"
 947:   )
 948:   for attempt in 1 2 3; do
 949:     if live_lab_utm_run_locked 10800 "${pull_args[@]}" > "$dst"; then
 950:       return 0
 951:     else
 952:       rc=$?
 953:     fi
 954:     if [[ "$attempt" -lt 3 ]]; then
 955:       sleep 2
 956:     fi
 957:   done
 958:   live_lab_utm_run_locked 10800 "${pull_args[@]}" > "$dst"
 959: }
 960: 
 961: live_lab_remote_src_dir() {
 962:   local target="$1"
 963:   local user
 964:   user="$(live_lab_target_user "$target")"
 965:   if [[ "$user" == "root" ]]; then
 966:     printf '/root/Rustynet'
 967:     return 0
 968:   fi
 969:   printf '/home/%s/Rustynet' "$user"
 970: }

 972: live_lab_ssh_via_ssh() {
 973:   local target="$1"
 974:   local command="$2"
 975:   local _timeout="${3:-10800}"
 976:   local ssh_args=(
 977:     ssh
 978:     -n
 979:     -o LogLevel=ERROR
 980:     -o BatchMode=yes
 981:     -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes
 982:     -o UpdateHostKeys=no
 983:     -o UserKnownHostsFile="$LIVE_LAB_KNOWN_HOSTS"
 984:     -o ConnectTimeout=30
 985:     -o ServerAliveInterval=60
 986:     -o ServerAliveCountMax=20
 987:     -o IdentitiesOnly=yes
 988:     -i "$LIVE_LAB_SSH_IDENTITY_FILE"
 989:     -- "$target" "$command"
 990:   )
 991:   local attempt rc
 992:   live_lab_require_pinned_host_entry "$target" || return 1
 993:   for attempt in 1 2 3; do
 994:     if "${ssh_args[@]}"; then
 995:       return 0
 996:     else
 997:       rc=$?
 998:     fi
 999:     if [[ "$rc" -ne 255 ]]; then
1000:       return "$rc"
1001:     fi
1002:     if [[ "$attempt" -lt 3 ]]; then
1003:       sleep 2
1004:     fi
1005:   done
1006:   "${ssh_args[@]}"
1007: }

1015:     scp
1016:     -q
1017:     -o LogLevel=ERROR
1018:     -o BatchMode=yes
1019:     -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes
1020:     -o UpdateHostKeys=no
1021:     -o UserKnownHostsFile="$LIVE_LAB_KNOWN_HOSTS"
1022:     -o ConnectTimeout=30
1023:     -o ServerAliveInterval=60
1024:     -o ServerAliveCountMax=20
1025:     -o IdentitiesOnly=yes
1026:     -i "$LIVE_LAB_SSH_IDENTITY_FILE"
1027:     -- "$src" "${target}:${dst}"
1028:   )
1029:   local attempt rc
1030:   live_lab_require_pinned_host_entry "$target" || return 1
1031:   for attempt in 1 2 3; do
1032:     if "${scp_args[@]}"; then
1033:       return 0
1034:     else
1035:       rc=$?
1036:     fi
1037:     if [[ "$rc" -ne 255 ]]; then
1038:       return "$rc"
1039:     fi
1040:     if [[ "$attempt" -lt 3 ]]; then
1041:       sleep 2
1042:     fi
1043:   done

1045: }

1085: live_lab_capture_via_ssh() {
1086:   local target="$1"
1087:   local body="$2"
1088:   local timeout="${3:-10800}"
1089:   local raw
1090:   raw="$(live_lab_ssh_via_ssh "$target" "printf '__CAP_BEGIN__\\n'; { ${body}; }; printf '\\n__CAP_END__\\n'" "$timeout")" || return $?
1091:   live_lab_extract_capture_output "$raw"
1092: }

1094: live_lab_ssh() {
1095:   local target="$1"
1096:   local command="$2"
1097:   local timeout="${3:-10800}"
1098:   if live_lab_target_uses_utm_transport "$target"; then
1099:     if live_lab_utm_exec "$target" "$command" "$timeout"; then
1100:       return 0
1101:     fi
1102:     printf 'UTM exec failed for %s; falling back to SSH\n' "$target" >&2
1103:   fi
1104:   live_lab_ssh_via_ssh "$target" "$command" "$timeout"
1105: }

1107: live_lab_scp_to() {
1108:   local src="$1"
1109:   local target="$2"
1110:   local dst="$3"
1111:   local timeout="${4:-10800}"
1112:   if live_lab_target_uses_utm_transport "$target"; then
1113:     if live_lab_utm_push "$src" "$target" "$dst"; then
1114:       return 0
1115:     fi
1116:     printf 'UTM file push failed for %s; falling back to SCP\n' "$target" >&2
1117:   fi
1118:   live_lab_scp_to_via_ssh "$src" "$target" "$dst" "$timeout"
1119: }

1126:   if live_lab_target_uses_utm_transport "$target"; then
1127:     if live_lab_utm_pull "$target" "$src" "$dst"; then
1128:       return 0
1129:     fi
1130:     printf 'UTM file pull failed for %s; falling back to SCP\n' "$target" >&2
1131:   fi
1132:   live_lab_scp_from_via_ssh "$target" "$src" "$dst" "$timeout"
1133: }

1135: live_lab_capture() {
1136:   local target="$1"
1137:   local body="$2"
1138:   local timeout="${3:-10800}"
1139:   if live_lab_target_uses_utm_transport "$target"; then
1140:     if live_lab_utm_exec "$target" "$body" "$timeout"; then
1141:       return 0
1142:     fi
1143:     printf 'UTM capture failed for %s; falling back to SSH\n' "$target" >&2
1144:   fi
1145:   live_lab_capture_via_ssh "$target" "$body" "$timeout"
1146: }
1147: 
1148: live_lab_extract_capture_output() {
1149:   local raw="$1"
1150:   printf '%s\n' "$raw" | awk '
1151:     /__CAP_BEGIN__/ {
1152:       capture=1
1153:       prev_set=0
1154:       next
1155:     }
1156:     /__CAP_END__/ {
1157:       if (prev_set && prev != "") {
1158:         print prev
1159:       }
1160:       capture=0
1161:       prev_set=0
1162:       next
1163:     }
1164:     capture && tolower($0) !~ /password:/ {
1165:       gsub(/\r/, "", $0)
1166:       if (prev_set) {
1167:         print prev
1168:       }
1169:       prev=$0
1170:       prev_set=1
1171:     }
1172:   '
1173: }

1175: live_lab_rootify() {
1176:   local body="$1"
1177:   # Preserve the installed RustyNet binaries under sudo while keeping the
1178:   # command path fixed to a small, predictable set of system directories.
1179:   printf 'root(){ sudo -n env PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin "$@"; }; set -euo pipefail; %s' "$body"
1180: }
1181: 
1182: live_lab_rootify_direct() {
1183:   local body="$1"
1184:   printf 'root(){ env PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin "$@"; }; set -euo pipefail; %s' "$body"
1185: }
1186: 
1187: live_lab_verify_sudo() {
1188:   local target="$1"
1189:   local hostname_precheck_cmd
1190:   local verify_cmd
1191:   hostname_precheck_cmd="current_hostname=\$(hostname); if ! grep -Eq \"(^|[[:space:]])\${current_hostname}([[:space:]]|$)\" /etc/hosts; then printf 'local hostname %s is missing from /etc/hosts\\n' \"\$current_hostname\"; exit 1; fi"
1192:   live_lab_ssh "$target" "$hostname_precheck_cmd" || return 1
1193:   verify_cmd="if timeout 15 sudo -n -k true >/dev/null 2>&1; then :; else printf 'passwordless sudo (sudo -n) is required for live lab automation\\n'; printf 'user: %s\\n' \"\$(id -un)\"; printf 'groups: %s\\n' \"\$(id -Gn)\"; exit 1; fi"
1194:   live_lab_ssh "$target" "$verify_cmd"
1195: }
1196: 
1197: live_lab_retry_verify_sudo() {
1198:   local target="$1"
1199:   local attempts="${2:-3}"
1200:   local sleep_secs="${3:-2}"
1201:   local attempt
1202: 
1203:   for ((attempt=1; attempt<=attempts; attempt++)); do
1204:     if live_lab_verify_sudo "$target"; then
1205:       return 0
1206:     fi
1207:     if (( attempt < attempts )); then
1208:       sleep "$sleep_secs"
1209:     fi
1210:   done
1211: 
1212:   live_lab_verify_sudo "$target"
1213: }
1214: 
1215: live_lab_push_sudo_password() {
1216:   local target="$1"
1217:   if live_lab_target_uses_utm_transport "$target"; then
1218:     local existing
1219:     for existing in "${LIVE_LAB_REMOTE_CLEANUP_TARGETS[@]:-}"; do
1220:       if [[ "$existing" == "$target" ]]; then
1221:         live_lab_retry_verify_sudo "$target" || return 1
1222:         return 0
1223:       fi
1224:     done
1225:     LIVE_LAB_REMOTE_CLEANUP_TARGETS+=("$target")
1226:     live_lab_retry_verify_sudo "$target" || return 1
1227:     return 0
1228:   fi
1229:   local existing
1230:   for existing in "${LIVE_LAB_REMOTE_CLEANUP_TARGETS[@]:-}"; do
1231:     if [[ "$existing" == "$target" ]]; then
1232:       live_lab_retry_verify_sudo "$target" || return 1
1233:       return 0
1234:     fi
1235:   done
1236:   LIVE_LAB_REMOTE_CLEANUP_TARGETS+=("$target")
1237:   live_lab_retry_verify_sudo "$target" || return 1
1238: }
1239: 
1240: live_lab_run_root() {
1241:   local target="$1"
1242:   local body="$2"
1243:   if live_lab_target_uses_utm_transport "$target"; then
1244:     if live_lab_utm_exec_root "$target" "$(live_lab_rootify_direct "$body")"; then
1245:       return 0
1246:     fi
1247:     printf 'UTM root exec failed for %s; falling back to SSH\n' "$target" >&2
1248:   fi
1249:   live_lab_push_sudo_password "$target" || return 1
1250:   live_lab_ssh_via_ssh "$target" "$(live_lab_rootify "$body")"
1251: }
1252: 
1253: live_lab_retry_root() {
1254:   local target="$1"
1255:   local body="$2"
1256:   local attempts="${3:-20}"
1257:   local sleep_secs="${4:-2}"
1258:   local attempt
1259:   for ((attempt=1; attempt<=attempts; attempt++)); do
1260:     if live_lab_run_root "$target" "$body" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1261:       return 0
1262:     fi
1263:     if (( attempt < attempts )); then
1264:       sleep "$sleep_secs"
1265:     fi
1266:   done
1267:   live_lab_run_root "$target" "$body"
1268: }
1269: 
1270: live_lab_capture_root() {
1271:   local target="$1"
1272:   local body="$2"
1273:   if live_lab_target_uses_utm_transport "$target"; then
1274:     if live_lab_utm_exec_root "$target" "$(live_lab_rootify_direct "$body")"; then
1275:       return 0
1276:     fi
1277:     printf 'UTM root capture failed for %s; falling back to SSH\n' "$target" >&2
1278:   fi
1279:   live_lab_push_sudo_password "$target" || return 1
1280:   live_lab_capture_via_ssh "$target" "$(live_lab_rootify "$body")"
1281: }

1283: live_lab_base64_to_hex() {
1284:   local value="$1"
1285:   printf '%s' "$value" | openssl base64 -d -A 2>/dev/null | xxd -p -c 256 | tr -d '\n'
1286: }

1288: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1289: # Platform-aware path helpers.
1290: #
1291: # Each function accepts a platform string ("linux", "windows", "macos") and
1292: # returns the canonical Rustynet path for that platform.  The default is
1293: # "linux" so existing callers that never pass a platform continue to work.
1294: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1295: 
1296: # Returns the data directory for rustynetd on the given platform.
1297: rustynet_data_dir() {
1298:   local platform="${1:-linux}"
1299:   case "$platform" in
1300:     windows) printf '%s' 'C:\ProgramData\RustyNet' ;;
1301:     *)       printf '%s' '/var/lib/rustynet' ;;
1302:   esac
1303: }
1304: 
1305: # Returns the config directory for rustynetd on the given platform.
1306: rustynet_config_dir() {
1307:   local platform="${1:-linux}"
1308:   case "$platform" in
1309:     windows) printf '%s' 'C:\ProgramData\RustyNet\config' ;;
1310:     *)       printf '%s' '/etc/rustynet' ;;
1311:   esac
1312: }
1313: 
1314: # Returns the daemon control socket / named-pipe path for the given platform.
1315: rustynet_daemon_socket() {
1316:   local platform="${1:-linux}"
1317:   case "$platform" in
1318:     windows) printf '%s' '\\.\pipe\RustyNet\rustynetd' ;;
1319:     *)       printf '%s' '/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock' ;;
1320:   esac
1321: }
1322: 
1323: # Returns the WireGuard public key path for the given platform.
1324: rustynet_wg_pub_key_path() {
1325:   local platform="${1:-linux}"
1326:   case "$platform" in
1327:     windows) printf '%s' 'C:\ProgramData\RustyNet\keys\wireguard.pub' ;;
1328:     *)       printf '%s' '/var/lib/rustynet/keys/wireguard.pub' ;;
1329:   esac
1330: }
1331: 
1332: # Returns the assignment bundle path for the given platform.
1333: rustynet_assignment_bundle_path() {
1334:   local platform="${1:-linux}"
1335:   case "$platform" in
1336:     windows) printf '%s' 'C:\ProgramData\RustyNet\trust\rustynetd.assignment' ;;
1337:     *)       printf '%s' '/var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.assignment' ;;
1338:   esac
1339: }
1340: 
1341: # Returns the assignment watermark path for the given platform.
1342: rustynet_assignment_watermark_path() {
1343:   local platform="${1:-linux}"
1344:   case "$platform" in
1345:     windows) printf '%s' 'C:\ProgramData\RustyNet\trust\rustynetd.assignment.watermark' ;;
1346:     *)       printf '%s' '/var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.assignment.watermark' ;;
1347:   esac
1348: }
1349: 
1350: # Returns the assignment verifier key path for the given platform.
1351: rustynet_assignment_pub_path() {
1352:   local platform="${1:-linux}"
1353:   case "$platform" in
1354:     windows) printf '%s' 'C:\ProgramData\RustyNet\trust\assignment.pub' ;;
1355:     *)       printf '%s' '/etc/rustynet/assignment.pub' ;;
1356:   esac
1357: }
1358: 
1359: # Returns true (exit 0) if the platform uses a Unix/SSH shell; false (exit 1) for Windows.
1360: rustynet_platform_uses_unix_shell() {
1361:   local platform="${1:-linux}"
1362:   [[ "$platform" != "windows" ]]
1363: }
1364: 
1365: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1366: # End platform-aware path helpers.
1367: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1368: 
1369: live_lab_collect_pubkey_hex() {
1370:   local target="$1"
1371:   local platform="${2:-linux}"
1372:   local wg_pub_path
1373:   wg_pub_path="$(rustynet_wg_pub_key_path "$platform")"
1374:   local pub_b64
1375:   if live_lab_target_uses_utm_transport "$target"; then
1376:     if rustynet_platform_uses_unix_shell "$platform"; then
1377:       pub_b64="$(live_lab_utm_exec_root "$target" "cat '${wg_pub_path}' | tr -d '[:space:]'; printf '\n'")" || return 1
1378:     else
1379:       # Windows UTM: read the key via PowerShell, stripping whitespace.
1380:       pub_b64="$(live_lab_utm_exec_root "$target" "powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command \"(Get-Content -Path '${wg_pub_path}' -Raw).Trim()\"")" || return 1
1381:     fi
1382:     pub_b64="${pub_b64//$'\r'/}"
1383:     pub_b64="${pub_b64//$'\n'/}"
1384:   else
1385:     if rustynet_platform_uses_unix_shell "$platform"; then
1386:       pub_b64="$(live_lab_capture_root "$target" "root cat '${wg_pub_path}' | tr -d '[:space:]'")"
1387:     else
1388:       # Windows SSH: shell is PowerShell; read via Get-Content.
1389:       pub_b64="$(live_lab_capture_root "$target" "powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command \"(Get-Content -Path '${wg_pub_path}' -Raw).Trim()\"")"
1390:     fi
1391:   fi
1392:   local pub_hex
1393:   pub_hex="$(live_lab_base64_to_hex "$pub_b64")"
1394:   if [[ ! "$pub_hex" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]; then
1395:     echo "failed to decode wireguard pubkey for ${target}" >&2
1396:     return 1
1397:   fi
1398:   printf '%s' "$pub_hex"
1399: }

1401: live_lab_fetch_root_file_to_local() {
1402:   local target="$1"
1403:   local remote_path="$2"
1404:   local local_path="$3"
1405:   local quoted_remote_path
1406:   if live_lab_target_uses_utm_transport "$target"; then
1407:     live_lab_scp_from "$target" "$remote_path" "$local_path"
1408:     return $?
1409:   fi
1410:   quoted_remote_path="$(printf '%q' "$remote_path")"
1411:   live_lab_capture_root "$target" "root cat ${quoted_remote_path}" > "$local_path"
1412: }

1414: live_lab_quote_env_value() {
1415:   local value="$1"
1416:   if [[ "$value" == *$'\n'* || "$value" == *$'\r'* ]]; then
1417:     echo "env value contains newline characters" >&2
1418:     return 1
1419:   fi
1420:   value="${value//\\/\\\\}"
1421:   value="${value//\"/\\\"}"
1422:   value="${value//\$/\\\$}"
1423:   value="${value//\`/\\\`}"
1424:   printf '"%s"' "$value"
1425: }

1427: live_lab_append_env_assignment() {
1428:   local env_path="$1"
1429:   local key="$2"
1430:   local value="$3"
1431:   printf '%s=%s\n' "$key" "$(live_lab_quote_env_value "$value")" >> "$env_path"
1432: }

1434: live_lab_write_assignment_refresh_env() {
1435:   local env_path="$1"
1436:   local target_node_id="$2"
1437:   local nodes_spec="$3"
1438:   local allow_spec="$4"
1439:   local exit_node_id="${5:-}"
1440:   : > "$env_path"
1441:   live_lab_append_env_assignment "$env_path" "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_TARGET_NODE_ID" "$target_node_id"
1442:   live_lab_append_env_assignment "$env_path" "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_NODES" "$nodes_spec"
1443:   live_lab_append_env_assignment "$env_path" "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_ALLOW" "$allow_spec"
1444:   live_lab_append_env_assignment "$env_path" "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_SIGNING_SECRET" "/etc/rustynet/assignment.signing.secret"
1445:   live_lab_append_env_assignment "$env_path" "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_SIGNING_SECRET_PASSPHRASE_FILE" "/run/credentials/rustynetd-assignment-refresh.service/signing_key_passphrase"
1446:   live_lab_append_env_assignment "$env_path" "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_TTL_SECS" "300"
1447:   live_lab_append_env_assignment "$env_path" "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_MIN_REMAINING_SECS" "180"
1448:   if [[ -n "$exit_node_id" ]]; then
1449:     live_lab_append_env_assignment "$env_path" "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_EXIT_NODE_ID" "$exit_node_id"
1450:   fi
1451: }

1534: live_lab_apply_role_coupling() {
1535:   local target="$1"
1536:   local target_role="$2"
1537:   local preferred_exit_node_id="${3:-}"
1538:   local enable_exit_advertise="${4:-false}"
1539:   local env_path="${5:-}"
1540:   local skip_client_exit_route_wait="${6:-false}"
1541:   local platform="${7:-linux}"
1542:   local command
1543:   local daemon_socket bundle_path watermark_path config_dir
1544:   daemon_socket="$(rustynet_daemon_socket "$platform")"
1545:   bundle_path="$(rustynet_assignment_bundle_path "$platform")"
1546:   watermark_path="$(rustynet_assignment_watermark_path "$platform")"
1547:   config_dir="$(rustynet_config_dir "$platform")"
1548:   if [[ -z "$env_path" ]]; then
1549:     env_path="${config_dir}/assignment-refresh.env"
1550:   fi
1551:   live_lab_push_sudo_password "$target" || return 1
1552:   command="root env RUSTYNET_SOCKET='${daemon_socket}' RUSTYNET_AUTO_TUNNEL_BUNDLE='${bundle_path}' RUSTYNET_AUTO_TUNNEL_WATERMARK='${watermark_path}' rustynet ops apply-role-coupling --target-role '${target_role}' --enable-exit-advertise '${enable_exit_advertise}' --env-path '${env_path}'"
1553:   if [[ -n "$preferred_exit_node_id" ]]; then
1554:     command+=" --preferred-exit-node-id '${preferred_exit_node_id}'"
1555:   fi
1556:   if [[ "$skip_client_exit_route_wait" == "true" ]]; then
1557:     command+=" --skip-client-exit-route-convergence-wait"
1558:   fi
1559:   live_lab_run_root "$target" "$command" || return 1
1560: }

1572:   watermark_path="$(rustynet_assignment_watermark_path "$platform")"

1574:   if [[ -z "$env_path" ]]; then
1575:     env_path="${config_dir}/assignment-refresh.env"
1576:   fi

1579:   if [[ -n "$lan_routes" ]]; then
1580:     command+=" --lan-routes '${lan_routes}'"

1585: live_lab_wait_for_daemon_socket() {
1586:   local target="$1"
1587:   local socket_path="${2:-/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock}"
1588:   local attempts="${3:-20}"
1589:   local sleep_secs="${4:-2}"
1590:   # For Unix: check for the socket file.  For Windows (named pipe), the socket
1591:   # path argument is not a filesystem path — callers should pass the pre-built
1592:   # platform-aware path but the test command differs.
1593:   local test_command
1594:   if [[ "$socket_path" == \\\\* || "$socket_path" == '\\'* ]]; then
1595:     # Named pipe: probe by attempting a zero-byte read with rustynet status.
1596:     test_command="root rustynet status"
1597:   else
1598:     test_command="root test -S '${socket_path}'"
1599:   fi
1600:   live_lab_retry_root "$target" "$test_command" "$attempts" "$sleep_secs" || return 1
1601: }

1638: printf '__RNLAB_JOURNAL_END__\n'

1642: live_lab_signed_state_body() {
1643:   local node_id="$1"
1644:   local zone_name="${2:-${RUSTYNET_DNS_ZONE_NAME:-rustynet}}"
1645:   local max_age_secs="${3:-${CROSS_NETWORK_SIGNED_ARTIFACT_MAX_AGE_SECS:-900}}"
1646:   local max_clock_skew_secs="${4:-${CROSS_NETWORK_MAX_TIME_SKEW_SECS:-2}}"
1647:   local quoted_node_id quoted_zone_name quoted_max_age quoted_max_clock_skew
1648:   quoted_node_id="$(live_lab_shell_quote "$node_id")"
1649:   quoted_zone_name="$(live_lab_shell_quote "$zone_name")"
1650:   quoted_max_age="$(live_lab_shell_quote "$max_age_secs")"
1651:   quoted_max_clock_skew="$(live_lab_shell_quote "$max_clock_skew_secs")"
1652:   cat <<EOF
1653: node_id=${quoted_node_id}
1654: zone_name=${quoted_zone_name}
1655: max_age_secs=${quoted_max_age}
1656: max_clock_skew_secs=${quoted_max_clock_skew}
1657: artifact_chain_result=fail
1658: netcheck_rc=0
1659: assignment_verify_rc=0
1660: traversal_verify_rc=0
1661: trust_verify_rc=0
1662: dns_zone_verify_rc=0
1663: netcheck_output="\$(root env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet netcheck 2>&1)" || netcheck_rc=\$?
1664: assignment_verify_output="\$(root env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet assignment verify --bundle /var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.assignment --verifier-key /etc/rustynet/assignment.pub --watermark /var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.assignment.watermark --expected-node-id "\$node_id" --max-age-secs "\$max_age_secs" --max-clock-skew-secs "\$max_clock_skew_secs" 2>&1)" || assignment_verify_rc=\$?
1665: traversal_verify_output="\$(root env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet traversal verify --bundle /var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.traversal --verifier-key /etc/rustynet/traversal.pub --watermark /var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.traversal.watermark --expected-source-node-id "\$node_id" --max-age-secs "\$max_age_secs" --max-clock-skew-secs "\$max_clock_skew_secs" 2>&1)" || traversal_verify_rc=\$?
1666: trust_verify_output="\$(root env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet trust verify --evidence /var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.trust --verifier-key /etc/rustynet/trust-evidence.pub --watermark /var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.trust.watermark --max-age-secs "\$max_age_secs" --max-clock-skew-secs "\$max_clock_skew_secs" 2>&1)" || trust_verify_rc=\$?
1667: dns_zone_verify_output="\$(root env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet dns zone verify --bundle /var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.dns-zone --verifier-key /etc/rustynet/dns-zone.pub --expected-zone-name "\$zone_name" 2>&1)" || dns_zone_verify_rc=\$?
1668: if [[ "\$assignment_verify_rc" -eq 0 && "\$traversal_verify_rc" -eq 0 && "\$trust_verify_rc" -eq 0 && "\$dns_zone_verify_rc" -eq 0 ]]; then
1669:   artifact_chain_result=pass
1670: fi
1671: printf 'signed_state_snapshot_version=1\n'
1672: printf 'signed_state_node_id=%s\n' "\$node_id"
1673: printf 'signed_state_zone_name=%s\n' "\$zone_name"
1674: printf 'signed_state_max_age_secs=%s\n' "\$max_age_secs"
1675: printf 'signed_state_max_clock_skew_secs=%s\n' "\$max_clock_skew_secs"
1676: printf 'artifact_chain_result=%s\n' "\$artifact_chain_result"
1677: printf 'signed_state_health=%s\n' "\$artifact_chain_result"
1678: printf 'signed_artifact_chain_status=%s\n' "\$artifact_chain_result"
1679: if [[ "\$artifact_chain_result" == "pass" ]]; then
1680:   printf 'signed_artifact_chain_ok\n'
1681: fi
1682: printf 'netcheck_rc=%s\n' "\$netcheck_rc"
1683: printf 'assignment_verify_rc=%s\n' "\$assignment_verify_rc"
1684: printf 'traversal_verify_rc=%s\n' "\$traversal_verify_rc"
1685: printf 'trust_verify_rc=%s\n' "\$trust_verify_rc"
1686: printf 'dns_zone_verify_rc=%s\n' "\$dns_zone_verify_rc"
1687: printf 'netcheck_begin\n'
1688: printf '%s\n' "\$netcheck_output"
1689: printf 'netcheck_end\n'
1690: printf 'assignment_verify_begin\n'
1691: printf '%s\n' "\$assignment_verify_output"
1692: printf 'assignment_verify_end\n'
1693: printf 'traversal_verify_begin\n'
1694: printf '%s\n' "\$traversal_verify_output"
1695: printf 'traversal_verify_end\n'
1696: printf 'trust_verify_begin\n'
1697: printf '%s\n' "\$trust_verify_output"
1698: printf 'trust_verify_end\n'
1699: printf 'dns_zone_verify_begin\n'
1700: printf '%s\n' "\$dns_zone_verify_output"
1701: printf 'dns_zone_verify_end\n'
1702: EOF
1703: }

1717: live_lab_route_policy_body() {
1718:   local destination="${1:-1.1.1.1}"
1719:   local expected_next_hop="${2:-}"
1720:   local quoted_destination quoted_expected
1721:   quoted_destination="$(live_lab_shell_quote "$destination")"
1722:   quoted_expected="$(live_lab_shell_quote "$expected_next_hop")"
1723:   cat <<EOF
1724: destination=${quoted_destination}
1725: expected_next_hop=${quoted_expected}
1726: route_get_output=""
1727: route_get_rc=0
1728: if route_get_output="\$(ip -4 route get "\$destination" 2>&1)"; then
1729:   :
1730: else
1731:   route_get_rc=\$?
1732: fi
1733: actual_route_table="main"
1734: if [[ "\$route_get_output" =~ (^|[[:space:]])table[[:space:]]+([^[:space:]]+) ]]; then
1735:   actual_route_table="\${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
1736: fi
1737: actual_route_device=""
1738: if [[ "\$route_get_output" =~ (^|[[:space:]])dev[[:space:]]+([^[:space:]]+) ]]; then
1739:   actual_route_device="\${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
1740: fi
1741: actual_via=""
1742: if [[ "\$route_get_output" =~ (^|[[:space:]])via[[:space:]]+([^[:space:]]+) ]]; then
1743:   actual_via="\${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
1744: fi
1745: actual_next_hop="unresolved"
1746: if [[ -n "\$actual_via" ]]; then
1747:   actual_next_hop="\$actual_via"
1748: elif [[ -n "\$actual_route_device" && "\$route_get_rc" -eq 0 ]]; then
1749:   actual_next_hop="direct:\$actual_route_device"
1750: fi
1751: expected_next_hop_match="skipped"
1752: if [[ -n "\$expected_next_hop" ]]; then
1753:   if [[ "\$actual_next_hop" == "\$expected_next_hop" ]]; then
1754:     expected_next_hop_match="pass"
1755:   else
1756:     expected_next_hop_match="fail"
1757:   fi
1758: fi
1759: printf 'route_policy_version=1\n'
1760: printf 'route_destination=%s\n' "\$destination"
1761: printf 'route_get_rc=%s\n' "\$route_get_rc"
1762: printf 'actual_route_table=%s\n' "\$actual_route_table"
1763: printf 'actual_route_device=%s\n' "\$actual_route_device"
1764: printf 'actual_next_hop=%s\n' "\$actual_next_hop"
1765: printf 'expected_next_hop_match=%s\n' "\$expected_next_hop_match"
1766: printf 'ip_rule_begin\n'
1767: ip rule show || true
1768: printf 'ip_rule_end\n'
1769: printf 'route_main_begin\n'
1770: ip -4 route show table main || true
1771: printf 'route_main_end\n'
1772: printf 'route_51820_begin\n'
1773: ip -4 route show table 51820 || true
1774: printf 'route_51820_end\n'
1775: printf 'route_get_begin\n'
1776: printf '%s\n' "\$route_get_output"
1777: printf 'route_get_end\n'
1778: EOF
1779: }

1791: live_lab_dns_state_body() {
1792:   local probe
1793:   local quoted_probes=""
1794:   for probe in "$@"; do
1795:     quoted_probes+=" $(live_lab_shell_quote "$probe")"
1796:   done
1797:   cat <<EOF
1798: probe_names=(${quoted_probes})
1799: if [[ "\${#probe_names[@]}" -eq 0 ]]; then
1800:   probe_names=(localhost)
1801:   current_hostname="\$(hostname 2>/dev/null || true)"
1802:   if [[ -n "\$current_hostname" && "\$current_hostname" != "localhost" ]]; then
1803:     probe_names+=("\$current_hostname")
1804:   fi
1805: fi
1806: resolv_conf_target="\$(readlink -f /etc/resolv.conf 2>/dev/null || printf '/etc/resolv.conf')"
1807: systemd_resolved_service="missing"
1808: managed_dns_service="missing"
1809: if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1810:   systemd_resolved_service="\$(systemctl is-active systemd-resolved.service 2>/dev/null || true)"
1811:   [[ -n "\$systemd_resolved_service" ]] || systemd_resolved_service="unknown"
1812:   managed_dns_service="\$(systemctl is-active rustynetd-managed-dns.service 2>/dev/null || true)"
1813:   [[ -n "\$managed_dns_service" ]] || managed_dns_service="unknown"
1814: fi
1815: resolvectl_available=0
1816: if command -v resolvectl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1817:   resolvectl_available=1
1818: fi
1819: run_dns_probe() {
1820:   local probe="\$1"
1821:   if [[ "\$resolvectl_available" -eq 1 ]]; then
1822:     if command -v timeout >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1823:       root timeout 15 resolvectl query --legend=no "\$probe" 2>/dev/null || timeout 15 resolvectl query --legend=no "\$probe" 2>/dev/null || true
1824:     else
1825:       root resolvectl query --legend=no "\$probe" 2>/dev/null || resolvectl query --legend=no "\$probe" 2>/dev/null || true
1826:     fi
1827:     return 0
1828:   fi
1829:   getent ahostsv4 "\$probe" 2>/dev/null || getent hosts "\$probe" 2>/dev/null || true
1830: }
1831: printf 'dns_state_version=1\n'
1832: printf 'resolv_conf_target=%s\n' "\$resolv_conf_target"
1833: printf 'systemd_resolved_service=%s\n' "\$systemd_resolved_service"
1834: printf 'managed_dns_service=%s\n' "\$managed_dns_service"
1835: printf 'resolvectl_available=%s\n' "\$resolvectl_available"
1836: printf 'probe_count=%s\n' "\${#probe_names[@]}"
1837: for index in "\${!probe_names[@]}"; do
1838:   printf 'probe_%s=%s\n' "\$index" "\${probe_names[\$index]}"
1839: done
1840: printf 'resolv_conf_begin\n'
1841: if root test -f /etc/resolv.conf; then
1842:   root cat /etc/resolv.conf 2>/dev/null || cat /etc/resolv.conf 2>/dev/null || true
1843: else
1844:   printf 'resolv.conf missing\n'
1845: fi
1846: printf 'resolv_conf_end\n'
1847: printf 'service_status_begin\n'
1848: printf 'systemd_resolved_service=%s\n' "\$systemd_resolved_service"
1849: printf 'managed_dns_service=%s\n' "\$managed_dns_service"
1850: printf 'service_status_end\n'
1851: printf 'resolvectl_status_begin\n'
1852: if [[ "\$resolvectl_available" -eq 1 ]]; then
1853:   if command -v timeout >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1854:     root timeout 15 resolvectl status 2>/dev/null || timeout 15 resolvectl status 2>/dev/null || true
1855:   else
1856:     root resolvectl status 2>/dev/null || resolvectl status 2>/dev/null || true
1857:   fi
1858: else
1859:   printf 'resolvectl_missing\n'
1860: fi
1861: printf 'resolvectl_status_end\n'
1862: for probe in "\${probe_names[@]}"; do
1863:   printf 'probe_begin=%s\n' "\$probe"
1864:   run_dns_probe "\$probe"
1865:   printf 'probe_end=%s\n' "\$probe"
1866: done
1867: EOF
1868: }
1869:

1873: $(live_lab_dns_state_body "$@")
1874: printf '__RNLAB_DNS_STATE_END__\n'
1875: EOF
1876: }

1878: live_lab_dns_zone_body() {
1879:   local node_id="$1"
1880:   local zone_name="${2:-${RUSTYNET_DNS_ZONE_NAME:-rustynet}}"
1881:   local quoted_node_id quoted_zone_name
1882:   quoted_node_id="$(live_lab_shell_quote "$node_id")"
1883:   quoted_zone_name="$(live_lab_shell_quote "$zone_name")"
1884:   cat <<EOF
1885: node_id=${quoted_node_id}
1886: zone_name=${quoted_zone_name}
1887: status_rc=0
1888: dns_inspect_rc=0
1889: dns_zone_verify_rc=0
1890: status_output="\$(root env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet status 2>&1)" || status_rc=\$?
1891: dns_inspect_output="\$(root env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet dns inspect 2>&1)" || dns_inspect_rc=\$?
1892: dns_zone_verify_output="\$(root env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet dns zone verify --bundle /var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.dns-zone --verifier-key /etc/rustynet/dns-zone.pub --expected-zone-name "\$zone_name" 2>&1)" || dns_zone_verify_rc=\$?
1893: dns_zone_bundle_present=0
1894: dns_zone_verifier_present=0
1895: dns_zone_watermark_present=0
1896: if root test -f /var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.dns-zone; then
1897:   dns_zone_bundle_present=1
1898: fi
1899: if root test -f /etc/rustynet/dns-zone.pub; then
1900:   dns_zone_verifier_present=1
1901: fi
1902: if root test -e /var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.dns-zone.watermark; then
1903:   dns_zone_watermark_present=1
1904: fi
1905: printf 'dns_zone_snapshot_version=1\n'
1906: printf 'dns_zone_node_id=%s\n' "\$node_id"
1907: printf 'dns_zone_name=%s\n' "\$zone_name"
1908: printf 'status_rc=%s\n' "\$status_rc"
1909: printf 'dns_inspect_rc=%s\n' "\$dns_inspect_rc"
1910: printf 'dns_zone_verify_rc=%s\n' "\$dns_zone_verify_rc"
1911: printf 'dns_zone_bundle_present=%s\n' "\$dns_zone_bundle_present"
1912: printf 'dns_zone_verifier_present=%s\n' "\$dns_zone_verifier_present"
1913: printf 'dns_zone_watermark_present=%s\n' "\$dns_zone_watermark_present"
1914: printf 'status_begin\n'
1915: printf '%s\n' "\$status_output"
1916: printf 'status_end\n'
1917: printf 'dns_inspect_begin\n'
1918: printf '%s\n' "\$dns_inspect_output"
1919: printf 'dns_inspect_end\n'
1920: printf 'dns_zone_verify_begin\n'
1921: printf '%s\n' "\$dns_zone_verify_output"
1922: printf 'dns_zone_verify_end\n'
1923: EOF
1924: }

1989: live_lab_secret_hygiene_body() {
1990:   cat <<'EOF'
1991: plaintext_present=0
1992: for path in /var/lib/rustynet/keys/wireguard.passphrase /etc/rustynet/wireguard.passphrase /etc/rustynet/signing_key_passphrase; do
1993:   if root test -e "$path"; then
1994:     printf 'plaintext_passphrase_present=%s\n' "$path"
1995:     plaintext_present=1
1996:   else
1997:     printf 'plaintext_passphrase_absent=%s\n' "$path"
1998:   fi
1999: done
2000: for path in /etc/rustynet/credentials/wg_key_passphrase.cred /etc/rustynet/credentials/signing_key_passphrase.cred; do
2001:   if root test -e "$path"; then
2002:     printf 'credential_present=%s\n' "$path"
2003:   else
2004:     printf 'credential_missing=%s\n' "$path"
2005:   fi
2006: done
2007: if root test -S /run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock; then
2008:   printf 'daemon_socket=present\n'
2009: else
2010:   printf 'daemon_socket=missing\n'
2011: fi
2012: if [[ "$plaintext_present" -eq 0 ]]; then
2013:   printf 'result=no-plaintext-passphrase-files\n'
2014: else
2015:   printf 'result=plaintext-passphrase-files-present\n'
2016: fi
2017: EOF
2018: }

2092: live_lab_time_snapshot_body() {
2093:   local reference_unix="${1:-}"
2094:   local max_clock_skew_secs="${2:-${CROSS_NETWORK_MAX_TIME_SKEW_SECS:-2}}"
2095:   local quoted_reference_unix quoted_max_clock_skew_secs
2096:   quoted_reference_unix="$(live_lab_shell_quote "$reference_unix")"
2097:   quoted_max_clock_skew_secs="$(live_lab_shell_quote "$max_clock_skew_secs")"
2098:   cat <<EOF
2099: reference_unix=${quoted_reference_unix}
2100: max_clock_skew_secs=${quoted_max_clock_skew_secs}
2101: time_snapshot_status=pass
2102: timedatectl_available=0
2103: chronyc_available=0
2104: ntpq_available=0
2105: sync_evidence_present=0
2106: sync_source_kind=none
2107: sync_source_detail=none
2108: system_clock_synchronized=unknown
2109: clock_skew_secs=unknown
2110: remote_unix_now="\$(date -u +%s)"
2111: timedatectl_status_output=""
2112: timedatectl_show_output=""
2113: timedatectl_timesync_output=""
2114: chronyc_tracking_output=""
2115: chronyc_sources_output=""
2116: ntpq_output=""
2117: timesync_service_output=""
2118: normalize_single_line() {
2119:   tr '\n' ' ' | tr -s ' '
2120: }
2121: if command -v timedatectl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2122:   timedatectl_available=1
2123: fi
2124: if command -v chronyc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2125:   chronyc_available=1
2126: fi
2127: if command -v ntpq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2128:   ntpq_available=1
2129: fi
2130: if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2131:   timesync_service_output="\$(root systemctl status systemd-timesyncd.service chronyd.service chrony.service --no-pager -l 2>/dev/null || systemctl status systemd-timesyncd.service chronyd.service chrony.service --no-pager -l 2>/dev/null || true)"
2132: fi
2133: if [[ "\$timedatectl_available" -eq 1 ]]; then
2134:   timedatectl_status_output="\$(root timedatectl status 2>/dev/null || timedatectl status 2>/dev/null || true)"
2135:   timedatectl_show_output="\$(root timedatectl show --all 2>/dev/null || timedatectl show --all 2>/dev/null || true)"
2136:   timedatectl_timesync_output="\$(root timedatectl show-timesync --all 2>/dev/null || timedatectl show-timesync --all 2>/dev/null || true)"
2137:   if grep -Eq 'System clock synchronized:[[:space:]]+yes' <<<"\$timedatectl_status_output" \
2138:     || grep -Eq '^SystemClockSynchronized=yes$' <<<"\$timedatectl_show_output" \
2139:     || grep -Eq '^NTPSynchronized=yes$' <<<"\$timedatectl_show_output"; then
2140:     system_clock_synchronized=yes
2141:   elif grep -Eq 'System clock synchronized:[[:space:]]+no' <<<"\$timedatectl_status_output" \
2142:     || grep -Eq '^SystemClockSynchronized=no$' <<<"\$timedatectl_show_output" \
2143:     || grep -Eq '^NTPSynchronized=no$' <<<"\$timedatectl_show_output"; then
2144:     system_clock_synchronized=no
2145:   fi
2146:   sync_source_detail="\$(awk -F= '/^(ServerName|ServerAddress)=/ && \$2 != "" { print \$2; exit }' <<<"\$timedatectl_timesync_output" | normalize_single_line)"
2147:   if [[ "\$system_clock_synchronized" == "yes" && -n "\$sync_source_detail" ]]; then
2148:     sync_evidence_present=1
2149:     sync_source_kind=timedatectl
2150:   fi
2151: fi
2152: if [[ "\$sync_evidence_present" -eq 0 && "\$chronyc_available" -eq 1 ]]; then
2153:   chronyc_tracking_output="\$(root chronyc tracking 2>/dev/null || chronyc tracking 2>/dev/null || true)"
2154:   chronyc_sources_output="\$(root chronyc sources -v 2>/dev/null || chronyc sources -v 2>/dev/null || true)"
2155:   if grep -Eq 'Leap status[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*Normal' <<<"\$chronyc_tracking_output"; then
2156:     sync_source_detail="\$(awk -F':[[:space:]]*' '/^Reference ID/ { print \$2; exit }' <<<"\$chronyc_tracking_output" | normalize_single_line)"
2157:     if [[ -z "\$sync_source_detail" ]]; then
2158:       sync_source_detail="\$(awk '/^[[:space:]]*[\^\=\#\?\+\-xo~]\*/ { print \$2; exit }' <<<"\$chronyc_sources_output" | normalize_single_line)"
2159:     fi
2160:     if [[ -n "\$sync_source_detail" && "\$sync_source_detail" != *"LOCAL"* && "\$sync_source_detail" != "00000000" ]]; then
2161:       sync_evidence_present=1
2162:       sync_source_kind=chronyc
2163:       system_clock_synchronized=yes
2164:     fi
2165:   fi
2166: fi
2167: if [[ "\$sync_evidence_present" -eq 0 && "\$ntpq_available" -eq 1 ]]; then
2168:   ntpq_output="\$(root ntpq -p 2>/dev/null || ntpq -p 2>/dev/null || true)"
2169:   sync_source_detail="\$(awk '/^\*/ { print \$1 " " \$2; exit }' <<<"\$ntpq_output" | normalize_single_line)"
2170:   if [[ -n "\$sync_source_detail" ]]; then
2171:     sync_evidence_present=1
2172:     sync_source_kind=ntpq
2173:     system_clock_synchronized=yes
2174:   fi
2175: fi
2176: if [[ "\$sync_evidence_present" -eq 0 ]]; then
2177:   time_snapshot_status=fail
2178: fi
2179: if [[ "\$reference_unix" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
2180:   if (( remote_unix_now >= reference_unix )); then
2181:     clock_skew_secs=\$((remote_unix_now - reference_unix))
2182:   else
2183:     clock_skew_secs=\$((reference_unix - remote_unix_now))
2184:   fi
2185: else
2186:   time_snapshot_status=fail
2187: fi
2188: if [[ "\$clock_skew_secs" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "\$max_clock_skew_secs" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] \
2189:   && (( clock_skew_secs > max_clock_skew_secs )); then
2190:   time_snapshot_status=fail
2191: fi
2192: printf '__RNLAB_TIME_BEGIN__\n'
2193: printf 'time_snapshot_version=2\n'
2194: printf 'utc_now=%s\n' "\$(date -u +%FT%TZ)"
2195: printf 'reference_unix=%s\n' "\$reference_unix"
2196: printf 'max_clock_skew_secs=%s\n' "\$max_clock_skew_secs"
2197: printf 'remote_unix_now=%s\n' "\$remote_unix_now"
2198: printf 'clock_skew_secs=%s\n' "\$clock_skew_secs"
2199: printf 'timedatectl_available=%s\n' "\$timedatectl_available"
2200: printf 'chronyc_available=%s\n' "\$chronyc_available"
2201: printf 'ntpq_available=%s\n' "\$ntpq_available"
2202: printf 'system_clock_synchronized=%s\n' "\$system_clock_synchronized"
2203: printf 'sync_evidence_present=%s\n' "\$sync_evidence_present"
2204: printf 'sync_source_kind=%s\n' "\$sync_source_kind"
2205: printf 'sync_source_detail=%s\n' "\$sync_source_detail"
2206: printf 'time_snapshot_status=%s\n' "\$time_snapshot_status"
2207: if [[ "\$timedatectl_available" -eq 1 || "\$chronyc_available" -eq 1 || "\$ntpq_available" -eq 1 ]]; then
2208:   printf 'time_sync_observability=full\n'
2209: else
2210:   printf 'time_sync_observability=partial\n'
2211: fi
2212: printf 'date_begin\n'
2213: date -u +%FT%TZ
2214: date -u +%s
2215: printf 'date_end\n'
2216: printf 'timedatectl_begin\n'
2217: if [[ "\$timedatectl_available" -eq 1 ]]; then
2218:   printf '%s\n' "\$timedatectl_status_output"
2219:   printf 'timedatectl_show_begin\n'
2220:   printf '%s\n' "\$timedatectl_show_output"

2274: live_lab_process_snapshot_body() {
2275:   cat <<'EOF'
2276: process_snapshot_status=pass
2277: ps_output="$(root ps -eo pid=,ppid=,user=,comm=,args= --sort=pid 2>/dev/null || ps -eo pid=,ppid=,user=,comm=,args= --sort=pid 2>/dev/null || true)"
2278: count_matches() {
2279:   awk 'NF { count++ } END { print count + 0 }'
2280: }
2281: unit_property() {
2282:   local unit="$1"
2283:   local property="$2"
2284:   root systemctl show "$unit" --property="$property" --value 2>/dev/null || systemctl show "$unit" --property="$property" --value 2>/dev/null || true
2285: }
2286: daemon_matches="$(grep -E '(^|[[:space:]])rustynetd([[:space:]]|/).* daemon([[:space:]]|$)' <<<"$ps_output" || true)"
2287: helper_matches="$(grep -E '(^|[[:space:]])rustynetd([[:space:]]|/).* privileged-helper([[:space:]]|$)' <<<"$ps_output" || true)"
2288: managed_dns_matches="$(grep -E 'rustynetd-managed-dns' <<<"$ps_output" || true)"
2289: resolved_matches="$(grep -E '(^|[[:space:]])systemd-resolve(d)?([[:space:]]|$)' <<<"$ps_output" || true)"
2290: all_rustynetd_matches="$(grep -E '(^|[[:space:]])rustynetd([[:space:]]|$)' <<<"$ps_output" || true)"
2291: daemon_process_count="$(printf '%s\n' "$daemon_matches" | count_matches)"
2292: helper_process_count="$(printf '%s\n' "$helper_matches" | count_matches)"
2293: managed_dns_process_count="$(printf '%s\n' "$managed_dns_matches" | count_matches)"
2294: systemd_resolved_process_count="$(printf '%s\n' "$resolved_matches" | count_matches)"
2295: unexpected_rustynetd_process_count=0
2296: unexpected_rustynetd_matches=""
2297: while IFS= read -r line; do
2298:   [[ -n "$line" ]] || continue
2299:   if [[ "$line" == *"rustynetd daemon"* || "$line" == *"rustynetd privileged-helper"* ]]; then
2300:     continue
2301:   fi
2302:   unexpected_rustynetd_process_count=$((unexpected_rustynetd_process_count + 1))
2303:   unexpected_rustynetd_matches+="${line}"$'\n'
2304: done <<<"$all_rustynetd_matches"
2305: rustynetd_active_state="$(unit_property rustynetd.service ActiveState)"
2306: rustynetd_sub_state="$(unit_property rustynetd.service SubState)"
2307: rustynetd_main_pid="$(unit_property rustynetd.service MainPID)"
2308: helper_active_state="$(unit_property rustynetd-privileged-helper.service ActiveState)"
2309: helper_sub_state="$(unit_property rustynetd-privileged-helper.service SubState)"
2310: helper_main_pid="$(unit_property rustynetd-privileged-helper.service MainPID)"
2311: managed_dns_active_state="$(unit_property rustynetd-managed-dns.service ActiveState)"
2312: managed_dns_sub_state="$(unit_property rustynetd-managed-dns.service SubState)"
2313: managed_dns_main_pid="$(unit_property rustynetd-managed-dns.service MainPID)"
2314: systemd_resolved_active_state="$(unit_property systemd-resolved.service ActiveState)"
2315: systemd_resolved_sub_state="$(unit_property systemd-resolved.service SubState)"
2316: systemd_resolved_main_pid="$(unit_property systemd-resolved.service MainPID)"
2317: if [[ "$daemon_process_count" != "1" || "$helper_process_count" != "1" || "$unexpected_rustynetd_process_count" != "0" ]]; then
2318:   process_snapshot_status=fail
2319: fi
2320: if [[ "$rustynetd_active_state" != "active" || "$rustynetd_sub_state" != "running" ]]; then
2321:   process_snapshot_status=fail
2322: fi
2323: if [[ "$helper_active_state" != "active" || "$helper_sub_state" != "running" ]]; then
2324:   process_snapshot_status=fail
2325: fi
2326: if [[ "$managed_dns_active_state" != "active" || ( "$managed_dns_sub_state" != "exited" && "$managed_dns_sub_state" != "running" ) ]]; then
2327:   process_snapshot_status=fail
2328: fi
2329: if [[ ! "$managed_dns_process_count" =~ ^[0-9]+$ || "$managed_dns_process_count" -ne 0 ]]; then
2330:   process_snapshot_status=fail
2331: fi
2332: if [[ "$systemd_resolved_active_state" != "active" || ! "$systemd_resolved_process_count" =~ ^[0-9]+$ || "$systemd_resolved_process_count" -lt 1 ]]; then
2333:   process_snapshot_status=fail
2334: fi
2335: printf '__RNLAB_PROCESS_BEGIN__\n'
2336: printf 'process_snapshot_version=2\n'
2337: printf 'daemon_process_count=%s\n' "$daemon_process_count"
2338: printf 'helper_process_count=%s\n' "$helper_process_count"
2339: printf 'managed_dns_process_count=%s\n' "$managed_dns_process_count"
2340: printf 'systemd_resolved_process_count=%s\n' "$systemd_resolved_process_count"
2341: printf 'unexpected_rustynetd_process_count=%s\n' "$unexpected_rustynetd_process_count"
2342: printf 'rustynetd_active_state=%s\n' "$rustynetd_active_state"
2343: printf 'rustynetd_sub_state=%s\n' "$rustynetd_sub_state"
2344: printf 'rustynetd_main_pid=%s\n' "$rustynetd_main_pid"
2345: printf 'helper_active_state=%s\n' "$helper_active_state"
2346: printf 'helper_sub_state=%s\n' "$helper_sub_state"
2347: printf 'helper_main_pid=%s\n' "$helper_main_pid"
2348: printf 'managed_dns_active_state=%s\n' "$managed_dns_active_state"
2349: printf 'managed_dns_sub_state=%s\n' "$managed_dns_sub_state"
2350: printf 'managed_dns_main_pid=%s\n' "$managed_dns_main_pid"
2351: printf 'systemd_resolved_active_state=%s\n' "$systemd_resolved_active_state"
2352: printf 'systemd_resolved_sub_state=%s\n' "$systemd_resolved_sub_state"
2353: printf 'systemd_resolved_main_pid=%s\n' "$systemd_resolved_main_pid"
2354: printf 'process_snapshot_status=%s\n' "$process_snapshot_status"
2355: printf 'daemon_matches_begin\n'
2356: printf '%s\n' "$daemon_matches"
2357: printf 'daemon_matches_end\n'
2358: printf 'helper_matches_begin\n'
2359: printf '%s\n' "$helper_matches"
2360: printf 'helper_matches_end\n'
2361: printf 'managed_dns_matches_begin\n'
2362: printf '%s\n' "$managed_dns_matches"
2363: printf 'managed_dns_matches_end\n'
2364: printf 'systemd_resolved_matches_begin\n'
2365: printf '%s\n' "$resolved_matches"
2366: printf 'systemd_resolved_matches_end\n'
2367: printf 'unexpected_rustynetd_matches_begin\n'
2368: printf '%s\n' "$unexpected_rustynetd_matches"
2369: printf 'unexpected_rustynetd_matches_end\n'
2370: printf 'ps_begin\n'
2371: printf '%s\n' "$ps_output"
2372: printf 'ps_end\n'
2373: printf 'pgrep_begin\n'
2374: for pattern in \
2375:   rustynetd \
2376:   rustynetd-privileged-helper \
2377:   rustynetd-managed-dns \
2378:   systemd-timesyncd \
2379:   chronyd \
2380:   chrony \
2381:   systemd-resolved \
2382:   wg
2383: do
2384:   printf 'pattern=%s\n' "$pattern"
2385:   root pgrep -af "$pattern" 2>/dev/null || pgrep -af "$pattern" 2>/dev/null || true
2386: done
2387: printf 'pgrep_end\n'
2388: printf 'systemd_show_begin\n'
2389: for unit in \
2390:   rustynetd.service \
2391:   rustynetd-privileged-helper.service \
2392:   rustynetd-managed-dns.service \
2393:   systemd-timesyncd.service \
2394:   chronyd.service \
2395:   chrony.service \
2396:   systemd-resolved.service
2397: do
2398:   printf 'unit=%s\n' "$unit"
2399:   root systemctl show "$unit" \
2400:     --property=Id,LoadState,ActiveState,SubState,MainPID,ExecMainPID,FragmentPath,UnitFileState \
2401:     2>/dev/null || systemctl show "$unit" \
2402:     --property=Id,LoadState,ActiveState,SubState,MainPID,ExecMainPID,FragmentPath,UnitFileState \
2403:     2>/dev/null || true
2404: done
2405: printf 'systemd_show_end\n'
2406: printf 'cmdline_begin\n'
2407: for pattern in \
2408:   rustynetd \
2409:   rustynetd-privileged-helper \
2410:   rustynetd-managed-dns \
2411:   systemd-timesyncd \
2412:   chronyd \
2413:   chrony \
2414:   systemd-resolved \
2415:   wg
2416: do
2417:   process_pids="$(root pgrep -f "$pattern" 2>/dev/null || pgrep -f "$pattern" 2>/dev/null || true)"
2418:   for pid in $process_pids; do
2419:     printf 'pattern=%s pid=%s\n' "$pattern" "$pid"
2420:     root cat "/proc/$pid/cmdline" 2>/dev/null | tr '\0' ' ' || cat "/proc/$pid/cmdline" 2>/dev/null | tr '\0' ' ' || true
2421:     printf '\n'
2422:   done
2423: done
2424: printf 'cmdline_end\n'
2425: printf '__RNLAB_PROCESS_END__\n'
2426: EOF
2427: }
