2444: live_lab_socket_snapshot_body() {
2445:   cat <<'EOF'
2446: socket_snapshot_status=pass
2447: expected_daemon_socket=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock
2448: expected_helper_socket=/run/rustynet/rustynetd-privileged.sock
2449: expected_runtime_dir=/run/rustynet
2450: expected_dns_bind_addr="${RUSTYNET_DNS_RESOLVER_BIND_ADDR:-127.0.0.1:53535}"
2451: expected_wg_listen_port="${RUSTYNET_WG_LISTEN_PORT:-51820}"
2452: expected_dns_host="${expected_dns_bind_addr%:*}"
2453: expected_dns_port="${expected_dns_bind_addr##*:}"
2454: tcp_listener_output="$(root ss -H -ltnp 2>/dev/null || ss -H -ltnp 2>/dev/null || true)"
2455: udp_listener_output="$(root ss -H -lunp 2>/dev/null || ss -H -lunp 2>/dev/null || true)"
2456: unix_listener_output="$(root ss -H -xlpn 2>/dev/null || ss -H -xlpn 2>/dev/null || true)"
2457: runtime_socket_listing="$(root find /run/rustynet -maxdepth 1 -type s -name '*.sock' 2>/dev/null | sort || find /run/rustynet -maxdepth 1 -type s -name '*.sock' 2>/dev/null | sort || true)"
2458: socket_fact() {
2459:   local fact_name="$1"
2460:   local path="$2"
2461:   local stat_output mode owner group kind
2462:   printf 'socket_fact_begin\n'
2463:   printf 'name=%s\n' "$fact_name"
2464:   printf 'path=%s\n' "$path"
2465:   if root test -e "$path"; then
2466:     stat_output="$(root stat -Lc '%a|%U|%G|%F' "$path" 2>/dev/null || stat -Lc '%a|%U|%G|%F' "$path" 2>/dev/null || true)"
2467:     IFS='|' read -r mode owner group kind <<<"$stat_output"
2468:     printf 'present=1\n'
2469:     printf 'mode=%s\n' "$mode"
2470:     printf 'owner=%s\n' "$owner"
2471:     printf 'group=%s\n' "$group"
2472:     printf 'type=%s\n' "$kind"
2473:   else
2474:     printf 'present=0\n'
2475:   fi
2476:   printf 'socket_fact_end\n'
2477: }
2478: daemon_socket_present=0
2479: helper_socket_present=0
2480: if root test -S "$expected_daemon_socket"; then
2481:   daemon_socket_present=1
2482: fi
2483: if root test -S "$expected_helper_socket"; then
2484:   helper_socket_present=1
2485: fi
2486: daemon_unix_listener_count="$(awk -v path="$expected_daemon_socket" 'index($0, path) { count++ } END { print count + 0 }' <<<"$unix_listener_output")"
2487: helper_unix_listener_count="$(awk -v path="$expected_helper_socket" 'index($0, path) { count++ } END { print count + 0 }' <<<"$unix_listener_output")"
2488: wireguard_udp_listener_count="$(awk -v suffix=":"expected_wg_listen_port '$4 ~ suffix"$" { count++ } END { print count + 0 }' <<<"$udp_listener_output")"
2489: dns_udp_loopback_listener_count="$(awk -v port=":"expected_dns_port '($4 ~ port"$") && ($4 ~ /^127\.0\.0\.1:/ || $4 ~ /^\[::1\]:/) { count++ } END { print count + 0 }' <<<"$udp_listener_output")"
2490: dns_udp_nonloopback_listener_count="$(awk -v port=":"expected_dns_port '($4 ~ port"$") && $4 !~ /^127\.0\.0\.1:/ && $4 !~ /^\[::1\]:/ { count++ } END { print count + 0 }' <<<"$udp_listener_output")"
2491: dns_tcp_listener_count="$(awk -v port=":"expected_dns_port '$4 ~ port"$" { count++ } END { print count + 0 }' <<<"$tcp_listener_output")"
2492: unexpected_runtime_socket_count=0
2493: unexpected_runtime_sockets=""
2494: while IFS= read -r socket_path; do
2495:   [[ -n "$socket_path" ]] || continue
2496:   case "$socket_path" in
2497:     "$expected_daemon_socket"|"$expected_helper_socket")
2498:       ;;
2499:     *)
2500:       unexpected_runtime_socket_count=$((unexpected_runtime_socket_count + 1))
2501:       unexpected_runtime_sockets+="${socket_path}"$'\n'
2502:       ;;
2503:   esac
2504: done <<<"$runtime_socket_listing"
2505: if [[ "$daemon_socket_present" != "1" || "$helper_socket_present" != "1" ]]; then
2506:   socket_snapshot_status=fail
2507: fi
2508: if [[ "$daemon_unix_listener_count" != "1" || "$helper_unix_listener_count" != "1" ]]; then
2509:   socket_snapshot_status=fail
2510: fi
2511: if [[ "$wireguard_udp_listener_count" != "1" || "$dns_udp_loopback_listener_count" != "1" ]]; then
2512:   socket_snapshot_status=fail
2513: fi
2514: if [[ "$dns_udp_nonloopback_listener_count" != "0" || "$dns_tcp_listener_count" != "0" || "$unexpected_runtime_socket_count" != "0" ]]; then
2515:   socket_snapshot_status=fail
2516: fi
2517: printf '__RNLAB_SOCKET_BEGIN__\n'
2518: printf 'socket_snapshot_version=2\n'
2519: printf 'expected_daemon_socket=%s\n' "$expected_daemon_socket"
2520: printf 'expected_helper_socket=%s\n' "$expected_helper_socket"
2521: printf 'expected_runtime_dir=%s\n' "$expected_runtime_dir"
2522: printf 'expected_dns_bind_addr=%s\n' "$expected_dns_bind_addr"
2523: printf 'expected_wg_listen_port=%s\n' "$expected_wg_listen_port"
2524: printf 'daemon_socket_present=%s\n' "$daemon_socket_present"
2525: printf 'helper_socket_present=%s\n' "$helper_socket_present"
2526: printf 'daemon_unix_listener_count=%s\n' "$daemon_unix_listener_count"
2527: printf 'helper_unix_listener_count=%s\n' "$helper_unix_listener_count"
2528: printf 'wireguard_udp_listener_count=%s\n' "$wireguard_udp_listener_count"
2529: printf 'dns_udp_loopback_listener_count=%s\n' "$dns_udp_loopback_listener_count"
2530: printf 'dns_udp_nonloopback_listener_count=%s\n' "$dns_udp_nonloopback_listener_count"
2531: printf 'dns_tcp_listener_count=%s\n' "$dns_tcp_listener_count"
2532: printf 'unexpected_runtime_socket_count=%s\n' "$unexpected_runtime_socket_count"
2533: printf 'socket_snapshot_status=%s\n' "$socket_snapshot_status"
2534: socket_fact daemon_socket "$expected_daemon_socket"
2535: socket_fact helper_socket "$expected_helper_socket"
2536: socket_fact runtime_dir "$expected_runtime_dir"
2537: printf 'runtime_socket_listing_begin\n'
2538: printf '%s\n' "$runtime_socket_listing"
2539: printf 'runtime_socket_listing_end\n'
2540: printf 'unexpected_runtime_sockets_begin\n'
2541: printf '%s\n' "$unexpected_runtime_sockets"
2542: printf 'unexpected_runtime_sockets_end\n'
2543: printf 'listen_tcp_begin\n'
2544: printf '%s\n' "$tcp_listener_output"
2545: printf 'listen_tcp_end\n'
2546: printf 'listen_udp_begin\n'
2547: printf '%s\n' "$udp_listener_output"
2548: printf 'listen_udp_end\n'
2549: printf 'listen_unix_begin\n'
2550: printf '%s\n' "$unix_listener_output"
2551: printf 'listen_unix_end\n'
2552: printf '__RNLAB_SOCKET_END__\n'
2553: EOF
2554: }

2574: emit_permissions_fact() {

2630: )
2631: forbidden_plaintext_paths=(
2632:   /var/lib/rustynet/keys/wireguard.passphrase
2633:   /etc/rustynet/wireguard.passphrase
2634:   /etc/rustynet/signing_key_passphrase
2635: )
2636: printf 'required_path_count=%s\n' "${#required_paths[@]}"
2637: for path in "${required_paths[@]}"; do
2638:   emit_permissions_fact required "$path"
2639: done
2640: printf 'conditional_secret_path_count=%s\n' "${#conditional_secret_paths[@]}"
2641: for path in "${conditional_secret_paths[@]}"; do
2642:   emit_permissions_fact conditional_secret "$path"
2643: done
2644: printf 'forbidden_plaintext_path_count=%s\n' "${#forbidden_plaintext_paths[@]}"
2645: for path in "${forbidden_plaintext_paths[@]}"; do
2646:   emit_permissions_fact forbidden_plaintext "$path"
2647:   if root test -e "$path"; then
2648:     permissions_snapshot_status=fail
2649:   fi
2650: done
2651: printf 'permissions_snapshot_status=%s\n' "$permissions_snapshot_status"
2652: printf '__RNLAB_PERMISSIONS_END__\n'
2653: EOF
2654: }
2655:

2671: live_lab_peer_inventory_snapshot_body() {
2672:   local discovery_script_path="$1"
2673:   local quoted_discovery_script_path
2674:   quoted_discovery_script_path="$(live_lab_shell_quote "$discovery_script_path")"
2675:   cat <<EOF
2676: overall_status=pass
2677: last_step_rc=0
2678: run_step() {
2679:   local step_name="\$1"
2680:   shift
2681:   local rc=0
2682:   printf '%s_begin\n' "\$step_name"
2683:   if "\$@"; then
2684:     rc=0
2685:   else
2686:     rc=\$?
2687:     overall_status=fail
2688:   fi
2689:   last_step_rc="\$rc"
2690:   printf '%s_rc=%s\n' "\$step_name" "\$rc"
2691:   printf '%s_end\n' "\$step_name"
2692: }
2693: printf '__RNLAB_PEER_INVENTORY_BEGIN__\n'
2694: printf 'peer_inventory_version=1\n'
2695: printf 'peer_inventory_source=collect_network_discovery_info.sh\n'
2696: run_step discovery_bundle root bash $quoted_discovery_script_path --quiet
2697: printf 'peer_inventory_health=%s\n' "\$overall_status"
2698: printf 'peer_inventory_status=%s\n' "\$overall_status"
2699: printf '__RNLAB_PEER_INVENTORY_END__\n'
2700: EOF
2701: }

2781: live_lab_collect_node_snapshot() {
2782:   local target="$1"
2783:   local node_id="$2"
2784:   local role="$3"
2785:   local body snapshot
2786:   local expected_next_hop=""
2787:   local reference_unix
2788:   local max_clock_skew_secs="${CROSS_NETWORK_MAX_TIME_SKEW_SECS:-2}"
2789:   if [[ "$role" == "client" ]]; then
2790:     expected_next_hop="direct:rustynet0"
2791:   fi
2792:   reference_unix="$(date -u +%s)"
2793:   body="$(printf '%s\n%s\n%s\n%s\n%s\n%s\n%s\n%s\n%s\n%s\n%s\n%s' \
2794:     "$(live_lab_service_snapshot_body)" \
2795:     "$(live_lab_network_snapshot_body)" \
2796:     "$(live_lab_time_snapshot_body "$reference_unix" "$max_clock_skew_secs")" \
2797:     "$(live_lab_process_snapshot_body)" \
2798:     "$(live_lab_socket_snapshot_body)" \
2799:     "$(live_lab_permissions_snapshot_body)" \
2800:     "$(live_lab_route_policy_snapshot_body "1.1.1.1" "$expected_next_hop")" \
2801:     "$(live_lab_dns_state_snapshot_body)" \
2802:     "$(live_lab_firewall_snapshot_body)" \
2803:     "$(live_lab_dns_zone_snapshot_body "$node_id")" \
2804:     "$(live_lab_signed_state_snapshot_body "$node_id")" \
2805:     "$(live_lab_secret_hygiene_snapshot_body)")"
2806:   snapshot="$(live_lab_capture_root "$target" "$body")" || return 1
2807:   {
2808:     printf 'node_snapshot_version=1\n'
2809:     printf 'target=%s\n' "$target"
2810:     printf 'node_id=%s\n' "$node_id"
2811:     printf 'role=%s\n' "$role"
2812:     printf 'collected_at_utc=%s\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)"
2813:     printf '%s\n' "$snapshot"
2814:   }
2815: }
2816: 
2817: live_lab_collect_runtime_validation_snapshot() {
2818:   local target="$1"
2819:   local node_id="$2"
2820:   local role="$3"
2821:   local body snapshot
2822:   local expected_next_hop=""
2823:   if [[ "$role" == "client" ]]; then
2824:     expected_next_hop="direct:rustynet0"
2825:   fi
2826:   # Keep the runtime convergence snapshot small on the UTM path.
2827:   # Signed-state and DNS-zone convergence are validated separately by
2828:   # dedicated collectors before baseline runtime sampling begins.
2829:   body="$(printf '%s\n%s\n%s\n' \
2830:     "$(live_lab_status_snapshot_body)" \
2831:     "$(live_lab_route_policy_snapshot_body "1.1.1.1" "$expected_next_hop")" \
2832:     "$(live_lab_secret_hygiene_snapshot_body)")"
2833:   snapshot="$(live_lab_capture_root "$target" "$body")" || return 1
2834:   {
2835:     printf 'node_snapshot_version=1\n'
2836:     printf 'target=%s\n' "$target"
2837:     printf 'node_id=%s\n' "$node_id"
2838:     printf 'role=%s\n' "$role"
2839:     printf 'collected_at_utc=%s\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)"
2840:     printf '%s\n' "$snapshot"
2841:   }
2842: }
2843: 
2844: live_lab_no_plaintext_passphrase_check() {
2845:   local target="$1"
2846:   local hygiene
2847:   hygiene="$(live_lab_collect_secret_hygiene "$target")" || return 1
2848:   if [[ "$hygiene" == *"result=no-plaintext-passphrase-files"* ]]; then
2849:     printf 'no-plaintext-passphrase-files\n'
2850:     return 0
2851:   fi
2852:   printf '%s\n' "$hygiene"
2853:   return 1
2854: }

  75: validate_positive_integer() {
  76:   local name="$1"
  77:   local value="$2"
  78:   if [[ ! "$value" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || (( value <= 0 )); then
  79:     echo "$name must be a positive integer (got: $value)" >&2
  80:     exit 2
  81:   fi

  84: extract_netcheck_value() {
  85:   local netcheck="$1"
  86:   local key="$2"
  87:   printf '%s\n' "$netcheck" | tr ' ' '\n' | awk -F '=' -v key="$key" '$1 == key { print $2; exit }'
  88: }

  90: netcheck_is_valid() {
  91:   local netcheck="$1"
  92:   [[ "$netcheck" == *"traversal_error=none"* ]] || return 1
  93:   [[ "$netcheck" != *"traversal_alarm_state=critical"* ]] || return 1
  94:   [[ "$netcheck" != *"traversal_alarm_state=error"* ]] || return 1
  95:   [[ "$netcheck" != *"traversal_alarm_state=missing"* ]] || return 1
  96:   [[ "$netcheck" != *"dns_alarm_state=critical"* ]] || return 1
  97:   [[ "$netcheck" != *"dns_alarm_state=error"* ]] || return 1
  98:   [[ "$netcheck" != *"dns_alarm_state=missing"* ]] || return 1
  99:   return 0

 102: join_existing_artifacts() {
 103:   local joined=""
 104:   local item
 105:   for item in "$@"; do
 106:     [[ -n "$item" && -f "$item" ]] || continue
 107:     if [[ -n "$joined" ]]; then
 108:       joined+=$'\x1f'
 109:     fi
 110:     joined+="$item"
 111:   done
 112:   printf '%s' "$joined"
 113: }

 115: apply_controller_block() {
 116:   local target="$1"
 117:   local controller_ip="$2"
 118:   live_lab_run_root "$target" "
 119: root nft delete table inet rustynet_controller_switch_gate >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 120: root nft add table inet rustynet_controller_switch_gate
 121: root nft 'add chain inet rustynet_controller_switch_gate input { type filter hook input priority -150; policy accept; }'
 122: root nft 'add chain inet rustynet_controller_switch_gate output { type filter hook output priority -150; policy accept; }'
 123: root nft add rule inet rustynet_controller_switch_gate input ip saddr ${controller_ip} counter drop
 124: root nft add rule inet rustynet_controller_switch_gate output ip daddr ${controller_ip} counter drop
 125: "
 126: }

 254:         "relay_network_id": os.environ["RELAY_NETWORK_ID_ENV"],
 255:         "nat_profile": os.environ["NAT_PROFILE_ENV"],
 256:         "impairment_profile": os.environ["IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE_ENV"],
 257:     },
 258:     "checks": {
 259:         "controller_switch_success": os.environ["CHECK_CONTROLLER_SWITCH_SUCCESS_ENV"],
 260:         "relay_remote_exit_ready": os.environ["CHECK_RELAY_REMOTE_EXIT_READY_ENV"],
 261:         "controller_reconnect_within_slo": os.environ["CHECK_CONTROLLER_RECONNECT_WITHIN_SLO_ENV"],
 262:         "reconnect_via_pull_refresh": os.environ["CHECK_RECONNECT_VIA_PULL_REFRESH_ENV"],
 263:         "no_underlay_leak_during_reconnect": os.environ["CHECK_NO_UNDERLAY_LEAK_DURING_RECONNECT_ENV"],
 264:         "signed_state_valid_during_reconnect": os.environ["CHECK_SIGNED_STATE_VALID_DURING_RECONNECT_ENV"],
 265:         "cross_network_topology_heuristic": os.environ["CHECK_CROSS_NETWORK_TOPOLOGY_HEURISTIC_ENV"],
 266:         "no_plaintext_passphrase_files": os.environ["CHECK_NO_PLAINTEXT_PASSPHRASE_FILES_ENV"],
 267:     },
 268:     "source_artifacts": split_paths(os.environ.get("SOURCE_ARTIFACTS_ENV", "")),
 269:     "log_artifacts": split_paths(os.environ.get("LOG_ARTIFACTS_ENV", "")),
 270:     "implementation_state": "live_measured_validator",
 271: }
 272: 
 273: if payload["status"] == "fail":
 274:     payload["failure_summary"] = os.environ.get("FAILURE_SUMMARY_ENV", "").strip()
 275: 
 276: report_path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
 277: PY
 278: }
 279: 
 280: cleanup() {
 281:   local rc=$?
 282:   set +e
 283:   if [[ -n "$CLIENT_HOST" ]]; then
 284:     clear_controller_block "$CLIENT_HOST" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 285:   fi
 286:   if [[ -n "$RELAY_HOST" ]]; then
 287:     clear_controller_block "$RELAY_HOST" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 288:   fi
 289:   if [[ "$REPORT_WRITTEN" -eq 0 ]]; then
 290:     write_report fail
 291:   fi
 292:   REPORT_WRITTEN=1
 293:   if [[ -n "$WORK_DIR" && -d "$WORK_DIR" ]]; then
 294:     rm -rf "$WORK_DIR"
 295:   fi
 296:   live_lab_cleanup
 297:   exit "$rc"
 298: }
 299: 
 300: trap cleanup EXIT
 301: 
 302: while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
 303:   case "$1" in
 304:     --ssh-identity-file) SSH_IDENTITY_FILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 305:     --client-host) CLIENT_HOST="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 306:     --exit-host) EXIT_HOST="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 307:     --relay-host) RELAY_HOST="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 308:     --client-node-id) CLIENT_NODE_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 309:     --exit-node-id) EXIT_NODE_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 310:     --relay-node-id) RELAY_NODE_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 311:     --client-network-id) CLIENT_NETWORK_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 312:     --exit-network-id) EXIT_NETWORK_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 313:     --relay-network-id) RELAY_NETWORK_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 314:     --client-underlay-ip) CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 315:     --exit-underlay-ip) EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 316:     --relay-underlay-ip) RELAY_UNDERLAY_IP="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 317:     --nat-profile) NAT_PROFILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 318:     --impairment-profile) IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 319:     --ssh-allow-cidrs) SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 320:     --controller-outage-secs) CONTROLLER_OUTAGE_SECS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 321:     --reconnect-slo-secs) RECONNECT_SLO_SECS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 322:     --report-path) REPORT_PATH="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 323:     --log-path) LOG_PATH="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 324:     -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
 325:     *) echo "unknown argument: $1" >&2; usage; exit 2 ;;
 326:   esac
 327: done
 328: 
 329: if [[ -z "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE" || -z "$CLIENT_HOST" || -z "$EXIT_HOST" || -z "$RELAY_HOST" || -z "$CLIENT_NODE_ID" || -z "$EXIT_NODE_ID" || -z "$RELAY_NODE_ID" || -z "$CLIENT_NETWORK_ID" || -z "$EXIT_NETWORK_ID" || -z "$RELAY_NETWORK_ID" ]]; then
 330:   usage >&2
 331:   exit 2
 332: fi
 333: if [[ -z "$NAT_PROFILE" || -z "$IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE" ]]; then
 334:   echo "--nat-profile and --impairment-profile must be non-empty" >&2
 335:   exit 2
 336: fi
 337: 
 338: if [[ "$CLIENT_HOST" == "$EXIT_HOST" || "$CLIENT_HOST" == "$RELAY_HOST" || "$EXIT_HOST" == "$RELAY_HOST" ]]; then
 339:   echo "client, exit, and relay hosts must all differ" >&2
 340:   exit 2
 341: fi
 342: 
 343: if [[ "$CLIENT_NETWORK_ID" == "$EXIT_NETWORK_ID" || "$CLIENT_NETWORK_ID" == "$RELAY_NETWORK_ID" || "$EXIT_NETWORK_ID" == "$RELAY_NETWORK_ID" ]]; then
 344:   echo "client, exit, and relay network ids must all differ" >&2
 345:   exit 2
 346: fi
 347: 
 348: if [[ -n "$CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
 349:   cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops validate-ipv4-address --ip "$CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP" >/dev/null
 350: fi
 351: if [[ -n "$EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
 352:   cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops validate-ipv4-address --ip "$EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP" >/dev/null
 353: fi
 354: if [[ -n "$RELAY_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
 355:   cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops validate-ipv4-address --ip "$RELAY_UNDERLAY_IP" >/dev/null
 356: fi
 357: 
 358: validate_positive_integer "controller outage seconds" "$CONTROLLER_OUTAGE_SECS"
 359: validate_positive_integer "reconnect slo seconds" "$RECONNECT_SLO_SECS"
 360: 
 361: mkdir -p "$(dirname "$REPORT_PATH")" "$(dirname "$LOG_PATH")"
 362: : > "$LOG_PATH"
 363: exec >> "$LOG_PATH" 2>&1
 364: 
 365: main() {
 366:   local relay_rc
 367:   local route_leak_samples signed_state_invalid_samples
 368:   local client_route client_status client_netcheck relay_netcheck
 369:   local local_ts restore_started_unix reconnect_unix reconnect_secs
 370:   local client_refresh_logs relay_refresh_logs
 371:   local client_refresh_output relay_refresh_output
 372:   local client_plaintext_start relay_plaintext_start exit_plaintext_start
 373:   local client_plaintext_end relay_plaintext_end exit_plaintext_end
 374:   local artifact_dir
 375: 
 376:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="preparing controller switch artifacts"
 377:   WORK_DIR="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/rustynet-cross-network-controller-switch.XXXXXX")"
 378:   artifact_dir="$(dirname "$REPORT_PATH")"
 379:   RELAY_REPORT_PATH="$artifact_dir/cross_network_controller_switch_relay_stage_report.json"
 380:   RELAY_LOG_PATH="$artifact_dir/cross_network_controller_switch_relay_stage.log"
 381:   MONITOR_LOG_PATH="$artifact_dir/cross_network_controller_switch_monitor.log"
 382:   MONITOR_SUMMARY_PATH="$artifact_dir/cross_network_controller_switch_summary.json"
 383:   SOURCE_ARTIFACTS=(
 384:     "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/e2e/live_linux_cross_network_controller_switch_test.sh"
 385:     "$RELAY_REPORT_PATH"
 386:     "$MONITOR_SUMMARY_PATH"
 387:   )
 388:   LOG_ARTIFACTS=(
 389:     "$RELAY_LOG_PATH"
 390:     "$MONITOR_LOG_PATH"
 391:   )
 392: 
 393:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="bootstrapping relay remote-exit path before controller-switch simulation"
 394:   if RUSTYNET_EXPECTED_GIT_COMMIT="${RUSTYNET_EXPECTED_GIT_COMMIT:-}" \
 395:     bash "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/e2e/live_linux_cross_network_relay_remote_exit_test.sh" \
 396:       --ssh-identity-file "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE" \
 397:       --client-host "$CLIENT_HOST" \
 398:       --exit-host "$EXIT_HOST" \
 399:       --relay-host "$RELAY_HOST" \
 400:       --client-node-id "$CLIENT_NODE_ID" \
 401:       --exit-node-id "$EXIT_NODE_ID" \
 402:       --relay-node-id "$RELAY_NODE_ID" \
 403:       --client-network-id "$CLIENT_NETWORK_ID" \
 404:       --exit-network-id "$EXIT_NETWORK_ID" \
 405:       --relay-network-id "$RELAY_NETWORK_ID" \
 406:       --client-underlay-ip "${CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP:-}" \
 407:       --exit-underlay-ip "${EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP:-}" \
 408:       --relay-underlay-ip "${RELAY_UNDERLAY_IP:-}" \
 409:       --nat-profile "$NAT_PROFILE" \
 410:       --impairment-profile "$IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE" \
 411:       --ssh-allow-cidrs "$SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS" \
 412:       --report-path "$RELAY_REPORT_PATH" \
 413:       --log-path "$RELAY_LOG_PATH"; then
 414:     relay_rc=0
 415:   else
 416:     relay_rc=$?
 417:   fi
 418: 
 419:   if [[ ! -f "$RELAY_REPORT_PATH" ]]; then
 420:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="relay bootstrap validator failed before emitting evidence"
 421:     return 1
 422:   fi
 423: 
 424:   mapfile -t relay_results < <(
 425:     cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops read-cross-network-report-fields \
 426:       --report-path "$RELAY_REPORT_PATH" \
 427:       --include-status \
 428:       --check relay_remote_exit_success \
 429:       --check remote_exit_no_underlay_leak \
 430:       --check cross_network_topology_heuristic
 431:   ) || return 1
 432: 
 433:   if [[ "${relay_results[0]:-fail}" == 'pass' && "${relay_results[1]:-fail}" == 'pass' && "${relay_results[2]:-fail}" == 'pass' ]]; then
 434:     CHECK_RELAY_REMOTE_EXIT_READY="pass"
 435:   fi
 436:   if [[ "${relay_results[3]:-fail}" == 'pass' ]]; then
 437:     CHECK_CROSS_NETWORK_TOPOLOGY_HEURISTIC="pass"
 438:   fi
 439: 
 440:   if [[ "$relay_rc" -ne 0 || "$CHECK_RELAY_REMOTE_EXIT_READY" != 'pass' ]]; then
 441:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="relay bootstrap did not produce a secure baseline for controller-switch validation"
 442:     return 1
 443:   fi
 444: 
 445:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="initializing live-lab runtime for controller-switch validation"
 446:   live_lab_init "rustynet-cross-network-controller-switch" "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE"
 447:   live_lab_push_sudo_password "$EXIT_HOST"
 448:   live_lab_push_sudo_password "$RELAY_HOST"
 449:   live_lab_push_sudo_password "$CLIENT_HOST"
 450:   live_lab_wait_for_daemon_socket "$EXIT_HOST"
 451:   live_lab_wait_for_daemon_socket "$RELAY_HOST"
 452:   live_lab_wait_for_daemon_socket "$CLIENT_HOST"
 453: 
 454:   if [[ -n "$CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
 455:     CLIENT_ADDR="$CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP"
 456:   else
 457:     CLIENT_ADDR="$(live_lab_resolved_target_address "$CLIENT_HOST")"
 458:   fi
 459:   if [[ -n "$EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
 460:     EXIT_ADDR="$EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP"
 461:   else
 462:     EXIT_ADDR="$(live_lab_resolved_target_address "$EXIT_HOST")"
 463:   fi
 464:   if [[ -n "$RELAY_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
 465:     RELAY_ADDR="$RELAY_UNDERLAY_IP"
 466:   else
 467:     RELAY_ADDR="$(live_lab_resolved_target_address "$RELAY_HOST")"
 468:   fi
 469:   CONTROLLER_IP="$EXIT_ADDR"
 470: 
 471:   client_plaintext_start="$(live_lab_no_plaintext_passphrase_check "$CLIENT_HOST" || true)"
 472:   relay_plaintext_start="$(live_lab_no_plaintext_passphrase_check "$RELAY_HOST" || true)"
 473:   exit_plaintext_start="$(live_lab_no_plaintext_passphrase_check "$EXIT_HOST" || true)"
 474: 
 475:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="blocking controller underlay path with nftables"
 476:   CONTROLLER_SWITCH_STARTED_UNIX="$(date +%s)"
 477:   apply_controller_block "$CLIENT_HOST" "$CONTROLLER_IP"
 478:   apply_controller_block "$RELAY_HOST" "$CONTROLLER_IP"
 479: 
 480:   : > "$MONITOR_LOG_PATH"
 481:   route_leak_samples=0
 482:   signed_state_invalid_samples=0
 483: 
 484:   for ((i=1; i<=CONTROLLER_OUTAGE_SECS; i++)); do
 485:     local_ts="$(date +%s)"
 486:     client_route="$(live_lab_capture "$CLIENT_HOST" "ip -4 route get 1.1.1.1 || true")"
 487:     client_status="$(live_lab_status "$CLIENT_HOST")"
 488:     client_netcheck="$(live_lab_capture_root "$CLIENT_HOST" "root env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet netcheck || true")"
 489:     relay_netcheck="$(live_lab_capture_root "$RELAY_HOST" "root env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet netcheck || true")"
 490: 
 491:     if ! grep -Fq 'dev rustynet0' <<<"$client_route"; then
 492:       route_leak_samples=$((route_leak_samples + 1))
 493:     fi
 494:     if ! netcheck_is_valid "$client_netcheck" || ! netcheck_is_valid "$relay_netcheck"; then
 495:       signed_state_invalid_samples=$((signed_state_invalid_samples + 1))
 496:     fi
 497: 
 498:     printf '%s|phase=blocked|iter=%s|route=%s|status=%s|client_netcheck=%s|relay_netcheck=%s\n' \
 499:       "$local_ts" "$i" \
 500:       "$(printf '%s' "$client_route" | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ';')" \
 501:       "$(printf '%s' "$client_status" | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ';')" \
 502:       "$(printf '%s' "$client_netcheck" | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ';')" \
 503:       "$(printf '%s' "$relay_netcheck" | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ';')" >> "$MONITOR_LOG_PATH"
 504: 
 505:     sleep 1
 506:   done
 507: 
 508:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="restoring controller underlay path"
 509:   clear_controller_block "$CLIENT_HOST"
 510:   clear_controller_block "$RELAY_HOST"
 511:   restore_started_unix="$(date +%s)"
 512: 
 513:   reconnect_unix=0
 514:   for ((i=1; i<=RECONNECT_SLO_SECS; i++)); do
 515:     local_ts="$(date +%s)"
 516:     client_status="$(live_lab_status "$CLIENT_HOST")"
 517:     client_route="$(live_lab_capture "$CLIENT_HOST" "ip -4 route get 1.1.1.1 || true")"
 518:     client_netcheck="$(live_lab_capture_root "$CLIENT_HOST" "root env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet netcheck || true")"
 519:     relay_netcheck="$(live_lab_capture_root "$RELAY_HOST" "root env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet netcheck || true")"
 520: 
 521:     if ! grep -Fq 'dev rustynet0' <<<"$client_route"; then
 522:       route_leak_samples=$((route_leak_samples + 1))
 523:     fi
 524:     if ! netcheck_is_valid "$client_netcheck" || ! netcheck_is_valid "$relay_netcheck"; then
 525:       signed_state_invalid_samples=$((signed_state_invalid_samples + 1))
 526:     fi
 527: 
 528:     printf '%s|phase=recovery|iter=%s|route=%s|status=%s|client_netcheck=%s|relay_netcheck=%s\n' \
 529:       "$local_ts" "$i" \
 530:       "$(printf '%s' "$client_route" | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ';')" \
 531:       "$(printf '%s' "$client_status" | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ';')" \
 532:       "$(printf '%s' "$client_netcheck" | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ';')" \
 533:       "$(printf '%s' "$relay_netcheck" | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ';')" >> "$MONITOR_LOG_PATH"
 534: 
 535:     if grep -Fq "exit_node=${RELAY_NODE_ID}" <<<"$client_status" && grep -Fq 'state=ExitActive' <<<"$client_status" && grep -Fq 'dev rustynet0' <<<"$client_route" && netcheck_is_valid "$client_netcheck" && netcheck_is_valid "$relay_netcheck"; then
 536:       reconnect_unix="$local_ts"
 537:       break
 538:     fi
 539:     sleep 1
 540:   done
 541: 
 542:   reconnect_secs=-1
 543:   if (( reconnect_unix > 0 )); then
 544:     reconnect_secs=$((reconnect_unix - restore_started_unix))
 545:     if (( reconnect_secs >= 0 && reconnect_secs <= RECONNECT_SLO_SECS )); then
 546:       CHECK_CONTROLLER_RECONNECT_WITHIN_SLO="pass"
 547:     fi
 548:   fi
 549: 
 550:   if (( route_leak_samples == 0 )); then
 551:     CHECK_NO_UNDERLAY_LEAK_DURING_RECONNECT="pass"
 552:   fi
 553:   if (( signed_state_invalid_samples == 0 )); then
 554:     CHECK_SIGNED_STATE_VALID_DURING_RECONNECT="pass"
 555:   fi
 556: 
 557:   client_refresh_logs="$(live_lab_capture_root "$CLIENT_HOST" "root journalctl -u rustynetd --since '@${CONTROLLER_SWITCH_STARTED_UNIX}' --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -F 'signed state refresh completed' || true")"
 558:   relay_refresh_logs="$(live_lab_capture_root "$RELAY_HOST" "root journalctl -u rustynetd --since '@${CONTROLLER_SWITCH_STARTED_UNIX}' --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -F 'signed state refresh completed' || true")"
 559:   if [[ -n "$client_refresh_logs" || -n "$relay_refresh_logs" ]]; then
 560:     CHECK_RECONNECT_VIA_PULL_REFRESH="pass"
 561:   fi
 562: 
 563:   if [[ "$CHECK_RECONNECT_VIA_PULL_REFRESH" != 'pass' ]]; then
 564:     client_refresh_output="$(live_lab_capture_root "$CLIENT_HOST" "root env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet state refresh || true")"
 565:     relay_refresh_output="$(live_lab_capture_root "$RELAY_HOST" "root env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet state refresh || true")"
 566:     if [[ "$client_refresh_output" == *"signed state refresh completed"* && "$relay_refresh_output" == *"signed state refresh completed"* ]]; then
 567:       CHECK_RECONNECT_VIA_PULL_REFRESH="pass"
 568:     fi
 569:   fi
 570: 
 571:   client_plaintext_end="$(live_lab_no_plaintext_passphrase_check "$CLIENT_HOST" || true)"
 572:   relay_plaintext_end="$(live_lab_no_plaintext_passphrase_check "$RELAY_HOST" || true)"
 573:   exit_plaintext_end="$(live_lab_no_plaintext_passphrase_check "$EXIT_HOST" || true)"
 574:   if [[ "$client_plaintext_start" == 'no-plaintext-passphrase-files' && "$relay_plaintext_start" == 'no-plaintext-passphrase-files' && "$exit_plaintext_start" == 'no-plaintext-passphrase-files' && "$client_plaintext_end" == 'no-plaintext-passphrase-files' && "$relay_plaintext_end" == 'no-plaintext-passphrase-files' && "$exit_plaintext_end" == 'no-plaintext-passphrase-files' ]]; then
 575:     CHECK_NO_PLAINTEXT_PASSPHRASE_FILES="pass"
 576:   fi
 577: 
 578:   write_summary \
 579:     "$reconnect_secs" \
 580:     "$route_leak_samples" \
 581:     "$signed_state_invalid_samples" \
 582:     "$CHECK_CONTROLLER_RECONNECT_WITHIN_SLO" \
 583:     "$CHECK_RECONNECT_VIA_PULL_REFRESH" \
 584:     "$reconnect_unix"
 585: 
 586:   if [[ "$CHECK_RELAY_REMOTE_EXIT_READY" == 'pass' && "$CHECK_CONTROLLER_RECONNECT_WITHIN_SLO" == 'pass' && "$CHECK_RECONNECT_VIA_PULL_REFRESH" == 'pass' && "$CHECK_NO_UNDERLAY_LEAK_DURING_RECONNECT" == 'pass' && "$CHECK_SIGNED_STATE_VALID_DURING_RECONNECT" == 'pass' && "$CHECK_CROSS_NETWORK_TOPOLOGY_HEURISTIC" == 'pass' && "$CHECK_NO_PLAINTEXT_PASSPHRASE_FILES" == 'pass' ]]; then
 587:     CHECK_CONTROLLER_SWITCH_SUCCESS="pass"
 588:   fi
 589: 
 590:   if [[ "$CHECK_CONTROLLER_SWITCH_SUCCESS" != 'pass' ]]; then
 591:     if [[ "$CHECK_CONTROLLER_RECONNECT_WITHIN_SLO" != 'pass' ]]; then
 592:       FAILURE_SUMMARY="controller switch reconvergence exceeded reconnect SLO (${RECONNECT_SLO_SECS}s), measured=${reconnect_secs}s"
 593:     elif [[ "$CHECK_RECONNECT_VIA_PULL_REFRESH" != 'pass' ]]; then
 594:       FAILURE_SUMMARY="controller switch did not show signed pull-refresh recovery evidence"
 595:     elif [[ "$CHECK_NO_UNDERLAY_LEAK_DURING_RECONNECT" != 'pass' ]]; then
 596:       FAILURE_SUMMARY="underlay leak detected while controller path was switching"
 597:     elif [[ "$CHECK_SIGNED_STATE_VALID_DURING_RECONNECT" != 'pass' ]]; then
 598:       FAILURE_SUMMARY="signed state became invalid while controller path was switching"
 599:     elif [[ "$CHECK_NO_PLAINTEXT_PASSPHRASE_FILES" != 'pass' ]]; then
 600:       FAILURE_SUMMARY="plaintext passphrase files were detected during controller-switch validation"
 601:     else
 602:       FAILURE_SUMMARY="controller switch validation checks did not all pass"
 603:     fi
 604:     return 1
 605:   fi
 606: 
 607:   FAILURE_SUMMARY=""
 608: }
 609: 
 610: if main; then
 611:   write_report pass
 612:   REPORT_WRITTEN=1
 613: else
 614:   write_report fail
 615:   REPORT_WRITTEN=1
 616:   exit 1
 617: fi
 618: 
 619: live_lab_log "Cross-network controller-switch report written: $REPORT_PATH"

===== /scripts/e2e/live_linux_cross_network_direct_remote_exit_test.sh =====

   1: #!/usr/bin/env bash
   2: set -euo pipefail

  16: EXIT_HOST=""

  18: EXIT_NODE_ID=""
