  30: FAILURE_SUMMARY="cross-network direct remote-exit validator did not complete"
  31: CHECK_DIRECT_REMOTE_EXIT_SUCCESS="fail"
  32: CHECK_REMOTE_EXIT_NO_UNDERLAY_LEAK="fail"
  33: CHECK_REMOTE_EXIT_SERVER_IP_BYPASS_IS_NARROW="fail"
  34: CHECK_CROSS_NETWORK_TOPOLOGY_HEURISTIC="fail"
  35: CHECK_CLIENT_EXIT_SELECTED="fail"
  36: CHECK_EXIT_SERVING_ROUTE="fail"
  37: CHECK_CLIENT_ROUTE_VIA_RUSTYNET="fail"
  38: CHECK_EXIT_ENDPOINT_VISIBLE="fail"
  39: CHECK_EXIT_MASQUERADE_PRESENT="fail"
  40: CHECK_NO_PLAINTEXT_PASSPHRASE_FILES="fail"
  41: CLIENT_ADDR=""
  42: EXIT_ADDR=""
  43: BYPASS_REPORT_PATH=""
  44: BYPASS_LOG_PATH=""
  45: CLIENT_STATUS_FILE=""
  46: EXIT_STATUS_FILE=""
  47: CLIENT_INTERNET_ROUTE_FILE=""
  48: CLIENT_ENDPOINTS_FILE=""
  49: EXIT_NFT_FILE=""
  50: CLIENT_PLAINTEXT_FILE=""
  51: EXIT_PLAINTEXT_FILE=""
  52: SSH_TRUST_SUMMARY_PATH=""
  53: SOURCE_ARTIFACTS=()
  54: LOG_ARTIFACTS=()
  55: PATH_STATUS_LINE=""
  56: 
  57: usage() {
  58:   cat <<'USAGE'
  59: usage: live_linux_cross_network_direct_remote_exit_test.sh --ssh-identity-file <path> --client-host <user@host> --exit-host <user@host> --client-node-id <id> --exit-node-id <id> --client-network-id <id> --exit-network-id <id> [options]
  60: 
  61: options:
  62:   --known-hosts-file <path>
  63:   --nat-profile <profile>
  64:   --impairment-profile <profile>
  65:   --ssh-allow-cidrs <cidr[,cidr]>
  66:   --client-underlay-ip <ipv4>
  67:   --exit-underlay-ip <ipv4>
  68:   --report-path <path>
  69:   --log-path <path>
  70: USAGE
  71: }
  72: 
  73: write_report() {
  74:   local status="$1"
  75:   local args=(
  76:     cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops generate-cross-network-remote-exit-report
  77:     --suite cross_network_direct_remote_exit
  78:     --report-path "$REPORT_PATH"
  79:     --log-path "$LOG_PATH"
  80:     --status "$status"
  81:     --failure-summary "$FAILURE_SUMMARY"
  82:     --implementation-state live_measured_validator
  83:     --client-host "$CLIENT_HOST"
  84:     --exit-host "$EXIT_HOST"
  85:     --client-network-id "$CLIENT_NETWORK_ID"
  86:     --exit-network-id "$EXIT_NETWORK_ID"
  87:     --nat-profile "$NAT_PROFILE"
  88:     --impairment-profile "$IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE"
  89:     --source-artifact "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/e2e/live_linux_cross_network_direct_remote_exit_test.sh"
  90:     --check "direct_remote_exit_success=${CHECK_DIRECT_REMOTE_EXIT_SUCCESS}"
  91:     --check "remote_exit_no_underlay_leak=${CHECK_REMOTE_EXIT_NO_UNDERLAY_LEAK}"
  92:     --check "remote_exit_server_ip_bypass_is_narrow=${CHECK_REMOTE_EXIT_SERVER_IP_BYPASS_IS_NARROW}"
  93:     --check "cross_network_topology_heuristic=${CHECK_CROSS_NETWORK_TOPOLOGY_HEURISTIC}"
  94:     --check "client_exit_selected=${CHECK_CLIENT_EXIT_SELECTED}"
  95:     --check "exit_serving_route=${CHECK_EXIT_SERVING_ROUTE}"
  96:     --check "client_route_via_rustynet0=${CHECK_CLIENT_ROUTE_VIA_RUSTYNET}"
  97:     --check "exit_endpoint_visible=${CHECK_EXIT_ENDPOINT_VISIBLE}"
  98:     --check "exit_masquerade_present=${CHECK_EXIT_MASQUERADE_PRESENT}"
  99:     --check "no_plaintext_passphrase_files=${CHECK_NO_PLAINTEXT_PASSPHRASE_FILES}"
 100:   )
 101:   local item
 102:   set +u
 103:   if [[ -n "$PATH_STATUS_LINE" ]]; then
 104:     args+=(--path-status-line "$PATH_STATUS_LINE")
 105:   fi
 106:   for item in "${SOURCE_ARTIFACTS[@]}"; do
 107:     [[ -n "$item" ]] || continue
 108:     args+=(--source-artifact "$item")
 109:   done
 110:   for item in "${LOG_ARTIFACTS[@]}"; do
 111:     [[ -n "$item" ]] || continue
 112:     args+=(--log-artifact "$item")
 113:   done
 114:   set -u
 115:   "${args[@]}"
 116: }
 117: 
 118: cleanup() {
 119:   local rc=$?
 120:   set +e
 121:   if [[ "$REPORT_WRITTEN" -eq 0 ]]; then
 122:     write_report fail
 123:   fi
 124:   REPORT_WRITTEN=1
 125:   live_lab_cleanup
 126:   exit "$rc"
 127: }
 128: 
 129: trap cleanup EXIT
 130: 
 131: while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
 132:   case "$1" in
 133:     --ssh-identity-file) SSH_IDENTITY_FILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 134:     --known-hosts-file) KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 135:     --client-host) CLIENT_HOST="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 136:     --exit-host) EXIT_HOST="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 137:     --client-node-id) CLIENT_NODE_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 138:     --exit-node-id) EXIT_NODE_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 139:     --client-network-id) CLIENT_NETWORK_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 140:     --exit-network-id) EXIT_NETWORK_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 141:     --client-underlay-ip) CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 142:     --exit-underlay-ip) EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 143:     --nat-profile) NAT_PROFILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 144:     --impairment-profile) IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 145:     --ssh-allow-cidrs) SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 146:     --report-path) REPORT_PATH="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 147:     --log-path) LOG_PATH="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 148:     -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
 149:     *) echo "unknown argument: $1" >&2; usage; exit 2 ;;
 150:   esac
 151: done
 152: 
 153: if [[ -z "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE" || -z "$CLIENT_HOST" || -z "$EXIT_HOST" || -z "$CLIENT_NODE_ID" || -z "$EXIT_NODE_ID" || -z "$CLIENT_NETWORK_ID" || -z "$EXIT_NETWORK_ID" ]]; then
 154:   usage >&2
 155:   exit 2
 156: fi
 157: if [[ -z "$NAT_PROFILE" || -z "$IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE" ]]; then
 158:   echo "--nat-profile and --impairment-profile must be non-empty" >&2
 159:   exit 2
 160: fi
 161: 
 162: if [[ "$CLIENT_HOST" == "$EXIT_HOST" ]]; then
 163:   echo "--client-host and --exit-host must differ" >&2
 164:   exit 2
 165: fi
 166: 
 167: if [[ "$CLIENT_NETWORK_ID" == "$EXIT_NETWORK_ID" ]]; then
 168:   echo "--client-network-id and --exit-network-id must differ" >&2
 169:   exit 2
 170: fi
 171: 
 172: if [[ -n "$CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
 173:   cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops validate-ipv4-address --ip "$CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP" >/dev/null
 174: fi
 175: if [[ -n "$EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
 176:   cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops validate-ipv4-address --ip "$EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP" >/dev/null
 177: fi
 178: if [[ -n "$KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE" ]]; then
 179:   export LIVE_LAB_PINNED_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE="$KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE"
 180: fi
 181: 
 182: mkdir -p "$(dirname "$REPORT_PATH")" "$(dirname "$LOG_PATH")"
 183: : > "$LOG_PATH"
 184: exec >> "$LOG_PATH" 2>&1
 185: 
 186: main() {
 187:   local issue_env assign_pub_local exit_assignment_local client_assignment_local
 188:   local exit_refresh_local client_refresh_local
 189:   local traversal_env traversal_pub_local exit_traversal_local client_traversal_local
 190:   local bypass_status client_status client_netcheck exit_status client_internet_route client_endpoints exit_nft
 191:   local client_plaintext_check exit_plaintext_check
 192:   local artifact_dir
 193:   local path_proven_direct signed_state_healthy
 194: 
 195:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="initializing live-lab runtime"
 196: 
 197:   live_lab_init "rustynet-cross-network-direct-remote-exit" "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE"
 198: 
 199:   issue_env="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/rn_issue_cross_network_direct.env"
 200:   assign_pub_local="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/assignment.pub"
 201:   exit_assignment_local="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/assignment-exit"
 202:   client_assignment_local="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/assignment-client"
 203:   exit_refresh_local="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/assignment-refresh-exit.env"
 204:   client_refresh_local="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/assignment-refresh-client.env"
 205:   traversal_env="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/rn_issue_cross_network_direct_traversal.env"
 206:   traversal_pub_local="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/traversal.pub"
 207:   exit_traversal_local="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/traversal-exit"
 208:   client_traversal_local="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/traversal-client"
 209:   artifact_dir="$(dirname "$REPORT_PATH")"
 210:   BYPASS_REPORT_PATH="$artifact_dir/cross_network_direct_remote_exit_server_ip_bypass_report.json"
 211:   BYPASS_LOG_PATH="$artifact_dir/cross_network_direct_remote_exit_server_ip_bypass.log"
 212:   SSH_TRUST_SUMMARY_PATH="$artifact_dir/cross_network_direct_remote_exit_ssh_trust_summary.txt"
 213:   SOURCE_ARTIFACTS=("$BYPASS_REPORT_PATH" "$SSH_TRUST_SUMMARY_PATH")
 214:   LOG_ARTIFACTS=("$BYPASS_LOG_PATH")
 215:   CLIENT_STATUS_FILE="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/client_status.txt"
 216:   EXIT_STATUS_FILE="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/exit_status.txt"
 217:   CLIENT_INTERNET_ROUTE_FILE="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/client_internet_route.txt"
 218:   CLIENT_ENDPOINTS_FILE="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/client_endpoints.txt"
 219:   EXIT_NFT_FILE="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/exit_nft.txt"
 220:   CLIENT_PLAINTEXT_FILE="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/client_plaintext_check.txt"
 221:   EXIT_PLAINTEXT_FILE="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/exit_plaintext_check.txt"
 222: 
 223:   live_lab_push_sudo_password "$EXIT_HOST"
 224:   live_lab_push_sudo_password "$CLIENT_HOST"
 225:   live_lab_write_ssh_trust_summary "$SSH_TRUST_SUMMARY_PATH" "$CLIENT_HOST" "$EXIT_HOST"
 226: 
 227:   live_lab_log "Collecting WireGuard public keys"
 228:   EXIT_PUB_HEX="$(live_lab_collect_pubkey_hex "$EXIT_HOST")"
 229:   CLIENT_PUB_HEX="$(live_lab_collect_pubkey_hex "$CLIENT_HOST")"
 230:   if [[ -n "$EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
 231:     EXIT_ADDR="$EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP"
 232:   else
 233:     EXIT_ADDR="$(live_lab_resolved_target_address "$EXIT_HOST")"
 234:   fi
 235:   if [[ -n "$CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
 236:     CLIENT_ADDR="$CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP"
 237:   else
 238:     CLIENT_ADDR="$(live_lab_resolved_target_address "$CLIENT_HOST")"
 239:   fi
 240: 
 241:   NODES_SPEC="${EXIT_NODE_ID}|${EXIT_ADDR}:51820|${EXIT_PUB_HEX};${CLIENT_NODE_ID}|${CLIENT_ADDR}:51820|${CLIENT_PUB_HEX}"
 242:   ALLOW_SPEC="${CLIENT_NODE_ID}|${EXIT_NODE_ID};${EXIT_NODE_ID}|${CLIENT_NODE_ID}"
 243: 
 244:   : > "$issue_env"
 245:   live_lab_append_env_assignment "$issue_env" "NODES_SPEC" "$NODES_SPEC"
 246:   live_lab_append_env_assignment "$issue_env" "ALLOW_SPEC" "$ALLOW_SPEC"
 247:   live_lab_append_env_assignment "$issue_env" "ASSIGNMENTS_SPEC" "${EXIT_NODE_ID}|-;${CLIENT_NODE_ID}|${EXIT_NODE_ID}"
 248: 
 249:   live_lab_log "Issuing signed direct remote-exit assignments on $EXIT_HOST"
 250:   live_lab_issue_assignment_bundles_from_env "$EXIT_HOST" "$issue_env" "/tmp/rn_issue_cross_network_direct.env"
 251: 
 252:   live_lab_capture_root "$EXIT_HOST" "root cat /run/rustynet/assignment-issue/rn-assignment.pub" > "$assign_pub_local"
 253:   live_lab_capture_root "$EXIT_HOST" "root cat /run/rustynet/assignment-issue/rn-assignment-$EXIT_NODE_ID.assignment" > "$exit_assignment_local"
 254:   live_lab_capture_root "$EXIT_HOST" "root cat /run/rustynet/assignment-issue/rn-assignment-$CLIENT_NODE_ID.assignment" > "$client_assignment_local"
 255: 
 256:   live_lab_log "Distributing signed assignments"
 257:   live_lab_install_assignment_bundle "$EXIT_HOST" "$assign_pub_local" "$exit_assignment_local"
 258:   live_lab_install_assignment_bundle "$CLIENT_HOST" "$assign_pub_local" "$client_assignment_local"
 259: 
 260:   live_lab_write_assignment_refresh_env "$exit_refresh_local" "$EXIT_NODE_ID" "$NODES_SPEC" "$ALLOW_SPEC"
 261:   live_lab_write_assignment_refresh_env "$client_refresh_local" "$CLIENT_NODE_ID" "$NODES_SPEC" "$ALLOW_SPEC" "$EXIT_NODE_ID"
 262:   live_lab_install_assignment_refresh_env "$EXIT_HOST" "$exit_refresh_local"
 263:   live_lab_install_assignment_refresh_env "$CLIENT_HOST" "$client_refresh_local"
 264: 
 265:   : > "$traversal_env"
 266:   live_lab_append_env_assignment "$traversal_env" "NODES_SPEC" "$NODES_SPEC"
 267:   live_lab_append_env_assignment "$traversal_env" "ALLOW_SPEC" "$ALLOW_SPEC"
 268: 
 269:   live_lab_log "Issuing signed traversal bundles for direct remote-exit topology"
 270:   live_lab_issue_traversal_bundles_from_env "$EXIT_HOST" "$traversal_env" "/tmp/rn_issue_cross_network_direct_traversal.env"
 271: 
 272:   live_lab_capture_root "$EXIT_HOST" "root cat /run/rustynet/traversal-issue/rn-traversal.pub" > "$traversal_pub_local"
 273:   live_lab_capture_root "$EXIT_HOST" "root cat /run/rustynet/traversal-issue/rn-traversal-$EXIT_NODE_ID.traversal" > "$exit_traversal_local"
 274:   live_lab_capture_root "$EXIT_HOST" "root cat /run/rustynet/traversal-issue/rn-traversal-$CLIENT_NODE_ID.traversal" > "$client_traversal_local"
 275: 
 276:   install_traversal_bundle() {
 277:     local host="$1"
 278:     local bundle_local="$2"
 279:     live_lab_scp_to "$traversal_pub_local" "$host" "/tmp/rn-traversal.pub"
 280:     live_lab_scp_to "$bundle_local" "$host" "/tmp/rn-traversal.bundle"
 281:     live_lab_run_root "$host" "root install -m 0644 -o root -g root /tmp/rn-traversal.pub /etc/rustynet/traversal.pub && root install -m 0640 -o root -g rustynetd /tmp/rn-traversal.bundle /var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.traversal && root rm -f /var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.traversal.watermark /tmp/rn-traversal.pub /tmp/rn-traversal.bundle"
 282:   }
 283: 
 284:   live_lab_log "Distributing signed traversal bundles"
 285:   install_traversal_bundle "$EXIT_HOST" "$exit_traversal_local"
 286:   install_traversal_bundle "$CLIENT_HOST" "$client_traversal_local"
 287: 
 288:   live_lab_log "Enforcing runtime roles"
 289:   live_lab_enforce_host "$EXIT_HOST" "admin" "$EXIT_NODE_ID" "$SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS" "$(live_lab_remote_src_dir "$EXIT_HOST")"
 290:   live_lab_enforce_host "$CLIENT_HOST" "client" "$CLIENT_NODE_ID" "$SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS" "$(live_lab_remote_src_dir "$CLIENT_HOST")"
 291:   live_lab_wait_for_daemon_socket "$EXIT_HOST"
 292:   live_lab_wait_for_daemon_socket "$CLIENT_HOST"
 293: 
 294:   live_lab_log "Advertising default route on remote exit"
 295:   live_lab_retry_root "$EXIT_HOST" "root env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet route advertise 0.0.0.0/0" 10 2
 296:   sleep 5
 297: 
 298:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="capturing direct remote-exit steady-state evidence"
 299:   client_status="$(live_lab_status "$CLIENT_HOST")"
 300:   client_netcheck="$(live_lab_capture_root "$CLIENT_HOST" "root env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet netcheck")"
 301:   exit_status="$(live_lab_status "$EXIT_HOST")"
 302:   PATH_STATUS_LINE="$client_netcheck"
 303:   client_internet_route="$(live_lab_capture "$CLIENT_HOST" "ip -4 route get 1.1.1.1 || true")"
 304:   client_endpoints="$(live_lab_capture_root "$CLIENT_HOST" "root wg show rustynet0 endpoints || true")"
 305:   exit_nft="$(live_lab_capture_root "$EXIT_HOST" "root nft list ruleset || true")"
 306:   client_plaintext_check="$(live_lab_no_plaintext_passphrase_check "$CLIENT_HOST")"
 307:   exit_plaintext_check="$(live_lab_no_plaintext_passphrase_check "$EXIT_HOST")"
 308: 
 309:   printf '%s\n' "$client_status" > "$CLIENT_STATUS_FILE"
 310:   printf '%s\n' "$exit_status" > "$EXIT_STATUS_FILE"
 311:   printf '%s\n' "$client_internet_route" > "$CLIENT_INTERNET_ROUTE_FILE"
 312:   printf '%s\n' "$client_endpoints" > "$CLIENT_ENDPOINTS_FILE"
 313:   printf '%s\n' "$exit_nft" > "$EXIT_NFT_FILE"
 314:   printf '%s\n' "$client_plaintext_check" > "$CLIENT_PLAINTEXT_FILE"
 315:   printf '%s\n' "$exit_plaintext_check" > "$EXIT_PLAINTEXT_FILE"
 316: 
 317:   live_lab_log "Client status"
 318:   printf '%s\n' "$client_status"
 319:   live_lab_log "Exit status"
 320:   printf '%s\n' "$exit_status"
 321:   live_lab_log "Client route to internet"
 322:   printf '%s\n' "$client_internet_route"
 323:   live_lab_log "Client endpoints"
 324:   printf '%s\n' "$client_endpoints"
 325:   live_lab_log "Client netcheck"
 326:   printf '%s\n' "$client_netcheck"
 327: 
 328:   path_proven_direct=0
 329:   if [[ "$client_netcheck" == *"path_mode=direct_active"* && "$client_netcheck" == *"path_live_proven=true"* ]]; then
 330:     path_proven_direct=1
 331:   fi
 332:   signed_state_healthy=0
 333:   if [[ "$client_netcheck" != *"traversal_alarm_state=critical"* && "$client_netcheck" != *"traversal_alarm_state=error"* && "$client_netcheck" != *"traversal_alarm_state=missing"* && "$client_netcheck" != *"dns_alarm_state=critical"* && "$client_netcheck" != *"dns_alarm_state=error"* && "$client_netcheck" != *"dns_alarm_state=missing"* && "$client_netcheck" == *"traversal_error=none"* ]]; then
 334:     signed_state_healthy=1
 335:   fi
 336: 
 337:   if (( path_proven_direct == 1 )) && grep -Fq "exit_node=${EXIT_NODE_ID}" <<<"$client_status" && grep -Fq 'state=ExitActive' <<<"$client_status"; then
 338:     CHECK_CLIENT_EXIT_SELECTED="pass"
 339:   fi
 340:   if grep -Fq 'serving_exit_node=true' <<<"$exit_status"; then
 341:     CHECK_EXIT_SERVING_ROUTE="pass"
 342:   fi
 343:   if grep -Fq 'dev rustynet0' <<<"$client_internet_route"; then
 344:     CHECK_CLIENT_ROUTE_VIA_RUSTYNET="pass"
 345:   fi
 346:   if grep -Fq "${EXIT_ADDR}:51820" <<<"$client_endpoints"; then
 347:     CHECK_EXIT_ENDPOINT_VISIBLE="pass"
 348:   fi
 349:   if grep -Fq 'masquerade' <<<"$exit_nft"; then
 350:     CHECK_EXIT_MASQUERADE_PRESENT="pass"
 351:   fi
 352:   if [[ "$client_plaintext_check" == 'no-plaintext-passphrase-files' && "$exit_plaintext_check" == 'no-plaintext-passphrase-files' ]]; then
 353:     CHECK_NO_PLAINTEXT_PASSPHRASE_FILES="pass"
 354:   fi
 355: 
 356:   topology_result="$(cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops classify-cross-network-topology --ip-a "$CLIENT_ADDR" --ip-b "$EXIT_ADDR")" || return 1
 357:   if [[ "$topology_result" == "pass" ]]; then
 358:     CHECK_CROSS_NETWORK_TOPOLOGY_HEURISTIC="pass"
 359:   else
 360:     CHECK_CROSS_NETWORK_TOPOLOGY_HEURISTIC="fail"
 361:   fi
 362: 
 363:   if [[ "$CHECK_CLIENT_EXIT_SELECTED" == 'pass' && "$CHECK_EXIT_SERVING_ROUTE" == 'pass' && "$CHECK_CLIENT_ROUTE_VIA_RUSTYNET" == 'pass' && "$CHECK_EXIT_ENDPOINT_VISIBLE" == 'pass' && "$CHECK_EXIT_MASQUERADE_PRESENT" == 'pass' && "$CHECK_NO_PLAINTEXT_PASSPHRASE_FILES" == 'pass' && "$CHECK_CROSS_NETWORK_TOPOLOGY_HEURISTIC" == 'pass' ]] && (( signed_state_healthy == 1 )); then
 364:     CHECK_DIRECT_REMOTE_EXIT_SUCCESS="pass"
 365:   fi
 366: 
 367:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="validating narrow server-IP bypass and leak resistance on direct remote-exit path"
 368:   if RUSTYNET_EXPECTED_GIT_COMMIT="${RUSTYNET_EXPECTED_GIT_COMMIT:-}" \
 369:     bash "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/e2e/live_linux_server_ip_bypass_test.sh" \
 370:       --ssh-identity-file "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE" \
 371:       --client-host "$CLIENT_HOST" \
 372:       --probe-host "$EXIT_HOST" \
 373:       --ssh-allow-cidrs "$SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS" \
 374:       --report-path "$BYPASS_REPORT_PATH" \
 375:       --log-path "$BYPASS_LOG_PATH"; then
 376:     bypass_status=0
 377:   else
 378:     bypass_status=$?
 379:   fi
 380: 
 381:   if [[ "$bypass_status" -ne 0 && ! -f "$BYPASS_REPORT_PATH" ]]; then
 382:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="server-IP bypass validator failed before emitting evidence"
 383:     return 1
 384:   fi
 385: 
 386:   mapfile -t bypass_results < <(
 387:     cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops read-cross-network-report-fields \
 388:       --report-path "$BYPASS_REPORT_PATH" \
 389:       --check internet_route_via_rustynet0 \
 390:       --check probe_service_blocked_from_client \
 391:       --check probe_endpoint_route_direct_not_tunnelled \
 392:       --check no_unexpected_bypass_routes
 393:   ) || return 1
 394: 
 395:   if [[ "${bypass_results[0]}" == 'pass' && "${bypass_results[1]}" == 'pass' ]]; then
 396:     CHECK_REMOTE_EXIT_NO_UNDERLAY_LEAK="pass"
 397:   fi
 398:   if [[ "${bypass_results[1]}" == 'pass' && "${bypass_results[2]}" == 'pass' && "${bypass_results[3]}" == 'pass' ]]; then
 399:     CHECK_REMOTE_EXIT_SERVER_IP_BYPASS_IS_NARROW="pass"
 400:   fi
 401: 
 402:   if [[ "$CHECK_DIRECT_REMOTE_EXIT_SUCCESS" != 'pass' ]]; then
 403:     if [[ "$CHECK_CROSS_NETWORK_TOPOLOGY_HEURISTIC" != 'pass' ]]; then
 404:       FAILURE_SUMMARY="client and exit underlay addresses share the same local prefix; refusing to claim cross-network direct remote exit on same-subnet topology"
 405:     else
 406:       FAILURE_SUMMARY="direct remote-exit steady-state checks did not all pass"
 407:     fi
 408:     return 1
 409:   fi
 410:   if [[ "$CHECK_REMOTE_EXIT_NO_UNDERLAY_LEAK" != 'pass' ]]; then
 411:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="direct remote-exit path leaked or could not prove leak resistance"
 412:     return 1
 413:   fi
 414:   if [[ "$CHECK_REMOTE_EXIT_SERVER_IP_BYPASS_IS_NARROW" != 'pass' ]]; then
 415:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="server-IP bypass on the direct remote-exit path was broader than allowed"
 416:     return 1
 417:   fi
 418: 
 419:   FAILURE_SUMMARY=""
 420: }
 421: 
 422: if main; then
 423:   write_report pass
 424:   REPORT_WRITTEN=1
 425: else
 426:   write_report fail
 427:   REPORT_WRITTEN=1
 428:   exit 1
 429: fi
 430: 
 431: live_lab_log "Cross-network direct remote-exit report written: $REPORT_PATH"

===== /scripts/e2e/live_linux_cross_network_failback_roaming_test.sh =====

   1: #!/usr/bin/env bash
   2: set -euo pipefail
   3: umask 077
   4: 
   5: ROOT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
   6: cd "$ROOT_DIR"
   7: 
   8: source "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/e2e/live_lab_common.sh"
   9: 
  10: LIVE_LAB_LOG_PREFIX="cross-network-failback-roaming"
  11: export LIVE_LAB_LOG_PREFIX
  12: 
  13: SSH_IDENTITY_FILE=""
  14: KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE="${LIVE_LAB_PINNED_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE:-}"
  15: CLIENT_HOST=""
  16: EXIT_HOST=""
  17: RELAY_HOST=""
  18: CLIENT_NODE_ID=""
  19: EXIT_NODE_ID=""
  20: RELAY_NODE_ID=""
  21: CLIENT_NETWORK_ID=""
  22: EXIT_NETWORK_ID=""
  23: RELAY_NETWORK_ID=""
  24: CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP="${RUSTYNET_CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP:-}"
  25: EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP="${RUSTYNET_EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP:-}"
  26: RELAY_UNDERLAY_IP="${RUSTYNET_RELAY_UNDERLAY_IP:-}"
  27: NAT_PROFILE="baseline_lan"
  28: IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE="none"
  29: SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS="192.168.18.0/24"
  30: FAILBACK_RECOVERY_SLO_SECS=30
  31: FAILBACK_MONITOR_ITERATIONS=35
  32: REPORT_PATH="$ROOT_DIR/artifacts/phase10/cross_network_failback_roaming_report.json"
  33: LOG_PATH="$ROOT_DIR/artifacts/phase10/source/cross_network_failback_roaming.log"
  34: 
  35: WORK_DIR=""
  36: REPORT_WRITTEN=0
  37: FAILURE_SUMMARY="cross-network failback and roaming validator did not complete"
  38: CHECK_RELAY_TO_DIRECT_FAILBACK_SUCCESS="fail"
  39: CHECK_ENDPOINT_ROAM_RECOVERY_SUCCESS="fail"
  40: CHECK_REMOTE_EXIT_NO_UNDERLAY_LEAK="fail"
  41: CHECK_CROSS_NETWORK_TOPOLOGY_HEURISTIC="fail"
  42: CHECK_FAILBACK_RECOVERY_SLO="fail"
  43: CHECK_NO_UNDERLAY_LEAK_DURING_FAILBACK="fail"
  44: CHECK_SIGNED_STATE_VALID_DURING_FAILBACK="fail"
  45: RELAY_REPORT_PATH=""
  46: RELAY_LOG_PATH=""
  47: BYPASS_REPORT_PATH=""
  48: BYPASS_LOG_PATH=""
  49: FAILBACK_MONITOR_LOG=""
  50: FAILBACK_SLO_SUMMARY_PATH=""
  51: SSH_TRUST_SUMMARY_PATH=""
  52: SOURCE_ARTIFACTS=()
  53: LOG_ARTIFACTS=()
  54: PATH_STATUS_LINE=""
  55: CLIENT_ADDR=""
  56: EXIT_ADDR=""
  57: RELAY_ADDR=""
  58: ROAM_ALIAS_IP=""
  59: ROAM_INTERFACE=""
  60: ROAM_PREFIX=""
  61: 
  62: usage() {
  63:   cat <<'USAGE'
  64: usage: live_linux_cross_network_failback_roaming_test.sh --ssh-identity-file <path> --client-host <user@host> --exit-host <user@host> --relay-host <user@host> --client-node-id <id> --exit-node-id <id> --relay-node-id <id> --client-network-id <id> --exit-network-id <id> --relay-network-id <id> [options]
  65: 
  66: options:
  67:   --known-hosts-file <path>
  68:   --nat-profile <profile>
  69:   --impairment-profile <profile>
  70:   --ssh-allow-cidrs <cidr[,cidr]>
  71:   --client-underlay-ip <ipv4>
  72:   --exit-underlay-ip <ipv4>
  73:   --relay-underlay-ip <ipv4>
  74:   --failback-recovery-slo-secs <seconds>      Default: 30
  75:   --failback-monitor-iterations <count>       Default: 35
  76:   --report-path <path>
  77:   --log-path <path>
  78: USAGE
  79: }
  80: 
  81: parse_positive_integer() {
  82:   local flag="$1"
  83:   local raw="$2"
  84:   if [[ ! "$raw" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || (( raw <= 0 )); then
  85:     echo "${flag} must be a positive integer (got: ${raw})" >&2
  86:     exit 2
  87:   fi
  88: }
  89: 
  90: write_report() {
  91:   local status="$1"
  92:   local args=(
  93:     cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops generate-cross-network-remote-exit-report
  94:     --suite cross_network_failback_roaming
  95:     --report-path "$REPORT_PATH"
  96:     --log-path "$LOG_PATH"
  97:     --status "$status"
  98:     --failure-summary "$FAILURE_SUMMARY"
  99:     --implementation-state live_measured_validator
 100:     --client-host "$CLIENT_HOST"
 101:     --exit-host "$EXIT_HOST"
 102:     --relay-host "$RELAY_HOST"
 103:     --client-network-id "$CLIENT_NETWORK_ID"
 104:     --exit-network-id "$EXIT_NETWORK_ID"
 105:     --relay-network-id "$RELAY_NETWORK_ID"
 106:     --nat-profile "$NAT_PROFILE"
 107:     --impairment-profile "$IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE"
 108:     --source-artifact "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/e2e/live_linux_cross_network_failback_roaming_test.sh"
 109:     --check "relay_to_direct_failback_success=${CHECK_RELAY_TO_DIRECT_FAILBACK_SUCCESS}"
 110:     --check "endpoint_roam_recovery_success=${CHECK_ENDPOINT_ROAM_RECOVERY_SUCCESS}"
 111:     --check "remote_exit_no_underlay_leak=${CHECK_REMOTE_EXIT_NO_UNDERLAY_LEAK}"
 112:     --check "cross_network_topology_heuristic=${CHECK_CROSS_NETWORK_TOPOLOGY_HEURISTIC}"
 113:     --check "failback_reconnect_within_slo=${CHECK_FAILBACK_RECOVERY_SLO}"
 114:     --check "no_underlay_leak_while_reconnecting=${CHECK_NO_UNDERLAY_LEAK_DURING_FAILBACK}"
 115:     --check "signed_state_valid_while_reconnecting=${CHECK_SIGNED_STATE_VALID_DURING_FAILBACK}"
 116:   )
 117:   local item
 118:   set +u
 119:   if [[ -n "$PATH_STATUS_LINE" ]]; then
 120:     args+=(--path-status-line "$PATH_STATUS_LINE")
 121:   fi
 122:   for item in "${SOURCE_ARTIFACTS[@]}"; do
 123:     [[ -n "$item" ]] || continue
 124:     args+=(--source-artifact "$item")
 125:   done
 126:   for item in "${LOG_ARTIFACTS[@]}"; do
 127:     [[ -n "$item" ]] || continue
 128:     args+=(--log-artifact "$item")
 129:   done
 130:   set -u
 131:   "${args[@]}"
 132: }
 133: 
 134: cleanup() {
 135:   local rc=$?
 136:   set +e
 137:   if [[ -n "$ROAM_ALIAS_IP" && -n "$ROAM_INTERFACE" && -n "$ROAM_PREFIX" ]]; then
 138:     live_lab_run_root "$EXIT_HOST" "root ip addr del '${ROAM_ALIAS_IP}/${ROAM_PREFIX}' dev '${ROAM_INTERFACE}' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 139:   fi
 140:   if [[ "$REPORT_WRITTEN" -eq 0 ]]; then
 141:     write_report fail
 142:   fi
 143:   REPORT_WRITTEN=1
 144:   if [[ -n "$WORK_DIR" && -d "$WORK_DIR" ]]; then
 145:     rm -rf "$WORK_DIR"
 146:   fi
 147:   live_lab_cleanup
 148:   exit "$rc"
 149: }
 150: 
 151: trap cleanup EXIT
 152: 
 153: while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
 154:   case "$1" in
 155:     --ssh-identity-file) SSH_IDENTITY_FILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 156:     --known-hosts-file) KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 157:     --client-host) CLIENT_HOST="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 158:     --exit-host) EXIT_HOST="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 159:     --relay-host) RELAY_HOST="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 160:     --client-node-id) CLIENT_NODE_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 161:     --exit-node-id) EXIT_NODE_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 162:     --relay-node-id) RELAY_NODE_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 163:     --client-network-id) CLIENT_NETWORK_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 164:     --exit-network-id) EXIT_NETWORK_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 165:     --relay-network-id) RELAY_NETWORK_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 166:     --client-underlay-ip) CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 167:     --exit-underlay-ip) EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 168:     --relay-underlay-ip) RELAY_UNDERLAY_IP="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 169:     --nat-profile) NAT_PROFILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 170:     --impairment-profile) IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 171:     --ssh-allow-cidrs) SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 172:     --failback-recovery-slo-secs)
 173:       parse_positive_integer "--failback-recovery-slo-secs" "$2"
 174:       FAILBACK_RECOVERY_SLO_SECS="$2"
 175:       shift 2
 176:       ;;
 177:     --failback-monitor-iterations)
 178:       parse_positive_integer "--failback-monitor-iterations" "$2"
 179:       FAILBACK_MONITOR_ITERATIONS="$2"
 180:       shift 2
 181:       ;;
 182:     --report-path) REPORT_PATH="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 183:     --log-path) LOG_PATH="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 184:     -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
 185:     *) echo "unknown argument: $1" >&2; usage; exit 2 ;;
 186:   esac
 187: done
 188: 
 189: if [[ -z "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE" || -z "$CLIENT_HOST" || -z "$EXIT_HOST" || -z "$RELAY_HOST" || -z "$CLIENT_NODE_ID" || -z "$EXIT_NODE_ID" || -z "$RELAY_NODE_ID" || -z "$CLIENT_NETWORK_ID" || -z "$EXIT_NETWORK_ID" || -z "$RELAY_NETWORK_ID" ]]; then
 190:   usage >&2
 191:   exit 2
 192: fi
 193: if [[ -z "$NAT_PROFILE" || -z "$IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE" ]]; then
 194:   echo "--nat-profile and --impairment-profile must be non-empty" >&2
 195:   exit 2
 196: fi
 197: 
 198: if [[ "$CLIENT_HOST" == "$EXIT_HOST" || "$CLIENT_HOST" == "$RELAY_HOST" || "$EXIT_HOST" == "$RELAY_HOST" ]]; then
 199:   echo "client, exit, and relay hosts must all differ" >&2
 200:   exit 2
 201: fi
 202: 
 203: if [[ -n "$CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
 204:   cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops validate-ipv4-address --ip "$CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP" >/dev/null
 205: fi
 206: if [[ -n "$EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
 207:   cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops validate-ipv4-address --ip "$EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP" >/dev/null
 208: fi
 209: if [[ -n "$RELAY_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
 210:   cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops validate-ipv4-address --ip "$RELAY_UNDERLAY_IP" >/dev/null
 211: fi
 212: if [[ -n "$KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE" ]]; then
 213:   export LIVE_LAB_PINNED_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE="$KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE"
 214: fi
 215: 
 216: mkdir -p "$(dirname "$REPORT_PATH")" "$(dirname "$LOG_PATH")"
 217: : > "$LOG_PATH"
 218: exec >> "$LOG_PATH" 2>&1
 219: 
 220: main() {
 221:   local relay_rc bypass_status
 222:   local switch_ts first_switch_ts reconvergence_secs first_switch_json
 223:   local local_ts
 224:   local client_status client_route client_endpoints client_netcheck
 225:   local issue_env assign_pub_local exit_assignment_local relay_assignment_local client_assignment_local
 226:   local exit_refresh_local relay_refresh_local client_refresh_local
 227:   local client_status_after_roam client_netcheck_after_roam client_route_after_roam client_endpoints_after_roam
 228:   local artifact_dir
 229:   local route_leak_samples signed_state_invalid_samples netcheck_invalid route_has_underlay_dev
 230:   local route_line
 231:   local final_direct_path_live final_signed_state_healthy
 232: 
 233:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="bootstrapping relay remote-exit path before failback"
 234:   WORK_DIR="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/rustynet-cross-network-failback-roaming.XXXXXX")"
 235:   artifact_dir="$(dirname "$REPORT_PATH")"
 236:   RELAY_REPORT_PATH="$artifact_dir/cross_network_failback_roaming_relay_stage_report.json"
 237:   RELAY_LOG_PATH="$artifact_dir/cross_network_failback_roaming_relay_stage.log"
 238:   BYPASS_REPORT_PATH="$artifact_dir/cross_network_failback_roaming_server_ip_bypass_report.json"
 239:   BYPASS_LOG_PATH="$artifact_dir/cross_network_failback_roaming_server_ip_bypass.log"
 240:   FAILBACK_MONITOR_LOG="$artifact_dir/cross_network_failback_roaming_monitor.log"
 241:   FAILBACK_SLO_SUMMARY_PATH="$artifact_dir/cross_network_failback_roaming_slo_summary.json"
 242:   SSH_TRUST_SUMMARY_PATH="$artifact_dir/cross_network_failback_roaming_ssh_trust_summary.txt"
 243:   SOURCE_ARTIFACTS=("$RELAY_REPORT_PATH" "$BYPASS_REPORT_PATH" "$FAILBACK_SLO_SUMMARY_PATH" "$SSH_TRUST_SUMMARY_PATH")
 244:   LOG_ARTIFACTS=("$RELAY_LOG_PATH" "$BYPASS_LOG_PATH" "$FAILBACK_MONITOR_LOG")
 245: 
 246:   if RUSTYNET_EXPECTED_GIT_COMMIT="${RUSTYNET_EXPECTED_GIT_COMMIT:-}" \
 247:     bash "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/e2e/live_linux_cross_network_relay_remote_exit_test.sh" \
 248:       --ssh-identity-file "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE" \
 249:       --client-host "$CLIENT_HOST" \
 250:       --exit-host "$EXIT_HOST" \
 251:       --relay-host "$RELAY_HOST" \
 252:       --client-node-id "$CLIENT_NODE_ID" \
 253:       --exit-node-id "$EXIT_NODE_ID" \
 254:       --relay-node-id "$RELAY_NODE_ID" \
 255:       --client-network-id "$CLIENT_NETWORK_ID" \
 256:       --exit-network-id "$EXIT_NETWORK_ID" \
 257:       --relay-network-id "$RELAY_NETWORK_ID" \
 258:       --client-underlay-ip "${CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP:-}" \
 259:       --exit-underlay-ip "${EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP:-}" \
 260:       --relay-underlay-ip "${RELAY_UNDERLAY_IP:-}" \
 261:       --nat-profile "$NAT_PROFILE" \
 262:       --impairment-profile "$IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE" \
 263:       --ssh-allow-cidrs "$SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS" \
 264:       --report-path "$RELAY_REPORT_PATH" \
 265:       --log-path "$RELAY_LOG_PATH"; then
 266:     relay_rc=0
 267:   else
 268:     relay_rc=$?
 269:   fi
 270: 
 271:   if [[ ! -f "$RELAY_REPORT_PATH" ]]; then
 272:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="relay bootstrap validator failed before emitting evidence"
 273:     return 1
 274:   fi
 275: 
 276:   if [[ -n "$CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
 277:     CLIENT_ADDR="$CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP"
 278:   else
 279:     CLIENT_ADDR="$(live_lab_resolved_target_address "$CLIENT_HOST")"
 280:   fi
 281:   if [[ -n "$EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
 282:     EXIT_ADDR="$EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP"
 283:   else
 284:     EXIT_ADDR="$(live_lab_resolved_target_address "$EXIT_HOST")"
 285:   fi
 286:   if [[ -n "$RELAY_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
 287:     RELAY_ADDR="$RELAY_UNDERLAY_IP"
 288:   else
 289:     RELAY_ADDR="$(live_lab_resolved_target_address "$RELAY_HOST")"
 290:   fi
 291: 
 292:   topology_result="$(cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops classify-cross-network-topology --ip-a "$CLIENT_ADDR" --ip-b "$EXIT_ADDR")" || return 1
 293:   if [[ "$topology_result" == "pass" ]]; then
 294:     CHECK_CROSS_NETWORK_TOPOLOGY_HEURISTIC="pass"
 295:   else
 296:     CHECK_CROSS_NETWORK_TOPOLOGY_HEURISTIC="fail"
 297:   fi
 298: 
 299:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="initializing failback and roaming live-lab runtime"
 300:   live_lab_init "rustynet-cross-network-failback-roaming" "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE"
 301:   live_lab_push_sudo_password "$EXIT_HOST"
 302:   live_lab_push_sudo_password "$RELAY_HOST"
 303:   live_lab_push_sudo_password "$CLIENT_HOST"
 304:   live_lab_write_ssh_trust_summary "$SSH_TRUST_SUMMARY_PATH" "$CLIENT_HOST" "$EXIT_HOST" "$RELAY_HOST"
 305:   live_lab_wait_for_daemon_socket "$EXIT_HOST"
 306:   live_lab_wait_for_daemon_socket "$RELAY_HOST"
 307:   live_lab_wait_for_daemon_socket "$CLIENT_HOST"
 308: 
 309:   : > "$FAILBACK_MONITOR_LOG"
 310:   switch_ts="$(date +%s)"
 311:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="switching client from relay exit to direct exit"
 312:   live_lab_apply_role_coupling "$CLIENT_HOST" "client" "$EXIT_NODE_ID" "false" "/etc/rustynet/assignment-refresh.env"
 313: 
 314:   first_switch_ts=""
 315:   route_leak_samples=0
 316:   signed_state_invalid_samples=0
 317:   for ((i=1; i<=FAILBACK_MONITOR_ITERATIONS; i++)); do
 318:     local_ts="$(date +%s)"
 319:     client_status="$(live_lab_status "$CLIENT_HOST")"
 320:     client_route="$(live_lab_capture "$CLIENT_HOST" "ip -4 route get 1.1.1.1 || true")"
 321:     client_endpoints="$(live_lab_capture_root "$CLIENT_HOST" "root wg show rustynet0 endpoints || true")"
 322:     client_netcheck="$(live_lab_capture_root "$CLIENT_HOST" "root env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet netcheck || true")"
 323: 
 324:     netcheck_invalid=0
 325:     if [[ "$client_netcheck" == *"traversal_alarm_state=critical"* || "$client_netcheck" == *"traversal_alarm_state=error"* || "$client_netcheck" == *"traversal_alarm_state=missing"* ]]; then
 326:       netcheck_invalid=1
 327:     fi
 328:     if [[ "$client_netcheck" != *"traversal_error=none"* ]]; then
 329:       netcheck_invalid=1
 330:     fi
 331:     if (( netcheck_invalid != 0 )); then
 332:       signed_state_invalid_samples=$((signed_state_invalid_samples + 1))
 333:     fi
 334: 
 335:     route_has_underlay_dev=0
 336:     while IFS= read -r route_line; do
 337:       [[ -n "$route_line" ]] || continue
 338:       if [[ "$route_line" =~ [[:space:]]dev[[:space:]]([^[:space:]]+) ]]; then
 339:         if [[ "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}" != "rustynet0" ]]; then
 340:           route_has_underlay_dev=1
 341:           break
 342:         fi
 343:       fi
 344:     done <<< "$client_route"
 345:     if (( route_has_underlay_dev != 0 )); then
 346:       route_leak_samples=$((route_leak_samples + 1))
 347:     fi
 348: 
 349:     printf '%s|iter=%s|route=%s|status=%s|endpoints=%s|netcheck=%s\n' \
 350:       "$local_ts" "$i" \
 351:       "$(printf '%s' "$client_route" | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ';')" \
 352:       "$(printf '%s' "$client_status" | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ';')" \
 353:       "$(printf '%s' "$client_endpoints" | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ';')" \
 354:       "$(printf '%s' "$client_netcheck" | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ';')" >> "$FAILBACK_MONITOR_LOG"
 355:     if [[ -z "$first_switch_ts" ]] && grep -Fq "exit_node=${EXIT_NODE_ID}" <<<"$client_status" && grep -Fq 'dev rustynet0' <<<"$client_route" && [[ "$client_netcheck" == *"path_mode=direct_active"* ]] && [[ "$client_netcheck" == *"path_live_proven=true"* ]]; then
 356:       first_switch_ts="$local_ts"
 357:     fi
 358:     sleep 1
 359:   done
 360: 
 361:   if [[ -n "$first_switch_ts" ]]; then
 362:     reconvergence_secs=$((first_switch_ts - switch_ts))
 363:   else
 364:     reconvergence_secs=-1
 365:   fi
 366: 
 367:   relay_ready_check="$(cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops read-cross-network-report-fields --report-path "$RELAY_REPORT_PATH" --check relay_remote_exit_success)" || return 1
 368:   if [[ "$relay_ready_check" == 'pass' && "$CHECK_CROSS_NETWORK_TOPOLOGY_HEURISTIC" == 'pass' && "$reconvergence_secs" -ge 0 && "$reconvergence_secs" -le "$FAILBACK_RECOVERY_SLO_SECS" ]]; then
 369:     CHECK_FAILBACK_RECOVERY_SLO="pass"
 370:   fi
 371:   if [[ "$route_leak_samples" -eq 0 ]]; then
 372:     CHECK_NO_UNDERLAY_LEAK_DURING_FAILBACK="pass"
 373:   fi
 374:   if [[ "$signed_state_invalid_samples" -eq 0 ]]; then
 375:     CHECK_SIGNED_STATE_VALID_DURING_FAILBACK="pass"
 376:   fi
 377: 
 378:   if [[ "$CHECK_FAILBACK_RECOVERY_SLO" == 'pass' && "$CHECK_NO_UNDERLAY_LEAK_DURING_FAILBACK" == 'pass' && "$CHECK_SIGNED_STATE_VALID_DURING_FAILBACK" == 'pass' ]]; then
 379:     CHECK_RELAY_TO_DIRECT_FAILBACK_SUCCESS="pass"
 380:   fi
 381: 
 382:   first_switch_json="null"
 383:   if [[ -n "$first_switch_ts" ]]; then
 384:     first_switch_json="$first_switch_ts"
 385:   fi
 386:   cat > "$FAILBACK_SLO_SUMMARY_PATH" <<EOF
 387: {
 388:   "switch_unix": $switch_ts,
 389:   "first_direct_unix": $first_switch_json,
 390:   "reconvergence_secs": $reconvergence_secs,
 391:   "recovery_slo_secs": $FAILBACK_RECOVERY_SLO_SECS,
 392:   "monitor_iterations": $FAILBACK_MONITOR_ITERATIONS,
 393:   "underlay_leak_samples": $route_leak_samples,
 394:   "signed_state_invalid_samples": $signed_state_invalid_samples,
 395:   "checks": {
 396:     "failback_reconnect_within_slo": "$CHECK_FAILBACK_RECOVERY_SLO",
 397:     "no_underlay_leak_while_reconnecting": "$CHECK_NO_UNDERLAY_LEAK_DURING_FAILBACK",
 398:     "signed_state_valid_while_reconnecting": "$CHECK_SIGNED_STATE_VALID_DURING_FAILBACK"
 399:   }
 400: }
 401: EOF
 402: 
 403:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="computing endpoint roam alias and issuing updated signed assignments"
 404:   mapfile -t roam_values < <(
 405:     cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops choose-cross-network-roam-alias \
 406:       --exit-ip "$EXIT_ADDR" \
 407:       --used-ip "$EXIT_ADDR" \
 408:       --used-ip "$CLIENT_ADDR" \
 409:       --used-ip "$RELAY_ADDR"
 410:   ) || return 1
 411:   ROAM_ALIAS_IP="${roam_values[0]}"
 412:   ROAM_PREFIX="${roam_values[1]}"
 413:   ROAM_INTERFACE="$(live_lab_capture "$EXIT_HOST" "ip -4 route get '$CLIENT_ADDR' 2>/dev/null | awk '{for (i=1; i<=NF; i++) if (\$i == \"dev\") {print \$(i+1); exit}}' || true")"
 414:   if [[ -z "$ROAM_INTERFACE" ]]; then
 415:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="failed to determine exit underlay interface for endpoint roam"
 416:     return 1
 417:   fi
 418: 
 419:   live_lab_run_root "$EXIT_HOST" "root ip addr show dev '$ROAM_INTERFACE' | grep -Fq '${ROAM_ALIAS_IP}/${ROAM_PREFIX}' || root ip addr add '${ROAM_ALIAS_IP}/${ROAM_PREFIX}' dev '$ROAM_INTERFACE'"
 420: 
 421:   issue_env="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/rn_issue_cross_network_roam.env"
 422:   assign_pub_local="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/assignment.pub"
 423:   exit_assignment_local="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/assignment-exit"
 424:   relay_assignment_local="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/assignment-relay"
 425:   client_assignment_local="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/assignment-client"
 426:   exit_refresh_local="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/assignment-refresh-exit.env"
 427:   relay_refresh_local="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/assignment-refresh-relay.env"
 428:   client_refresh_local="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/assignment-refresh-client.env"
 429: 
 430:   EXIT_PUB_HEX="$(live_lab_collect_pubkey_hex "$EXIT_HOST")"
 431:   RELAY_PUB_HEX="$(live_lab_collect_pubkey_hex "$RELAY_HOST")"
 432:   CLIENT_PUB_HEX="$(live_lab_collect_pubkey_hex "$CLIENT_HOST")"
 433:   NODES_SPEC="${EXIT_NODE_ID}|${ROAM_ALIAS_IP}:51820|${EXIT_PUB_HEX};${RELAY_NODE_ID}|${RELAY_ADDR}:51820|${RELAY_PUB_HEX};${CLIENT_NODE_ID}|${CLIENT_ADDR}:51820|${CLIENT_PUB_HEX}"
 434:   ALLOW_SPEC="${CLIENT_NODE_ID}|${RELAY_NODE_ID};${RELAY_NODE_ID}|${CLIENT_NODE_ID};${CLIENT_NODE_ID}|${EXIT_NODE_ID};${EXIT_NODE_ID}|${CLIENT_NODE_ID};${RELAY_NODE_ID}|${EXIT_NODE_ID};${EXIT_NODE_ID}|${RELAY_NODE_ID}"
 435: 
 436:   : > "$issue_env"
 437:   live_lab_append_env_assignment "$issue_env" "NODES_SPEC" "$NODES_SPEC"
 438:   live_lab_append_env_assignment "$issue_env" "ALLOW_SPEC" "$ALLOW_SPEC"
 439:   live_lab_append_env_assignment "$issue_env" "ASSIGNMENTS_SPEC" "${EXIT_NODE_ID}|-;${RELAY_NODE_ID}|${EXIT_NODE_ID};${CLIENT_NODE_ID}|${EXIT_NODE_ID}"
 440: 
 441:   live_lab_issue_assignment_bundles_from_env "$EXIT_HOST" "$issue_env" "/tmp/rn_issue_cross_network_roam.env"
 442: 
 443:   live_lab_capture_root "$EXIT_HOST" "root cat /run/rustynet/assignment-issue/rn-assignment.pub" > "$assign_pub_local"
 444:   live_lab_capture_root "$EXIT_HOST" "root cat /run/rustynet/assignment-issue/rn-assignment-$EXIT_NODE_ID.assignment" > "$exit_assignment_local"
 445:   live_lab_capture_root "$EXIT_HOST" "root cat /run/rustynet/assignment-issue/rn-assignment-$RELAY_NODE_ID.assignment" > "$relay_assignment_local"
 446:   live_lab_capture_root "$EXIT_HOST" "root cat /run/rustynet/assignment-issue/rn-assignment-$CLIENT_NODE_ID.assignment" > "$client_assignment_local"
 447: 
 448:   live_lab_install_assignment_bundle "$EXIT_HOST" "$assign_pub_local" "$exit_assignment_local"
 449:   live_lab_install_assignment_bundle "$RELAY_HOST" "$assign_pub_local" "$relay_assignment_local"
 450:   live_lab_install_assignment_bundle "$CLIENT_HOST" "$assign_pub_local" "$client_assignment_local"
 451: 
 452:   live_lab_write_assignment_refresh_env "$exit_refresh_local" "$EXIT_NODE_ID" "$NODES_SPEC" "$ALLOW_SPEC"
 453:   live_lab_write_assignment_refresh_env "$relay_refresh_local" "$RELAY_NODE_ID" "$NODES_SPEC" "$ALLOW_SPEC" "$EXIT_NODE_ID"
 454:   live_lab_write_assignment_refresh_env "$client_refresh_local" "$CLIENT_NODE_ID" "$NODES_SPEC" "$ALLOW_SPEC" "$EXIT_NODE_ID"
 455:   live_lab_install_assignment_refresh_env "$EXIT_HOST" "$exit_refresh_local"
 456:   live_lab_install_assignment_refresh_env "$RELAY_HOST" "$relay_refresh_local"
 457:   live_lab_install_assignment_refresh_env "$CLIENT_HOST" "$client_refresh_local"
 458: 
 459:   live_lab_enforce_host "$EXIT_HOST" "admin" "$EXIT_NODE_ID" "$SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS" "$(live_lab_remote_src_dir "$EXIT_HOST")"
 460:   live_lab_enforce_host "$RELAY_HOST" "admin" "$RELAY_NODE_ID" "$SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS" "$(live_lab_remote_src_dir "$RELAY_HOST")"
 461:   live_lab_enforce_host "$CLIENT_HOST" "client" "$CLIENT_NODE_ID" "$SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS" "$(live_lab_remote_src_dir "$CLIENT_HOST")"
 462:   live_lab_wait_for_daemon_socket "$EXIT_HOST"
 463:   live_lab_wait_for_daemon_socket "$RELAY_HOST"
 464:   live_lab_wait_for_daemon_socket "$CLIENT_HOST"
 465:   live_lab_retry_root "$EXIT_HOST" "root env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet route advertise 0.0.0.0/0" 10 2
 466:   live_lab_retry_root "$RELAY_HOST" "root env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet route advertise 0.0.0.0/0" 10 2
 467:   sleep 5
 468: 
 469:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="capturing endpoint roam recovery evidence"
 470:   client_status_after_roam="$(live_lab_status "$CLIENT_HOST")"
 471:   client_netcheck_after_roam="$(live_lab_capture_root "$CLIENT_HOST" "root env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet netcheck || true")"
 472:   PATH_STATUS_LINE="$client_netcheck_after_roam"
 473:   client_route_after_roam="$(live_lab_capture "$CLIENT_HOST" "ip -4 route get 1.1.1.1 || true")"
 474:   client_endpoints_after_roam="$(live_lab_capture_root "$CLIENT_HOST" "root wg show rustynet0 endpoints || true")"
 475:   live_lab_log "Client status after roam"
 476:   printf '%s\n' "$client_status_after_roam"
 477:   live_lab_log "Client netcheck after roam"
 478:   printf '%s\n' "$client_netcheck_after_roam"
 479:   live_lab_log "Client route after roam"
 480:   printf '%s\n' "$client_route_after_roam"
 481:   live_lab_log "Client endpoints after roam"
 482:   printf '%s\n' "$client_endpoints_after_roam"
 483: 
 484:   final_direct_path_live=0
 485:   if [[ "$client_netcheck_after_roam" == *"path_mode=direct_active"* && "$client_netcheck_after_roam" == *"path_live_proven=true"* ]]; then
 486:     final_direct_path_live=1
 487:   fi
 488:   final_signed_state_healthy=0
 489:   if [[ "$client_netcheck_after_roam" != *"traversal_alarm_state=critical"* && "$client_netcheck_after_roam" != *"traversal_alarm_state=error"* && "$client_netcheck_after_roam" != *"traversal_alarm_state=missing"* && "$client_netcheck_after_roam" != *"dns_alarm_state=critical"* && "$client_netcheck_after_roam" != *"dns_alarm_state=error"* && "$client_netcheck_after_roam" != *"dns_alarm_state=missing"* && "$client_netcheck_after_roam" == *"traversal_error=none"* ]]; then
 490:     final_signed_state_healthy=1
 491:   fi
 492: 
 493:   if (( final_direct_path_live == 1 )) && (( final_signed_state_healthy == 1 )) && grep -Fq "exit_node=${EXIT_NODE_ID}" <<<"$client_status_after_roam" && grep -Fq 'dev rustynet0' <<<"$client_route_after_roam" && grep -Fq "${ROAM_ALIAS_IP}:51820" <<<"$client_endpoints_after_roam"; then
 494:     CHECK_ENDPOINT_ROAM_RECOVERY_SUCCESS="pass"
 495:   fi
 496: 
 497:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="validating narrow server-IP bypass and leak resistance after endpoint roam"
 498:   if RUSTYNET_EXPECTED_GIT_COMMIT="${RUSTYNET_EXPECTED_GIT_COMMIT:-}" \
 499:     bash "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/e2e/live_linux_server_ip_bypass_test.sh" \
 500:       --ssh-identity-file "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE" \
 501:       --client-host "$CLIENT_HOST" \
 502:       --probe-host "$EXIT_HOST" \
 503:       --probe-bind-ip "$ROAM_ALIAS_IP" \
 504:       --ssh-allow-cidrs "$SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS" \
 505:       --report-path "$BYPASS_REPORT_PATH" \
 506:       --log-path "$BYPASS_LOG_PATH"; then
 507:     bypass_status=0
 508:   else
 509:     bypass_status=$?
 510:   fi
 511: 
 512:   if [[ "$bypass_status" -ne 0 && ! -f "$BYPASS_REPORT_PATH" ]]; then
 513:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="server-IP bypass validator failed before emitting failback/roaming evidence"
 514:     return 1
 515:   fi
 516: 
 517:   mapfile -t bypass_results < <(
 518:     cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops read-cross-network-report-fields \
 519:       --report-path "$BYPASS_REPORT_PATH" \
 520:       --check internet_route_via_rustynet0 \
 521:       --check probe_service_blocked_from_client
 522:   ) || return 1
 523: 
 524:   if [[ "${bypass_results[0]}" == 'pass' && "${bypass_results[1]}" == 'pass' ]]; then
 525:     CHECK_REMOTE_EXIT_NO_UNDERLAY_LEAK="pass"
 526:   fi
 527: 
 528:   if [[ "$CHECK_RELAY_TO_DIRECT_FAILBACK_SUCCESS" != 'pass' ]]; then
 529:     if [[ "$CHECK_FAILBACK_RECOVERY_SLO" != 'pass' ]]; then
 530:       FAILURE_SUMMARY="relay-to-direct failback exceeded reconnect SLO (${FAILBACK_RECOVERY_SLO_SECS}s), measured=${reconvergence_secs}s"
 531:     elif [[ "$CHECK_NO_UNDERLAY_LEAK_DURING_FAILBACK" != 'pass' ]]; then
 532:       FAILURE_SUMMARY="underlay leak detected while reconnecting during relay-to-direct failback"
 533:     elif [[ "$CHECK_SIGNED_STATE_VALID_DURING_FAILBACK" != 'pass' ]]; then
 534:       FAILURE_SUMMARY="signed traversal state became invalid while reconnecting during relay-to-direct failback"
 535:     else
 536:       FAILURE_SUMMARY="relay-to-direct failback did not reconverge securely"
 537:     fi
 538:     return 1
 539:   fi
 540:   if [[ "$CHECK_ENDPOINT_ROAM_RECOVERY_SUCCESS" != 'pass' ]]; then
 541:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="client did not recover after signed endpoint roam"
 542:     return 1
 543:   fi
 544:   if [[ "$CHECK_REMOTE_EXIT_NO_UNDERLAY_LEAK" != 'pass' ]]; then
 545:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="post-roam path leaked or could not prove leak resistance"
 546:     return 1
 547:   fi
 548: 
 549:   FAILURE_SUMMARY=""
 550:   [[ "$relay_rc" -eq 0 ]]
 551: }
 552: 
 553: if main; then
 554:   write_report pass
 555:   REPORT_WRITTEN=1
 556: else
 557:   write_report fail
 558:   REPORT_WRITTEN=1
 559:   exit 1
 560: fi
 561: 
 562: live_lab_log "Cross-network failback and roaming report written: $REPORT_PATH"

  72: validate_positive_integer() {
  73:   local name="$1"
  74:   local value="$2"
  75:   if [[ ! "$value" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || (( value <= 0 )); then
  76:     echo "$name must be a positive integer (got: $value)" >&2
  77:     exit 2
  78:   fi
  79: }

  81: extract_netcheck_value() {
  82:   local netcheck="$1"
  83:   local key="$2"
  84:   printf '%s\n' "$netcheck" | tr ' ' '\n' | awk -F '=' -v key="$key" '$1 == key { print $2; exit }'
  85: }
  86: 
  87: netcheck_is_valid() {
  88:   local netcheck="$1"
  89:   [[ "$netcheck" == *"traversal_error=none"* ]] || return 1
  90:   [[ "$netcheck" != *"traversal_alarm_state=critical"* ]] || return 1
  91:   [[ "$netcheck" != *"traversal_alarm_state=error"* ]] || return 1
  92:   [[ "$netcheck" != *"traversal_alarm_state=missing"* ]] || return 1
  93:   [[ "$netcheck" != *"dns_alarm_state=critical"* ]] || return 1
  94:   [[ "$netcheck" != *"dns_alarm_state=error"* ]] || return 1
  95:   [[ "$netcheck" != *"dns_alarm_state=missing"* ]] || return 1
  96:   return 0
  97: }

  99: join_existing_artifacts() {
 100:   local joined=""
 101:   local item
 102:   for item in "$@"; do
 103:     [[ -n "$item" && -f "$item" ]] || continue
 104:     if [[ -n "$joined" ]]; then
 105:       joined+=$'\x1f'
 106:     fi
 107:     joined+="$item"
 108:   done
 109:   printf '%s' "$joined"
 110: }

 112: choose_alias() {

 114:     cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops choose-cross-network-roam-alias \

 117:       --used-ip "$EXIT_ADDR"

 120:   ALIAS_PREFIX="${alias_values[1]:-}"
 121:   if [[ -z "$ALIAS_IP" || -z "$ALIAS_PREFIX" ]]; then
 122:     echo "failed to choose roam alias for client endpoint switch" >&2
 123:     return 1
 124:   fi
 125: }

 137: apply_alias_switch() {
 138:   local target="$1"
 139:   local iface="$2"
 140:   local alias_ip="$3"
 141:   local alias_prefix="$4"
 142:   live_lab_run_root "$target" "
 143: root ip addr show dev '$iface' | grep -Fq '${alias_ip}/${alias_prefix}' || root ip addr add '${alias_ip}/${alias_prefix}' dev '$iface'
 144: root ip route replace default dev '$iface' src '$alias_ip'
 145: "
 146: }

 148: clear_alias_switch() {
 149:   local target="$1"
 150:   local iface="$2"
 151:   local alias_ip="$3"
 152:   local alias_prefix="$4"
 153:   local original_default="$5"
 154:   live_lab_run_root "$target" "
 155: if [[ -n '$original_default' ]]; then
 156:   while IFS= read -r line; do
 157:     [[ -n \"\$line\" ]] || continue
 158:     root ip route replace \$line || true
 159:   done <<< '$original_default'
 160: fi
 161: root ip addr del '${alias_ip}/${alias_prefix}' dev '$iface' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 162: " >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 163: }

 289:         "nat_profile": os.environ["NAT_PROFILE_ENV"],
 290:         "impairment_profile": os.environ["IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE_ENV"],
 291:     },
 292:     "checks": {
 293:         "node_network_switch_success": os.environ["CHECK_NODE_NETWORK_SWITCH_SUCCESS_ENV"],
 294:         "direct_remote_exit_ready": os.environ["CHECK_DIRECT_REMOTE_EXIT_READY_ENV"],
 295:         "endpoint_change_detected": os.environ["CHECK_ENDPOINT_CHANGE_DETECTED_ENV"],
 296:         "traversal_reissue_triggered": os.environ["CHECK_TRAVERSAL_REISSUE_TRIGGERED_ENV"],
 297:         "session_reconnect_within_slo": os.environ["CHECK_SESSION_RECONNECT_WITHIN_SLO_ENV"],
 298:         "peer_received_updated_endpoint_hint": os.environ["CHECK_PEER_RECEIVED_UPDATED_ENDPOINT_HINT_ENV"],
 299:         "no_underlay_leak_during_transition": os.environ["CHECK_NO_UNDERLAY_LEAK_DURING_TRANSITION_ENV"],
 300:         "signed_state_valid_during_transition": os.environ["CHECK_SIGNED_STATE_VALID_DURING_TRANSITION_ENV"],
 301:         "cross_network_topology_heuristic": os.environ["CHECK_CROSS_NETWORK_TOPOLOGY_HEURISTIC_ENV"],
 302:         "no_plaintext_passphrase_files": os.environ["CHECK_NO_PLAINTEXT_PASSPHRASE_FILES_ENV"],
 303:     },
 304:     "source_artifacts": split_paths(os.environ.get("SOURCE_ARTIFACTS_ENV", "")),
 305:     "log_artifacts": split_paths(os.environ.get("LOG_ARTIFACTS_ENV", "")),
 306:     "implementation_state": "live_measured_validator",
 307: }
 308: 
 309: if payload["status"] == "fail":
 310:     payload["failure_summary"] = os.environ.get("FAILURE_SUMMARY_ENV", "").strip()
 311: 
 312: report_path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
 313: PY
 314: }
 315: 
 316: cleanup() {
 317:   local rc=$?
 318:   set +e
 319:   if [[ -n "$CLIENT_HOST" && -n "$CLIENT_IFACE" && -n "$ALIAS_IP" && -n "$ALIAS_PREFIX" ]]; then
 320:     clear_alias_switch "$CLIENT_HOST" "$CLIENT_IFACE" "$ALIAS_IP" "$ALIAS_PREFIX" "$ORIGINAL_ROUTE_SNAPSHOT"
 321:   fi
 322:   if [[ "$REPORT_WRITTEN" -eq 0 ]]; then
 323:     write_report fail
 324:   fi
 325:   REPORT_WRITTEN=1
 326:   if [[ -n "$WORK_DIR" && -d "$WORK_DIR" ]]; then
 327:     rm -rf "$WORK_DIR"
 328:   fi
 329:   live_lab_cleanup
 330:   exit "$rc"
 331: }
 332: 
 333: trap cleanup EXIT
 334: 
 335: while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
 336:   case "$1" in
 337:     --ssh-identity-file) SSH_IDENTITY_FILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 338:     --client-host) CLIENT_HOST="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 339:     --exit-host) EXIT_HOST="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 340:     --client-node-id) CLIENT_NODE_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 341:     --exit-node-id) EXIT_NODE_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 342:     --client-network-id) CLIENT_NETWORK_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 343:     --exit-network-id) EXIT_NETWORK_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 344:     --client-underlay-ip) CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 345:     --exit-underlay-ip) EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 346:     --nat-profile) NAT_PROFILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 347:     --impairment-profile) IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 348:     --ssh-allow-cidrs) SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 349:     --reconnect-slo-secs) RECONNECT_SLO_SECS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 350:     --report-path) REPORT_PATH="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 351:     --log-path) LOG_PATH="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 352:     -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
 353:     *) echo "unknown argument: $1" >&2; usage; exit 2 ;;
 354:   esac
 355: done
 356: 
 357: if [[ -z "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE" || -z "$CLIENT_HOST" || -z "$EXIT_HOST" || -z "$CLIENT_NODE_ID" || -z "$EXIT_NODE_ID" || -z "$CLIENT_NETWORK_ID" || -z "$EXIT_NETWORK_ID" ]]; then
 358:   usage >&2
 359:   exit 2
 360: fi
 361: if [[ -z "$NAT_PROFILE" || -z "$IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE" ]]; then
 362:   echo "--nat-profile and --impairment-profile must be non-empty" >&2
 363:   exit 2
 364: fi
 365: 
 366: if [[ "$CLIENT_HOST" == "$EXIT_HOST" ]]; then
 367:   echo "--client-host and --exit-host must differ" >&2
 368:   exit 2
 369: fi
 370: 
 371: if [[ "$CLIENT_NETWORK_ID" == "$EXIT_NETWORK_ID" ]]; then
 372:   echo "--client-network-id and --exit-network-id must differ" >&2
 373:   exit 2
 374: fi
 375: 
 376: if [[ -n "$CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
 377:   cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops validate-ipv4-address --ip "$CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP" >/dev/null
 378: fi
 379: if [[ -n "$EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
 380:   cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops validate-ipv4-address --ip "$EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP" >/dev/null
 381: fi
 382: 
 383: validate_positive_integer "reconnect slo seconds" "$RECONNECT_SLO_SECS"
 384: 
 385: mkdir -p "$(dirname "$REPORT_PATH")" "$(dirname "$LOG_PATH")"
 386: : > "$LOG_PATH"
 387: exec >> "$LOG_PATH" 2>&1
 388: 
 389: main() {
 390:   local direct_rc
 391:   local route_leak_samples signed_state_invalid_samples
 392:   local local_ts reconnect_unix reconnect_secs
 393:   local client_status client_route client_netcheck exit_netcheck client_endpoints exit_endpoints
 394:   local pre_change_fingerprint post_change_fingerprint
 395:   local pre_reissue_events post_reissue_events
 396:   local client_plaintext_start exit_plaintext_start
 397:   local client_plaintext_end exit_plaintext_end
 398:   local alias_apply_rc=0
 399:   local artifact_dir
 400: 
 401:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="preparing node network-switch artifacts"
 402:   WORK_DIR="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/rustynet-cross-network-node-switch.XXXXXX")"
 403:   artifact_dir="$(dirname "$REPORT_PATH")"
 404:   DIRECT_REPORT_PATH="$artifact_dir/cross_network_node_network_switch_direct_stage_report.json"
 405:   DIRECT_LOG_PATH="$artifact_dir/cross_network_node_network_switch_direct_stage.log"
 406:   MONITOR_LOG_PATH="$artifact_dir/cross_network_node_network_switch_monitor.log"
 407:   MONITOR_SUMMARY_PATH="$artifact_dir/cross_network_node_network_switch_summary.json"
 408:   SOURCE_ARTIFACTS=(
 409:     "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/e2e/live_linux_cross_network_node_network_switch_test.sh"
 410:     "$DIRECT_REPORT_PATH"
 411:     "$MONITOR_SUMMARY_PATH"
 412:   )
 413:   LOG_ARTIFACTS=(
 414:     "$DIRECT_LOG_PATH"
 415:     "$MONITOR_LOG_PATH"
 416:   )
 417: 
 418:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="bootstrapping direct remote-exit path before node network-switch simulation"
 419:   if RUSTYNET_EXPECTED_GIT_COMMIT="${RUSTYNET_EXPECTED_GIT_COMMIT:-}" \
 420:     bash "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/e2e/live_linux_cross_network_direct_remote_exit_test.sh" \
 421:       --ssh-identity-file "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE" \
 422:       --client-host "$CLIENT_HOST" \
 423:       --exit-host "$EXIT_HOST" \
 424:       --client-node-id "$CLIENT_NODE_ID" \
 425:       --exit-node-id "$EXIT_NODE_ID" \
 426:       --client-network-id "$CLIENT_NETWORK_ID" \
 427:       --exit-network-id "$EXIT_NETWORK_ID" \
 428:       --client-underlay-ip "${CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP:-}" \
 429:       --exit-underlay-ip "${EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP:-}" \
 430:       --nat-profile "$NAT_PROFILE" \
 431:       --impairment-profile "$IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE" \
 432:       --ssh-allow-cidrs "$SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS" \
 433:       --report-path "$DIRECT_REPORT_PATH" \
 434:       --log-path "$DIRECT_LOG_PATH"; then
 435:     direct_rc=0
 436:   else
 437:     direct_rc=$?
 438:   fi
 439: 
 440:   if [[ ! -f "$DIRECT_REPORT_PATH" ]]; then
 441:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="direct baseline validator failed before emitting evidence"
 442:     return 1
 443:   fi
 444: 
 445:   mapfile -t direct_results < <(
 446:     cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops read-cross-network-report-fields \
 447:       --report-path "$DIRECT_REPORT_PATH" \
 448:       --include-status \
 449:       --check direct_remote_exit_success \
 450:       --check remote_exit_no_underlay_leak \
 451:       --check cross_network_topology_heuristic
 452:   ) || return 1
 453: 
 454:   if [[ "${direct_results[0]:-fail}" == 'pass' && "${direct_results[1]:-fail}" == 'pass' && "${direct_results[2]:-fail}" == 'pass' ]]; then
 455:     CHECK_DIRECT_REMOTE_EXIT_READY="pass"
 456:   fi
 457:   if [[ "${direct_results[3]:-fail}" == 'pass' ]]; then
 458:     CHECK_CROSS_NETWORK_TOPOLOGY_HEURISTIC="pass"
 459:   fi
 460: 
 461:   if [[ "$direct_rc" -ne 0 || "$CHECK_DIRECT_REMOTE_EXIT_READY" != 'pass' ]]; then
 462:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="direct baseline did not produce secure readiness for node switch validation"
 463:     return 1
 464:   fi
 465: 
 466:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="initializing runtime for node underlay switch validation"
 467:   live_lab_init "rustynet-cross-network-node-switch" "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE"
 468:   live_lab_push_sudo_password "$EXIT_HOST"
 469:   live_lab_push_sudo_password "$CLIENT_HOST"
 470:   live_lab_wait_for_daemon_socket "$EXIT_HOST"
 471:   live_lab_wait_for_daemon_socket "$CLIENT_HOST"
 472: 
 473:   if [[ -n "$CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
 474:     CLIENT_ADDR="$CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP"
 475:   else
 476:     CLIENT_ADDR="$(live_lab_resolved_target_address "$CLIENT_HOST")"
 477:   fi
 478:   if [[ -n "$EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
 479:     EXIT_ADDR="$EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP"
 480:   else
 481:     EXIT_ADDR="$(live_lab_resolved_target_address "$EXIT_HOST")"
 482:   fi
 483:   choose_alias || return 1
 484:   CLIENT_IFACE="$(capture_default_route_iface "$CLIENT_HOST" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
 485:   if [[ -z "$CLIENT_IFACE" ]]; then
 486:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="failed to resolve client default underlay interface"
 487:     return 1
 488:   fi
 489:   ORIGINAL_ROUTE_SNAPSHOT="$(capture_default_route_snapshot "$CLIENT_HOST")"
 490: 
 491:   client_plaintext_start="$(live_lab_no_plaintext_passphrase_check "$CLIENT_HOST" || true)"
 492:   exit_plaintext_start="$(live_lab_no_plaintext_passphrase_check "$EXIT_HOST" || true)"
 493: 
 494:   pre_change_fingerprint="$(extract_netcheck_value "$(live_lab_capture_root "$CLIENT_HOST" "root env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet netcheck || true")" "traversal_endpoint_fingerprint")"
 495:   pre_reissue_events="$(extract_netcheck_value "$(live_lab_capture_root "$CLIENT_HOST" "root env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet netcheck || true")" "traversal_preexpiry_refresh_events")"
 496:   if [[ -z "$pre_reissue_events" || ! "$pre_reissue_events" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
 497:     pre_reissue_events=0
 498:   fi
 499: 
 500:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="applying client underlay alias and route switch"
 501:   SWITCH_STARTED_UNIX="$(date +%s)"
 502:   if ! apply_alias_switch "$CLIENT_HOST" "$CLIENT_IFACE" "$ALIAS_IP" "$ALIAS_PREFIX"; then
 503:     alias_apply_rc=1
 504:   fi
 505:   if [[ "$alias_apply_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
 506:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="failed to apply client alias route switch"
 507:     return 1
 508:   fi
 509: 
 510:   : > "$MONITOR_LOG_PATH"
 511:   route_leak_samples=0
 512:   signed_state_invalid_samples=0
 513:   reconnect_unix=0
 514: 
 515:   for ((i=1; i<=RECONNECT_SLO_SECS; i++)); do
 516:     local_ts="$(date +%s)"
 517:     client_status="$(live_lab_status "$CLIENT_HOST")"
 518:     client_route="$(live_lab_capture "$CLIENT_HOST" "ip -4 route get 1.1.1.1 || true")"
 519:     client_netcheck="$(live_lab_capture_root "$CLIENT_HOST" "root env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet netcheck || true")"
 520:     exit_netcheck="$(live_lab_capture_root "$EXIT_HOST" "root env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet netcheck || true")"
 521:     client_endpoints="$(live_lab_capture_root "$CLIENT_HOST" "root wg show rustynet0 endpoints || true")"
 522:     exit_endpoints="$(live_lab_capture_root "$EXIT_HOST" "root wg show rustynet0 endpoints || true")"
 523: 
 524:     if ! grep -Fq 'dev rustynet0' <<<"$client_route"; then
 525:       route_leak_samples=$((route_leak_samples + 1))
 526:     fi
 527:     if ! netcheck_is_valid "$client_netcheck" || ! netcheck_is_valid "$exit_netcheck"; then
 528:       signed_state_invalid_samples=$((signed_state_invalid_samples + 1))
 529:     fi
 530: 
 531:     post_change_fingerprint="$(extract_netcheck_value "$client_netcheck" "traversal_endpoint_fingerprint")"
 532:     post_reissue_events="$(extract_netcheck_value "$client_netcheck" "traversal_preexpiry_refresh_events")"
 533:     if [[ -z "$post_reissue_events" || ! "$post_reissue_events" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
 534:       post_reissue_events=0
 535:     fi
 536: 
 537:     if [[ -n "$pre_change_fingerprint" && -n "$post_change_fingerprint" && "$pre_change_fingerprint" != "$post_change_fingerprint" ]]; then
 538:       CHECK_ENDPOINT_CHANGE_DETECTED="pass"
 539:     fi
 540:     if (( post_reissue_events > pre_reissue_events )); then
 541:       CHECK_TRAVERSAL_REISSUE_TRIGGERED="pass"
 542:     fi
 543:     if grep -Fq "${ALIAS_IP}:51820" <<<"$exit_endpoints" || grep -Fq "${ALIAS_IP}:51820" <<<"$client_endpoints"; then
 544:       CHECK_PEER_RECEIVED_UPDATED_ENDPOINT_HINT="pass"
 545:     fi
 546: 
 547:     printf '%s|iter=%s|route=%s|status=%s|client_netcheck=%s|exit_netcheck=%s|client_endpoints=%s|exit_endpoints=%s\n' \
 548:       "$local_ts" "$i" \
 549:       "$(printf '%s' "$client_route" | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ';')" \
 550:       "$(printf '%s' "$client_status" | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ';')" \
 551:       "$(printf '%s' "$client_netcheck" | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ';')" \
 552:       "$(printf '%s' "$exit_netcheck" | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ';')" \
 553:       "$(printf '%s' "$client_endpoints" | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ';')" \
 554:       "$(printf '%s' "$exit_endpoints" | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ';')" >> "$MONITOR_LOG_PATH"
 555: 
 556:     if grep -Fq "exit_node=${EXIT_NODE_ID}" <<<"$client_status" && grep -Fq 'state=ExitActive' <<<"$client_status" && grep -Fq 'dev rustynet0' <<<"$client_route" && netcheck_is_valid "$client_netcheck" && netcheck_is_valid "$exit_netcheck"; then
 557:       reconnect_unix="$local_ts"
 558:       break
 559:     fi
 560: 
 561:     sleep 1
 562:   done
 563: 
 564:   reconnect_secs=-1
 565:   if (( reconnect_unix > 0 )); then
 566:     reconnect_secs=$((reconnect_unix - SWITCH_STARTED_UNIX))
 567:     if (( reconnect_secs >= 0 && reconnect_secs <= RECONNECT_SLO_SECS )); then
 568:       CHECK_SESSION_RECONNECT_WITHIN_SLO="pass"
 569:     fi
 570:   fi
 571: 
 572:   if (( route_leak_samples == 0 )); then
 573:     CHECK_NO_UNDERLAY_LEAK_DURING_TRANSITION="pass"
 574:   fi
 575:   if (( signed_state_invalid_samples == 0 )); then
 576:     CHECK_SIGNED_STATE_VALID_DURING_TRANSITION="pass"
 577:   fi
 578: 
 579:   client_plaintext_end="$(live_lab_no_plaintext_passphrase_check "$CLIENT_HOST" || true)"
 580:   exit_plaintext_end="$(live_lab_no_plaintext_passphrase_check "$EXIT_HOST" || true)"
 581:   if [[ "$client_plaintext_start" == 'no-plaintext-passphrase-files' && "$exit_plaintext_start" == 'no-plaintext-passphrase-files' && "$client_plaintext_end" == 'no-plaintext-passphrase-files' && "$exit_plaintext_end" == 'no-plaintext-passphrase-files' ]]; then
 582:     CHECK_NO_PLAINTEXT_PASSPHRASE_FILES="pass"
 583:   fi
 584: 
 585:   write_summary \
 586:     "$reconnect_secs" \
 587:     "$route_leak_samples" \
 588:     "$signed_state_invalid_samples" \
 589:     "$CHECK_ENDPOINT_CHANGE_DETECTED" \
 590:     "$CHECK_TRAVERSAL_REISSUE_TRIGGERED" \
 591:     "$CHECK_PEER_RECEIVED_UPDATED_ENDPOINT_HINT" \
 592:     "$reconnect_unix"
 593: 
 594:   if [[ "$CHECK_DIRECT_REMOTE_EXIT_READY" == 'pass' && "$CHECK_ENDPOINT_CHANGE_DETECTED" == 'pass' && "$CHECK_TRAVERSAL_REISSUE_TRIGGERED" == 'pass' && "$CHECK_SESSION_RECONNECT_WITHIN_SLO" == 'pass' && "$CHECK_PEER_RECEIVED_UPDATED_ENDPOINT_HINT" == 'pass' && "$CHECK_NO_UNDERLAY_LEAK_DURING_TRANSITION" == 'pass' && "$CHECK_SIGNED_STATE_VALID_DURING_TRANSITION" == 'pass' && "$CHECK_CROSS_NETWORK_TOPOLOGY_HEURISTIC" == 'pass' && "$CHECK_NO_PLAINTEXT_PASSPHRASE_FILES" == 'pass' ]]; then
 595:     CHECK_NODE_NETWORK_SWITCH_SUCCESS="pass"
 596:   fi
 597: 
 598:   if [[ "$CHECK_NODE_NETWORK_SWITCH_SUCCESS" != 'pass' ]]; then
 599:     if [[ "$CHECK_ENDPOINT_CHANGE_DETECTED" != 'pass' ]]; then
 600:       FAILURE_SUMMARY="endpoint-change detection did not trigger during node underlay switch"
 601:     elif [[ "$CHECK_TRAVERSAL_REISSUE_TRIGGERED" != 'pass' ]]; then
 602:       FAILURE_SUMMARY="traversal re-issue did not trigger during node underlay switch"
 603:     elif [[ "$CHECK_PEER_RECEIVED_UPDATED_ENDPOINT_HINT" != 'pass' ]]; then
 604:       FAILURE_SUMMARY="peer did not observe updated endpoint hint after node underlay switch"
 605:     elif [[ "$CHECK_SESSION_RECONNECT_WITHIN_SLO" != 'pass' ]]; then
 606:       FAILURE_SUMMARY="session reconvergence exceeded reconnect SLO (${RECONNECT_SLO_SECS}s), measured=${reconnect_secs}s"
 607:     elif [[ "$CHECK_NO_UNDERLAY_LEAK_DURING_TRANSITION" != 'pass' ]]; then
 608:       FAILURE_SUMMARY="underlay leak detected during node underlay switch transition"
 609:     elif [[ "$CHECK_SIGNED_STATE_VALID_DURING_TRANSITION" != 'pass' ]]; then
 610:       FAILURE_SUMMARY="signed state became invalid during node underlay switch transition"
 611:     elif [[ "$CHECK_NO_PLAINTEXT_PASSPHRASE_FILES" != 'pass' ]]; then
 612:       FAILURE_SUMMARY="plaintext passphrase files detected during node network-switch validation"
 613:     else
 614:       FAILURE_SUMMARY="node network-switch validation checks did not all pass"
 615:     fi
 616:     return 1
 617:   fi
 618: 
 619:   FAILURE_SUMMARY=""
 620: }
 621: 
 622: if main; then
 623:   write_report pass
 624:   REPORT_WRITTEN=1
 625: else
 626:   write_report fail
 627:   REPORT_WRITTEN=1
 628:   exit 1
 629: fi
 630: 
 631: live_lab_log "Cross-network node network-switch report written: $REPORT_PATH"

===== /scripts/e2e/live_linux_cross_network_relay_remote_exit_test.sh =====

  35: CHECK_RELAY_REMOTE_EXIT_SUCCESS="fail"
  36: CHECK_REMOTE_EXIT_NO_UNDERLAY_LEAK="fail"
  37: CHECK_REMOTE_EXIT_SERVER_IP_BYPASS_IS_NARROW="fail"
  38: CHECK_CROSS_NETWORK_TOPOLOGY_HEURISTIC="fail"
  39: CHECK_CLIENT_EXIT_IS_RELAY="fail"
  40: CHECK_RELAY_EXIT_IS_FINAL="fail"
  41: CHECK_RELAY_SERVES_EXIT="fail"
  42: CHECK_FINAL_EXIT_SERVES="fail"
  43: CHECK_CLIENT_ROUTE_VIA_RUSTYNET="fail"
  44: CHECK_RELAY_PEER_VISIBILITY="fail"
  45: CHECK_NO_PLAINTEXT_PASSPHRASE_FILES="fail"
  46: CLIENT_ADDR=""
  47: EXIT_ADDR=""
  48: RELAY_ADDR=""
  49: SSH_TRUST_SUMMARY_PATH=""
  50: BYPASS_REPORT_PATH=""
  51: BYPASS_LOG_PATH=""
  52: SOURCE_ARTIFACTS=()
  53: LOG_ARTIFACTS=()
  54: PATH_STATUS_LINE=""
  55: 
  56: usage() {
  57:   cat <<'USAGE'
  58: usage: live_linux_cross_network_relay_remote_exit_test.sh --ssh-identity-file <path> --client-host <user@host> --exit-host <user@host> --relay-host <user@host> --client-node-id <id> --exit-node-id <id> --relay-node-id <id> --client-network-id <id> --exit-network-id <id> --relay-network-id <id> [options]
  59: 
  60: options:
  61:   --known-hosts-file <path>
  62:   --nat-profile <profile>
  63:   --impairment-profile <profile>
  64:   --ssh-allow-cidrs <cidr[,cidr]>
  65:   --client-underlay-ip <ipv4>
  66:   --exit-underlay-ip <ipv4>
  67:   --relay-underlay-ip <ipv4>

  69:   --log-path <path>
  70: USAGE
