  72: 
  73: write_report() {
  74:   local status="$1"
  75:   local args=(
  76:     cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops generate-cross-network-remote-exit-report
  77:     --suite cross_network_relay_remote_exit
  78:     --report-path "$REPORT_PATH"
  79:     --log-path "$LOG_PATH"
  80:     --status "$status"
  81:     --failure-summary "$FAILURE_SUMMARY"
  82:     --implementation-state live_measured_validator
  83:     --client-host "$CLIENT_HOST"
  84:     --exit-host "$EXIT_HOST"
  85:     --relay-host "$RELAY_HOST"
  86:     --client-network-id "$CLIENT_NETWORK_ID"
  87:     --exit-network-id "$EXIT_NETWORK_ID"
  88:     --relay-network-id "$RELAY_NETWORK_ID"
  89:     --nat-profile "$NAT_PROFILE"
  90:     --impairment-profile "$IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE"
  91:     --source-artifact "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/e2e/live_linux_cross_network_relay_remote_exit_test.sh"
  92:     --check "relay_remote_exit_success=${CHECK_RELAY_REMOTE_EXIT_SUCCESS}"
  93:     --check "remote_exit_no_underlay_leak=${CHECK_REMOTE_EXIT_NO_UNDERLAY_LEAK}"
  94:     --check "remote_exit_server_ip_bypass_is_narrow=${CHECK_REMOTE_EXIT_SERVER_IP_BYPASS_IS_NARROW}"
  95:     --check "cross_network_topology_heuristic=${CHECK_CROSS_NETWORK_TOPOLOGY_HEURISTIC}"
  96:     --check "client_exit_is_relay=${CHECK_CLIENT_EXIT_IS_RELAY}"
  97:     --check "relay_exit_is_final=${CHECK_RELAY_EXIT_IS_FINAL}"
  98:     --check "relay_serves_exit=${CHECK_RELAY_SERVES_EXIT}"
  99:     --check "final_exit_serves=${CHECK_FINAL_EXIT_SERVES}"
 100:     --check "client_route_via_rustynet0=${CHECK_CLIENT_ROUTE_VIA_RUSTYNET}"
 101:     --check "relay_peer_visibility=${CHECK_RELAY_PEER_VISIBILITY}"
 102:     --check "no_plaintext_passphrase_files=${CHECK_NO_PLAINTEXT_PASSPHRASE_FILES}"
 103:   )
 104:   local item
 105:   set +u
 106:   if [[ -n "$PATH_STATUS_LINE" ]]; then
 107:     args+=(--path-status-line "$PATH_STATUS_LINE")
 108:   fi
 109:   for item in "${SOURCE_ARTIFACTS[@]}"; do
 110:     [[ -n "$item" ]] || continue
 111:     args+=(--source-artifact "$item")
 112:   done
 113:   for item in "${LOG_ARTIFACTS[@]}"; do
 114:     [[ -n "$item" ]] || continue
 115:     args+=(--log-artifact "$item")
 116:   done
 117:   set -u
 118:   "${args[@]}"
 119: }
 120: 
 121: cleanup() {
 122:   local rc=$?
 123:   set +e
 124:   if [[ "$REPORT_WRITTEN" -eq 0 ]]; then
 125:     write_report fail
 126:   fi
 127:   REPORT_WRITTEN=1
 128:   live_lab_cleanup
 129:   exit "$rc"
 130: }
 131: 
 132: trap cleanup EXIT
 133: 
 134: while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
 135:   case "$1" in
 136:     --ssh-identity-file) SSH_IDENTITY_FILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 137:     --known-hosts-file) KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 138:     --client-host) CLIENT_HOST="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 139:     --exit-host) EXIT_HOST="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 140:     --relay-host) RELAY_HOST="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 141:     --client-node-id) CLIENT_NODE_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 142:     --exit-node-id) EXIT_NODE_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 143:     --relay-node-id) RELAY_NODE_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 144:     --client-network-id) CLIENT_NETWORK_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 145:     --exit-network-id) EXIT_NETWORK_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 146:     --relay-network-id) RELAY_NETWORK_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 147:     --client-underlay-ip) CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 148:     --exit-underlay-ip) EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 149:     --relay-underlay-ip) RELAY_UNDERLAY_IP="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 150:     --nat-profile) NAT_PROFILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 151:     --impairment-profile) IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 152:     --ssh-allow-cidrs) SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 153:     --report-path) REPORT_PATH="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 154:     --log-path) LOG_PATH="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 155:     -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
 156:     *) echo "unknown argument: $1" >&2; usage; exit 2 ;;
 157:   esac
 158: done
 159: 
 160: if [[ -z "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE" || -z "$CLIENT_HOST" || -z "$EXIT_HOST" || -z "$RELAY_HOST" || -z "$CLIENT_NODE_ID" || -z "$EXIT_NODE_ID" || -z "$RELAY_NODE_ID" || -z "$CLIENT_NETWORK_ID" || -z "$EXIT_NETWORK_ID" || -z "$RELAY_NETWORK_ID" ]]; then
 161:   usage >&2
 162:   exit 2
 163: fi
 164: if [[ -z "$NAT_PROFILE" || -z "$IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE" ]]; then
 165:   echo "--nat-profile and --impairment-profile must be non-empty" >&2
 166:   exit 2
 167: fi
 168: 
 169: if [[ "$CLIENT_HOST" == "$EXIT_HOST" || "$CLIENT_HOST" == "$RELAY_HOST" || "$EXIT_HOST" == "$RELAY_HOST" ]]; then
 170:   echo "client, exit, and relay hosts must all differ" >&2
 171:   exit 2
 172: fi
 173: 
 174: if [[ "$CLIENT_NETWORK_ID" == "$EXIT_NETWORK_ID" || "$CLIENT_NETWORK_ID" == "$RELAY_NETWORK_ID" || "$EXIT_NETWORK_ID" == "$RELAY_NETWORK_ID" ]]; then
 175:   echo "client, exit, and relay network ids must all differ" >&2
 176:   exit 2
 177: fi
 178: 
 179: if [[ -n "$CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
 180:   cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops validate-ipv4-address --ip "$CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP" >/dev/null
 181: fi
 182: if [[ -n "$EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
 183:   cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops validate-ipv4-address --ip "$EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP" >/dev/null
 184: fi
 185: if [[ -n "$RELAY_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
 186:   cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops validate-ipv4-address --ip "$RELAY_UNDERLAY_IP" >/dev/null
 187: fi
 188: if [[ -n "$KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE" ]]; then
 189:   export LIVE_LAB_PINNED_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE="$KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE"
 190: fi
 191: 
 192: mkdir -p "$(dirname "$REPORT_PATH")" "$(dirname "$LOG_PATH")"
 193: : > "$LOG_PATH"
 194: exec >> "$LOG_PATH" 2>&1
 195: 
 196: main() {
 197:   local issue_env assign_pub_local exit_assignment_local relay_assignment_local client_assignment_local
 198:   local exit_refresh_local relay_refresh_local client_refresh_local
 199:   local traversal_env traversal_pub_local
 200:   local exit_traversal_local relay_traversal_local client_traversal_local
 201:   local client_status client_netcheck relay_status exit_status client_route relay_endpoints client_plaintext_check relay_plaintext_check exit_plaintext_check
 202:   local bypass_status
 203:   local artifact_dir
 204:   local relay_path_live signed_state_healthy
 205: 
 206:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="initializing relay remote-exit live-lab runtime"
 207:   live_lab_init "rustynet-cross-network-relay-remote-exit" "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE"
 208: 
 209:   issue_env="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/rn_issue_cross_network_relay.env"
 210:   assign_pub_local="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/assignment.pub"
 211:   exit_assignment_local="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/assignment-exit"
 212:   relay_assignment_local="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/assignment-relay"
 213:   client_assignment_local="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/assignment-client"
 214:   exit_refresh_local="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/assignment-refresh-exit.env"
 215:   relay_refresh_local="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/assignment-refresh-relay.env"
 216:   client_refresh_local="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/assignment-refresh-client.env"
 217:   traversal_env="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/rn_issue_cross_network_relay_traversal.env"
 218:   traversal_pub_local="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/traversal.pub"
 219:   exit_traversal_local="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/traversal-exit"
 220:   relay_traversal_local="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/traversal-relay"
 221:   client_traversal_local="$LIVE_LAB_WORK_DIR/traversal-client"
 222:   artifact_dir="$(dirname "$REPORT_PATH")"
 223:   BYPASS_REPORT_PATH="$artifact_dir/cross_network_relay_remote_exit_server_ip_bypass_report.json"
 224:   BYPASS_LOG_PATH="$artifact_dir/cross_network_relay_remote_exit_server_ip_bypass.log"
 225:   SSH_TRUST_SUMMARY_PATH="$artifact_dir/cross_network_relay_remote_exit_ssh_trust_summary.txt"
 226:   SOURCE_ARTIFACTS=("$BYPASS_REPORT_PATH" "$SSH_TRUST_SUMMARY_PATH")
 227:   LOG_ARTIFACTS=("$BYPASS_LOG_PATH")
 228: 
 229:   live_lab_push_sudo_password "$EXIT_HOST"
 230:   live_lab_push_sudo_password "$RELAY_HOST"
 231:   live_lab_push_sudo_password "$CLIENT_HOST"
 232:   live_lab_write_ssh_trust_summary "$SSH_TRUST_SUMMARY_PATH" "$CLIENT_HOST" "$EXIT_HOST" "$RELAY_HOST"
 233: 
 234:   live_lab_log "Collecting WireGuard public keys"
 235:   EXIT_PUB_HEX="$(live_lab_collect_pubkey_hex "$EXIT_HOST")"
 236:   RELAY_PUB_HEX="$(live_lab_collect_pubkey_hex "$RELAY_HOST")"
 237:   CLIENT_PUB_HEX="$(live_lab_collect_pubkey_hex "$CLIENT_HOST")"
 238:   if [[ -n "$EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
 239:     EXIT_ADDR="$EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP"
 240:   else
 241:     EXIT_ADDR="$(live_lab_resolved_target_address "$EXIT_HOST")"
 242:   fi
 243:   if [[ -n "$RELAY_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
 244:     RELAY_ADDR="$RELAY_UNDERLAY_IP"
 245:   else
 246:     RELAY_ADDR="$(live_lab_resolved_target_address "$RELAY_HOST")"
 247:   fi
 248:   if [[ -n "$CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
 249:     CLIENT_ADDR="$CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP"
 250:   else
 251:     CLIENT_ADDR="$(live_lab_resolved_target_address "$CLIENT_HOST")"
 252:   fi
 253: 
 254:   NODES_SPEC="${EXIT_NODE_ID}|${EXIT_ADDR}:51820|${EXIT_PUB_HEX};${RELAY_NODE_ID}|${RELAY_ADDR}:51820|${RELAY_PUB_HEX};${CLIENT_NODE_ID}|${CLIENT_ADDR}:51820|${CLIENT_PUB_HEX}"
 255:   ALLOW_SPEC="${CLIENT_NODE_ID}|${RELAY_NODE_ID};${RELAY_NODE_ID}|${CLIENT_NODE_ID};${CLIENT_NODE_ID}|${EXIT_NODE_ID};${EXIT_NODE_ID}|${CLIENT_NODE_ID};${RELAY_NODE_ID}|${EXIT_NODE_ID};${EXIT_NODE_ID}|${RELAY_NODE_ID}"
 256: 
 257:   : > "$issue_env"
 258:   live_lab_append_env_assignment "$issue_env" "NODES_SPEC" "$NODES_SPEC"
 259:   live_lab_append_env_assignment "$issue_env" "ALLOW_SPEC" "$ALLOW_SPEC"
 260:   live_lab_append_env_assignment "$issue_env" "ASSIGNMENTS_SPEC" "${EXIT_NODE_ID}|-;${RELAY_NODE_ID}|${EXIT_NODE_ID};${CLIENT_NODE_ID}|${RELAY_NODE_ID}"
 261: 
 262:   live_lab_log "Issuing signed relay remote-exit assignments on $EXIT_HOST"
 263:   live_lab_issue_assignment_bundles_from_env "$EXIT_HOST" "$issue_env" "/tmp/rn_issue_cross_network_relay.env"
 264: 
 265:   live_lab_capture_root "$EXIT_HOST" "root cat /run/rustynet/assignment-issue/rn-assignment.pub" > "$assign_pub_local"
 266:   live_lab_capture_root "$EXIT_HOST" "root cat /run/rustynet/assignment-issue/rn-assignment-$EXIT_NODE_ID.assignment" > "$exit_assignment_local"
 267:   live_lab_capture_root "$EXIT_HOST" "root cat /run/rustynet/assignment-issue/rn-assignment-$RELAY_NODE_ID.assignment" > "$relay_assignment_local"
 268:   live_lab_capture_root "$EXIT_HOST" "root cat /run/rustynet/assignment-issue/rn-assignment-$CLIENT_NODE_ID.assignment" > "$client_assignment_local"
 269: 
 270:   live_lab_log "Distributing signed assignments"
 271:   live_lab_install_assignment_bundle "$EXIT_HOST" "$assign_pub_local" "$exit_assignment_local"
 272:   live_lab_install_assignment_bundle "$RELAY_HOST" "$assign_pub_local" "$relay_assignment_local"
 273:   live_lab_install_assignment_bundle "$CLIENT_HOST" "$assign_pub_local" "$client_assignment_local"
 274: 
 275:   live_lab_write_assignment_refresh_env "$exit_refresh_local" "$EXIT_NODE_ID" "$NODES_SPEC" "$ALLOW_SPEC"
 276:   live_lab_write_assignment_refresh_env "$relay_refresh_local" "$RELAY_NODE_ID" "$NODES_SPEC" "$ALLOW_SPEC" "$EXIT_NODE_ID"
 277:   live_lab_write_assignment_refresh_env "$client_refresh_local" "$CLIENT_NODE_ID" "$NODES_SPEC" "$ALLOW_SPEC" "$RELAY_NODE_ID"
 278:   live_lab_install_assignment_refresh_env "$EXIT_HOST" "$exit_refresh_local"
 279:   live_lab_install_assignment_refresh_env "$RELAY_HOST" "$relay_refresh_local"
 280:   live_lab_install_assignment_refresh_env "$CLIENT_HOST" "$client_refresh_local"
 281: 
 282:   : > "$traversal_env"
 283:   live_lab_append_env_assignment "$traversal_env" "NODES_SPEC" "$NODES_SPEC"
 284:   live_lab_append_env_assignment "$traversal_env" "ALLOW_SPEC" "$ALLOW_SPEC"
 285: 
 286:   live_lab_log "Issuing signed traversal bundles for relay remote-exit topology"
 287:   live_lab_issue_traversal_bundles_from_env "$EXIT_HOST" "$traversal_env" "/tmp/rn_issue_cross_network_relay_traversal.env"
 288: 
 289:   live_lab_capture_root "$EXIT_HOST" "root cat /run/rustynet/traversal-issue/rn-traversal.pub" > "$traversal_pub_local"
 290:   live_lab_capture_root "$EXIT_HOST" "root cat /run/rustynet/traversal-issue/rn-traversal-$EXIT_NODE_ID.traversal" > "$exit_traversal_local"
 291:   live_lab_capture_root "$EXIT_HOST" "root cat /run/rustynet/traversal-issue/rn-traversal-$RELAY_NODE_ID.traversal" > "$relay_traversal_local"
 292:   live_lab_capture_root "$EXIT_HOST" "root cat /run/rustynet/traversal-issue/rn-traversal-$CLIENT_NODE_ID.traversal" > "$client_traversal_local"
 293: 
 294:   install_traversal_bundle() {
 295:     local host="$1"
 296:     local bundle_local="$2"
 297:     live_lab_scp_to "$traversal_pub_local" "$host" "/tmp/rn-traversal.pub"
 298:     live_lab_scp_to "$bundle_local" "$host" "/tmp/rn-traversal.bundle"
 299:     live_lab_run_root "$host" "root install -m 0644 -o root -g root /tmp/rn-traversal.pub /etc/rustynet/traversal.pub && root install -m 0640 -o root -g rustynetd /tmp/rn-traversal.bundle /var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.traversal && root rm -f /var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.traversal.watermark /tmp/rn-traversal.pub /tmp/rn-traversal.bundle"
 300:   }
 301: 
 302:   live_lab_log "Distributing signed traversal bundles"
 303:   install_traversal_bundle "$EXIT_HOST" "$exit_traversal_local"
 304:   install_traversal_bundle "$RELAY_HOST" "$relay_traversal_local"
 305:   install_traversal_bundle "$CLIENT_HOST" "$client_traversal_local"
 306: 
 307:   live_lab_log "Enforcing runtime roles"
 308:   live_lab_enforce_host "$EXIT_HOST" "admin" "$EXIT_NODE_ID" "$SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS" "$(live_lab_remote_src_dir "$EXIT_HOST")"
 309:   live_lab_enforce_host "$RELAY_HOST" "admin" "$RELAY_NODE_ID" "$SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS" "$(live_lab_remote_src_dir "$RELAY_HOST")"
 310:   live_lab_enforce_host "$CLIENT_HOST" "client" "$CLIENT_NODE_ID" "$SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS" "$(live_lab_remote_src_dir "$CLIENT_HOST")"
 311:   live_lab_wait_for_daemon_socket "$EXIT_HOST"
 312:   live_lab_wait_for_daemon_socket "$RELAY_HOST"
 313:   live_lab_wait_for_daemon_socket "$CLIENT_HOST"
 314: 
 315:   live_lab_log "Advertising default route on relay and final exit"
 316:   live_lab_retry_root "$EXIT_HOST" "root env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet route advertise 0.0.0.0/0" 10 2
 317:   live_lab_retry_root "$RELAY_HOST" "root env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet route advertise 0.0.0.0/0" 10 2
 318:   sleep 5
 319: 
 320:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="capturing relay remote-exit steady-state evidence"
 321:   client_status="$(live_lab_status "$CLIENT_HOST")"
 322:   client_netcheck="$(live_lab_capture_root "$CLIENT_HOST" "root env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet netcheck")"
 323:   PATH_STATUS_LINE="$client_netcheck"
 324:   relay_status="$(live_lab_status "$RELAY_HOST")"
 325:   exit_status="$(live_lab_status "$EXIT_HOST")"
 326:   client_route="$(live_lab_capture "$CLIENT_HOST" "ip -4 route get 1.1.1.1 || true")"
 327:   relay_endpoints="$(live_lab_capture_root "$RELAY_HOST" "root wg show rustynet0 endpoints || true")"
 328:   client_plaintext_check="$(live_lab_no_plaintext_passphrase_check "$CLIENT_HOST")"
 329:   relay_plaintext_check="$(live_lab_no_plaintext_passphrase_check "$RELAY_HOST")"
 330:   exit_plaintext_check="$(live_lab_no_plaintext_passphrase_check "$EXIT_HOST")"
 331: 
 332:   live_lab_log "Client status"
 333:   printf '%s\n' "$client_status"
 334:   live_lab_log "Relay status"
 335:   printf '%s\n' "$relay_status"
 336:   live_lab_log "Final exit status"
 337:   printf '%s\n' "$exit_status"
 338:   live_lab_log "Client route"
 339:   printf '%s\n' "$client_route"
 340:   live_lab_log "Relay endpoints"
 341:   printf '%s\n' "$relay_endpoints"
 342:   live_lab_log "Client netcheck"
 343:   printf '%s\n' "$client_netcheck"
 344: 
 345:   relay_path_live=0
 346:   if [[ "$client_netcheck" == *"path_mode=relay_active"* && "$client_netcheck" == *"path_live_proven=true"* && "$client_netcheck" == *"relay_session_state=live"* ]]; then
 347:     relay_path_live=1
 348:   fi
 349:   signed_state_healthy=0
 350:   if [[ "$client_netcheck" != *"traversal_alarm_state=critical"* && "$client_netcheck" != *"traversal_alarm_state=error"* && "$client_netcheck" != *"traversal_alarm_state=missing"* && "$client_netcheck" != *"dns_alarm_state=critical"* && "$client_netcheck" != *"dns_alarm_state=error"* && "$client_netcheck" != *"dns_alarm_state=missing"* && "$client_netcheck" == *"traversal_error=none"* ]]; then
 351:     signed_state_healthy=1
 352:   fi
 353: 
 354:   if (( relay_path_live == 1 )) && grep -Fq "exit_node=${RELAY_NODE_ID}" <<<"$client_status" && grep -Fq 'state=ExitActive' <<<"$client_status"; then
 355:     CHECK_CLIENT_EXIT_IS_RELAY="pass"
 356:   fi
 357:   if grep -Fq "exit_node=${EXIT_NODE_ID}" <<<"$relay_status"; then
 358:     CHECK_RELAY_EXIT_IS_FINAL="pass"
 359:   fi
 360:   if grep -Fq 'serving_exit_node=true' <<<"$relay_status"; then
 361:     CHECK_RELAY_SERVES_EXIT="pass"
 362:   fi
 363:   if grep -Fq 'serving_exit_node=true' <<<"$exit_status"; then
 364:     CHECK_FINAL_EXIT_SERVES="pass"
 365:   fi
 366:   if grep -Fq 'dev rustynet0' <<<"$client_route"; then
 367:     CHECK_CLIENT_ROUTE_VIA_RUSTYNET="pass"
 368:   fi
 369:   if grep -Fq "${CLIENT_ADDR}:51820" <<<"$relay_endpoints" && grep -Fq "${EXIT_ADDR}:51820" <<<"$relay_endpoints"; then
 370:     CHECK_RELAY_PEER_VISIBILITY="pass"
 371:   fi
 372:   if [[ "$client_plaintext_check" == 'no-plaintext-passphrase-files' && "$relay_plaintext_check" == 'no-plaintext-passphrase-files' && "$exit_plaintext_check" == 'no-plaintext-passphrase-files' ]]; then
 373:     CHECK_NO_PLAINTEXT_PASSPHRASE_FILES="pass"
 374:   fi
 375: 
 376:   topology_result="$(cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops classify-cross-network-topology --ip-a "$CLIENT_ADDR" --ip-b "$EXIT_ADDR")" || return 1
 377:   if [[ "$topology_result" == "pass" ]]; then
 378:     CHECK_CROSS_NETWORK_TOPOLOGY_HEURISTIC="pass"
 379:   else
 380:     CHECK_CROSS_NETWORK_TOPOLOGY_HEURISTIC="fail"
 381:   fi
 382: 
 383:   if [[ "$CHECK_CLIENT_EXIT_IS_RELAY" == 'pass' && "$CHECK_RELAY_EXIT_IS_FINAL" == 'pass' && "$CHECK_RELAY_SERVES_EXIT" == 'pass' && "$CHECK_FINAL_EXIT_SERVES" == 'pass' && "$CHECK_CLIENT_ROUTE_VIA_RUSTYNET" == 'pass' && "$CHECK_RELAY_PEER_VISIBILITY" == 'pass' && "$CHECK_NO_PLAINTEXT_PASSPHRASE_FILES" == 'pass' && "$CHECK_CROSS_NETWORK_TOPOLOGY_HEURISTIC" == 'pass' ]] && (( signed_state_healthy == 1 )); then
 384:     CHECK_RELAY_REMOTE_EXIT_SUCCESS="pass"
 385:   fi
 386: 
 387:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="validating narrow server-IP bypass and leak resistance on relay remote-exit path"
 388:   if RUSTYNET_EXPECTED_GIT_COMMIT="${RUSTYNET_EXPECTED_GIT_COMMIT:-}" \
 389:     bash "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/e2e/live_linux_server_ip_bypass_test.sh" \
 390:       --ssh-identity-file "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE" \
 391:       --client-host "$CLIENT_HOST" \
 392:       --probe-host "$EXIT_HOST" \
 393:       --ssh-allow-cidrs "$SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS" \
 394:       --report-path "$BYPASS_REPORT_PATH" \
 395:       --log-path "$BYPASS_LOG_PATH"; then
 396:     bypass_status=0
 397:   else
 398:     bypass_status=$?
 399:   fi
 400: 
 401:   if [[ "$bypass_status" -ne 0 && ! -f "$BYPASS_REPORT_PATH" ]]; then
 402:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="server-IP bypass validator failed before emitting relay evidence"
 403:     return 1
 404:   fi
 405: 
 406:   mapfile -t bypass_results < <(
 407:     cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops read-cross-network-report-fields \
 408:       --report-path "$BYPASS_REPORT_PATH" \
 409:       --check internet_route_via_rustynet0 \
 410:       --check probe_service_blocked_from_client \
 411:       --check probe_endpoint_route_direct_not_tunnelled \
 412:       --check no_unexpected_bypass_routes
 413:   ) || return 1
 414: 
 415:   if [[ "${bypass_results[0]}" == 'pass' && "${bypass_results[1]}" == 'pass' ]]; then
 416:     CHECK_REMOTE_EXIT_NO_UNDERLAY_LEAK="pass"
 417:   fi
 418:   if [[ "${bypass_results[1]}" == 'pass' && "${bypass_results[2]}" == 'pass' && "${bypass_results[3]}" == 'pass' ]]; then
 419:     CHECK_REMOTE_EXIT_SERVER_IP_BYPASS_IS_NARROW="pass"
 420:   fi
 421: 
 422:   if [[ "$CHECK_RELAY_REMOTE_EXIT_SUCCESS" != 'pass' ]]; then
 423:     if [[ "$CHECK_CROSS_NETWORK_TOPOLOGY_HEURISTIC" != 'pass' ]]; then
 424:       FAILURE_SUMMARY="client and final-exit underlay addresses share the same local prefix; refusing to claim cross-network relay remote exit on same-subnet topology"
 425:     else
 426:       FAILURE_SUMMARY="relay remote-exit steady-state checks did not all pass"
 427:     fi
 428:     return 1
 429:   fi
 430:   if [[ "$CHECK_REMOTE_EXIT_NO_UNDERLAY_LEAK" != 'pass' ]]; then
 431:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="relay remote-exit path leaked or could not prove leak resistance"
 432:     return 1
 433:   fi
 434:   if [[ "$CHECK_REMOTE_EXIT_SERVER_IP_BYPASS_IS_NARROW" != 'pass' ]]; then
 435:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="server-IP bypass on the relay remote-exit path was broader than allowed"
 436:     return 1
 437:   fi
 438: 
 439:   FAILURE_SUMMARY=""
 440: }

  67:     cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops generate-cross-network-remote-exit-report

  75:     --client-host "$CLIENT_HOST"
  76:     --exit-host "$EXIT_HOST"
  77:     --client-network-id "$CLIENT_NETWORK_ID"
  78:     --exit-network-id "$EXIT_NETWORK_ID"
  79:     --nat-profile "$NAT_PROFILE"
  80:     --impairment-profile "$IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE"
  81:     --source-artifact "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/e2e/live_linux_cross_network_remote_exit_dns_test.sh"
  82:     --check "managed_dns_resolution_success=${CHECK_MANAGED_DNS_RESOLUTION_SUCCESS}"

  87:     --check "managed_dns_child_ready=${CHECK_MANAGED_DNS_CHILD_READY}"

  93:   fi
  94:   for item in "${SOURCE_ARTIFACTS[@]}"; do

  96:     args+=(--source-artifact "$item")
  97:   done
  98:   for item in "${LOG_ARTIFACTS[@]}"; do
  99:     [[ -n "$item" ]] || continue
 100:     args+=(--log-artifact "$item")
 101:   done

 103:   "${args[@]}"

 108:   set +e

 119: while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
 120:   case "$1" in
 121:     --ssh-identity-file) SSH_IDENTITY_FILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 122:     --known-hosts-file) KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 123:     --client-host) CLIENT_HOST="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 124:     --exit-host) EXIT_HOST="$2"; shift 2 ;;

 128:     --exit-network-id) EXIT_NETWORK_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 129:     --client-underlay-ip) CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 130:     --exit-underlay-ip) EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 131:     --nat-profile) NAT_PROFILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 132:     --impairment-profile) IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 133:     --ssh-allow-cidrs) SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 134:     --zone-name) ZONE_NAME="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 135:     --dns-interface) DNS_INTERFACE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 136:     --dns-bind-addr) DNS_BIND_ADDR="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 137:     --report-path) REPORT_PATH="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 138:     --log-path) LOG_PATH="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 139:     -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
 140:     *) echo "unknown argument: $1" >&2; usage; exit 2 ;;
 141:   esac
 142: done
 143: 
 144: if [[ -z "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE" || -z "$CLIENT_HOST" || -z "$EXIT_HOST" || -z "$CLIENT_NODE_ID" || -z "$EXIT_NODE_ID" || -z "$CLIENT_NETWORK_ID" || -z "$EXIT_NETWORK_ID" ]]; then
 145:   usage >&2
 146:   exit 2
 147: fi
 148: if [[ -z "$NAT_PROFILE" || -z "$IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE" ]]; then
 149:   echo "--nat-profile and --impairment-profile must be non-empty" >&2
 150:   exit 2
 151: fi
 152: 
 153: if [[ "$CLIENT_HOST" == "$EXIT_HOST" ]]; then
 154:   echo "--client-host and --exit-host must differ" >&2
 155:   exit 2
 156: fi
 157: 
 158: if [[ "$CLIENT_NETWORK_ID" == "$EXIT_NETWORK_ID" ]]; then
 159:   echo "--client-network-id and --exit-network-id must differ" >&2
 160:   exit 2
 161: fi
 162: 
 163: if [[ -n "$CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
 164:   cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops validate-ipv4-address --ip "$CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP" >/dev/null
 165: fi
 166: if [[ -n "$EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
 167:   cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops validate-ipv4-address --ip "$EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP" >/dev/null
 168: fi
 169: if [[ -n "$KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE" ]]; then
 170:   export LIVE_LAB_PINNED_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE="$KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE"
 171: fi
 172: 
 173: mkdir -p "$(dirname "$REPORT_PATH")" "$(dirname "$LOG_PATH")"
 174: : > "$LOG_PATH"
 175: exec >> "$LOG_PATH" 2>&1
 176: 
 177: main() {
 178:   local artifact_dir
 179:   local direct_rc managed_rc
 180: 
 181:   artifact_dir="$(dirname "$REPORT_PATH")"
 182:   DIRECT_REPORT_PATH="$artifact_dir/cross_network_remote_exit_dns_direct_remote_exit_report.json"
 183:   DIRECT_LOG_PATH="$artifact_dir/cross_network_remote_exit_dns_direct_remote_exit.log"
 184:   MANAGED_DNS_REPORT_PATH="$artifact_dir/cross_network_remote_exit_dns_managed_dns_report.json"
 185:   MANAGED_DNS_LOG_PATH="$artifact_dir/cross_network_remote_exit_dns_managed_dns.log"
 186:   SSH_TRUST_SUMMARY_PATH="$artifact_dir/cross_network_remote_exit_dns_ssh_trust_summary.txt"
 187:   SOURCE_ARTIFACTS=("$DIRECT_REPORT_PATH" "$MANAGED_DNS_REPORT_PATH" "$SSH_TRUST_SUMMARY_PATH")
 188:   LOG_ARTIFACTS=("$DIRECT_LOG_PATH" "$MANAGED_DNS_LOG_PATH")
 189: 
 190:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="verifying pinned host-key and passwordless-sudo prerequisites"
 191:   live_lab_init "rustynet-cross-network-remote-exit-dns" "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE"
 192:   live_lab_push_sudo_password "$EXIT_HOST"
 193:   live_lab_push_sudo_password "$CLIENT_HOST"
 194:   live_lab_write_ssh_trust_summary "$SSH_TRUST_SUMMARY_PATH" "$CLIENT_HOST" "$EXIT_HOST"
 195: 
 196:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="bootstrapping direct remote-exit path for DNS validation"
 197:   if RUSTYNET_EXPECTED_GIT_COMMIT="${RUSTYNET_EXPECTED_GIT_COMMIT:-}" \
 198:     bash "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/e2e/live_linux_cross_network_direct_remote_exit_test.sh" \
 199:       --ssh-identity-file "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE" \
 200:       --client-host "$CLIENT_HOST" \
 201:       --exit-host "$EXIT_HOST" \
 202:       --client-node-id "$CLIENT_NODE_ID" \
 203:       --exit-node-id "$EXIT_NODE_ID" \
 204:       --client-network-id "$CLIENT_NETWORK_ID" \
 205:       --exit-network-id "$EXIT_NETWORK_ID" \
 206:       --client-underlay-ip "${CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP:-}" \
 207:       --exit-underlay-ip "${EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP:-}" \
 208:       --nat-profile "$NAT_PROFILE" \
 209:       --impairment-profile "$IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE" \
 210:       --ssh-allow-cidrs "$SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS" \
 211:       --report-path "$DIRECT_REPORT_PATH" \
 212:       --log-path "$DIRECT_LOG_PATH"; then
 213:     direct_rc=0
 214:   else
 215:     direct_rc=$?
 216:   fi
 217: 
 218:   if [[ ! -f "$DIRECT_REPORT_PATH" ]]; then
 219:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="direct remote-exit child validator failed before emitting evidence"
 220:     return 1
 221:   fi
 222: 
 223:   mapfile -t direct_results < <(
 224:     cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops read-cross-network-report-fields \
 225:       --report-path "$DIRECT_REPORT_PATH" \
 226:       --include-status \
 227:       --check direct_remote_exit_success \
 228:       --check remote_exit_no_underlay_leak \
 229:       --check cross_network_topology_heuristic
 230:   ) || return 1
 231: 
 232:   if [[ "${direct_results[0]}" == 'pass' && "${direct_results[1]}" == 'pass' ]]; then
 233:     CHECK_DIRECT_REMOTE_EXIT_READY="pass"
 234:   fi
 235:   if [[ "${direct_results[2]}" == 'pass' ]]; then
 236:     CHECK_REMOTE_EXIT_NO_UNDERLAY_LEAK="pass"
 237:   fi
 238:   if [[ "${direct_results[3]}" == 'pass' ]]; then
 239:     CHECK_CROSS_NETWORK_TOPOLOGY_HEURISTIC="pass"
 240:   fi
 241: 
 242:   if [[ "$direct_rc" -ne 0 || "$CHECK_DIRECT_REMOTE_EXIT_READY" != 'pass' ]]; then
 243:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="direct remote-exit child validator did not prove a secure cross-network remote-exit path"
 244:     return 1
 245:   fi
 246: 
 247:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="running managed DNS validation on the remote-exit client"
 248:   if RUSTYNET_EXPECTED_GIT_COMMIT="${RUSTYNET_EXPECTED_GIT_COMMIT:-}" \
 249:     bash "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/e2e/live_linux_managed_dns_test.sh" \
 250:       --ssh-identity-file "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE" \
 251:       --signer-host "$EXIT_HOST" \
 252:       --client-host "$CLIENT_HOST" \
 253:       --signer-node-id "$EXIT_NODE_ID" \
 254:       --client-node-id "$CLIENT_NODE_ID" \
 255:       --ssh-allow-cidrs "$SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS" \
 256:       --zone-name "$ZONE_NAME" \
 257:       --dns-interface "$DNS_INTERFACE" \
 258:       --dns-bind-addr "$DNS_BIND_ADDR" \
 259:       --report-path "$MANAGED_DNS_REPORT_PATH" \
 260:       --log-path "$MANAGED_DNS_LOG_PATH"; then
 261:     managed_rc=0
 262:   else
 263:     managed_rc=$?
 264:   fi
 265: 
 266:   if [[ ! -f "$MANAGED_DNS_REPORT_PATH" ]]; then
 267:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="managed DNS child validator failed before emitting evidence"
 268:     return 1
 269:   fi
 270: 
 271:   mapfile -t managed_results < <(
 272:     cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops read-cross-network-report-fields \
 273:       --report-path "$MANAGED_DNS_REPORT_PATH" \
 274:       --include-status \
 275:       --check dns_inspect_valid \
 276:       --check managed_dns_service_active \
 277:       --check resolvectl_split_dns_configured \
 278:       --check loopback_resolver_answers_managed_name \
 279:       --check systemd_resolved_answers_managed_name \
 280:       --check alias_resolves_to_expected_ip \
 281:       --check non_managed_query_refused \
 282:       --check stale_bundle_fail_closed \
 283:       --check valid_bundle_restored
 284:   ) || return 1
 285: 
 286:   if [[ "${managed_results[0]}" == 'pass' ]]; then
 287:     CHECK_MANAGED_DNS_CHILD_READY="pass"
 288:   fi
 289:   if [[ "${managed_results[1]}" == 'pass' && "${managed_results[2]}" == 'pass' && "${managed_results[3]}" == 'pass' && "${managed_results[4]}" == 'pass' && "${managed_results[5]}" == 'pass' && "${managed_results[6]}" == 'pass' ]]; then
 290:     CHECK_MANAGED_DNS_RESOLUTION_SUCCESS="pass"
 291:   fi
 292:   if [[ "${managed_results[7]}" == 'pass' && "${managed_results[8]}" == 'pass' && "${managed_results[9]}" == 'pass' ]]; then
 293:     CHECK_REMOTE_EXIT_DNS_FAIL_CLOSED="pass"
 294:   fi
 295: 
 296:   if [[ "$managed_rc" -ne 0 || "$CHECK_MANAGED_DNS_CHILD_READY" != 'pass' ]]; then
 297:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="managed DNS child validator did not produce a passing managed DNS runtime"
 298:     return 1
 299:   fi
 300:   if [[ "$CHECK_MANAGED_DNS_RESOLUTION_SUCCESS" != 'pass' ]]; then
 301:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="managed DNS did not resolve securely on the remote-exit client"
 302:     return 1
 303:   fi
 304:   if [[ "$CHECK_REMOTE_EXIT_DNS_FAIL_CLOSED" != 'pass' ]]; then
 305:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="managed DNS did not fail closed under stale or unauthorized queries on the remote-exit client"
 306:     return 1
 307:   fi
 308:   if [[ "$CHECK_REMOTE_EXIT_NO_UNDERLAY_LEAK" != 'pass' ]]; then
 309:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="remote-exit DNS path could not prove underlay leak resistance"
 310:     return 1
 311:   fi
 312:   if [[ "$CHECK_CROSS_NETWORK_TOPOLOGY_HEURISTIC" != 'pass' ]]; then
 313:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="client and exit underlay topology did not credibly prove a cross-network claim"
 314:     return 1
 315:   fi
 316: 
 317:   FAILURE_SUMMARY=""
 318: }
 319: 
 320: if main; then
 321:   write_report pass
 322:   REPORT_WRITTEN=1
 323: else
 324:   write_report fail
 325:   REPORT_WRITTEN=1
 326:   exit 1
 327: fi
 328: 
 329: printf 'cross-network remote-exit DNS report written: %s\n' "$REPORT_PATH"

  78: validate_positive_integer() {

 144: trap cleanup EXIT
 145: 
 146: while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
 147:   case "$1" in
 148:     --ssh-identity-file) SSH_IDENTITY_FILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 149:     --known-hosts-file) KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 150:     --client-host) CLIENT_HOST="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 151:     --exit-host) EXIT_HOST="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 152:     --client-node-id) CLIENT_NODE_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 153:     --exit-node-id) EXIT_NODE_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 154:     --client-network-id) CLIENT_NETWORK_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 155:     --exit-network-id) EXIT_NETWORK_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 156:     --client-underlay-ip) CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 157:     --exit-underlay-ip) EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 158:     --nat-profile) NAT_PROFILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 159:     --impairment-profile) IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 160:     --ssh-allow-cidrs) SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 161:     --soak-duration-secs) SOAK_DURATION_SECS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 162:     --sample-interval-secs) SOAK_SAMPLE_INTERVAL_SECS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 163:     --max-consecutive-failures) SOAK_MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 164:     --max-failing-samples) SOAK_MAX_FAILING_SAMPLES="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 165:     --report-path) REPORT_PATH="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 166:     --log-path) LOG_PATH="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 167:     -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
 168:     *) echo "unknown argument: $1" >&2; usage; exit 2 ;;
 169:   esac
 170: done
 171: 
 172: if [[ -z "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE" || -z "$CLIENT_HOST" || -z "$EXIT_HOST" || -z "$CLIENT_NETWORK_ID" || -z "$EXIT_NETWORK_ID" ]]; then
 173:   usage >&2
 174:   exit 2
 175: fi
 176: if [[ -z "$NAT_PROFILE" || -z "$IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE" ]]; then
 177:   echo "--nat-profile and --impairment-profile must be non-empty" >&2
 178:   exit 2
 179: fi
 180: 
 181: if [[ "$CLIENT_HOST" == "$EXIT_HOST" ]]; then
 182:   echo "--client-host and --exit-host must differ" >&2
 183:   exit 2
 184: fi
 185: 
 186: if [[ "$CLIENT_NETWORK_ID" == "$EXIT_NETWORK_ID" ]]; then
 187:   echo "--client-network-id and --exit-network-id must differ" >&2
 188:   exit 2
 189: fi
 190: 
 191: if [[ -n "$CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
 192:   cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops validate-ipv4-address --ip "$CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP" >/dev/null
 193: fi
 194: if [[ -n "$EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
 195:   cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops validate-ipv4-address --ip "$EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP" >/dev/null
 196: fi
 197: 
 198: validate_positive_integer "soak duration seconds" "$SOAK_DURATION_SECS"
 199: validate_positive_integer "sample interval seconds" "$SOAK_SAMPLE_INTERVAL_SECS"
 200: validate_positive_integer "max consecutive failures" "$SOAK_MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES"
 201: validate_positive_integer "max failing samples" "$SOAK_MAX_FAILING_SAMPLES"
 202: 
 203: if (( SOAK_SAMPLE_INTERVAL_SECS > SOAK_DURATION_SECS )); then
 204:   echo "sample interval must be <= soak duration" >&2
 205:   exit 2
 206: fi
 207: if [[ -n "$KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE" ]]; then
 208:   export LIVE_LAB_PINNED_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE="$KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE"
 209: fi
 210: 
 211: mkdir -p "$(dirname "$REPORT_PATH")" "$(dirname "$LOG_PATH")"
 212: : > "$LOG_PATH"
 213: exec >> "$LOG_PATH" 2>&1
 214: 
 215: main() {
 216:   local artifact_dir direct_rc bypass_rc
 217:   local sample_result sample_reason
 218:   local client_status client_route client_endpoints
 219:   local final_client_status
 220:   local sample_ts start_ts end_ts elapsed_secs deadline
 221:   local samples=0 failing_samples=0 consecutive_failures=0 max_consecutive_observed=0
 222:   local first_failure_reason=""
 223:   local direct_samples=0 relay_samples=0 fail_closed_samples=0 other_path_samples=0
 224:   local path_transition_count=0 status_mismatch_samples=0 route_mismatch_samples=0
 225:   local endpoint_mismatch_samples=0 dns_alarm_bad_samples=0 transport_identity_failures=0
 226:   local endpoint_change_events_start=0 endpoint_change_events_end=0 endpoint_change_events_delta=0
 227:   local first_non_direct_reason="none" last_path_mode="none" last_path_reason="none"
 228:   local previous_path_mode=""
 229:   local client_plaintext_start exit_plaintext_start client_plaintext_end exit_plaintext_end
 230:   local status_ok route_ok endpoint_ok
 231:   local path_mode path_reason transport_identity_state transport_identity_error
 232:   local dns_alarm_state dns_alarm_reason endpoint_change_events_raw endpoint_change_events
 233:   local pre_leak_check="fail" pre_bypass_check="fail"
 234:   local post_leak_check="fail" post_bypass_check="fail"
 235: 
 236:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="preparing cross-network remote-exit soak artifacts"
 237:   WORK_DIR="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/rustynet-cross-network-remote-exit-soak.XXXXXX")"
 238: 
 239:   artifact_dir="$(dirname "$REPORT_PATH")"
 240:   DIRECT_REPORT_PATH="$artifact_dir/cross_network_remote_exit_soak_direct_remote_exit_report.json"
 241:   DIRECT_LOG_PATH="$artifact_dir/cross_network_remote_exit_soak_direct_remote_exit.log"
 242:   BYPASS_REPORT_PATH="$artifact_dir/cross_network_remote_exit_soak_server_ip_bypass_report.json"
 243:   BYPASS_LOG_PATH="$artifact_dir/cross_network_remote_exit_soak_server_ip_bypass.log"
 244:   MONITOR_LOG_PATH="$artifact_dir/cross_network_remote_exit_soak_monitor.log"
 245:   MONITOR_SUMMARY_PATH="$artifact_dir/cross_network_remote_exit_soak_monitor_summary.json"
 246:   SSH_TRUST_SUMMARY_PATH="$artifact_dir/cross_network_remote_exit_soak_ssh_trust_summary.txt"
 247:   SOURCE_ARTIFACTS=("$DIRECT_REPORT_PATH" "$BYPASS_REPORT_PATH" "$MONITOR_SUMMARY_PATH" "$SSH_TRUST_SUMMARY_PATH")
 248:   LOG_ARTIFACTS=("$DIRECT_LOG_PATH" "$BYPASS_LOG_PATH" "$MONITOR_LOG_PATH")
 249: 
 250:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="bootstrapping secure direct remote-exit baseline for soak validation"
 251:   if RUSTYNET_EXPECTED_GIT_COMMIT="${RUSTYNET_EXPECTED_GIT_COMMIT:-}" \
 252:     bash "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/e2e/live_linux_cross_network_direct_remote_exit_test.sh" \
 253:       --ssh-identity-file "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE" \
 254:       --client-host "$CLIENT_HOST" \
 255:       --exit-host "$EXIT_HOST" \
 256:       --client-node-id "$CLIENT_NODE_ID" \
 257:       --exit-node-id "$EXIT_NODE_ID" \
 258:       --client-network-id "$CLIENT_NETWORK_ID" \
 259:       --exit-network-id "$EXIT_NETWORK_ID" \
 260:       --client-underlay-ip "${CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP:-}" \
 261:       --exit-underlay-ip "${EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP:-}" \
 262:       --nat-profile "$NAT_PROFILE" \
 263:       --impairment-profile "$IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE" \
 264:       --ssh-allow-cidrs "$SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS" \
 265:       --report-path "$DIRECT_REPORT_PATH" \
 266:       --log-path "$DIRECT_LOG_PATH"; then
 267:     direct_rc=0
 268:   else
 269:     direct_rc=$?
 270:   fi
 271: 
 272:   if [[ ! -f "$DIRECT_REPORT_PATH" ]]; then
 273:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="direct remote-exit child validator failed before emitting evidence"
 274:     return 1
 275:   fi
 276: 
 277:   mapfile -t direct_results < <(
 278:     cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops read-cross-network-report-fields \
 279:       --report-path "$DIRECT_REPORT_PATH" \
 280:       --include-status \
 281:       --check direct_remote_exit_success \
 282:       --check remote_exit_no_underlay_leak \
 283:       --check remote_exit_server_ip_bypass_is_narrow \
 284:       --check cross_network_topology_heuristic
 285:   ) || return 1
 286: 
 287:   local direct_status="${direct_results[0]:-fail}"
 288:   local direct_success="${direct_results[1]:-fail}"
 289:   local direct_leak_check="${direct_results[2]:-fail}"
 290:   local direct_bypass_check="${direct_results[3]:-fail}"
 291:   local direct_topology_check="${direct_results[4]:-fail}"
 292:   local direct_client_underlay
 293:   local direct_exit_underlay
 294: 
 295:   if [[ "$direct_status" == 'pass' && "$direct_success" == 'pass' ]]; then
 296:     CHECK_DIRECT_REMOTE_EXIT_READY="pass"
 297:   fi
 298:   if [[ "$direct_leak_check" == 'pass' ]]; then
 299:     pre_leak_check="pass"
 300:   fi
 301:   if [[ "$direct_bypass_check" == 'pass' ]]; then
 302:     pre_bypass_check="pass"
 303:   fi
 304:   if [[ "$direct_topology_check" == 'pass' ]]; then
 305:     CHECK_CROSS_NETWORK_TOPOLOGY_HEURISTIC="pass"
 306:   fi
 307:   if [[ -n "$CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
 308:     direct_client_underlay="$CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP"
 309:   else
 310:     direct_client_underlay="$(live_lab_resolved_target_address "$CLIENT_HOST")"
 311:   fi
 312:   if [[ -n "$EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
 313:     direct_exit_underlay="$EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP"
 314:   else
 315:     direct_exit_underlay="$(live_lab_resolved_target_address "$EXIT_HOST")"
 316:   fi
 317:   CLIENT_ADDR="$direct_client_underlay"
 318:   EXIT_ADDR="$direct_exit_underlay"
 319: 
 320:   if [[ "$direct_rc" -ne 0 || "$CHECK_DIRECT_REMOTE_EXIT_READY" != 'pass' ]]; then
 321:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="direct remote-exit baseline failed; refusing soak claim"
 322:     return 1
 323:   fi
 324:   if [[ "$CHECK_CROSS_NETWORK_TOPOLOGY_HEURISTIC" != 'pass' ]]; then
 325:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="direct remote-exit baseline did not prove a credible cross-network topology"
 326:     return 1
 327:   fi
 328: 
 329:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="initializing live runtime monitor for cross-network soak"
 330:   live_lab_init "rustynet-cross-network-remote-exit-soak" "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE"
 331:   live_lab_push_sudo_password "$EXIT_HOST"
 332:   live_lab_push_sudo_password "$CLIENT_HOST"
 333:   live_lab_write_ssh_trust_summary "$SSH_TRUST_SUMMARY_PATH" "$CLIENT_HOST" "$EXIT_HOST"
 334:   live_lab_wait_for_daemon_socket "$EXIT_HOST"
 335:   live_lab_wait_for_daemon_socket "$CLIENT_HOST"
 336: 
 337:   client_plaintext_start="$(live_lab_no_plaintext_passphrase_check "$CLIENT_HOST" || true)"
 338:   exit_plaintext_start="$(live_lab_no_plaintext_passphrase_check "$EXIT_HOST" || true)"
 339: 
 340:   : > "$MONITOR_LOG_PATH"
 341:   start_ts="$(date +%s)"
 342:   deadline=$((start_ts + SOAK_DURATION_SECS))
 343: 
 344:   while (( $(date +%s) < deadline )); do
 345:     sample_ts="$(date +%s)"
 346:     samples=$((samples + 1))
 347:     sample_result="pass"
 348:     sample_reason=""
 349: 
 350:     if client_status="$(live_lab_status "$CLIENT_HOST" 2>/dev/null)"; then
 351:       status_ok=1
 352:     else
 353:       client_status="status-command-failed"
 354:       status_ok=0
 355:     fi
 356:     if client_route="$(live_lab_capture "$CLIENT_HOST" "ip -4 route get 1.1.1.1 || true" 2>/dev/null)"; then
 357:       route_ok=1
 358:     else
 359:       client_route="route-command-failed"
 360:       route_ok=0
 361:     fi
 362:     if client_endpoints="$(live_lab_capture_root "$CLIENT_HOST" "root wg show rustynet0 endpoints || true" 2>/dev/null)"; then
 363:       endpoint_ok=1
 364:     else
 365:       client_endpoints="endpoint-command-failed"
 366:       endpoint_ok=0
 367:     fi
 368: 
 369:     path_mode="$(live_lab_extract_inline_field "$client_status" "path_mode" || true)"
 370:     path_reason="$(live_lab_extract_inline_field "$client_status" "path_reason" || true)"
 371:     transport_identity_state="$(live_lab_extract_inline_field "$client_status" "transport_socket_identity_state" || true)"
 372:     transport_identity_error="$(live_lab_extract_inline_field "$client_status" "transport_socket_identity_error" || true)"
 373:     dns_alarm_state="$(live_lab_extract_inline_field "$client_status" "dns_alarm_state" || true)"
 374:     dns_alarm_reason="$(live_lab_extract_inline_field "$client_status" "dns_alarm_reason" || true)"
 375:     endpoint_change_events_raw="$(live_lab_extract_inline_field "$client_status" "traversal_endpoint_change_events" || true)"
 376:     if [[ "$endpoint_change_events_raw" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
 377:       endpoint_change_events="$endpoint_change_events_raw"
 378:     else
 379:       endpoint_change_events=0
 380:     fi
 381:     if (( samples == 1 )); then
 382:       endpoint_change_events_start="$endpoint_change_events"
 383:     fi
 384:     endpoint_change_events_end="$endpoint_change_events"
 385:     last_path_mode="${path_mode:-unknown}"
 386:     last_path_reason="${path_reason:-unknown}"
 387:     if [[ -n "$previous_path_mode" && "$last_path_mode" != "$previous_path_mode" ]]; then
 388:       path_transition_count=$((path_transition_count + 1))
 389:     fi
 390:     previous_path_mode="$last_path_mode"
 391: 
 392:     case "$last_path_mode" in
 393:       direct_active)
 394:         direct_samples=$((direct_samples + 1))
 395:         ;;
 396:       relay_active)
 397:         relay_samples=$((relay_samples + 1))
 398:         if [[ "$first_non_direct_reason" == "none" ]]; then
 399:           first_non_direct_reason="${last_path_reason:-unknown}"
 400:         fi
 401:         ;;
 402:       *)
 403:         if grep -Fq 'state=FailClosed' <<<"$client_status" || [[ "$last_path_mode" == *"fail_closed"* ]] || [[ "$last_path_mode" == *"blocked"* ]]; then
 404:           fail_closed_samples=$((fail_closed_samples + 1))
 405:         else
 406:           other_path_samples=$((other_path_samples + 1))
 407:         fi
 408:         if [[ "$last_path_mode" != "direct_active" && "$first_non_direct_reason" == "none" ]]; then
 409:           first_non_direct_reason="${last_path_reason:-unknown}"
 410:         fi
 411:         ;;
 412:     esac
 413: 
 414:     if [[ "$last_path_mode" != "direct_active" ]]; then
 415:       sample_result="fail"
 416:       sample_reason+="path_not_direct;"
 417:     fi
 418: 
 419:     if (( status_ok == 0 )) || ! grep -Fq "exit_node=${EXIT_NODE_ID}" <<<"$client_status" || ! grep -Fq 'state=ExitActive' <<<"$client_status"; then
 420:       sample_result="fail"
 421:       sample_reason+="status_not_exit_active;"
 422:       status_mismatch_samples=$((status_mismatch_samples + 1))
 423:     fi
 424:     if (( route_ok == 0 )) || ! grep -Fq 'dev rustynet0' <<<"$client_route"; then
 425:       sample_result="fail"
 426:       sample_reason+="route_not_tunnelled;"
 427:       route_mismatch_samples=$((route_mismatch_samples + 1))
 428:     fi
 429:     if (( endpoint_ok == 0 )) || ! grep -Fq "${EXIT_ADDR}:51820" <<<"$client_endpoints"; then
 430:       sample_result="fail"
 431:       sample_reason+="exit_endpoint_not_visible;"
 432:       endpoint_mismatch_samples=$((endpoint_mismatch_samples + 1))
 433:     fi
 434:     if [[ "$dns_alarm_state" == "critical" || "$dns_alarm_state" == "error" || "$dns_alarm_state" == "missing" || "${dns_alarm_reason:-none}" != "none" ]]; then
 435:       sample_result="fail"
 436:       sample_reason+="dns_alarm_bad;"
 437:       dns_alarm_bad_samples=$((dns_alarm_bad_samples + 1))
 438:     fi
 439:     if [[ "$transport_identity_state" != "authoritative_backend_shared_transport" || "${transport_identity_error:-none}" != "none" ]]; then
 440:       sample_result="fail"
 441:       sample_reason+="transport_identity_not_authoritative;"
 442:       transport_identity_failures=$((transport_identity_failures + 1))
 443:     fi
 444: 
 445:     printf '%s|sample=%s|result=%s|reason=%s|path_mode=%s|path_reason=%s|transport_identity_state=%s|transport_identity_error=%s|dns_alarm_state=%s|dns_alarm_reason=%s|endpoint_change_events=%s|status=%s|route=%s|endpoints=%s\n' \
 446:       "$sample_ts" \
 447:       "$samples" \
 448:       "$sample_result" \
 449:       "${sample_reason:-none}" \
 450:       "${last_path_mode:-unknown}" \
 451:       "${last_path_reason:-unknown}" \
 452:       "${transport_identity_state:-missing}" \
 453:       "${transport_identity_error:-missing}" \
 454:       "${dns_alarm_state:-missing}" \
 455:       "${dns_alarm_reason:-missing}" \
 456:       "$endpoint_change_events" \
 457:       "$(printf '%s' "$client_status" | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ';')" \
 458:       "$(printf '%s' "$client_route" | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ';')" \
 459:       "$(printf '%s' "$client_endpoints" | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ';')" >> "$MONITOR_LOG_PATH"
 460: 
 461:     if [[ "$sample_result" == "pass" ]]; then
 462:       consecutive_failures=0
 463:     else
 464:       failing_samples=$((failing_samples + 1))
 465:       consecutive_failures=$((consecutive_failures + 1))
 466:       if [[ -z "$first_failure_reason" ]]; then
 467:         first_failure_reason="${sample_reason:-unknown}"
 468:       fi
 469:       if (( consecutive_failures > max_consecutive_observed )); then
 470:         max_consecutive_observed="$consecutive_failures"
 471:       fi
 472:       if (( consecutive_failures > SOAK_MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES )); then
 473:         FAILURE_SUMMARY="soak monitor exceeded max consecutive failures (${SOAK_MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES})"
 474:         break
 475:       fi
 476:     fi
 477: 
 478:     sleep "$SOAK_SAMPLE_INTERVAL_SECS"
 479:   done
 480: 
 481:   end_ts="$(date +%s)"
 482:   elapsed_secs=$((end_ts - start_ts))
 483:   if (( endpoint_change_events_end >= endpoint_change_events_start )); then
 484:     endpoint_change_events_delta=$((endpoint_change_events_end - endpoint_change_events_start))
 485:   else
 486:     endpoint_change_events_delta=0
 487:   fi
 488: 
 489:   client_plaintext_end="$(live_lab_no_plaintext_passphrase_check "$CLIENT_HOST" || true)"
 490:   exit_plaintext_end="$(live_lab_no_plaintext_passphrase_check "$EXIT_HOST" || true)"
 491:   if [[ "$client_plaintext_start" == 'no-plaintext-passphrase-files' && "$exit_plaintext_start" == 'no-plaintext-passphrase-files' && "$client_plaintext_end" == 'no-plaintext-passphrase-files' && "$exit_plaintext_end" == 'no-plaintext-passphrase-files' ]]; then
 492:     CHECK_NO_PLAINTEXT_PASSPHRASE_FILES="pass"
 493:   fi
 494: 
 495:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="running post-soak leak and bypass verification"
 496:   if RUSTYNET_EXPECTED_GIT_COMMIT="${RUSTYNET_EXPECTED_GIT_COMMIT:-}" \
 497:     bash "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/e2e/live_linux_server_ip_bypass_test.sh" \
 498:       --ssh-identity-file "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE" \
 499:       --client-host "$CLIENT_HOST" \
 500:       --probe-host "$EXIT_HOST" \
 501:       --ssh-allow-cidrs "$SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS" \
 502:       --report-path "$BYPASS_REPORT_PATH" \
 503:       --log-path "$BYPASS_LOG_PATH"; then
 504:     bypass_rc=0
 505:   else
 506:     bypass_rc=$?
 507:   fi
 508: 
 509:   if [[ ! -f "$BYPASS_REPORT_PATH" ]]; then
 510:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="post-soak server-IP bypass validator failed before emitting evidence"
 511:     return 1
 512:   fi
 513: 
 514:   mapfile -t bypass_results < <(
 515:     cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops read-cross-network-report-fields \
 516:       --report-path "$BYPASS_REPORT_PATH" \
 517:       --include-status \
 518:       --check internet_route_via_rustynet0 \
 519:       --check probe_service_blocked_from_client \
 520:       --check probe_endpoint_route_direct_not_tunnelled \
 521:       --check no_unexpected_bypass_routes
 522:   ) || return 1
 523: 
 524:   local bypass_status_value="${bypass_results[0]:-fail}"
 525:   local bypass_route_tunnelled="${bypass_results[1]:-fail}"
 526:   local bypass_probe_blocked="${bypass_results[2]:-fail}"
 527:   local bypass_probe_direct="${bypass_results[3]:-fail}"
 528:   local bypass_no_unexpected="${bypass_results[4]:-fail}"
 529: 
 530:   if [[ "$bypass_status_value" == 'pass' ]]; then
 531:     CHECK_POST_SOAK_BYPASS_READY="pass"
 532:   fi
 533:   if [[ "$bypass_route_tunnelled" == 'pass' && "$bypass_probe_blocked" == 'pass' ]]; then
 534:     post_leak_check="pass"
 535:   fi
 536:   if [[ "$bypass_probe_blocked" == 'pass' && "$bypass_probe_direct" == 'pass' && "$bypass_no_unexpected" == 'pass' ]]; then
 537:     post_bypass_check="pass"
 538:   fi
 539: 
 540:   if [[ "$pre_leak_check" == 'pass' && "$post_leak_check" == 'pass' ]]; then
 541:     CHECK_REMOTE_EXIT_NO_UNDERLAY_LEAK="pass"
 542:   fi
 543:   if [[ "$pre_bypass_check" == 'pass' && "$post_bypass_check" == 'pass' ]]; then
 544:     CHECK_REMOTE_EXIT_SERVER_IP_BYPASS_IS_NARROW="pass"
 545:   fi
 546: 
 547:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="capturing final live-path evidence after soak"
 548:   final_client_status="$(live_lab_status "$CLIENT_HOST")"
 549:   PATH_STATUS_LINE="$final_client_status"
 550:   live_lab_log "Final client status after soak"
 551:   printf '%s\n' "$final_client_status"
 552: 
 553:   if (( samples > 0 && elapsed_secs >= SOAK_DURATION_SECS && failing_samples <= SOAK_MAX_FAILING_SAMPLES && max_consecutive_observed <= SOAK_MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES && bypass_rc == 0 && direct_samples == samples && relay_samples == 0 && fail_closed_samples == 0 && other_path_samples == 0 && path_transition_count == 0 && status_mismatch_samples == 0 && route_mismatch_samples == 0 && endpoint_mismatch_samples == 0 && dns_alarm_bad_samples == 0 && transport_identity_failures == 0 )) && [[ "$CHECK_NO_PLAINTEXT_PASSPHRASE_FILES" == 'pass' ]]; then
 554:     CHECK_LONG_SOAK_STABLE="pass"
 555:   fi
 556: 
 557:   cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops write-cross-network-soak-monitor-summary \
 558:     --path "$MONITOR_SUMMARY_PATH" \
 559:     --samples "$samples" \
 560:     --failing-samples "$failing_samples" \
 561:     --max-consecutive-failures-observed "$max_consecutive_observed" \
 562:     --elapsed-secs "$elapsed_secs" \
 563:     --required-soak-duration-secs "$SOAK_DURATION_SECS" \
 564:     --allowed-failing-samples "$SOAK_MAX_FAILING_SAMPLES" \
 565:     --allowed-max-consecutive-failures "$SOAK_MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES" \
 566:     --direct-remote-exit-ready "$CHECK_DIRECT_REMOTE_EXIT_READY" \
 567:     --post-soak-bypass-ready "$CHECK_POST_SOAK_BYPASS_READY" \
 568:     --no-plaintext-passphrase-files "$CHECK_NO_PLAINTEXT_PASSPHRASE_FILES" \
 569:     --direct-samples "$direct_samples" \
 570:     --relay-samples "$relay_samples" \
 571:     --fail-closed-samples "$fail_closed_samples" \
 572:     --other-path-samples "$other_path_samples" \
 573:     --path-transition-count "$path_transition_count" \
 574:     --status-mismatch-samples "$status_mismatch_samples" \
 575:     --route-mismatch-samples "$route_mismatch_samples" \
 576:     --endpoint-mismatch-samples "$endpoint_mismatch_samples" \
 577:     --dns-alarm-bad-samples "$dns_alarm_bad_samples" \
 578:     --transport-identity-failures "$transport_identity_failures" \
 579:     --endpoint-change-events-start "$endpoint_change_events_start" \
 580:     --endpoint-change-events-end "$endpoint_change_events_end" \
 581:     --endpoint-change-events-delta "$endpoint_change_events_delta" \
 582:     --first-non-direct-reason "${first_non_direct_reason:-none}" \
 583:     --last-path-mode "${last_path_mode:-none}" \
 584:     --last-path-reason "${last_path_reason:-none}" \
 585:     --first-failure-reason "${first_failure_reason:-none}" \
 586:     --long-soak-stable "$CHECK_LONG_SOAK_STABLE" >/dev/null
 587: 
 588:   if [[ "$CHECK_CROSS_NETWORK_TOPOLOGY_HEURISTIC" != 'pass' ]]; then
 589:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="soak path topology did not credibly prove a cross-network claim"
 590:     return 1
 591:   fi
 592:   if [[ "$CHECK_DIRECT_REMOTE_EXIT_READY" != 'pass' ]]; then
 593:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="soak path did not preserve direct remote-exit bootstrap proof"
 594:     return 1
 595:   fi
 596:   if [[ "$CHECK_POST_SOAK_BYPASS_READY" != 'pass' ]]; then
 597:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="soak path did not produce a passing post-soak server-IP bypass report"
 598:     return 1
 599:   fi
 600:   if [[ "$CHECK_NO_PLAINTEXT_PASSPHRASE_FILES" != 'pass' ]]; then
 601:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="soak path detected plaintext passphrase material before or after soak"
 602:     return 1
 603:   fi
 604:   if [[ "$CHECK_LONG_SOAK_STABLE" != 'pass' ]]; then
 605:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="cross-network remote-exit soak stability checks failed (samples=${samples}, failing=${failing_samples}, consecutive=${max_consecutive_observed}, direct=${direct_samples}, relay=${relay_samples}, fail_closed=${fail_closed_samples}, other=${other_path_samples}, transitions=${path_transition_count}, status_mismatch=${status_mismatch_samples}, route_mismatch=${route_mismatch_samples}, endpoint_mismatch=${endpoint_mismatch_samples}, dns_alarm_bad=${dns_alarm_bad_samples}, transport_identity_failures=${transport_identity_failures}, elapsed=${elapsed_secs}s, first_failure=${first_failure_reason:-none}, first_non_direct=${first_non_direct_reason:-none})"
 606:     return 1
 607:   fi
 608:   if [[ "$CHECK_REMOTE_EXIT_NO_UNDERLAY_LEAK" != 'pass' ]]; then
 609:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="cross-network remote-exit soak could not prove underlay leak resistance before and after soak"
 610:     return 1
 611:   fi
 612:   if [[ "$CHECK_REMOTE_EXIT_SERVER_IP_BYPASS_IS_NARROW" != 'pass' ]]; then
 613:     FAILURE_SUMMARY="cross-network remote-exit soak server-IP bypass scope was broader than allowed"
 614:     return 1
 615:   fi
 616: 
 617:   FAILURE_SUMMARY=""
 618: }
 619: 
 620: if main; then
 621:   write_report pass
 622:   REPORT_WRITTEN=1
 623: else
 624:   write_report fail
 625:   REPORT_WRITTEN=1
 626:   exit 1
 627: fi
 628: 
 629: printf 'cross-network remote-exit soak report written: %s\n' "$REPORT_PATH"

  96: format_elapsed_duration() {
  97:   local total_secs="${1:-0}"
  98:   local days hours minutes seconds
  99:   if (( total_secs < 0 )); then
 100:     total_secs=0
 101:   fi
 102:   days=$((total_secs / 86400))
 103:   hours=$(((total_secs % 86400) / 3600))
 104:   minutes=$(((total_secs % 3600) / 60))
 105:   seconds=$((total_secs % 60))
 106:   if (( days > 0 )); then
 107:     printf '%dd %02dh %02dm %02ds' "$days" "$hours" "$minutes" "$seconds"
 108:   elif (( hours > 0 )); then
 109:     printf '%02dh %02dm %02ds' "$hours" "$minutes" "$seconds"
 110:   else
 111:     printf '%02dm %02ds' "$minutes" "$seconds"
 112:   fi
 113: }

 124: options:
 125:   --profile <path>               Load saved lab profile (.env-style)
 126:   --source-mode <mode>           Source mode: working-tree | local-head | origin-main
 127:   --use-origin-main              Fetch and archive latest committed origin/main
 128:   --use-local-head               Archive local committed HEAD (default)
 129:   --exit-target <user@host|host>     Primary exit node target
 130:   --client-target <user@host|host>   Primary client node target
 131:   --entry-target <user@host|host>    Entry relay / alternate exit target
 132:   --aux-target <user@host|host>      Auxiliary client / blind-exit target
 133:   --extra-target <user@host|host>    Optional extra client target
 134:   --fifth-client-target <user@host|host>
 135:                                 Optional fifth client target for six-node live labs
 136:   --ssh-identity-file <path>     SSH private key for key-based authentication
 137:   --ssh-password-file <path>     REMOVED. Use --ssh-identity-file for key auth.
 138:   --sudo-password-file <path>    REMOVED. Password files are not accepted here.
 139:   --ssh-known-hosts-file <path>  Pinned SSH known_hosts file (defaults to ~/.ssh/known_hosts)
 140:   --network-id <id>              Override generated network ID
 141:   --ssh-allow-cidrs <cidrs>      SSH management CIDRs (default: ${SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS})
 142:   --repo-ref <ref>               Explicit git ref to archive (implies source-mode=ref)
 143:   --report-dir <path>            Override report output directory
 144:   --setup-only                   Run only the preflight + baseline setup stages
 145:   --skip-setup                   Skip preflight + baseline setup stages and run follow-on tests only
 146:   --preserve-report-state        Reuse an existing report dir instead of truncating stage state
 147:   --resume-from <stage>          Resume the setup stage sequence from a specific setup stage
 148:   --rerun-stage <stage>          Rerun one setup stage in an existing report dir
 149:   --max-parallel-node-workers <n>
 150:                                 Cap concurrent parallel worker fan-out (default: ${MAX_PARALLEL_NODE_WORKERS})
 151:   --traversal-ttl-secs <secs>    Signed traversal bundle TTL for issued lab bundles (1-120, default: ${TRAVERSAL_TTL_SECS})
 152:   --skip-gates                   Skip local full gate suite
 153:   --skip-soak                    Skip extended soak/reboot stages
 154:   --skip-cross-network           Skip cross-network validator stages
 155:   --force-cross-network          Force cross-network validator stages even on same-prefix underlay targets
 156:   --cross-network-nat-profiles <csv>
 157:                                  Cross-network NAT profile matrix to execute (default: ${CROSS_NETWORK_NAT_PROFILES})
 158:   --cross-network-required-nat-profiles <csv>
 159:                                  NAT profiles that must be present for matrix pass (default: same as --cross-network-nat-profiles)
 160:   --cross-network-impairment-profile <profile>
 161:                                  Deterministic stage-scoped impairment profile: none | latency_50ms_loss_1pct | latency_120ms_loss_3pct | loss_5pct (default: ${CROSS_NETWORK_IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE})
 162:   --cross-network-max-time-skew-secs <secs>
 163:                                  Maximum allowed host clock skew before cross-network validators run (default: ${CROSS_NETWORK_MAX_TIME_SKEW_SECS})
 164:   --cross-network-discovery-max-age-secs <secs>
 165:                                  Maximum allowed age for discovery bundles generated during preflight (default: ${CROSS_NETWORK_DISCOVERY_MAX_AGE_SECS})
 166:   --cross-network-signed-artifact-max-age-secs <secs>
 167:                                  Maximum allowed age for signed runtime artifacts in preflight (default: ${CROSS_NETWORK_SIGNED_ARTIFACT_MAX_AGE_SECS})
 168:   --cross-network-client-underlay-ip <ipv4>
 169:                                  Override client underlay endpoint/topology IP for cross-network validators
 170:   --cross-network-exit-underlay-ip <ipv4>
 171:                                  Override exit underlay endpoint/topology IP for cross-network validators
 172:   --cross-network-relay-underlay-ip <ipv4>
 173:                                  Override relay underlay endpoint/topology IP for cross-network validators
 174:   --cross-network-probe-underlay-ip <ipv4>
 175:                                  Override probe underlay endpoint/topology IP for cross-network validators
 176:   --reboot-hard-fail             Deprecated: extended soak is hard-fail by default
 177:   --dry-run                      Validate config and planned stages without touching hosts
 178:   -h, --help                     Show this help
 179: USAGE
 180: }

 182: prompt_value() {
 183:   local prompt="$1"
 184:   local default_value="${2:-}"
 185:   local reply
 186:   if [[ -n "$default_value" ]]; then
 187:     printf '%s [%s]: ' "$prompt" "$default_value" >&2
 188:   else
 189:     printf '%s: ' "$prompt" >&2
 190:   fi
 191:   read -r reply
 192:   if [[ -z "$reply" ]]; then
 193:     reply="$default_value"
 194:   fi
 195:   printf '%s' "$reply"
 196: }
 197: 
 198: prompt_secret() {
 199:   local prompt="$1"
 200:   local reply
 201:   printf '%s: ' "$prompt" >&2
 202:   read -r -s reply
 203:   printf '\n' >&2
 204:   printf '%s' "$reply"
 205: }
 206: 
 207: prompt_yes_no() {
 208:   local prompt="$1"
 209:   local default_answer="${2:-y}"
 210:   local suffix='[y/N]'
 211:   local reply=""
 212:   if [[ "$default_answer" == "y" || "$default_answer" == "Y" ]]; then
 213:     suffix='[Y/n]'
 214:   fi
 215:   while true; do
 216:     printf '%s %s: ' "$prompt" "$suffix" >&2
 217:     read -r reply
 218:     reply="$(trim_ascii "$reply")"
 219:     if [[ -z "$reply" ]]; then
 220:       reply="$default_answer"
 221:     fi
 222:     case "$reply" in
 223:       y|Y|yes|YES|Yes) return 0 ;;
 224:       n|N|no|NO|No) return 1 ;;
 225:       *) printf 'please answer yes or no\n' >&2 ;;
 226:     esac
 227:   done
 228: }
 229: 
 230: prompt_with_default() {
 231:   local prompt="$1"
 232:   local default_value="${2:-}"
 233:   local reply=""
 234:   if [[ -n "$default_value" ]]; then
 235:     printf '%s [%s]: ' "$prompt" "$default_value" >&2
 236:   else
 237:     printf '%s: ' "$prompt" >&2
 238:   fi
 239:   read -r reply
 240:   reply="$(trim_ascii "$reply")"
 241:   if [[ -z "$reply" ]]; then
 242:     reply="$default_value"
 243:   fi
 244:   printf '%s' "$reply"
 245: }

 247: require_cmd() {
 248:   local cmd="$1"
 249:   if ! command -v "$cmd" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 250:     printf 'missing required command: %s\n' "$cmd" >&2
 251:     return 1
 252:   fi
 253: }

 255: trim_ascii() {
 256:   local value="$1"
 257:   value="${value#"${value%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
 258:   value="${value%"${value##*[![:space:]]}"}"
 259:   printf '%s' "$value"
 260: }
 261: 
 262: validate_positive_integer() {
 263:   local name="$1"
 264:   local value="$2"
 265:   if [[ ! "$value" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || (( value <= 0 )); then
 266:     printf '%s must be a positive integer (got: %s)\n' "$name" "$value" >&2
 267:     return 1
 268:   fi
 269: }

 271: is_valid_profile_label() {
 272:   local value="$1"
 273:   [[ "$value" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ ]]
 274: }
 275: 
 276: is_supported_impairment_profile() {
 277:   local value="$1"
 278:   case "$value" in
 279:     none|latency_50ms_loss_1pct|latency_120ms_loss_3pct|loss_5pct) return 0 ;;
 280:     *) return 1 ;;
 281:   esac
 282: }

 284: parse_profile_csv_to_array() {
 285:   local raw="$1"
 286:   local target_array_name="$2"
 287:   local item trimmed existing duplicate
 288:   local -a items=()
 289:   local -a parsed=()
 290:   IFS=',' read -r -a items <<< "$raw"
 291:   for item in "${items[@]-}"; do
 292:     trimmed="$(trim_ascii "$item")"
 293:     [[ -n "$trimmed" ]] || continue
 294:     if ! is_valid_profile_label "$trimmed"; then
 295:       printf 'invalid profile label: %s\n' "$trimmed" >&2
 296:       return 1
 297:     fi
 298:     duplicate=0
 299:     for existing in "${parsed[@]-}"; do
 300:       if [[ "$existing" == "$trimmed" ]]; then
 301:         duplicate=1
 302:         break
 303:       fi
 304:     done
 305:     [[ "$duplicate" -eq 1 ]] && continue
 306:     parsed+=("$trimmed")
 307:   done
 308:   if [[ "${#parsed[@]}" -eq 0 ]]; then
 309:     printf 'profile list must include at least one non-empty label\n' >&2
 310:     return 1
 311:   fi
 312:   case "$target_array_name" in
 313:     CROSS_NETWORK_NAT_PROFILE_LIST)
 314:       CROSS_NETWORK_NAT_PROFILE_LIST=("${parsed[@]}")
 315:       ;;
 316:     CROSS_NETWORK_REQUIRED_NAT_PROFILE_LIST)
 317:       CROSS_NETWORK_REQUIRED_NAT_PROFILE_LIST=("${parsed[@]}")
 318:       ;;
 319:     *)
 320:       printf 'unsupported profile array target: %s\n' "$target_array_name" >&2
 321:       return 1
 322:       ;;
 323:   esac
 324: }
 325: 
 326: join_csv() {
 327:   local IFS=','
 328:   printf '%s' "$*"
 329: }
 330: 
 331: derive_ipv4_cidr_24() {
 332:   local address="$1"
 333:   if [[ "$address" =~ ^([0-9]{1,3})\.([0-9]{1,3})\.([0-9]{1,3})\.[0-9]{1,3}$ ]]; then
 334:     printf '%s.%s.%s.0/24' "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}" "${BASH_REMATCH[2]}" "${BASH_REMATCH[3]}"
 335:     return 0
 336:   fi
 337:   return 1
 338: }
 339: 
 340: auto_adjust_default_ssh_allow_cidrs_for_targets() {
 341:   local legacy_default="192.168.18.0/24"
 342:   local target address cidr existing duplicate
 343:   local -a derived=()
 344:   if [[ "$SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS" != "$legacy_default" ]]; then
 345:     return 0
 346:   fi
 347:   for target in "$EXIT_TARGET" "$CLIENT_TARGET" "$ENTRY_TARGET" "$AUX_TARGET" "$EXTRA_TARGET" "$FIFTH_CLIENT_TARGET"; do
 348:     [[ -n "$target" ]] || continue
 349:     address="$(live_lab_resolved_target_address "$target")"
 350:     if ! cidr="$(derive_ipv4_cidr_24 "$address")"; then
 351:       # Keep explicit/default value unchanged for non-IPv4 targets.
 352:       return 0
 353:     fi
 354:     duplicate=0
 355:     for existing in "${derived[@]-}"; do
 356:       if [[ "$existing" == "$cidr" ]]; then
 357:         duplicate=1
 358:         break
 359:       fi
 360:     done
 361:     if [[ "$duplicate" -eq 0 ]]; then
 362:       derived+=("$cidr")
 363:     fi
 364:   done
 365:   if [[ "${#derived[@]}" -gt 0 ]]; then
 366:     SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS="$(join_csv "${derived[@]}")"
 367:     if [[ "$SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS" != "$legacy_default" ]]; then
 368:       printf 'auto-adjusted SSH allow CIDRs from %s to %s based on target underlay addresses\n' \
 369:         "$legacy_default" "$SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS"
 370:     fi
 371:   fi
 372: }
 373: 
 374: prepare_cross_network_profile_config() {
 375:   parse_profile_csv_to_array "$CROSS_NETWORK_NAT_PROFILES" CROSS_NETWORK_NAT_PROFILE_LIST || return 1
 376:   if [[ -z "$CROSS_NETWORK_REQUIRED_NAT_PROFILES" ]]; then
 377:     CROSS_NETWORK_REQUIRED_NAT_PROFILES="$(join_csv "${CROSS_NETWORK_NAT_PROFILE_LIST[@]}")"
 378:   fi
 379:   parse_profile_csv_to_array "$CROSS_NETWORK_REQUIRED_NAT_PROFILES" CROSS_NETWORK_REQUIRED_NAT_PROFILE_LIST || return 1
 380:   if [[ -z "$CROSS_NETWORK_IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE" ]]; then
 381:     printf 'cross-network impairment profile must be non-empty\n' >&2
 382:     return 1
 383:   fi
 384:   if ! is_valid_profile_label "$CROSS_NETWORK_IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE"; then
 385:     printf 'invalid cross-network impairment profile: %s\n' "$CROSS_NETWORK_IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE" >&2
 386:     return 1
 387:   fi
 388:   if ! is_supported_impairment_profile "$CROSS_NETWORK_IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE"; then
 389:     printf 'unsupported cross-network impairment profile: %s (supported: none, latency_50ms_loss_1pct, latency_120ms_loss_3pct, loss_5pct)\n' "$CROSS_NETWORK_IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE" >&2
 390:     return 1
 391:   fi
 392:   local required profile found
 393:   for required in "${CROSS_NETWORK_REQUIRED_NAT_PROFILE_LIST[@]}"; do
 394:     found=0
 395:     for profile in "${CROSS_NETWORK_NAT_PROFILE_LIST[@]}"; do
 396:       if [[ "$profile" == "$required" ]]; then
 397:         found=1
 398:         break
 399:       fi
 400:     done
 401:     if [[ "$found" -eq 0 ]]; then
 402:       printf 'required NAT profile %s is not present in configured cross-network NAT profiles (%s)\n' \
 403:         "$required" "$CROSS_NETWORK_NAT_PROFILES" >&2
 404:       return 1
 405:     fi
 406:   done
 407: }

 412:   if [[ "$index" -eq 0 ]]; then
 413:     printf ''
 414:   else
 415:     printf '_%s' "$profile"
 416:   fi
 417: }

 443: is_valid_ipv4() {
 444:   local ip="$1"
 445:   local octet
 446:   local IFS='.'
 447:   read -r -a octets <<< "$ip"
 448:   [[ ${#octets[@]} -eq 4 ]] || return 1
 449:   for octet in "${octets[@]}"; do
 450:     [[ "$octet" =~ ^[0-9]{1,3}$ ]] || return 1
 451:     ((octet >= 0 && octet <= 255)) || return 1
 452:   done
 453: }
 454: 
 455: host_part_from_target() {
 456:   local target="$1"
 457:   if [[ "$target" == *"@"* ]]; then
 458:     printf '%s' "${target#*@}"
 459:   else
 460:     printf '%s' "$target"
 461:   fi
 462: }
 463: 
 464: validate_target_host() {
 465:   local label="$1"
 466:   local target="$2"
 467:   local host
 468:   host="$(host_part_from_target "$target")"
 469:   if [[ -z "$host" ]]; then
 470:     printf 'missing host for %s target\n' "$label" >&2
 471:     return 1
 472:   fi
 473:   if [[ "$host" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
 474:     if ! is_valid_ipv4 "$host"; then
 475:       printf 'invalid IPv4 address for %s target: %s\n' "$label" "$host" >&2
 476:       return 1
 477:     fi
 478:     return 0
 479:   fi
 480:   if [[ "$host" == *:* ]]; then
 481:     if [[ "$host" =~ ^[0-9A-Fa-f:]+$ ]]; then
 482:       return 0
 483:     fi
 484:     printf 'invalid IPv6 address for %s target: %s\n' "$label" "$host" >&2
 485:     return 1
 486:   fi
 487:   if [[ ! "$host" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ ]]; then
 488:     printf 'invalid host syntax for %s target: %s\n' "$label" "$host" >&2
 489:     return 1
 490:   fi
 491: }

 493: load_profile_file() {
 494:   local profile_path="$1"
 495:   local line key value
 496:   if [[ ! -f "$profile_path" ]]; then
 497:     printf 'missing profile file: %s\n' "$profile_path" >&2
 498:     return 1
 499:   fi
 500:   while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
 501:     line="$(trim_ascii "$line")"
 502:     [[ -n "$line" ]] || continue
 503:     [[ "${line:0:1}" == "#" ]] && continue
 504:     if [[ "$line" != *=* ]]; then
 505:       printf 'invalid profile line (expected KEY=VALUE): %s\n' "$line" >&2
 506:       return 1
 507:     fi
 508:     key="$(trim_ascii "${line%%=*}")"
 509:     value="${line#*=}"
 510:     value="$(trim_ascii "$value")"
 511:     if [[ "$value" == \"*\" && "$value" == *\" ]]; then
 512:       value="${value:1:${#value}-2}"
 513:     elif [[ "$value" == \'*\' && "$value" == *\' ]]; then
 514:       value="${value:1:${#value}-2}"
 515:     fi
 516:     case "$key" in
 517:       EXIT_TARGET) [[ -z "$EXIT_TARGET" ]] && EXIT_TARGET="$value" ;;
 518:       CLIENT_TARGET) [[ -z "$CLIENT_TARGET" ]] && CLIENT_TARGET="$value" ;;
 519:       EXIT_PLATFORM)    [[ -z "${EXIT_PLATFORM:-}"          || "$EXIT_PLATFORM"          == "linux" ]] && EXIT_PLATFORM="$value" ;;
 520:       CLIENT_PLATFORM)  [[ -z "${CLIENT_PLATFORM:-}"        || "$CLIENT_PLATFORM"        == "linux" ]] && CLIENT_PLATFORM="$value" ;;
 521:       ENTRY_PLATFORM)   [[ -z "${ENTRY_PLATFORM:-}"         || "$ENTRY_PLATFORM"         == "linux" ]] && ENTRY_PLATFORM="$value" ;;
 522:       AUX_PLATFORM)     [[ -z "${AUX_PLATFORM:-}"           || "$AUX_PLATFORM"           == "linux" ]] && AUX_PLATFORM="$value" ;;
 523:       EXTRA_PLATFORM)   [[ -z "${EXTRA_PLATFORM:-}"         || "$EXTRA_PLATFORM"         == "linux" ]] && EXTRA_PLATFORM="$value" ;;
 524:       FIFTH_CLIENT_PLATFORM) [[ -z "${FIFTH_CLIENT_PLATFORM:-}" || "$FIFTH_CLIENT_PLATFORM" == "linux" ]] && FIFTH_CLIENT_PLATFORM="$value" ;;
 525:       EXIT_REMOTE_SHELL|CLIENT_REMOTE_SHELL|ENTRY_REMOTE_SHELL|AUX_REMOTE_SHELL|EXTRA_REMOTE_SHELL|FIFTH_CLIENT_REMOTE_SHELL)
 526:         ;;
 527:       EXIT_GUEST_EXEC_MODE|CLIENT_GUEST_EXEC_MODE|ENTRY_GUEST_EXEC_MODE|AUX_GUEST_EXEC_MODE|EXTRA_GUEST_EXEC_MODE|FIFTH_CLIENT_GUEST_EXEC_MODE)
 528:         ;;
 529:       EXIT_SERVICE_MANAGER|CLIENT_SERVICE_MANAGER|ENTRY_SERVICE_MANAGER|AUX_SERVICE_MANAGER|EXTRA_SERVICE_MANAGER|FIFTH_CLIENT_SERVICE_MANAGER)
 530:         ;;
 531:       EXIT_RUSTYNET_SRC_DIR|CLIENT_RUSTYNET_SRC_DIR|ENTRY_RUSTYNET_SRC_DIR|AUX_RUSTYNET_SRC_DIR|EXTRA_RUSTYNET_SRC_DIR|FIFTH_CLIENT_RUSTYNET_SRC_DIR)
 532:         ;;
 533:       EXIT_UTM_NAME) [[ -z "$EXIT_UTM_NAME" ]] && EXIT_UTM_NAME="$value" ;;
 534:       CLIENT_UTM_NAME) [[ -z "$CLIENT_UTM_NAME" ]] && CLIENT_UTM_NAME="$value" ;;
 535:       ENTRY_TARGET)
 536:         ENTRY_TARGET_DECLARED=1
 537:         [[ -z "$ENTRY_TARGET" ]] && ENTRY_TARGET="$value"
 538:         ;;
 539:       ENTRY_UTM_NAME) [[ -z "$ENTRY_UTM_NAME" ]] && ENTRY_UTM_NAME="$value" ;;
 540:       AUX_TARGET)
 541:         AUX_TARGET_DECLARED=1
 542:         [[ -z "$AUX_TARGET" ]] && AUX_TARGET="$value"
 543:         ;;
 544:       AUX_UTM_NAME) [[ -z "$AUX_UTM_NAME" ]] && AUX_UTM_NAME="$value" ;;
 545:       EXTRA_TARGET)
 546:         EXTRA_TARGET_DECLARED=1
 547:         [[ -z "$EXTRA_TARGET" ]] && EXTRA_TARGET="$value"
 548:         ;;
 549:       EXTRA_UTM_NAME) [[ -z "$EXTRA_UTM_NAME" ]] && EXTRA_UTM_NAME="$value" ;;
 550:       FIFTH_CLIENT_TARGET)
 551:         FIFTH_CLIENT_TARGET_DECLARED=1
 552:         [[ -z "$FIFTH_CLIENT_TARGET" ]] && FIFTH_CLIENT_TARGET="$value"
 553:         ;;
 554:       FIFTH_CLIENT_UTM_NAME) [[ -z "$FIFTH_CLIENT_UTM_NAME" ]] && FIFTH_CLIENT_UTM_NAME="$value" ;;
 555:       SSH_IDENTITY_FILE) [[ -z "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE" ]] && SSH_IDENTITY_FILE="$value" ;;
 556:       SSH_PASSWORD_FILE) [[ -z "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE" ]] && SSH_IDENTITY_FILE="$value" ;;
 557:       SUDO_PASSWORD_FILE) [[ -z "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE" ]] && SSH_IDENTITY_FILE="$value" ;;
 558:       SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE) [[ -z "$SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE" ]] && SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE="$value" ;;
 559:       NETWORK_ID) [[ "$NETWORK_ID" == rn-live-lab-* ]] && NETWORK_ID="$value" ;;
 560:       SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS) [[ "$SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS" == "192.168.18.0/24" ]] && SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS="$value" ;;
 561:       TRAVERSAL_TTL_SECS) [[ "$TRAVERSAL_TTL_SECS" == "120" ]] && TRAVERSAL_TTL_SECS="$value" ;;
 562:       CROSS_NETWORK_NAT_PROFILES) [[ "$CROSS_NETWORK_NAT_PROFILES" == "${RUSTYNET_CROSS_NETWORK_NAT_PROFILES:-baseline_lan}" ]] && CROSS_NETWORK_NAT_PROFILES="$value" ;;
 563:       CROSS_NETWORK_REQUIRED_NAT_PROFILES) [[ -z "$CROSS_NETWORK_REQUIRED_NAT_PROFILES" ]] && CROSS_NETWORK_REQUIRED_NAT_PROFILES="$value" ;;
 564:       CROSS_NETWORK_IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE) [[ "$CROSS_NETWORK_IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE" == "${RUSTYNET_CROSS_NETWORK_IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE:-none}" ]] && CROSS_NETWORK_IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE="$value" ;;
 565:       CROSS_NETWORK_MAX_TIME_SKEW_SECS) [[ "$CROSS_NETWORK_MAX_TIME_SKEW_SECS" == "${RUSTYNET_CROSS_NETWORK_MAX_TIME_SKEW_SECS:-2}" ]] && CROSS_NETWORK_MAX_TIME_SKEW_SECS="$value" ;;
 566:       CROSS_NETWORK_DISCOVERY_MAX_AGE_SECS) [[ "$CROSS_NETWORK_DISCOVERY_MAX_AGE_SECS" == "${RUSTYNET_CROSS_NETWORK_DISCOVERY_MAX_AGE_SECS:-900}" ]] && CROSS_NETWORK_DISCOVERY_MAX_AGE_SECS="$value" ;;
 567:       CROSS_NETWORK_SIGNED_ARTIFACT_MAX_AGE_SECS) [[ "$CROSS_NETWORK_SIGNED_ARTIFACT_MAX_AGE_SECS" == "${RUSTYNET_CROSS_NETWORK_SIGNED_ARTIFACT_MAX_AGE_SECS:-900}" ]] && CROSS_NETWORK_SIGNED_ARTIFACT_MAX_AGE_SECS="$value" ;;
 568:       CROSS_NETWORK_CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP) [[ -z "$CROSS_NETWORK_CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP" ]] && CROSS_NETWORK_CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP="$value" ;;
 569:       CROSS_NETWORK_EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP) [[ -z "$CROSS_NETWORK_EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP" ]] && CROSS_NETWORK_EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP="$value" ;;
 570:       CROSS_NETWORK_RELAY_UNDERLAY_IP) [[ -z "$CROSS_NETWORK_RELAY_UNDERLAY_IP" ]] && CROSS_NETWORK_RELAY_UNDERLAY_IP="$value" ;;
 571:       CROSS_NETWORK_PROBE_UNDERLAY_IP) [[ -z "$CROSS_NETWORK_PROBE_UNDERLAY_IP" ]] && CROSS_NETWORK_PROBE_UNDERLAY_IP="$value" ;;
 572:       RUSTYNET_BACKEND) [[ -z "$RUSTYNET_BACKEND" ]] && RUSTYNET_BACKEND="$value" ;;
 573:       SOURCE_MODE)
 574:         if [[ "$SOURCE_MODE_EXPLICIT" -eq 0 ]]; then
 575:           SOURCE_MODE="$value"
 576:           SOURCE_MODE_EXPLICIT=1
 577:         fi
 578:         ;;
 579:       REPO_REF)
 580:         if [[ "$SOURCE_MODE_EXPLICIT" -eq 0 || "$SOURCE_MODE" == "ref" ]]; then
 581:           REPO_REF="$value"
 582:           if [[ "$SOURCE_MODE_EXPLICIT" -eq 0 ]]; then
 583:             SOURCE_MODE="ref"
 584:             SOURCE_MODE_EXPLICIT=1
 585:           fi
 586:         fi
 587:         ;;
 588:       REPORT_DIR)
 589:         if [[ "$REPORT_DIR" == "${ROOT_DIR}/artifacts/live_lab/${RUN_ID}" ]]; then
 590:           REPORT_DIR="$value"
 591:           LOG_DIR="$REPORT_DIR/logs"
 592:           VERIFICATION_DIR="$REPORT_DIR/verification"
 593:           STATE_DIR="$REPORT_DIR/state"
 594:           SUMMARY_JSON="$REPORT_DIR/run_summary.json"
 595:           SUMMARY_MD="$REPORT_DIR/run_summary.md"
 596:           FAILURE_DIGEST_JSON="$REPORT_DIR/failure_digest.json"
 597:           FAILURE_DIGEST_MD="$REPORT_DIR/failure_digest.md"
 598:           STAGE_TSV="$STATE_DIR/stages.tsv"
 599:           NODES_TSV="$STATE_DIR/nodes.tsv"
 600:           SOURCE_ARCHIVE="$STATE_DIR/rustynet-source.tar.gz"
 601:           PUBKEYS_TSV="$STATE_DIR/pubkeys.tsv"
 602:           ONEHOP_STATE_ENV="$STATE_DIR/onehop_state.env"
 603:         fi
 604:         ;;
 605:       '')
 606:         ;;
 607:       *)
 608:         printf 'unsupported profile key: %s\n' "$key" >&2
 609:         return 1
 610:         ;;
 611:     esac
 612:     :
 613:   done < "$profile_path"
 614:   return 0
 615: }
 616: 
 617: validate_source_mode() {
 618:   case "$SOURCE_MODE" in
 619:     working-tree|local-head|origin-main|ref)
 620:       ;;
 621:     *)
 622:       printf 'unsupported source mode: %s\n' "$SOURCE_MODE" >&2
 623:       return 1
 624:       ;;
 625:   esac
 626:   if [[ "$SOURCE_MODE" == "ref" ]]; then
 627:     if [[ -z "$REPO_REF" ]]; then
 628:       printf 'source-mode=ref requires --repo-ref <ref>\n' >&2
 629:       return 1
 630:     fi
 631:   fi
 632: }
 633: 
 634: resolve_source_ref() {
 635:   case "$SOURCE_MODE" in
 636:     local-head)
 637:       printf 'HEAD'
 638:       ;;
 639:     origin-main)
 640:       printf 'origin/main'
 641:       ;;
 642:     ref)
 643:       printf '%s' "$REPO_REF"
 644:       ;;
 645:     *)
 646:       printf ''
 647:       ;;
 648:   esac
 649: }
 650: 
 651: describe_source_mode() {
 652:   case "$SOURCE_MODE" in
 653:     working-tree)
 654:       printf 'local working tree'
 655:       ;;
 656:     local-head)
 657:       printf 'local committed HEAD'
 658:       ;;
 659:     origin-main)
 660:       printf 'latest committed origin/main'
 661:       ;;
 662:     ref)
 663:       printf 'git ref %s' "$REPO_REF"
 664:       ;;
 665:   esac
 666: }
