 668: fetch_git_ref_if_needed() {
 669:   local ref="$1"
 670:   if is_origin_branch_ref "$ref"; then
 671:     git -C "$ROOT_DIR" fetch origin --prune --quiet
 672:   fi
 673: }
 674: 
 675: git_ref_exists() {
 676:   local ref="$1"
 677:   git -C "$ROOT_DIR" rev-parse --verify --quiet "$ref" >/dev/null 2>&1
 678: }
 679: 
 680: is_origin_branch_ref() {
 681:   local ref="$1"
 682:   [[ "$ref" == origin/* ]]
 683: }
 684: 
 685: collect_interactive_git_branches() {
 686:   local branch
 687:   local seen=""
 688:   local branches=()
 689:   local remote_count=0
 690: 
 691:   while IFS= read -r branch; do
 692:     branch="$(trim_ascii "$branch")"
 693:     [[ -n "$branch" ]] || continue
 694:     [[ "$branch" == "origin" ]] && continue
 695:     [[ "$branch" == "HEAD" ]] && continue
 696:     [[ "$branch" == "origin/HEAD" ]] && continue
 697:     branch="${branch#origin/}"
 698:     if [[ ",$seen," != *",$branch,"* ]]; then
 699:       branches+=("$branch")
 700:       seen="${seen},${branch}"
 701:       remote_count=$((remote_count + 1))
 702:     fi
 703:   done < <(git -C "$ROOT_DIR" for-each-ref refs/remotes/origin --format='%(refname:short)' 2>/dev/null || true)
 704: 
 705:   if (( remote_count > 0 )); then
 706:     printf '%s\n' "${branches[@]}"
 707:     return 0
 708:   fi
 709: 
 710:   while IFS= read -r branch; do
 711:     branch="$(trim_ascii "$branch")"
 712:     [[ -n "$branch" ]] || continue
 713:     if [[ ",$seen," != *",$branch,"* ]]; then
 714:       branches+=("$branch")
 715:       seen="${seen},${branch}"
 716:     fi
 717:   done < <(git -C "$ROOT_DIR" for-each-ref refs/heads --format='%(refname:short)' 2>/dev/null || true)
 718: 
 719:   printf '%s\n' "${branches[@]}"
 720: }
 721: 
 722: default_interactive_git_branch() {
 723:   if git_ref_exists "refs/remotes/origin/main"; then
 724:     printf 'main'
 725:     return 0
 726:   fi
 727:   if git_ref_exists "refs/heads/main"; then
 728:     printf 'main'
 729:     return 0
 730:   fi
 731:   git -C "$ROOT_DIR" symbolic-ref --quiet --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || true
 732: }
 733: 
 734: resolve_interactive_git_branch_ref() {
 735:   local branch_name="$1"
 736:   if git_ref_exists "refs/remotes/origin/${branch_name}"; then
 737:     printf 'origin/%s' "$branch_name"
 738:     return 0
 739:   fi
 740:   if git_ref_exists "refs/heads/${branch_name}"; then
 741:     printf '%s' "$branch_name"
 742:     return 0
 743:   fi
 744:   if git_ref_exists "$branch_name"; then
 745:     printf '%s' "$branch_name"
 746:     return 0
 747:   fi
 748:   return 1
 749: }
 750: 
 751: prompt_for_git_branch_source() {
 752:   local fetch_failed=0
 753:   local branch_lines branch_count=0
 754:   local branch_choices=()
 755:   local branch default_branch selection selected_ref index
 756: 
 757:   if ! git -C "$ROOT_DIR" fetch origin --prune --quiet; then
 758:     fetch_failed=1
 759:     printf 'warning: git fetch origin failed; listing currently available local refs\n' >&2
 760:   fi
 761: 
 762:   branch_lines="$(collect_interactive_git_branches)"
 763:   while IFS= read -r branch; do
 764:     branch="$(trim_ascii "$branch")"
 765:     [[ -n "$branch" ]] || continue
 766:     branch_choices+=("$branch")
 767:     branch_count=$((branch_count + 1))
 768:   done <<< "$branch_lines"
 769: 
 770:   if [[ "$branch_count" -eq 0 ]]; then
 771:     printf 'no git branches available for interactive selection\n' >&2
 772:     return 1
 773:   fi
 774: 
 775:   printf 'Available branches:\n' >&2
 776:   for index in "${!branch_choices[@]}"; do
 777:     printf '  %d) %s\n' "$((index + 1))" "${branch_choices[$index]}" >&2
 778:   done
 779: 
 780:   default_branch="$(default_interactive_git_branch)"
 781:   if [[ -z "$default_branch" ]]; then
 782:     default_branch="${branch_choices[0]}"
 783:   fi
 784: 
 785:   while true; do
 786:     selection="$(prompt_with_default 'Branch to deploy (number or name)' "$default_branch")"
 787:     if [[ "$selection" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
 788:       index=$((selection - 1))
 789:       if (( index >= 0 && index < ${#branch_choices[@]} )); then
 790:         selection="${branch_choices[$index]}"
 791:       else
 792:         printf 'invalid branch selection: %s\n' "$selection" >&2
 793:         continue
 794:       fi
 795:     fi
 796:     selected_ref="$(resolve_interactive_git_branch_ref "$selection")" || {
 797:       printf 'unknown branch: %s\n' "$selection" >&2
 798:       continue
 799:     }
 800:     SOURCE_MODE="ref"
 801:     REPO_REF="$selected_ref"
 802:     if [[ "$fetch_failed" -eq 0 && "$selected_ref" == "origin/main" ]]; then
 803:       SOURCE_MODE="origin-main"
 804:     fi
 805:     return 0
 806:   done
 807: }

 809: node_target_for_label() {
 810:   local label="$1"
 811:   awk -F '\t' -v label="$label" '$1 == label { print $2; exit }' "$NODES_TSV"
 812: }

 814: node_id_for_label() {
 815:   local label="$1"
 816:   awk -F '\t' -v label="$label" '$1 == label { print $3; exit }' "$NODES_TSV"
 817: }
 818: 
 819: node_role_for_label() {
 820:   local label="$1"
 821:   awk -F '\t' -v label="$label" '$1 == label { print $4; exit }' "$NODES_TSV"
 822: }

 824: has_label() {
 825:   local label="$1"
 826:   awk -F '\t' -v label="$label" '$1 == label { found=1; exit } END { exit(found ? 0 : 1) }' "$NODES_TSV"
 827: }
 828: 
 829: node_count() {
 830:   awk 'END { print NR + 0 }' "$NODES_TSV"
 831: }

 833: has_four_node_live_topology() {
 834:   has_label entry && has_label aux
 835: }
 836: 
 837: has_five_node_release_gate_topology() {
 838:   has_four_node_live_topology && has_label extra
 839: }

 841: managed_peer_labels() {
 842:   awk -F '\t' '$1 != "exit" && $1 != "client" { print $1 }' "$NODES_TSV"
 843: }

 845: cross_network_network_id_for_label() {
 846:   local label="$1"
 847:   printf '%s-%s' "$NETWORK_ID" "$label"
 848: }

 850: cross_network_override_underlay_ip_for_label() {
 851:   local label="$1"
 852:   case "$label" in
 853:     client) printf '%s' "$CROSS_NETWORK_CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP" ;;
 854:     exit) printf '%s' "$CROSS_NETWORK_EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP" ;;
 855:     relay) printf '%s' "$CROSS_NETWORK_RELAY_UNDERLAY_IP" ;;
 856:     probe) printf '%s' "$CROSS_NETWORK_PROBE_UNDERLAY_IP" ;;
 857:     *) printf '' ;;
 858:   esac
 859: }
 860: 
 861: cross_network_underlay_ip_for_label() {
 862:   local label="$1"
 863:   local override target
 864:   override="$(cross_network_override_underlay_ip_for_label "$label")"
 865:   if [[ -n "$override" ]]; then
 866:     printf '%s' "$override"
 867:     return 0
 868:   fi
 869:   target="$(node_target_for_label "$label")"
 870:   if [[ -z "$target" ]]; then
 871:     return 1
 872:   fi
 873:   live_lab_resolved_target_address "$target"
 874: }
 875: 
 876: cross_network_relay_label() {
 877:   if has_label entry; then
 878:     printf 'entry'
 879:     return 0
 880:   fi
 881:   if has_label aux; then
 882:     printf 'aux'
 883:     return 0
 884:   fi
 885:   return 1
 886: }
 887: 
 888: cross_network_probe_label() {
 889:   if has_label aux; then
 890:     printf 'aux'
 891:     return 0
 892:   fi
 893:   if has_label entry; then
 894:     printf 'entry'
 895:     return 0
 896:   fi
 897:   return 1
 898: }

 900: cross_network_impairment_remote_script() {
 901:   local target="$1"
 902:   local remote_src
 903:   remote_src="$(live_lab_remote_src_dir "$target")"
 904:   printf '%s/scripts/e2e/apply_cross_network_impairment_profile.sh' "$remote_src"
 905: }
 906: 
 907: cross_network_apply_impairment_profile_target() {
 908:   local target="$1"
 909:   local script_path
 910:   script_path="$(cross_network_impairment_remote_script "$target")"
 911:   live_lab_run_root "$target" \
 912:     "root test -f '$script_path' && root bash '$script_path' --mode apply --profile '$CROSS_NETWORK_IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE' --interface rustynet0"
 913: }
 914: 
 915: cross_network_clear_impairment_profile_target() {
 916:   local target="$1"
 917:   local script_path
 918:   script_path="$(cross_network_impairment_remote_script "$target")"
 919:   live_lab_run_root "$target" \
 920:     "root test -f '$script_path' && root bash '$script_path' --mode clear --profile '$CROSS_NETWORK_IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE' --interface rustynet0"
 921: }
 922: 
 923: cross_network_stage_labels_for_impairment() {
 924:   local stage_kind="$1"
 925:   local relay_label probe_label
 926:   case "$stage_kind" in
 927:     direct|dns|soak|node_switch)
 928:       printf '%s\n' client exit
 929:       ;;
 930:     relay|failback|controller_switch)
 931:       relay_label="$(cross_network_relay_label)" || return 1
 932:       printf '%s\n' client exit "$relay_label"
 933:       ;;
 934:     adversarial)
 935:       probe_label="$(cross_network_probe_label)" || return 1
 936:       printf '%s\n' client exit "$probe_label"
 937:       ;;
 938:     *)
 939:       printf 'unsupported cross-network stage kind for impairment: %s\n' "$stage_kind" >&2
 940:       return 1
 941:       ;;
 942:   esac
 943: }
 944: 
 945: run_cross_network_stage_with_impairment() {
 946:   local stage_kind="$1"
 947:   shift
 948:   local -a cmd=("$@")
 949:   local -a labels=()
 950:   local -a targets=()
 951:   local -a applied_targets=()
 952:   local label target
 953:   local rc=0
 954:   local cleanup_failed=0
 955: 
 956:   if [[ "$CROSS_NETWORK_IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE" == "none" ]]; then
 957:     "${cmd[@]}"
 958:     return $?
 959:   fi
 960: 
 961:   while IFS= read -r label; do
 962:     [[ -n "$label" ]] || continue
 963:     target="$(node_target_for_label "$label")"
 964:     if [[ -z "$target" ]]; then
 965:       printf 'missing target for impairment label: %s\n' "$label" >&2
 966:       return 1
 967:     fi
 968:     labels+=("$label")
 969:     targets+=("$target")
 970:   done < <(cross_network_stage_labels_for_impairment "$stage_kind")
 971: 
 972:   set +e
 973:   for target in "${targets[@]}"; do
 974:     if ! cross_network_apply_impairment_profile_target "$target"; then
 975:       rc=1
 976:       break
 977:     fi
 978:     applied_targets+=("$target")
 979:   done
 980:   if [[ "$rc" -eq 0 ]]; then
 981:     "${cmd[@]}"
 982:     rc=$?
 983:   fi
 984:   for target in "${applied_targets[@]}"; do
 985:     if ! cross_network_clear_impairment_profile_target "$target"; then
 986:       cleanup_failed=1
 987:     fi
 988:   done
 989:   set -e
 990: 
 991:   if [[ "$cleanup_failed" -ne 0 ]]; then
 992:     printf 'failed to clear impairment profile (%s) on one or more targets\n' "$CROSS_NETWORK_IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE" >&2
 993:     return 1
 994:   fi
 995:   return "$rc"
 996: }
 997: 
 998: cross_network_stages_applicable() {
 999:   local client_target exit_target client_addr exit_addr same_prefix_rc
1000:   CROSS_NETWORK_SKIP_REASON=""
1001:   if [[ "$CROSS_NETWORK_MODE" == "skip" ]]; then
1002:     CROSS_NETWORK_SKIP_REASON="skipped by --skip-cross-network"
1003:     return 1
1004:   fi
1005:   if [[ "$CROSS_NETWORK_MODE" == "force" ]]; then
1006:     return 0
1007:   fi
1008:   client_target="$(node_target_for_label client)"
1009:   exit_target="$(node_target_for_label exit)"
1010:   if [[ -z "$client_target" || -z "$exit_target" ]]; then
1011:     CROSS_NETWORK_SKIP_REASON="requires client and exit targets"
1012:     return 1
1013:   fi
1014:   client_addr="$(cross_network_underlay_ip_for_label client)" || {
1015:     CROSS_NETWORK_SKIP_REASON="unable to resolve client underlay address"
1016:     return 1
1017:   }
1018:   exit_addr="$(cross_network_underlay_ip_for_label exit)" || {
1019:     CROSS_NETWORK_SKIP_REASON="unable to resolve exit underlay address"
1020:     return 1
1021:   }
1022:   set +e
1023:   local topology_result
1024:   topology_result="$(cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops classify-cross-network-topology --ip-a "$client_addr" --ip-b "$exit_addr" --ipv4-prefix 24 --ipv6-prefix 64 2>/dev/null)"
1025:   same_prefix_rc=$?
1026:   set -e
1027:   if [[ "$same_prefix_rc" -eq 0 ]]; then
1028:     topology_result="$(printf '%s' "$topology_result" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
1029:     if [[ "$topology_result" == "fail" ]]; then
1030:       same_prefix_rc=0
1031:     else
1032:       same_prefix_rc=1
1033:     fi
1034:   else
1035:     same_prefix_rc=2
1036:   fi
1037:   if [[ "$same_prefix_rc" -eq 0 ]]; then
1038:     CROSS_NETWORK_SKIP_REASON="requires distinct client/exit underlay prefixes (client=${client_addr}, exit=${exit_addr}); use --force-cross-network to override"
1039:     return 1
1040:   fi
1041:   if [[ "$same_prefix_rc" -eq 2 ]]; then
1042:     return 0
1043:   fi
1044:   return 0
1045: }

1047: normalize_target() {
1048:   local label="$1"
1049:   local value="$2"
1050:   local normalized="$value"
1051:   local user_part=""
1052:   local host_part=""
1053:   if [[ "$value" == *"@"* ]]; then
1054:     printf '%s' "$value"
1055:     return 0
1056:   fi
1057:   host_part="$value"
1058:   user_part="$(prompt_value "SSH user for ${label} (${host_part})")"
1059:   if [[ -z "$user_part" ]]; then
1060:     printf 'missing SSH user for %s\n' "$label" >&2
1061:     return 1
1062:   fi
1063:   normalized="${user_part}@${host_part}"
1064:   printf '%s' "$normalized"
1065: }

1067: ensure_password_file() {
1068:   local provided_path="$1"
1069:   local prompt="$2"
1070:   local __resultvar="$3"
1071:   local selected_path="$provided_path"
1072:   if [[ -z "$selected_path" && -t 0 && -t 1 ]]; then
1073:     selected_path="$(prompt_value "$prompt")"
1074:   fi
1075:   if [[ -z "$selected_path" ]]; then
1076:     printf 'missing required file path for %s\n' "$prompt" >&2
1077:     return 1
1078:   fi
1079:   if [[ ! -f "$selected_path" ]]; then
1080:     printf 'missing file: %s\n' "$selected_path" >&2
1081:     return 1
1082:   fi
1083:   if [[ -L "$selected_path" ]]; then
1084:     printf 'path must not be a symlink: %s\n' "$selected_path" >&2
1085:     return 1
1086:   fi
1087:   if ! cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops check-local-file-mode \
1088:     --path "$selected_path" \
1089:     --policy owner-only \
1090:     --label file >/dev/null
1091:   then
1092:     return 1
1093:   fi
1094:   printf -v "$__resultvar" '%s' "$selected_path"
1095: }

1097: record_node() {
1098:   local label="$1"
1099:   local target="$2"
1100:   local node_id="$3"
1101:   local role="$4"
1102:   printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$label" "$target" "$node_id" "$role" >> "$NODES_TSV"
1103: }

1105: record_stage() {
1106:   local stage_name="$1"
1107:   local severity="$2"
1108:   local status="$3"
1109:   local rc="$4"
1110:   local log_path="$5"
1111:   local message="$6"
1112:   local started_at="$7"
1113:   local finished_at="$8"
1114:   printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' \
1115:     "$stage_name" \
1116:     "$severity" \
1117:     "$status" \
1118:     "$rc" \
1119:     "$log_path" \
1120:     "$(sanitize_text "$message")" \
1121:     "$started_at" \
1122:     "$finished_at" >> "$STAGE_TSV"
1123: }
1124: 
1125: record_stage_skip() {
1126:   local stage_name="$1"
1127:   local severity="$2"
1128:   local message="$3"
1129:   local log_path="$LOG_DIR/${stage_name}.log"
1130:   : > "$log_path"
1131:   record_stage "$stage_name" "$severity" "skipped" "0" "$log_path" "$message" "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)"
1132:   refresh_failure_digest
1133: }

1135: is_setup_stage_name() {
1136:   case "$1" in
1137:     preflight|prepare_source_archive|verify_ssh_reachability|prime_remote_access|cleanup_hosts|bootstrap_hosts|collect_pubkeys|membership_setup|distribute_membership_state|issue_and_distribute_assignments|issue_and_distribute_traversal|issue_and_distribute_dns_zone|enforce_baseline_runtime|validate_baseline_runtime)
1138:       return 0
1139:       ;;
1140:     *)
1141:       return 1
1142:       ;;
1143:   esac
1144: }
1145: 
1146: setup_stage_index() {
1147:   local stage_name="$1"
1148:   local idx=0
1149:   local stages=(
1150:     preflight
1151:     prepare_source_archive
1152:     verify_ssh_reachability
1153:     prime_remote_access
1154:     cleanup_hosts
1155:     bootstrap_hosts
1156:     collect_pubkeys
1157:     membership_setup
1158:     distribute_membership_state
1159:     issue_and_distribute_assignments
1160:     issue_and_distribute_traversal
1161:     issue_and_distribute_dns_zone
1162:     enforce_baseline_runtime
1163:     validate_baseline_runtime
1164:   )
1165:   for idx in "${!stages[@]}"; do
1166:     if [[ "${stages[$idx]}" == "$stage_name" ]]; then
1167:       printf '%s' "$idx"
1168:       return 0
1169:     fi
1170:   done
1171:   return 1
1172: }

1174: reset_setup_stage_state() {
1175:   local reset_from="$1"
1176:   local reset_mode="$2"
1177:   local tmp_stage_tsv="${STAGE_TSV}.tmp"
1178:   local line stage_name stage_idx reset_idx
1179:   if [[ ! -f "$STAGE_TSV" ]]; then
1180:     return 0
1181:   fi
1182:   if ! reset_idx="$(setup_stage_index "$reset_from")"; then
1183:     printf 'unsupported setup stage for reset: %s\n' "$reset_from" >&2
1184:     return 1
1185:   fi
1186:   : > "$tmp_stage_tsv"
1187:   while IFS= read -r line; do
1188:     stage_name="${line%%$'\t'*}"
1189:     if is_setup_stage_name "$stage_name"; then
1190:       if [[ "$reset_mode" == "rerun" ]]; then
1191:         [[ "$stage_name" == "$reset_from" ]] && continue
1192:       else
1193:         stage_idx="$(setup_stage_index "$stage_name" || true)"
1194:         if [[ -n "$stage_idx" && "$stage_idx" -ge "$reset_idx" ]]; then
1195:           continue
1196:         fi
1197:       fi
1198:     fi
1199:     printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$tmp_stage_tsv"
1200:   done < "$STAGE_TSV"
1201:   mv "$tmp_stage_tsv" "$STAGE_TSV"
1202:   rm -f "$LOG_DIR/${reset_from}.log"
1203:   rm -rf "$STATE_DIR/parallel-${reset_from}"
1204: }
1205: 
1206: run_setup_stage() {
1207:   local severity="$1"
1208:   local stage_name="$2"
1209:   local description="$3"
1210:   shift 3
1211: 
1212:   if [[ -n "$RERUN_STAGE" ]]; then
1213:     if [[ "$stage_name" != "$RERUN_STAGE" ]]; then
1214:       return 0
1215:     fi
1216:   elif [[ -n "$RESUME_FROM_STAGE" ]]; then
1217:     local current_idx resume_idx
1218:     current_idx="$(setup_stage_index "$stage_name" || true)"
1219:     resume_idx="$(setup_stage_index "$RESUME_FROM_STAGE" || true)"
1220:     if [[ -z "$current_idx" || -z "$resume_idx" ]]; then
1221:       printf 'unsupported resume stage: %s\n' "$RESUME_FROM_STAGE" >&2
1222:       return 1
1223:     fi
1224:     if [[ "$current_idx" -lt "$resume_idx" ]]; then
1225:       return 0
1226:     fi
1227:   fi
1228: 
1229:   run_stage "$severity" "$stage_name" "$description" "$@"
1230: }
1231: 
1232: wait_for_parallel_slot() {
1233:   local max_jobs="$1"
1234:   local running
1235:   while true; do
1236:     running="$(jobs -rp | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
1237:     if [[ "$running" -lt "$max_jobs" ]]; then
1238:       return 0
1239:     fi
1240:     sleep 0.2
1241:   done
1242: }
1243: 
1244: update_overall_status() {
1245:   local severity="$1"
1246:   local status="$2"
1247:   if [[ "$status" != "fail" ]]; then
1248:     return 0
1249:   fi
1250:   FAILURE_COUNT=$((FAILURE_COUNT + 1))
1251:   if [[ "$severity" == "soft" ]]; then
1252:     SOFT_FAILURE_COUNT=$((SOFT_FAILURE_COUNT + 1))
1253:     if [[ "$OVERALL_STATUS" == "pass" ]]; then
1254:       OVERALL_STATUS="pass_with_warnings"
1255:     fi
1256:     return 0
1257:   fi
1258:   OVERALL_STATUS="fail"
1259: }

1308: live_lab_collect_forensics_bundle() {
1309:   local stage_name="$1"
1310:   local collected_at stage_dir node_dir label target node_id role manifest_path
1311:   collected_at="$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
1312:   stage_dir="$REPORT_DIR/forensics/${stage_name}/${collected_at}"
1313:   mkdir -p "$stage_dir"
1314: 
1315:   while IFS=$'\t' read -r label target node_id role; do
1316:     [[ -n "$target" ]] || continue
1317:     node_dir="$stage_dir/${label}"
1318:     mkdir -p "$node_dir"
1319: 
1320:     local service_snapshot service_rc network_snapshot network_rc route_policy route_policy_rc
1321:     local dns_state dns_state_rc time_snapshot time_rc process_snapshot process_rc
1322:     local socket_snapshot socket_rc permissions_snapshot permissions_rc
1323:     local firewall_snapshot firewall_rc dns_zone_snapshot dns_zone_rc signed_state_snapshot signed_state_rc
1324:     local secret_hygiene secret_rc node_snapshot node_rc
1325:     set +e
1326:     service_snapshot="$(live_lab_collect_service_snapshot "$target" 2>&1)"
1327:     service_rc=$?
1328:     set -e
1329:     {
1330:       printf 'capture_rc=%s\n' "$service_rc"
1331:       printf '%s\n' "$service_snapshot"
1332:     } > "$node_dir/service_snapshot.txt"
1333: 
1334:     set +e
1335:     network_snapshot="$(live_lab_collect_network_snapshot "$target" 2>&1)"
1336:     network_rc=$?
1337:     set -e
1338:     {
1339:       printf 'capture_rc=%s\n' "$network_rc"
1340:       printf '%s\n' "$network_snapshot"
1341:     } > "$node_dir/network_snapshot.txt"
1342: 
1343:     set +e
1344:     route_policy="$(live_lab_collect_route_policy "$target" 2>&1)"
1345:     route_policy_rc=$?
1346:     set -e
1347:     {
1348:       printf 'capture_rc=%s\n' "$route_policy_rc"
1349:       printf '%s\n' "$route_policy"
1350:     } > "$node_dir/route_policy.txt"
1351: 
1352:     set +e
1353:     dns_state="$(live_lab_collect_dns_snapshot "$target" 2>&1)"
1354:     dns_state_rc=$?
1355:     set -e
1356:     {
1357:       printf 'capture_rc=%s\n' "$dns_state_rc"
1358:       printf '%s\n' "$dns_state"
1359:     } > "$node_dir/dns_state.txt"
1360: 
1361:     set +e
1362:     time_snapshot="$(live_lab_collect_time_snapshot "$target" "$node_id" "$role" 2>&1)"
1363:     time_rc=$?
1364:     set -e
1365:     {
1366:       printf 'capture_rc=%s\n' "$time_rc"
1367:       printf '%s\n' "$time_snapshot"
1368:     } > "$node_dir/time_snapshot.txt"
1369: 
1370:     set +e
1371:     process_snapshot="$(live_lab_collect_process_snapshot "$target" "$node_id" "$role" 2>&1)"
1372:     process_rc=$?
1373:     set -e
1374:     {
1375:       printf 'capture_rc=%s\n' "$process_rc"
1376:       printf '%s\n' "$process_snapshot"
1377:     } > "$node_dir/process_snapshot.txt"
1378: 
1379:     set +e
1380:     socket_snapshot="$(live_lab_collect_socket_snapshot "$target" "$node_id" "$role" 2>&1)"
1381:     socket_rc=$?
1382:     set -e
1383:     {
1384:       printf 'capture_rc=%s\n' "$socket_rc"
1385:       printf '%s\n' "$socket_snapshot"
1386:     } > "$node_dir/socket_snapshot.txt"
1387: 
1388:     set +e
1389:     permissions_snapshot="$(live_lab_collect_permissions_snapshot "$target" "$node_id" "$role" 2>&1)"
1390:     permissions_rc=$?
1391:     set -e
1392:     {
1393:       printf 'capture_rc=%s\n' "$permissions_rc"
1394:       printf '%s\n' "$permissions_snapshot"
1395:     } > "$node_dir/permissions_snapshot.txt"
1396: 
1397:     set +e
1398:     firewall_snapshot="$(live_lab_collect_firewall_snapshot "$target" "$node_id" "$role" 2>&1)"
1399:     firewall_rc=$?
1400:     set -e
1401:     {
1402:       printf 'capture_rc=%s\n' "$firewall_rc"
1403:       printf '%s\n' "$firewall_snapshot"
1404:     } > "$node_dir/firewall.txt"
1405: 
1406:     set +e
1407:     dns_zone_snapshot="$(live_lab_collect_dns_zone_snapshot "$target" "$node_id" 2>&1)"
1408:     dns_zone_rc=$?
1409:     set -e
1410:     {
1411:       printf 'capture_rc=%s\n' "$dns_zone_rc"
1412:       printf '%s\n' "$dns_zone_snapshot"
1413:     } > "$node_dir/dns_zone.txt"
1414: 
1415:     set +e
1416:     signed_state_snapshot="$(live_lab_collect_signed_state_snapshot "$target" "$node_id" "$role" 2>&1)"
1417:     signed_state_rc=$?
1418:     set -e
1419:     {
1420:       printf 'capture_rc=%s\n' "$signed_state_rc"
1421:       printf '%s\n' "$signed_state_snapshot"
1422:     } > "$node_dir/signed_state.txt"
1423: 
1424:     set +e
1425:     secret_hygiene="$(live_lab_collect_secret_hygiene "$target" 2>&1)"
1426:     secret_rc=$?
1427:     set -e
1428:     {
1429:       printf 'capture_rc=%s\n' "$secret_rc"
1430:       printf '%s\n' "$secret_hygiene"
1431:     } > "$node_dir/secret_hygiene.txt"
1432: 
1433:     set +e
1434:     node_snapshot="$(live_lab_collect_node_snapshot "$target" "$node_id" "$role" 2>&1)"
1435:     node_rc=$?
1436:     set -e
1437:     {
1438:       printf 'capture_rc=%s\n' "$node_rc"
1439:       printf '%s\n' "$node_snapshot"
1440:     } > "$node_dir/node_snapshot.txt"
1441: 
1442:     {
1443:       printf 'label=%s\n' "$label"
1444:       printf 'target=%s\n' "$target"
1445:       printf 'node_id=%s\n' "$node_id"
1446:       printf 'role=%s\n' "$role"
1447:     } > "$node_dir/node_identity.txt"
1448:   done < "$NODES_TSV"
1449: 
1450:   local route_matrix_snapshot route_matrix_rc
1451:   set +e
1452:   route_matrix_snapshot="$(live_lab_collect_route_matrix_snapshot "$stage_name" 2>&1)"
1453:   route_matrix_rc=$?
1454:   set -e
1455:   {
1456:     printf 'capture_rc=%s\n' "$route_matrix_rc"
1457:     printf '%s\n' "$route_matrix_snapshot"
1458:   } > "$stage_dir/route_matrix.txt"
1459: 
1460:   local cluster_snapshot cluster_rc
1461:   set +e
1462:   cluster_snapshot="$(live_lab_collect_cluster_snapshot "$stage_name" 2>&1)"
1463:   cluster_rc=$?
1464:   set -e
1465:   {
1466:     printf 'capture_rc=%s\n' "$cluster_rc"
1467:     printf '%s\n' "$cluster_snapshot"
1468:   } > "$stage_dir/cluster_snapshot.txt"
1469: 
1470:   manifest_path="$stage_dir/manifest.json"
1471:   cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops write-cross-network-forensics-manifest \
1472:     --stage "$stage_name" \
1473:     --collected-at-utc "$collected_at" \
1474:     --stage-dir "$stage_dir" \
1475:     --output "$manifest_path" >/dev/null
1476: 
1477:   local artifact_index_path bundle_validation_path helper_output helper_rc
1478:   bundle_validation_path="$stage_dir/bundle_validation.json"
1479:   set +e
1480:   helper_output="$(live_lab_assert_forensics_bundle_complete "$stage_name" "$stage_dir" "$bundle_validation_path" 2>&1)"
1481:   helper_rc=$?
1482:   set -e
1483:   if [[ "$helper_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
1484:     printf '[forensics:%s] warning: failed to validate bundle completeness: %s\n' "$stage_name" "$helper_output" >&2
1485:   fi
1486: 
1487:   artifact_index_path="$stage_dir/artifact_index.json"
1488:   set +e
1489:   helper_output="$(live_lab_collect_stage_artifact_index "$stage_name" "$stage_dir" "$artifact_index_path" 2>&1)"
1490:   helper_rc=$?
1491:   set -e
1492:   if [[ "$helper_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
1493:     printf '[forensics:%s] warning: failed to write artifact index: %s\n' "$stage_name" "$helper_output" >&2
1494:   fi
1495: 
1496:   printf '%s' "$stage_dir"
1497: }

1525: live_lab_collect_cluster_snapshot() {
1526:   local stage_name="${1:-cluster_snapshot}"
1527:   local collected_at label target node_id role
1528:   local peer_inventory peer_rc signed_state signed_rc firewall firewall_rc cluster_status="pass"
1529: 
1530:   collected_at="$(date -u +%FT%TZ)"
1531:   {
1532:     printf '__RNLAB_CLUSTER_BEGIN__\n'
1533:     printf 'cluster_snapshot_version=1\n'
1534:     printf 'cluster_stage_name=%s\n' "$stage_name"
1535:     printf 'cluster_collected_at_utc=%s\n' "$collected_at"
1536:     printf 'cluster_node_count=%s\n' "$(node_count)"
1537:     while IFS=$'\t' read -r label target node_id role; do
1538:       [[ -n "$target" ]] || continue
1539:       printf 'cluster_node_begin\n'
1540:       printf 'label=%s\n' "$label"
1541:       printf 'target=%s\n' "$target"
1542:       printf 'node_id=%s\n' "$node_id"
1543:       printf 'role=%s\n' "$role"
1544: 
1545:       set +e
1546:       peer_inventory="$(live_lab_collect_peer_inventory_snapshot "$target" "$node_id" "$role" 2>&1)"
1547:       peer_rc=$?
1548:       signed_state="$(live_lab_collect_signed_state_snapshot "$target" "$node_id" "$role" 2>&1)"
1549:       signed_rc=$?
1550:       firewall="$(live_lab_collect_firewall_snapshot "$target" "$node_id" "$role" 2>&1)"
1551:       firewall_rc=$?
1552:       set -e
1553: 
1554:       if [[ "$peer_rc" -ne 0 || "$signed_rc" -ne 0 || "$firewall_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
1555:         cluster_status="fail"
1556:       fi
1557: 
1558:       printf 'peer_inventory_capture_rc=%s\n' "$peer_rc"
1559:       printf '%s\n' "$peer_inventory"
1560:       printf 'signed_state_capture_rc=%s\n' "$signed_rc"
1561:       printf '%s\n' "$signed_state"
1562:       printf 'firewall_capture_rc=%s\n' "$firewall_rc"
1563:       printf '%s\n' "$firewall"
1564:       printf 'cluster_node_end\n'
1565:     done < "$NODES_TSV"
1566:     printf 'cluster_snapshot_status=%s\n' "$cluster_status"
1567:     printf '__RNLAB_CLUSTER_END__\n'
1568:   }
1569: }

1571: live_lab_collect_route_matrix_snapshot() {
1572:   local stage_name="${1:-route_matrix}"
1573:   local collected_at source_label source_target source_node_id source_role
1574:   local dest_label dest_target dest_node_id dest_role
1575:   local route_policy_snapshot route_policy_rc
1576:   local source_status_snapshot source_status_rc
1577:   local source_default_route_snapshot source_default_route_rc
1578:   local matrix_status="pass"
1579: 
1580:   collected_at="$(date -u +%FT%TZ)"
1581:   {
1582:     printf '__RNLAB_ROUTE_MATRIX_BEGIN__\n'
1583:     printf 'route_matrix_version=2\n'
1584:     printf 'route_matrix_stage_name=%s\n' "$stage_name"
1585:     printf 'route_matrix_collected_at_utc=%s\n' "$collected_at"
1586:     printf 'route_matrix_node_count=%s\n' "$(node_count)"
1587:     while IFS=$'\t' read -r source_label source_target source_node_id source_role; do
1588:       [[ -n "$source_target" ]] || continue
1589:       printf 'source_node_begin\n'
1590:       printf 'source_label=%s\n' "$source_label"
1591:       printf 'source_target=%s\n' "$source_target"
1592:       printf 'source_node_id=%s\n' "$source_node_id"
1593:       printf 'source_role=%s\n' "$source_role"
1594:       set +e
1595:       source_status_snapshot="$(live_lab_collect_service_snapshot "$source_target" 2>&1)"
1596:       source_status_rc=$?
1597:       source_default_route_snapshot="$(live_lab_collect_route_policy "$source_target" "1.1.1.1" 2>&1)"
1598:       source_default_route_rc=$?
1599:       set -e
1600:       if [[ "$source_status_rc" -ne 0 || "$source_default_route_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
1601:         matrix_status="fail"
1602:       fi
1603:       printf 'source_status_capture_rc=%s\n' "$source_status_rc"
1604:       printf '%s\n' "$source_status_snapshot"
1605:       printf 'source_default_route_capture_rc=%s\n' "$source_default_route_rc"
1606:       printf '%s\n' "$source_default_route_snapshot"
1607:       while IFS=$'\t' read -r dest_label dest_target dest_node_id dest_role; do
1608:         [[ -n "$dest_target" ]] || continue
1609:         printf 'pair_begin\n'
1610:         printf 'destination_label=%s\n' "$dest_label"
1611:         printf 'destination_target=%s\n' "$dest_target"
1612:         printf 'destination_node_id=%s\n' "$dest_node_id"
1613:         printf 'destination_role=%s\n' "$dest_role"
1614:         set +e
1615:         route_policy_snapshot="$(live_lab_collect_route_policy "$source_target" "$(live_lab_resolved_target_address "$dest_target")" 2>&1)"
1616:         route_policy_rc=$?
1617:         set -e
1618:         if [[ "$route_policy_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
1619:           matrix_status="fail"
1620:         fi
1621:         printf 'route_policy_capture_rc=%s\n' "$route_policy_rc"
1622:         printf '%s\n' "$route_policy_snapshot"
1623:         printf 'pair_end\n'
1624:       done < "$NODES_TSV"
1625:       printf 'source_node_end\n'
1626:     done < "$NODES_TSV"
1627:     printf 'route_matrix_status=%s\n' "$matrix_status"
1628:     printf '__RNLAB_ROUTE_MATRIX_END__\n'
1629:     if [[ "$matrix_status" != "pass" ]]; then
1630:       exit 1
1631:     fi
1632:   }
1633: }
1634: 
1635: run_stage() {
1636:   local severity="$1"
1637:   local stage_name="$2"
1638:   local description="$3"
1639:   shift 3
1640:   local log_path="$LOG_DIR/${stage_name}.log"
1641:   local started_at="$(date -u +%FT%TZ)"
1642:   local finished_at
1643:   local rc
1644:   local status="pass"
1645:   local forensics_dir=""
1646:   printf '[stage:%s] START %s\n' "$stage_name" "$description" | tee "$log_path"
1647:   if (
1648:     set -euo pipefail
1649:     "$@"
1650:   ) 2>&1 | tee -a "$log_path"; then
1651:     rc=0
1652:   else
1653:     rc=$?
1654:   fi
1655:   finished_at="$(date -u +%FT%TZ)"
1656:   if [[ "$rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
1657:     status="fail"
1658:     printf '[stage:%s] FAIL rc=%s\n' "$stage_name" "$rc" | tee -a "$log_path"
1659:     if stage_requires_forensics_bundle "$stage_name"; then
1660:       if forensics_dir="$(collect_cross_network_failure_forensics "$stage_name")"; then
1661:         printf '[stage:%s] forensics bundle: %s\n' "$stage_name" "$forensics_dir" | tee -a "$log_path"
1662:       else
1663:         printf '[stage:%s] warning: failed to collect forensics bundle\n' "$stage_name" | tee -a "$log_path"
1664:       fi
1665:     fi
1666:     printf '[stage:%s] failure digest: %s\n' "$stage_name" "$FAILURE_DIGEST_MD" | tee -a "$log_path"
1667:   else
1668:     printf '[stage:%s] PASS\n' "$stage_name" | tee -a "$log_path"
1669:   fi
1670:   record_stage "$stage_name" "$severity" "$status" "$rc" "$log_path" "$description" "$started_at" "$finished_at"
1671:   update_overall_status "$severity" "$status"
1672:   refresh_failure_digest
1673:   if [[ "$status" == "fail" && "$severity" == "hard" ]]; then
1674:     write_run_summary
1675:     return "$rc"
1676:   fi
1677:   return 0
1678: }
1679:

1689:     return 1
1690:   fi
1691:   printf '%s/evidence/%s' "$LIVE_LAB_STAGE_DIR" "$label"
1692: }

1700:   printf '%s/%s' "$artifact_dir" "$artifact_name"

1707:   local artifact_path
1708:   artifact_path="$(stage_worker_artifact_path "$label" "$artifact_name")" || return 1
1709:   printf '%s\n' "$content" > "$artifact_path"
1710:   printf '%s' "$artifact_path"
1711: }
1712: 
1713: live_lab_extract_primary_failure_reason() {
1714:   local log_path="$1"
1715:   if [[ ! -f "$log_path" ]]; then
1716:     printf 'log file missing'
1717:     return 0
1718:   fi
1719:   awk '
1720:     function trim(value) {
1721:       sub(/^[[:space:]]+/, "", value)
1722:       sub(/[[:space:]]+$/, "", value)
1723:       return value
1724:     }
1725:     /^\[stage:/ && ($0 ~ /] START/ || $0 ~ /] PASS/ || $0 ~ /] FAIL/) { next }
1726:     /^\[parallel:/ { next }
1727:     /^----- / { next }
1728:     {
1729:       line = trim($0)
1730:       gsub(/\r/, "", line)
1731:       if (line == "") {
1732:         next
1733:       }
1734:       lines[++count] = line
1735:     }
1736:     END {
1737:       if (count == 0) {
1738:         print "see full log"
1739:         exit
1740:       }
1741:       for (i = count; i >= 1; i--) {
1742:         lower = tolower(lines[i])
1743:         if (lower ~ /error:|fail|timed out|timeout|permission denied|missing|invalid|mismatch|does not exist|no such|unreachable/) {
1744:           print lines[i]
1745:           exit
1746:         }
1747:       }
1748:       print lines[count]
1749:     }
1750:   ' "$log_path" | head -n 1 | tr '\t\r\n' '   '
1751: }
1752: 
1753: live_lab_emit_stage_result() {
1754:   local output_tsv="$1"
1755:   local stage_name="$2"
1756:   local label="$3"
1757:   local target="$4"
1758:   local node_id="$5"
1759:   local role="$6"
1760:   local rc="$7"
1761:   local started_at="$8"
1762:   local finished_at="$9"
1763:   local log_path="${10}"
1764:   local snapshot_path="${11:-}"
1765:   local route_policy_path="${12:-}"
1766:   local dns_state_path="${13:-}"
1767:   local primary_failure_reason="${14:-}"
1768:   printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' \
1769:     "$stage_name" \
1770:     "$label" \
1771:     "$target" \
1772:     "$node_id" \
1773:     "$role" \
1774:     "$rc" \
1775:     "$started_at" \
1776:     "$finished_at" \
1777:     "$log_path" \
1778:     "$snapshot_path" \
1779:     "$route_policy_path" \
1780:     "$dns_state_path" \
1781:     "$(sanitize_text "$primary_failure_reason")" >> "$output_tsv"
1782: }
1783: 
1784: parallel_stage_scope_matches() {
1785:   local scope="$1"
1786:   local label="$2"
1787:   case "$scope" in
1788:     all) return 0 ;;
1789:     non_exit)
1790:       [[ "$label" != "exit" ]]
1791:       return
1792:       ;;
1793:     exit_only)
1794:       [[ "$label" == "exit" ]]
1795:       return
1796:       ;;
1797:     *)
1798:       printf 'unsupported parallel scope: %s\n' "$scope" >&2
1799:       return 1
1800:       ;;
1801:   esac
1802: }
1803: 
1804: run_parallel_node_stage() {
1805:   local stage_name="$1"
1806:   local worker_fn="$2"
1807:   local scope="${3:-all}"
1808:   local stage_dir workers_tsv results_tsv worker_count=0 failed=0
1809:   local label target node_id role pid log_path rc started_at finished_at
1810:   local snapshot_path route_policy_path dns_state_path primary_failure_reason
1811:   local -x LIVE_LAB_STAGE_NAME="$stage_name"
1812:   local append_stage_dir="${LIVE_LAB_STAGE_APPEND:-0}"
1813: 
1814:   case "$scope" in
1815:     all|non_exit|exit_only)
1816:       ;;
1817:     *)
1818:       printf 'unsupported parallel scope: %s\n' "$scope" >&2
1819:       return 1
1820:       ;;
1821:   esac
1822: 
1823:   stage_dir="$(parallel_stage_dir "$stage_name")"
1824:   local -x LIVE_LAB_STAGE_DIR="$stage_dir"
1825:   workers_tsv="${stage_dir}/workers.tsv"
1826:   results_tsv="${stage_dir}/results.tsv"
1827:   if [[ "$append_stage_dir" != "1" ]]; then
1828:     rm -rf "$stage_dir"
1829:     mkdir -p "$stage_dir"
1830:   else
1831:     mkdir -p "$stage_dir"
1832:     [[ -f "$results_tsv" ]] || : > "$results_tsv"
1833:   fi
1834:   : > "$workers_tsv"
1835:   [[ "$append_stage_dir" == "1" ]] || : > "$results_tsv"
1836: 
1837:   while IFS=$'\t' read -r label target node_id role; do
1838:     if ! parallel_stage_scope_matches "$scope" "$label"; then
1839:       continue
1840:     fi
1841:     wait_for_parallel_slot "$MAX_PARALLEL_NODE_WORKERS"
1842:     log_path="${stage_dir}/${label}.log"
1843:     started_at="$(date -u +%FT%TZ)"
1844:     (
1845:       set -euo pipefail
1846:       live_lab_prepare_worker_known_hosts "${stage_name}.${label}"
1847:       "$worker_fn" "$label" "$target" "$node_id" "$role"
1848:     ) >"$log_path" 2>&1 &
1849:     pid=$!
1850:     printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' \
1851:       "$label" "$target" "$node_id" "$role" "$pid" "$log_path" "$started_at" >> "$workers_tsv"
1852:     worker_count=$((worker_count + 1))
1853:   done < "$NODES_TSV"
1854: 
1855:   if [[ "$worker_count" -eq 0 ]]; then
1856:     printf '[parallel:%s] no workers matched scope=%s\n' "$stage_name" "$scope"
1857:     return 0
1858:   fi
1859: 
1860:   while IFS=$'\t' read -r label target node_id role pid log_path started_at; do
1861:     if wait "$pid"; then
1862:       rc=0
1863:     else
1864:       rc=$?
1865:       failed=1
1866:     fi
1867:     finished_at="$(date -u +%FT%TZ)"
1868:     snapshot_path="${stage_dir}/evidence/${label}/snapshot.txt"
1869:     route_policy_path="${stage_dir}/evidence/${label}/route_policy.txt"
1870:     dns_state_path="${stage_dir}/evidence/${label}/dns_state.txt"
1871:     [[ -f "$snapshot_path" ]] || snapshot_path=""
1872:     [[ -f "$route_policy_path" ]] || route_policy_path=""
1873:     [[ -f "$dns_state_path" ]] || dns_state_path=""
1874:     primary_failure_reason=""
1875:     if [[ "$rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
1876:       primary_failure_reason="$(live_lab_extract_primary_failure_reason "$log_path")"
1877:     fi
1878:     live_lab_emit_stage_result \
1879:       "$results_tsv" \
1880:       "$stage_name" \
1881:       "$label" \
1882:       "$target" \
1883:       "$node_id" \
1884:       "$role" \
1885:       "$rc" \
1886:       "$started_at" \
1887:       "$finished_at" \
1888:       "$log_path" \
1889:       "$snapshot_path" \
1890:       "$route_policy_path" \
1891:       "$dns_state_path" \
1892:       "$primary_failure_reason"
1893:     printf '[parallel:%s] %s %s rc=%s\n' "$stage_name" "$label" "$target" "$rc"
1894:     printf -- '----- %s/%s (%s %s) BEGIN -----\n' "$stage_name" "$label" "$node_id" "$role"
1895:     cat "$log_path"
1896:     printf -- '\n----- %s/%s END -----\n' "$stage_name" "$label"
1897:   done < "$workers_tsv"
1898: 
1899:   [[ "$failed" -eq 0 ]]
1900: }
1901: 
1902: run_serial_node_stage() {
1903:   local stage_name="$1"
1904:   local worker_fn="$2"
1905:   local scope="${3:-all}"
1906:   local stage_dir workers_tsv results_tsv failed=0
1907:   local label target node_id role log_path rc started_at finished_at
1908:   local snapshot_path route_policy_path dns_state_path primary_failure_reason
1909:   local -x LIVE_LAB_STAGE_NAME="$stage_name"
1910:   local append_stage_dir="${LIVE_LAB_STAGE_APPEND:-0}"
1911: 
1912:   case "$scope" in
1913:     all|non_exit|exit_only)
1914:       ;;
1915:     *)
1916:       printf 'unsupported serial scope: %s\n' "$scope" >&2
1917:       return 1
1918:       ;;
1919:   esac
1920: 
1921:   stage_dir="$(parallel_stage_dir "$stage_name")"
1922:   local -x LIVE_LAB_STAGE_DIR="$stage_dir"

1928:   else
1929:     mkdir -p "$stage_dir"
1930:     [[ -f "$results_tsv" ]] || : > "$results_tsv"
1931:   fi
1932:   : > "$workers_tsv"
1933:   [[ "$append_stage_dir" == "1" ]] || : > "$results_tsv"
1934: 
1935:   while IFS=$'\t' read -r label target node_id role; do
1936:     if ! parallel_stage_scope_matches "$scope" "$label"; then
1937:       continue
1938:     fi

1947:     finished_at="$(date -u +%FT%TZ)"

1950:     dns_state_path="${stage_dir}/evidence/${label}/dns_state.txt"
1951:     [[ -f "$snapshot_path" ]] || snapshot_path=""
1952:     [[ -f "$route_policy_path" ]] || route_policy_path=""
1953:     [[ -f "$dns_state_path" ]] || dns_state_path=""
1954:     primary_failure_reason=""
1955:     if [[ "$rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
1956:       primary_failure_reason="$(live_lab_extract_primary_failure_reason "$log_path")"
1957:     fi
1958:     live_lab_emit_stage_result \
1959:       "$results_tsv" \
1960:       "$stage_name" \
1961:       "$label" \
1962:       "$target" \
1963:       "$node_id" \
1964:       "$role" \
1965:       "$rc" \
1966:       "$started_at" \
1967:       "$finished_at" \
1968:       "$log_path" \
1969:       "$snapshot_path" \
1970:       "$route_policy_path" \
1971:       "$dns_state_path" \
1972:       "$primary_failure_reason"
1973:     printf '[serial:%s] %s %s rc=%s\n' "$stage_name" "$label" "$target" "$rc"
1974:     printf -- '----- %s/%s (%s %s) BEGIN -----\n' "$stage_name" "$label" "$node_id" "$role"
1975:     cat "$log_path"
1976:     printf -- '\n----- %s/%s END -----\n' "$stage_name" "$label"
1977:     if [[ "$rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
1978:       failed=1
1979:     fi
1980:   done < "$NODES_TSV"
1981: 
1982:   [[ "$failed" -eq 0 ]]
1983: }

2010: validate_topology_inputs() {
2011:   local label target host
2012:   local seen_hosts_file="${STATE_DIR}/seen-hosts.tsv"
2013:   : > "$seen_hosts_file"
2014:   while IFS=$'\t' read -r label target _node_id _role; do
2015:     [[ -n "$target" ]] || continue
2016:     validate_target_host "$label" "$target" || return 1
2017:     host="$(host_part_from_target "$target")"
2018:     if awk -F '\t' -v host="$host" '($1 == host) { found=1; exit } END { exit(found ? 0 : 1) }' "$seen_hosts_file"; then
2019:       local prior_label
2020:       prior_label="$(awk -F '\t' -v host="$host" '($1 == host) { print $2; exit }' "$seen_hosts_file")"
2021:       printf 'duplicate host configured for %s and %s: %s\n' "$prior_label" "$label" "$host" >&2
2022:       return 1
2023:     fi
2024:     printf '%s\t%s\n' "$host" "$label" >> "$seen_hosts_file"
2025:   done < "$NODES_TSV"
2026: }

2052: run_root pkill -f '/tmp/rn_bootstrap.env' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

2055: run_root pkill -f 'sudo -S -p .* -k true' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

2059: run_root pkill -f 'dpkg' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
2060: run_root pkill -f 'dnf install -y' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

2062:

2064:   rustynetd.service \
2065:   rustynetd-privileged-helper.service \

2073:   rustynetd-trust-refresh.service \
2074:   rustynetd-trust-refresh.timer \

2080: else
2081:   run_root_timed 30 systemctl kill rustynetd-managed-dns.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

2085: run_root pkill -f 'rustynetd privileged-helper' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

2096:     done < <(run_root_timed 30 nft list tables 2>/dev/null | awk '/^table / && $3 ~ /^rustynet/ { print $2 " " $3 }' | tr -d '\r')
2097:     if ! run_root_timed 30 nft list tables 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '^table [^[:space:]]+ rustynet'; then
2098:       break
2099:     fi
2100:     sleep 1
2101:   done
2102:   if run_root_timed 30 nft list tables 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '^table [^[:space:]]+ rustynet'; then
2103:     echo "residual rustynet nftables state remained after cleanup" >&2
2104:     exit 1
2105:   fi
2106: fi
2107: run_root rm -f \
2108:   /etc/systemd/system/rustynetd.service \
2109:   /etc/systemd/system/rustynetd-privileged-helper.service \
2110:   /etc/systemd/system/rustynetd-managed-dns.service \

2114:   /etc/systemd/system/rustynetd-assignment-refresh.timer

2119: run_root rm -rf "${HOME}/Rustynet"
2120: EOF_CLEANUP
2121:   chmod 700 "$STATE_DIR/rn_cleanup.sh"

2154:   run_root_timed 30 ip -6 route flush table 51820 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
2155:   if command -v nft >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2156:     for _attempt in $(seq 1 3); do
2157:       while read -r family table_name; do
2158:         [[ -n "${family}" && -n "${table_name}" ]] || continue
2159:         run_root_timed 30 nft flush table "${family}" "${table_name}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
2160:         run_root_timed 30 nft delete table "${family}" "${table_name}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
2161:       done < <(run_root_timed 30 nft list tables 2>/dev/null | awk '/^table / && $3 ~ /^rustynet/ { print $2 " " $3 }' | tr -d '\r')
2162:       if ! run_root_timed 30 nft list tables 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '^table [^[:space:]]+ rustynet'; then
2163:         break
2164:       fi
2165:       sleep 1
2166:     done
2167:     if run_root_timed 30 nft list tables 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '^table [^[:space:]]+ rustynet'; then
2168:       echo "residual rustynet nftables state remained before bootstrap" >&2
2169:       exit 1

2171:   fi

2174: wait_for_package_manager_idle() {
2175:   local pattern="$1"
2176:   local label="$2"
2177:   local attempt
2178:   for attempt in $(seq 1 60); do
2179:     if ! pgrep -f "$pattern" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2180:       return 0
2181:     fi
2182:     sleep 2
2183:   done
2184:   echo "${label} remained busy after waiting for prior lab processes to exit" >&2
2185:   pgrep -af "$pattern" >&2 || true
2186:   exit 1
2187: }

2189: build_bootstrap_prereqs_present() {
2190:   local PATH="/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin:${PATH}"
2191:   local missing=0
2192:   local cmd
2193:   local llvm_found=0
2194:   for cmd in curl git make pkg-config clang nft wg rustup; do
2195:     if ! command -v "${cmd}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2196:       echo "[bootstrap] missing prerequisite command: ${cmd}" >&2
2197:       missing=1
2198:     fi
2199:   done
2200:   if ! command -v gcc >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! command -v cc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2201:     echo "[bootstrap] missing C compiler command (gcc/cc)" >&2
2202:     missing=1
2203:   fi
2204:   if ! command -v g++ >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! command -v c++ >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2205:     echo "[bootstrap] missing C++ compiler command (g++/c++)" >&2
2206:     missing=1
2207:   fi
2208:   if command -v llvm-config >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2209:     llvm_found=1
2210:   else
2211:     for cmd in /usr/bin/llvm-config-* /usr/local/bin/llvm-config-*; do
2212:       [[ -x "${cmd}" ]] || continue
2213:       llvm_found=1
2214:       break
2215:     done
2216:   fi
2217:   if [[ "${llvm_found}" -eq 0 ]]; then
2218:     echo "[bootstrap] missing llvm-config command" >&2
2219:     missing=1
2220:   fi
2221:   if command -v pkg-config >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2222:     if ! pkg-config --exists openssl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2223:       echo "[bootstrap] missing pkg-config openssl development metadata" >&2
2224:       missing=1
2225:     fi
2226:     if ! pkg-config --exists sqlite3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2227:       echo "[bootstrap] missing pkg-config sqlite3 development metadata" >&2
2228:       missing=1
2229:     fi
2230:   fi
2231:   if [[ ! -r /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt ]]; then
2232:     echo "[bootstrap] missing readable CA certificate bundle at /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt" >&2
2233:     missing=1
2234:   fi
2235:   [[ "${missing}" -eq 0 ]]
2236: }
2237: 
2238: install_prereqs() {
2239:   local os_id=""
2240:   local os_like=""
2241:   if [[ -f /etc/os-release ]]; then
2242:     # shellcheck disable=SC1091
2243:     . /etc/os-release
2244:     os_id="${ID:-}"
2245:     os_like="${ID_LIKE:-}"
2246:   fi
2247:   if build_bootstrap_prereqs_present; then
2248:     echo "[bootstrap] prerequisite toolchain already present; skipping package manager mutation" >&2
2249:     return 0
2250:   fi
2251:   if [[ "${os_id}" == "fedora" || "${os_like}" == *"fedora"* || "${os_like}" == *"rhel"* ]]; then
2252:     wait_for_package_manager_idle 'dnf|rpm' 'dnf/rpm'
2253:     run_root_timed 1800 dnf install -y \
2254:       ca-certificates curl git gcc gcc-c++ make pkgconf-pkg-config openssl-devel \
2255:       sqlite-devel clang llvm nftables wireguard-tools rustup
2256:   elif [[ "${os_id}" == "debian" || "${os_id}" == "ubuntu" || "${os_id}" == "linuxmint" || "${os_like}" == *"debian"* ]] || command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2257:     run_apt_update_hardened
2258:     run_apt_install_hardened \
2259:       ca-certificates curl git build-essential pkg-config libssl-dev libsqlite3-dev \
2260:       clang llvm nftables wireguard-tools openssl systemd-resolved libnss-resolve rustup
2261:   else
2262:     echo "unsupported package manager; expected apt-get or dnf" >&2
2263:     exit 1
2264:   fi
2265:   if ! build_bootstrap_prereqs_present; then
2266:     echo "[bootstrap] prerequisite verification failed after package installation" >&2
2267:     exit 1
2268:   fi
2269: }
2270: 
2271: ensure_llvm_config_alias() {
2272:   if command -v llvm-config >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2273:     return 0
2274:   fi
2275:   local candidate=""
2276:   for candidate in /usr/bin/llvm-config-* /usr/local/bin/llvm-config-*; do
2277:     [[ -x "${candidate}" ]] || continue
2278:     run_root ln -sf "${candidate}" /usr/local/bin/llvm-config
2279:     return 0
2280:   done
2281:   echo "[bootstrap] unable to locate versioned llvm-config binary" >&2
2282:   return 1
2283: }

2285: run_apt_update_hardened() {
2286:   local attempt
2287:   local apt_log
2288:   local -a apt_network_opts
2289:   apt_network_opts=(
2290:     -o Acquire::Retries=3
2291:     -o Acquire::ForceIPv4=true
2292:     -o Acquire::http::Timeout=60
2293:     -o Acquire::https::Timeout=60
2294:     -o Dpkg::Use-Pty=0
2295:   )
2296:   for attempt in $(seq 1 3); do
2297:     wait_for_package_manager_idle 'apt-get|/usr/lib/apt/methods/|dpkg' 'apt/dpkg'
2298:     apt_log="$(mktemp /tmp/rn-apt-update.XXXXXX.log)"
2299:     if run_root_timed 240 env DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get \
2300:       "${apt_network_opts[@]}" \
2301:       update 2>&1 | tee "${apt_log}"; then
2302:       if ! grep -Eiq '(^W: Failed to fetch|Temporary failure resolving|Some index files failed to download)' "${apt_log}"; then
2303:         rm -f "${apt_log}"
2304:         return 0
2305:       fi
2306:       echo "[bootstrap] apt-get update reported fetch warnings; treating as failure" >&2
2307:     fi
2308:     rm -f "${apt_log}"
2309:     if [[ "${attempt}" -lt 3 ]]; then
2310:       echo "[bootstrap] apt-get update attempt ${attempt} failed; retrying after DNS repair" >&2
2311:       run_root_timed 120 env DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get clean >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
2312:       repair_bootstrap_dns_state
2313:       sleep 2
2314:     fi
2315:   done
2316:   echo "[bootstrap] apt-get update failed after retries" >&2
2317:   emit_bootstrap_network_diagnostics "deb.debian.org"
2318:   return 1
2319: }
2320: 
2321: run_apt_install_hardened() {
2322:   local attempt
2323:   local -a apt_network_opts
2324:   apt_network_opts=(
2325:     -o Acquire::Retries=3
2326:     -o Acquire::ForceIPv4=true
2327:     -o Acquire::http::Timeout=60
2328:     -o Acquire::https::Timeout=60
2329:     -o Dpkg::Use-Pty=0
2330:   )
2331:   if [[ "$#" -eq 0 ]]; then
2332:     echo "run_apt_install_hardened requires package names" >&2
2333:     return 2
2334:   fi
2335:   for attempt in $(seq 1 3); do
2336:     if run_root_timed 5400 env DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get \
2337:       "${apt_network_opts[@]}" \
2338:       install -y --no-install-recommends "$@"; then
2339:       return 0
2340:     fi
2341:     if [[ "${attempt}" -lt 3 ]]; then
2342:       echo "[bootstrap] apt-get install attempt ${attempt} failed; retrying after DNS repair" >&2
2343:       run_root_timed 120 env DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get clean >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
2344:       repair_bootstrap_dns_state
2345:       sleep 2
2346:     fi
2347:   done
2348:   echo "[bootstrap] apt-get install failed after retries" >&2
2349:   emit_bootstrap_network_diagnostics "deb.debian.org"
2350:   return 1
2351: }
2352: 
2353: repair_managed_dns_prereqs() {
2354:   local os_id=""
2355:   local os_like=""
2356:   if [[ -f /etc/os-release ]]; then
2357:     # shellcheck disable=SC1091
2358:     . /etc/os-release
2359:     os_id="${ID:-}"
2360:     os_like="${ID_LIKE:-}"
2361:   fi
2362:   if [[ "${os_id}" != "debian" && "${os_id}" != "ubuntu" && "${os_id}" != "linuxmint" && "${os_like}" != *"debian"* ]]; then
2363:     return 0
2364:   fi
2365:   if ! command -v resolvectl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2366:     echo "managed DNS routing requires resolvectl on Debian-like hosts" >&2
2367:     exit 1
2368:   fi
2369:   run_root systemctl enable --now systemd-resolved.service
2370:   if ! run_root resolvectl status >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2371:     run_root systemctl reload dbus
2372:     run_root systemctl restart systemd-resolved.service
2373:     run_root resolvectl status >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
2374:       echo "managed DNS control plane remained unhealthy after dbus reload and systemd-resolved restart" >&2
2375:       exit 1
2376:     }
2377:   fi
2378: }
2379: 
2380: repair_local_hostname_resolution() {
2381:   local current_hostname=""
2382:   current_hostname="$(hostname)"
2383:   [[ -n "${current_hostname}" ]] || return 0
2384:   if grep -Eq "(^|[[:space:]])${current_hostname}([[:space:]]|$)" /etc/hosts; then
2385:     return 0
2386:   fi
2387:   run_root sh -c 'printf "\n127.0.1.1\t%s\n" "$1" >> /etc/hosts' sh "${current_hostname}"
2388: }

2390: repair_rustup_toolchain_state() {
2391:   local channel="$1"
2392:   rustup toolchain uninstall "$channel" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
2393:   rm -rf "$HOME/.rustup/tmp"
2394:   mkdir -p "$HOME/.rustup/downloads" "$HOME/.rustup/toolchains"
2395:   find "$HOME/.rustup/downloads" -maxdepth 1 -type f -delete 2>/dev/null || true
2396:   rm -rf "$HOME/.rustup/toolchains/${channel}" "$HOME/.rustup/toolchains/${channel}.tmp"*
2397: }

2399: repair_bootstrap_dns_state() {
2400:   local default_iface=""
2401:   local default_gateway=""
2402:   default_iface="$(ip -4 route show default 2>/dev/null | awk '/default/ { for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) if ($i == "dev") { print $(i + 1); exit } }')"
2403:   default_gateway="$(ip -4 route show default 2>/dev/null | awk '/default/ { print $3; exit }')"
2404: 
2405:   if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2406:     run_root_timed 30 systemctl reload dbus >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
2407:     run_root_timed 30 systemctl enable --now systemd-resolved.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
2408:     run_root_timed 30 systemctl restart systemd-resolved.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
2409:   fi
2410:   if [[ -e /run/systemd/resolve/stub-resolv.conf ]]; then
2411:     run_root_timed 30 ln -sf /run/systemd/resolve/stub-resolv.conf /etc/resolv.conf >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
2412:   fi
2413:   if command -v resolvectl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2414:     if [[ -n "${default_iface}" ]]; then
2415:       run_root_timed 30 resolvectl revert "${default_iface}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
2416:       if [[ -n "${default_gateway}" ]]; then
2417:         run_root_timed 30 resolvectl dns "${default_iface}" "${default_gateway}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
2418:       fi
2419:       run_root_timed 30 resolvectl domain "${default_iface}" "~." >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
2420:       run_root_timed 30 resolvectl default-route "${default_iface}" yes >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
2421:     fi
2422:     run_root_timed 30 resolvectl flush-caches >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
2423:   elif [[ -n "${default_gateway}" ]]; then
2424:     run_root sh -c 'printf "nameserver %s\noptions timeout:2 attempts:2\n" "$1" > /etc/resolv.conf' sh "${default_gateway}"
2425:   fi
2426: }
2427: 
2428: emit_bootstrap_network_diagnostics() {
2429:   local host="$1"
2430:   echo "[bootstrap] network diagnostics for host=${host}" >&2
2431:   echo "--- /etc/resolv.conf ---" >&2
2432:   cat /etc/resolv.conf >&2 || true
2433:   echo "--- ip -4 route ---" >&2
2434:   ip -4 route >&2 || true
2435:   echo "--- ip -4 addr ---" >&2
2436:   ip -4 addr >&2 || true
2437:   if command -v resolvectl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2438:     echo "--- resolvectl status ---" >&2
2439:     run_root_timed 30 resolvectl status >&2 || true
2440:     echo "--- resolvectl query ${host} ---" >&2
2441:     run_root_timed 30 resolvectl query "${host}" >&2 || true
2442:   fi
2443:   echo "--- getent ahosts ${host} ---" >&2
2444:   getent ahosts "${host}" >&2 || true
2445: }

2447: wait_for_bootstrap_rustup_endpoint() {
2448:   local channel="$1"
2449:   local endpoint="https://static.rust-lang.org/dist/channel-rust-${channel}.toml.sha256"
2450:   local attempt
2451:   for attempt in $(seq 1 8); do
2452:     if run_local_timed 60 curl --ipv4 --fail --silent --show-error --head "${endpoint}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2453:       return 0
2454:     fi
2455:     repair_bootstrap_dns_state
2456:     sleep 2
2457:   done
2458:   echo "[bootstrap] failed to reach Rust toolchain endpoint: ${endpoint}" >&2
2459:   emit_bootstrap_network_diagnostics "static.rust-lang.org"
2460:   return 1
2461: }
2462: 
2463: install_rust_toolchain_hardened() {
2464:   local channel="$1"
2465:   local attempt
2466:   wait_for_bootstrap_rustup_endpoint "${channel}" || return 1
2467:   for attempt in $(seq 1 3); do
2468:     if run_local_timed 3600 env \
2469:       RUSTUP_DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT=600 \
2470:       RUSTUP_CONCURRENT_DOWNLOADS=1 \
2471:       rustup toolchain install "${channel}" --profile minimal; then
2472:       return 0
2473:     fi
2474:     if [[ "${attempt}" -lt 3 ]]; then
2475:       echo "[bootstrap] rustup install attempt ${attempt} failed; retrying after DNS repair" >&2
2476:       repair_bootstrap_dns_state
2477:       wait_for_bootstrap_rustup_endpoint "${channel}" || true
2478:       sleep 2
2479:     fi
2480:   done
2481:   echo "[bootstrap] rustup toolchain install failed after retries for channel ${channel}" >&2
2482:   emit_bootstrap_network_diagnostics "static.rust-lang.org"
2483:   return 1
2484: }

2545:   local rc=$?

2586: stage_prepare_source_archive() {
2587:   local archive_ref=""
2588:   local tar_version
2589:   local -a tar_flags=()
2590:   write_remote_scripts
2591:   printf 'source mode: %s\n' "$(describe_source_mode)"
2592:   if [[ "$SOURCE_MODE" == "working-tree" ]]; then
2593:     tar_version="$(tar --version 2>/dev/null || true)"
2594:     tar_version="${tar_version%%$'\n'*}"
2595:     if [[ "$tar_version" == *"bsdtar"* ]]; then
2596:       # Prevent host-local metadata leakage into deployment archives on macOS.
2597:       tar_flags+=(--no-mac-metadata --no-xattrs --no-acls --no-fflags)
2598:     fi
2599:     COPYFILE_DISABLE=1 tar "${tar_flags[@]}" -C "$ROOT_DIR" \
2600:       --exclude='.git' \
2601:       --exclude='target' \
2602:       --exclude='.cargo-home' \
2603:       --exclude='.ci-home' \
2604:       --exclude='artifacts/live_lab' \
2605:       -czf "$SOURCE_ARCHIVE" .
2606:   else
2607:     archive_ref="$(resolve_source_ref)"
2608:     fetch_git_ref_if_needed "$archive_ref"
2609:     git -C "$ROOT_DIR" archive --format=tar.gz --output "$SOURCE_ARCHIVE" "$archive_ref"
2610:   fi
2611:   if [[ "$SOURCE_MODE" == "working-tree" ]]; then
2612:     git rev-parse HEAD > "$STATE_DIR/git_head.txt"
2613:   else
2614:     git -C "$ROOT_DIR" rev-parse "$(resolve_source_ref)" > "$STATE_DIR/git_head.txt"
2615:   fi
2616:   git status --short > "$STATE_DIR/git_status.txt"
2617:   printf '%s\n' "$(describe_source_mode)" > "$STATE_DIR/source_mode.txt"
2618: }

2620: stage_run_fresh_bootstrap_and_network_setup() {
2621:   run_setup_stage hard prepare_source_archive 'package local source tree for remote install' stage_prepare_source_archive || return 1
2622:   run_setup_stage hard verify_ssh_reachability 'verify all selected nodes are reachable via ssh' stage_verify_ssh_reachability || return 1
2623:   run_setup_stage hard prime_remote_access 'push sudo credentials to all targets' prime_remote_access || return 1
2624:   run_setup_stage hard cleanup_hosts 'remove prior RustyNet state from targets' stage_cleanup_hosts || return 1
2625:   run_setup_stage hard bootstrap_hosts 'fresh install and bootstrap RustyNet on all targets' stage_bootstrap_hosts || return 1
2626:   run_setup_stage hard collect_pubkeys 'collect WireGuard public keys from all targets' stage_collect_pubkeys || return 1
2627:   run_setup_stage hard membership_setup 'apply signed membership updates on primary exit' stage_membership_setup || return 1
2628:   run_setup_stage hard distribute_membership_state 'export and install membership state to peers' stage_distribute_membership_state || return 1
2629:   run_setup_stage hard issue_and_distribute_assignments 'issue signed one-hop assignments and install refresh env files' stage_issue_and_distribute_assignments || return 1
2630:   run_setup_stage hard issue_and_distribute_traversal 'issue and distribute signed traversal bundles for all managed peers' stage_issue_and_distribute_traversal || return 1
2631:   run_setup_stage hard issue_and_distribute_dns_zone 'issue and distribute signed DNS zone bundles for all managed peers' stage_issue_and_distribute_dns_zone || return 1
2632:   run_setup_stage hard enforce_baseline_runtime 'enforce baseline runtime roles and advertise exit route' stage_enforce_baseline_runtime || return 1
2633:   run_setup_stage hard validate_baseline_runtime 'validate one-hop routing and no-plaintext-passphrase state' stage_validate_baseline_runtime || return 1
2634: }

2653: bootstrap_host_worker() {
2654:   local label="$1"
2655:   local target="$2"
2656:   local node_id="$3"
2657:   local role="$4"
2658:   local env_path
2659:   local attempt max_attempts=12 sleep_secs=10
2660:   ssh_wait_for_host "$target" || return 1
2661:   live_lab_push_sudo_password "$target"
2662:   env_path="$STATE_DIR/bootstrap-${label}.env"
2663:   cat > "$env_path" <<EOF_ENV
2664: ROLE=${role}
2665: NODE_ID=${node_id}
2666: NETWORK_ID=${NETWORK_ID}
2667: SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS=${SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS}
2668: SOURCE_ARCHIVE=/tmp/rn_source.tar.gz
2669: EOF_ENV
2670:   if [[ -n "${RUSTYNET_BACKEND:-}" ]]; then
2671:     printf 'RUSTYNET_BACKEND=%s\n' "${RUSTYNET_BACKEND}" >> "$env_path"
2672:   fi
2673:   printf '[bootstrap] %s %s (%s %s)\n' "$label" "$target" "$node_id" "$role"
2674:   for attempt in $(seq 1 "$max_attempts"); do
2675:     if live_lab_scp_to "$STATE_DIR/rn_bootstrap.sh" "$target" "/tmp/rn_bootstrap.sh" &&
2676:       live_lab_scp_to "$env_path" "$target" "/tmp/rn_bootstrap.env" &&
2677:       live_lab_scp_to "$SOURCE_ARCHIVE" "$target" "/tmp/rn_source.tar.gz" &&
2678:       live_lab_ssh "$target" "chmod 700 /tmp/rn_bootstrap.sh && bash /tmp/rn_bootstrap.sh /tmp/rn_bootstrap.env" &&
2679:       live_lab_wait_for_daemon_socket "$target" &&
2680:       live_lab_run_root "$target" "root test -x /usr/local/bin/rustynet && root test -x /usr/local/bin/rustynetd && root test -f /var/lib/rustynet/keys/wireguard.pub && root getent group rustynetd >/dev/null 2>&1"
2681:     then
2682:       return 0
2683:     fi
2684:     if [[ "$attempt" -lt "$max_attempts" ]]; then
2685:       sleep "$sleep_secs"
2686:     fi
2687:   done
2688:   return 1
2689: }

2691: stage_collect_pubkeys() {
2692:   local label
2693:   local stage_dir
2694:   : > "$PUBKEYS_TSV"
2695:   stage_dir="$(parallel_stage_dir collect_pubkeys)"
2696:   run_parallel_node_stage collect_pubkeys collect_pubkey_worker
2697:   while IFS=$'\t' read -r label _target _node_id _role; do
2698:     if [[ ! -f "${stage_dir}/pubkey-${label}.tsv" ]]; then
2699:       printf 'missing pubkey result for %s\n' "$label" >&2
2700:       return 1
2701:     fi
2702:     cat "${stage_dir}/pubkey-${label}.tsv" >> "$PUBKEYS_TSV"
2703:   done < "$NODES_TSV"
2704: }

2706: collect_pubkey_worker() {
2707:   local label="$1"
2708:   local target="$2"
2709:   local node_id="$3"
2710:   local pub_hex
2711:   local stage_dir result_path
2712:   stage_dir="$(parallel_stage_dir collect_pubkeys)"
2713:   result_path="${stage_dir}/pubkey-${label}.tsv"
2714:   if ! pub_hex="$(live_lab_collect_pubkey_hex "$target")"; then
2715:     return 1
2716:   fi
2717:   if [[ -z "$pub_hex" ]]; then
2718:     echo "failed to collect wireguard pubkey for ${target}" >&2
2719:     return 1
2720:   fi
2721:   printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$label" "$target" "$node_id" "$pub_hex" > "$result_path"
2722:   printf '[pubkey] %s %s %s\n' "$label" "$target" "$pub_hex"
2723: }

2725: build_onehop_specs() {
2726:   local nodes_spec=""
2727:   local allow_spec=""
2728:   local assignments_spec=""
2729:   local exit_target exit_node_id target node_id pub_hex first="1"
2730:   exit_target="$(node_target_for_label exit)"
2731:   exit_node_id="$(node_id_for_label exit)"
2732:   while IFS=$'\t' read -r _label target node_id pub_hex; do
2733:     if [[ "$first" == "1" ]]; then
2734:       nodes_spec="${node_id}|$(live_lab_resolved_target_address "$target"):51820|${pub_hex}"
2735:       first="0"
2736:     else
2737:       nodes_spec="${nodes_spec};${node_id}|$(live_lab_resolved_target_address "$target"):51820|${pub_hex}"
2738:     fi
2739:     if [[ "$node_id" == "$exit_node_id" ]]; then
2740:       assignments_spec="${assignments_spec:+${assignments_spec};}${node_id}|-"
2741:     else
2742:       allow_spec="${allow_spec:+${allow_spec};}${node_id}|${exit_node_id};${exit_node_id}|${node_id}"
2743:       assignments_spec="${assignments_spec:+${assignments_spec};}${node_id}|${exit_node_id}"
2744:     fi
2745:   done < "$PUBKEYS_TSV"
2746: 
2747:   cat > "$ONEHOP_STATE_ENV" <<EOF_ENV
2748: NODES_SPEC=$(quote_env "$nodes_spec")
2749: ALLOW_SPEC=$(quote_env "$allow_spec")
2750: ASSIGNMENTS_SPEC=$(quote_env "$assignments_spec")
2751: EXIT_TARGET=$(quote_env "$exit_target")
2752: EXIT_NODE_ID=$(quote_env "$exit_node_id")
2753: EOF_ENV
2754: }
2755: 
2756: quote_env() {
2757:   local value="$1"
2758:   value="${value//\\/\\\\}"
2759:   value="${value//\"/\\\"}"
2760:   value="${value//\$/\\\$}"
2761:   value="${value//\`/\\\`}"
2762:   printf '"%s"' "$value"
2763: }

2913: stage_enforce_baseline_runtime() {
2914:   run_parallel_node_stage enforce_baseline_runtime enforce_runtime_worker
2915:   run_parallel_node_stage refresh_runtime_after_enforce refresh_runtime_state_worker
2916:   # Refresh trust evidence on every node BEFORE the route-advertise IPC
2917:   # below. enforce_runtime_worker (re)installs the systemd unit and
2918:   # restarts each daemon; on cold start the daemon stays in restricted-
2919:   # safe mode until it ingests fresh signed trust evidence. Without an
2920:   # explicit refresh here, the route advertise IPC at the next line is
2921:   # a mutating command and can be refused with "daemon is in
2922:   # restricted-safe mode" — same fail-closed pattern fixed in the live
2923:   # test bins (cca0418, fc648df, 172f8bb). The downstream
2924:   # refresh_trust_after_traversal step already runs this on every node;
2925:   # advancing it ahead of route advertise eliminates the gap without
2926:   # adding a new orchestrator step.
2927:   run_parallel_node_stage refresh_trust_after_enforce refresh_trust_evidence_worker
2928:   live_lab_retry_root "$(node_target_for_label exit)" "root env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet route advertise 0.0.0.0/0" 10 2 || return 1
2929:   sleep 5
2930:   # Refresh short-lived signed artifacts immediately before baseline validation
2931:   # so the runtime refresh path is not forced to consume stale trust or
2932:   # traversal inputs after the long bootstrap/setup window.
2933:   issue_and_distribute_traversal_snapshot refresh_traversal_after_enforce || return 1
2934:   run_parallel_node_stage refresh_trust_after_traversal refresh_trust_evidence_worker
2935:   run_parallel_node_stage refresh_runtime_after_traversal refresh_signed_state_worker
2936: }
2937: 
2938: enforce_runtime_worker() {
2939:   local label="$1"
2940:   local target="$2"
2941:   local node_id="$3"
2942:   local role="$4"
2943:   printf '[runtime-enforce] %s %s (%s %s)\n' "$label" "$target" "$node_id" "$role"
2944:   live_lab_enforce_host "$target" "$role" "$node_id" "$SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS" "$(live_lab_remote_src_dir "$target")"
2945:   live_lab_wait_for_daemon_socket "$target"
2946: }

2954:   live_lab_run_root "$target" "root rustynet ops force-local-assignment-refresh-now"
2955:   live_lab_wait_for_daemon_socket "$target"
2956: }

3002: validation_runtime_refresh_order() {
3003:   local target_label="$1"
3004:   if [[ "$target_label" != "exit" ]]; then
3005:     printf 'exit\n'
3006:   fi
3007:   printf '%s\n' "$target_label"
3008: }

3010: refresh_runtime_state_for_validation() {
3011:   local target_label="$1"
3012:   local refresh_label
3013:   while IFS= read -r refresh_label; do
3014:     [[ -n "$refresh_label" ]] || continue
3015:     refresh_runtime_state_for_label "$refresh_label" || return 1
3016:   done < <(validation_runtime_refresh_order "$target_label")
3017: }
3018: 
3019: refresh_runtime_state_for_validation_cluster() {
3020:   # Peer coordination is directional. Refresh client roles first so the exit
3021:   # can consume their latest coordination, then refresh the exit, then refresh
3022:   # client roles again so they can consume the exit coordination that was just
3023:   # published. This avoids the parallel race where exit and clients refresh
3024:   # against stale peer coordination in the same moment.
3025:   run_parallel_node_stage refresh_runtime_before_validate_non_exit refresh_runtime_state_worker non_exit || return 1
3026:   refresh_runtime_state_for_label exit || return 1
3027:   run_parallel_node_stage refresh_runtime_after_exit_before_validate refresh_runtime_state_worker non_exit || return 1
3028: }

3034:   issue_and_distribute_dns_zone_snapshot "$dns_stage_name" || return 1
3035: }
3036: 
3037: prime_baseline_runtime_validation_state() {
3038:   issue_baseline_validation_artifacts refresh_traversal_before_validate refresh_dns_zone_before_validate || return 1
3039:   refresh_runtime_state_for_validation_cluster || return 1
3040: }

3042: live_lab_collect_baseline_runtime_cluster_snapshot() {
3043:   local expected_membership_nodes exit_node_id
3044:   local label target node_id role snapshot capture_rc ready
3045:   local overall_status="pass"
3046: 
3047:   expected_membership_nodes="$(node_count)"
3048:   exit_node_id="$(node_id_for_label exit)"
3049: 
3050:   {
3051:     printf '__RNLAB_BASELINE_CLUSTER_BEGIN__\n'
3052:     printf 'baseline_cluster_version=1\n'
3053:     printf 'baseline_cluster_collected_at_utc=%s\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)"
3054:     while IFS=$'\t' read -r label target node_id role; do
3055:       [[ -n "$target" ]] || continue
3056:       set +e
3057:       snapshot="$(live_lab_collect_runtime_validation_snapshot "$target" "$node_id" "$role" 2>&1)"
3058:       capture_rc=$?
3059:       set -e
3060:       ready=0
3061:       if [[ "$capture_rc" -eq 0 ]] && live_lab_runtime_snapshot_ready \
3062:         "$snapshot" \
3063:         "$node_id" \
3064:         "$target" \
3065:         "$role" \
3066:         "$expected_membership_nodes" \
3067:         "$exit_node_id" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
3068:         ready=1
3069:       else
3070:         overall_status="fail"
3071:       fi
3072:       printf 'node_begin\n'
3073:       printf 'label=%s\n' "$label"
3074:       printf 'target=%s\n' "$target"
3075:       printf 'node_id=%s\n' "$node_id"
3076:       printf 'role=%s\n' "$role"
3077:       printf 'capture_rc=%s\n' "$capture_rc"
3078:       printf 'runtime_ready=%s\n' "$ready"
3079:       printf '%s\n' "$snapshot"
3080:       printf 'node_end\n'
3081:     done < "$NODES_TSV"
3082:     printf 'baseline_cluster_status=%s\n' "$overall_status"
3083:     printf '__RNLAB_BASELINE_CLUSTER_END__\n'
3084:   }
3085: }
3086: 
3087: baseline_cluster_not_ready_labels() {
3088:   local snapshot="$1"
3089:   awk '
3090:     /^node_begin$/ {
3091:       in_node = 1
3092:       label = ""
3093:       ready = ""
3094:       next
3095:     }
3096:     /^node_end$/ {
3097:       if (in_node && ready == "0" && label != "") {
3098:         print label
3099:       }
3100:       in_node = 0
3101:       next
3102:     }
3103:     in_node && /^label=/ {
3104:       label = substr($0, length("label=") + 1)
3105:       next
3106:     }
3107:     in_node && /^runtime_ready=/ {
3108:       ready = substr($0, length("runtime_ready=") + 1)
3109:       next
3110:     }
3111:   ' <<<"$snapshot"
3112: }
3113: 
3114: wait_for_baseline_runtime_cluster_convergence() {
3115:   local cluster_snapshot
3116:   local attempts=120
3117:   local sleep_secs=2
3118:   local refresh_every_attempts=60
3119:   local targeted_refresh_after_attempt=30
3120:   local attempt
3121:   local not_ready_labels=()
3122:   local label
3123:   for ((attempt = 1; attempt <= attempts; attempt++)); do
3124:     cluster_snapshot="$(live_lab_collect_baseline_runtime_cluster_snapshot 2>&1)" || cluster_snapshot="${cluster_snapshot:-}"
3125:     if [[ "$cluster_snapshot" == *"baseline_cluster_status=pass"* ]]; then
3126:       printf '[baseline-cluster]\n%s\n' "$cluster_snapshot"
3127:       return 0
3128:     fi
3129:     if (( attempt >= targeted_refresh_after_attempt )); then
3130:       not_ready_labels=()
3131:       while IFS= read -r label; do
3132:         [[ -n "$label" ]] || continue
3133:         not_ready_labels+=("$label")
3134:       done < <(baseline_cluster_not_ready_labels "$cluster_snapshot")
3135:       if (( ${#not_ready_labels[@]} > 0 && ${#not_ready_labels[@]} < $(node_count) )); then
3136:         printf '[baseline-cluster-targeted-refresh] attempt=%s labels=%s\n' "$attempt" "${not_ready_labels[*]}"
3137:         for label in "${not_ready_labels[@]}"; do
3138:           refresh_runtime_state_for_label "$label" || return 1
3139:         done
3140:       fi
3141:     fi
3142:     if (( attempt % refresh_every_attempts == 0 )); then
3143:       printf '[baseline-cluster-refresh] attempt=%s\n' "$attempt"
3144:       prime_baseline_runtime_validation_state || return 1
3145:     fi
3146:     if (( attempt < attempts )); then
3147:       sleep "$sleep_secs"
3148:     fi
3149:   done
3150:   printf '[baseline-cluster]\n%s\n' "$cluster_snapshot"
3151:   return 1
3152: }
3153: 
3154: refresh_signed_state_for_validation() {
3155:   local target_label="$1"
3156:   local refresh_label
3157:   while IFS= read -r refresh_label; do
3158:     [[ -n "$refresh_label" ]] || continue
3159:     refresh_signed_state_for_label "$refresh_label" || return 1
3160:   done < <(validation_runtime_refresh_order "$target_label")
3161: }
3162: 
3163: refresh_validation_state_for_label() {
3164:   local target_label="$1"
3165: 
3166:   # Validation depends on fresh traversal coordination and DNS-zone state.
3167:   # Reissue both immediately before the target sample, then refresh only the
3168:   # nodes that are on the critical path for that sample so the 30-second
3169:   # traversal coordination window is not consumed by unrelated nodes.
3170:   issue_and_distribute_traversal_snapshot "refresh_traversal_before_validate_${target_label}" || return 1
3171:   issue_and_distribute_dns_zone_snapshot "refresh_dns_zone_before_validate_${target_label}" || return 1
3172:   refresh_runtime_state_for_validation "$target_label" || return 1
3173:   refresh_signed_state_for_validation "$target_label" || return 1
3174:   refresh_runtime_state_for_validation "$target_label" || return 1
3175: }

3177: refresh_signed_state_worker() {
3178:   local label="$1"
3179:   local target="$2"
3180:   local node_id="$3"
3181:   local _role="$4"
3182:   printf '[signed-state-refresh] %s %s (%s)\n' "$label" "$target" "$node_id"
3183:   live_lab_wait_for_daemon_socket "$target"
3184:   live_lab_retry_root "$target" "root env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet state refresh" 5 2
3185: }

3190:     [[ -n "$refresh_target" ]] || continue
3191:     refresh_signed_state_worker "$refresh_label" "$refresh_target" "$refresh_node_id" "$refresh_role" || return 1
3192:   done < "$NODES_TSV"
3193: }

3195: stage_validate_baseline_runtime() {
3196:   local nft_rules
3197:   local force_ssh_for_validation=0
3198:   local original_max_parallel_workers="$MAX_PARALLEL_NODE_WORKERS"
3199:   local append_stage_dir_set=0
3200: 
3201:   if live_lab_has_utm_transport && live_lab_can_use_ssh_transport; then
3202:     # UTM guest-agent transport is serialized on this host, which consumes the
3203:     # short traversal coordination window during baseline validation. Once SSH
3204:     # reachability is established, force SSH transport for validation so we can
3205:     # refresh nodes and capture immediately while coordination records are
3206:     # still fresh.

3210:   fi

3216:     fi
3217:     return 1
3218:   }

3328: live_lab_runtime_snapshot_ready() {
3329:   local snapshot="$1"
3330:   local node_id="$2"
3331:   local target="$3"
3332:   local role="$4"
3333:   local expected_membership_nodes="$5"
3334:   local exit_node_id="$6"
3335:   local status state restricted_safe_mode bootstrap_error last_reconcile_error
3336: 
3337:   status="$(snapshot_section_text "$snapshot" "RNLAB_STATUS")"
3338:   [[ -n "$status" ]] || return 1
3339: 
3340:   state="$(snapshot_field_value "$status" "state")"
3341:   restricted_safe_mode="$(snapshot_field_value "$status" "restricted_safe_mode")"
3342:   bootstrap_error="$(snapshot_field_value "$status" "bootstrap_error")"
3343:   last_reconcile_error="$(snapshot_field_value "$status" "last_reconcile_error")"
3344: 
3345:   [[ -n "$state" && "$state" != "FailClosed" ]] || return 1
3346:   [[ "$restricted_safe_mode" == "false" ]] || return 1
3347:   [[ "$bootstrap_error" == "none" ]] || return 1
3348:   [[ "$last_reconcile_error" == "none" ]] || return 1
3349: 
3350:   live_lab_assert_runtime_spec \
3351:     "$snapshot" \
3352:     "$node_id" \
3353:     "$target" \
3354:     "$role" \
3355:     "$expected_membership_nodes" \
3356:     "$exit_node_id"
3357: }
