3359: live_lab_wait_for_node_convergence() {
3360:   local target="$1"
3361:   local node_id="$2"
3362:   local role="$3"
3363:   local expected_membership_nodes="$4"
3364:   local exit_node_id="$5"
3365:   local attempts="${6:-60}"
3366:   local sleep_secs="${7:-10}"
3367:   local attempt snapshot
3368: 
3369:   for ((attempt = 1; attempt <= attempts; attempt++)); do
3370:     snapshot="$(live_lab_collect_runtime_validation_snapshot "$target" "$node_id" "$role")" || snapshot=""
3371:     if [[ -n "$snapshot" ]] && live_lab_runtime_snapshot_ready \
3372:       "$snapshot" \
3373:       "$node_id" \
3374:       "$target" \
3375:       "$role" \
3376:       "$expected_membership_nodes" \
3377:       "$exit_node_id" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
3378:       printf '%s' "$snapshot"
3379:       return 0
3380:     fi
3381:     if [[ "$attempt" -lt "$attempts" ]]; then
3382:       sleep "$sleep_secs"
3383:     fi
3384:   done
3385: 
3386:   snapshot="$(live_lab_collect_runtime_validation_snapshot "$target" "$node_id" "$role")" || snapshot=""
3387:   if [[ -n "$snapshot" ]] && live_lab_runtime_snapshot_ready \
3388:     "$snapshot" \
3389:     "$node_id" \
3390:     "$target" \
3391:     "$role" \
3392:     "$expected_membership_nodes" \
3393:     "$exit_node_id" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
3394:     printf '%s' "$snapshot"
3395:     return 0
3396:   fi
3397:   printf '%s' "$snapshot"
3398:   return 1
3399: }

3401: live_lab_route_matrix_matches_expected_topology() {
3402:   local snapshot="$1"
3403:   local expected_exit_node_id="$2"
3404:   awk -v expected_exit="$expected_exit_node_id" '
3405:     function after(prefix) {
3406:       return substr($0, length(prefix) + 1)
3407:     }
3408:     function reset_source() {
3409:       source_id = ""
3410:       source_status_rc = ""
3411:       source_default_route_rc = ""
3412:       source_default_route_get_rc = ""
3413:       status_state = ""
3414:       status_exit_node = ""
3415:       status_serving_exit_node = ""
3416:       status_restricted_safe_mode = ""
3417:       status_bootstrap_error = ""
3418:       status_last_reconcile_error = ""
3419:       default_route_device = ""
3420:       default_route_table = ""
3421:       pair_count = 0
3422:     }
3423:     function finalize_pair() {
3424:       if (!in_pair) {
3425:         return
3426:       }
3427:       pair_count++
3428:       if (pair_destination_node_id == "" || pair_capture_rc != "0" || pair_route_get_rc != "0") {
3429:         fail = 1
3430:       }
3431:       in_pair = 0
3432:       pair_destination_node_id = ""
3433:       pair_capture_rc = ""
3434:       pair_route_get_rc = ""
3435:       next_route_context = ""
3436:     }
3437:     function finalize_source() {
3438:       if (!in_source) {
3439:         return
3440:       }
3441:       finalize_pair()
3442:       source_count++
3443:       if (source_id == "" || source_status_rc != "0" || source_default_route_rc != "0" || source_default_route_get_rc != "0") {
3444:         fail = 1
3445:       }
3446:       if (status_restricted_safe_mode != "false" || status_bootstrap_error != "none" || status_last_reconcile_error != "none") {
3447:         fail = 1
3448:       }
3449:       if (status_state == "" || status_state == "FailClosed") {
3450:         fail = 1
3451:       }
3452:       if (pair_count != expected_node_count + 0) {
3453:         fail = 1
3454:       }
3455:       if (source_id == expected_exit) {
3456:         exit_seen = 1
3457:         if (status_serving_exit_node != "true") {
3458:           fail = 1
3459:         }
3460:       } else {
3461:         if (status_exit_node != expected_exit) {
3462:           fail = 1
3463:         }
3464:         if (default_route_device != "rustynet0" || default_route_table != "51820") {
3465:           fail = 1
3466:         }
3467:       }
3468:       in_source = 0
3469:       in_status = 0
3470:       in_route_policy = 0
3471:       route_context = ""
3472:       next_route_context = ""
3473:     }
3474:     /^route_matrix_node_count=/ {
3475:       expected_node_count = after("route_matrix_node_count=")
3476:       next
3477:     }
3478:     /^route_matrix_status=/ {
3479:       overall_status = after("route_matrix_status=")
3480:       next
3481:     }
3482:     /^source_node_begin$/ {
3483:       finalize_source()
3484:       in_source = 1
3485:       reset_source()
3486:       next
3487:     }
3488:     /^source_node_end$/ {
3489:       finalize_source()
3490:       next
3491:     }
3492:     /^pair_begin$/ {
3493:       finalize_pair()
3494:       in_pair = 1
3495:       next
3496:     }
3497:     /^pair_end$/ {
3498:       finalize_pair()
3499:       next
3500:     }
3501:     /^source_node_id=/ && in_source && !in_pair {
3502:       source_id = after("source_node_id=")
3503:       next
3504:     }
3505:     /^source_status_capture_rc=/ && in_source {
3506:       source_status_rc = after("source_status_capture_rc=")
3507:       next
3508:     }
3509:     /^source_default_route_capture_rc=/ && in_source {
3510:       source_default_route_rc = after("source_default_route_capture_rc=")
3511:       next_route_context = "source_default"
3512:       next
3513:     }
3514:     /^route_policy_capture_rc=/ && in_pair {
3515:       pair_capture_rc = after("route_policy_capture_rc=")
3516:       next_route_context = "pair"
3517:       next
3518:     }
3519:     /^destination_node_id=/ && in_pair {
3520:       pair_destination_node_id = after("destination_node_id=")
3521:       next
3522:     }
3523:     /^__RNLAB_STATUS_BEGIN__$/ && in_source {
3524:       in_status = 1
3525:       next
3526:     }
3527:     /^__RNLAB_STATUS_END__$/ && in_source {
3528:       in_status = 0
3529:       next
3530:     }
3531:     /^__RNLAB_ROUTE_POLICY_BEGIN__$/ && in_source {
3532:       in_route_policy = 1
3533:       route_context = next_route_context
3534:       next_route_context = ""
3535:       next
3536:     }
3537:     /^__RNLAB_ROUTE_POLICY_END__$/ && in_source {
3538:       in_route_policy = 0
3539:       route_context = ""
3540:       next
3541:     }
3542:     in_status && /^state=/ {
3543:       status_state = after("state=")
3544:       next
3545:     }
3546:     in_status && /^exit_node=/ {
3547:       status_exit_node = after("exit_node=")
3548:       next
3549:     }
3550:     in_status && /^serving_exit_node=/ {
3551:       status_serving_exit_node = after("serving_exit_node=")
3552:       next
3553:     }
3554:     in_status && /^restricted_safe_mode=/ {
3555:       status_restricted_safe_mode = after("restricted_safe_mode=")
3556:       next
3557:     }
3558:     in_status && /^bootstrap_error=/ {
3559:       status_bootstrap_error = after("bootstrap_error=")
3560:       next
3561:     }
3562:     in_status && /^last_reconcile_error=/ {
3563:       status_last_reconcile_error = after("last_reconcile_error=")
3564:       next
3565:     }
3566:     in_route_policy && route_context == "source_default" && /^route_get_rc=/ {
3567:       source_default_route_get_rc = after("route_get_rc=")
3568:       next
3569:     }
3570:     in_route_policy && route_context == "source_default" && /^actual_route_device=/ {
3571:       default_route_device = after("actual_route_device=")
3572:       next
3573:     }
3574:     in_route_policy && route_context == "source_default" && /^actual_route_table=/ {
3575:       default_route_table = after("actual_route_table=")
3576:       next
3577:     }
3578:     in_route_policy && route_context == "pair" && /^route_get_rc=/ {
3579:       pair_route_get_rc = after("route_get_rc=")
3580:       next
3581:     }
3582:     END {
3583:       finalize_source()
3584:       if (expected_node_count == "" || source_count != expected_node_count + 0 || !exit_seen || overall_status != "pass" || fail) {
3585:         exit 1
3586:       }
3587:     }
3588:   ' <<<"$snapshot"
3589: }

3591: live_lab_wait_for_route_matrix_convergence() {
3592:   local expected_exit_node_id="$1"
3593:   local consecutive_polls="${2:-2}"
3594:   local attempts="${3:-20}"
3595:   local sleep_secs="${4:-3}"
3596:   local stage_name="${5:-route_matrix_convergence}"
3597:   local attempt snapshot
3598:   local matched_polls=0
3599: 
3600:   for ((attempt = 1; attempt <= attempts; attempt++)); do
3601:     snapshot="$(live_lab_collect_route_matrix_snapshot "$stage_name" 2>&1)" || snapshot="${snapshot:-}"
3602:     if [[ -n "$snapshot" ]] && live_lab_route_matrix_matches_expected_topology "$snapshot" "$expected_exit_node_id" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
3603:       matched_polls=$((matched_polls + 1))
3604:       if (( matched_polls >= consecutive_polls )); then
3605:         printf '%s' "$snapshot"
3606:         return 0
3607:       fi
3608:     else
3609:       matched_polls=0
3610:     fi
3611:     if [[ "$attempt" -lt "$attempts" ]]; then
3612:       sleep "$sleep_secs"
3613:     fi
3614:   done
3615: 
3616:   snapshot="$(live_lab_collect_route_matrix_snapshot "$stage_name" 2>&1)" || snapshot="${snapshot:-}"
3617:   printf '%s' "$snapshot"
3618:   return 1
3619: }

3621: validate_runtime_worker() {
3622:   local _label="$1"
3623:   local target="$2"
3624:   local node_id="$3"
3625:   local role="$4"
3626:   local expected_membership_nodes exit_node_id snapshot wait_rc
3627:   local route_policy route_policy_rc dns_snapshot dns_snapshot_rc expected_next_hop
3628:   local signed_state_snapshot signed_state_rc dns_zone_snapshot dns_zone_rc
3629:   local zone_name
3630:   local runtime_attempts=8
3631:   local runtime_sleep_secs=1
3632:   local signed_state_attempts=5
3633:   local signed_state_sleep_secs=1
3634:   local dns_zone_attempts=5
3635:   local dns_zone_sleep_secs=1
3636: 
3637:   expected_membership_nodes="$(node_count)"
3638:   exit_node_id="$(node_id_for_label exit)"
3639:   zone_name="${RUSTYNET_DNS_ZONE_NAME:-rustynet}"
3640:   expected_next_hop=""
3641:   if [[ "$role" == "client" ]]; then
3642:     expected_next_hop="direct:rustynet0"
3643:   fi
3644:   set +e
3645:   # Stage-level route-matrix convergence already waited for the cluster to
3646:   # settle before this worker runs. Keep the per-node wait short so we capture
3647:   # the fresh runtime and signed-state window immediately after the final
3648:   # refresh cycle instead of burning it here.
3649:   snapshot="$(live_lab_wait_for_node_convergence "$target" "$node_id" "$role" "$expected_membership_nodes" "$exit_node_id" "$runtime_attempts" "$runtime_sleep_secs")"
3650:   wait_rc=$?
3651:   signed_state_snapshot="$(live_lab_wait_for_signed_state_convergence "$target" "$node_id" "$role" "$zone_name" "${CROSS_NETWORK_SIGNED_ARTIFACT_MAX_AGE_SECS:-900}" "${CROSS_NETWORK_MAX_TIME_SKEW_SECS:-2}" "$signed_state_attempts" "$signed_state_sleep_secs")"
3652:   signed_state_rc=$?
3653:   dns_zone_snapshot="$(live_lab_wait_for_dns_zone_convergence "$target" "$node_id" "$zone_name" "$dns_zone_attempts" "$dns_zone_sleep_secs")"
3654:   dns_zone_rc=$?
3655:   route_policy="$(live_lab_collect_route_policy "$target" "1.1.1.1" "$expected_next_hop" 2>&1)"
3656:   route_policy_rc=$?
3657:   dns_snapshot="$(live_lab_collect_dns_snapshot "$target" 2>&1)"
3658:   dns_snapshot_rc=$?
3659:   set -e
3660:   if [[ -n "${LIVE_LAB_STAGE_DIR:-}" ]]; then
3661:     stage_worker_write_artifact "$_label" "signed_state.txt" "$(printf 'capture_rc=%s\n%s\n' "$signed_state_rc" "$signed_state_snapshot")" >/dev/null || return 1
3662:     stage_worker_write_artifact "$_label" "dns_zone.txt" "$(printf 'capture_rc=%s\n%s\n' "$dns_zone_rc" "$dns_zone_snapshot")" >/dev/null || return 1
3663:     stage_worker_write_artifact "$_label" "snapshot.txt" "$(printf 'capture_rc=%s\n%s\n' "$wait_rc" "$snapshot")" >/dev/null || return 1
3664:     stage_worker_write_artifact "$_label" "route_policy.txt" "$(printf 'capture_rc=%s\n%s\n' "$route_policy_rc" "$route_policy")" >/dev/null || return 1
3665:     stage_worker_write_artifact "$_label" "dns_state.txt" "$(printf 'capture_rc=%s\n%s\n' "$dns_snapshot_rc" "$dns_snapshot")" >/dev/null || return 1
3666:   fi
3667:   printf '[signed-state] %s %s\n%s\n' "$node_id" "$target" "$signed_state_snapshot"
3668:   printf '[dns-zone] %s %s\n%s\n' "$node_id" "$target" "$dns_zone_snapshot"
3669:   printf '[snapshot] %s %s\n%s\n' "$node_id" "$target" "$snapshot"
3670:   printf '[route-policy] %s %s\n%s\n' "$node_id" "$target" "$route_policy"
3671:   printf '[dns-state] %s %s\n%s\n' "$node_id" "$target" "$dns_snapshot"
3672:   [[ "$signed_state_rc" -eq 0 ]] || return "$signed_state_rc"
3673:   [[ "$dns_zone_rc" -eq 0 ]] || return "$dns_zone_rc"
3674:   [[ "$route_policy_rc" -eq 0 ]] || return "$route_policy_rc"
3675:   [[ "$dns_snapshot_rc" -eq 0 ]] || return "$dns_snapshot_rc"
3676:   live_lab_assert_runtime_spec \
3677:     "$snapshot" \
3678:     "$node_id" \
3679:     "$target" \
3680:     "$role" \
3681:     "$expected_membership_nodes" \
3682:     "$exit_node_id"
3683:   # Keep the convergence helper return code in the worker artifacts for
3684:   # forensics, but fail only on the explicit runtime, signed-state, DNS-zone,
3685:   # route-policy, and secret-hygiene assertions above. The helper can time out
3686:   # even when the final captured snapshot already satisfies the validator.
3687:   return 0
3688: }

3690: refresh_runtime_state_for_validation_worker() {
3691:   local label="$1"
3692:   local target="$2"
3693:   local _node_id="$3"
3694:   local role="$4"
3695:   local exit_node_id
3696: 
3697:   if [[ "$role" == "client" ]]; then
3698:     exit_node_id="$(node_id_for_label exit)"
3699:     [[ -n "$exit_node_id" ]] || {
3700:       printf 'missing exit node id for client validation refresh\n' >&2
3701:       return 1
3702:     }
3703:     printf '[runtime-refresh-role-coupling] %s %s (exit=%s)\n' "$label" "$target" "$exit_node_id"
3704:     # Baseline validation performs the authoritative route assertion itself.
3705:     # Skip the helper's internal route wait here so we do not spend the short
3706:     # signed-state window on a second convergence loop before collecting the
3707:     # final validation snapshots.
3708:     live_lab_apply_role_coupling "$target" "client" "$exit_node_id" "false" "/etc/rustynet/assignment-refresh.env" "true" || return 1
3709:     live_lab_wait_for_daemon_socket "$target"
3710:     return 0
3711:   fi
3712: 
3713:   refresh_runtime_state_worker "$label" "$target" "$_node_id" "$role"
3714: }

3721:   refresh_runtime_state_for_validation_worker "$label" "$target" "$node_id" "$role" || return 1
3722:   validate_runtime_worker "$label" "$target" "$node_id" "$role"
3723: }

3751: assert_local_gate_suite_provenance() {
3752:   local deployed_commit local_head
3753:   deployed_commit="$(current_run_git_commit)"
3754:   local_head="$(current_local_head_commit)"
3755:   if [[ "$deployed_commit" != "$local_head" ]]; then
3756:     printf 'local full gate suite refuses mixed-source attestation: deployed commit %s differs from local HEAD %s\n' \
3757:       "$deployed_commit" "$local_head" >&2
3758:     return 1
3759:   fi
3760:   if [[ "$SOURCE_MODE" == "working-tree" ]] && current_run_git_status_is_dirty; then
3761:     printf 'local full gate suite refuses dirty-working-tree attestation: commit-bound evidence requires a clean working tree or an explicit committed ref\n' >&2
3762:     return 1
3763:   fi
3764:   if current_local_source_tree_is_dirty; then
3765:     printf 'local full security gate suite refuses dirty source tree: tracked/untracked changes outside generated evidence paths make provenance non-commit-bound\n' >&2
3766:     return 1
3767:   fi
3768: }

3803: stage_run_local_full_gate_suite() {
3804:   local gate_log="$VERIFICATION_DIR/full_gate_suite_${RUN_ID}.log"
3805:   if ! has_five_node_release_gate_topology; then
3806:     printf 'local full gate suite requires the full five-node topology so release-gate evidence remains commit-bound and complete\n' >&2
3807:     return 1
3808:   fi
3809:   assert_local_gate_suite_provenance || return 1
3810:   mkdir -p "$VERIFICATION_DIR"
3811:   : > "$gate_log"
3812:   export RUSTYNET_FRESH_INSTALL_OS_MATRIX_PROFILE=linux
3813:   export RUSTYNET_FRESH_INSTALL_OS_MATRIX_EXPECTED_GIT_COMMIT
3814:   RUSTYNET_FRESH_INSTALL_OS_MATRIX_EXPECTED_GIT_COMMIT="$(current_run_git_commit)"
3815:   run_gate() {
3816:     local script="$1"
3817:     local rc=0
3818:     printf '\n[%s] RUN %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$script" | tee -a "$gate_log"
3819:     set +e
3820:     "$script" 2>&1 | tee -a "$gate_log"
3821:     rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
3822:     set -e
3823:     if [[ "$rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
3824:       printf '[%s] FAIL %s rc=%s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$script" "$rc" | tee -a "$gate_log"
3825:       return "$rc"
3826:     fi
3827:     printf '[%s] PASS %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$script" | tee -a "$gate_log"
3828:   }
3829:   refresh_phase6_linux_parity_probe_from_lab
3830:   run_gate ./scripts/ci/phase1_gates.sh
3831:   run_gate ./scripts/ci/phase3_gates.sh
3832:   run_gate ./scripts/ci/phase4_gates.sh
3833:   run_gate ./scripts/ci/phase5_gates.sh
3834:   run_gate ./scripts/ci/phase6_gates.sh
3835:   run_gate ./scripts/ci/phase7_gates.sh
3836:   run_gate ./scripts/ci/phase8_gates.sh
3837:   run_gate ./scripts/ci/phase9_gates.sh
3838:   run_gate ./scripts/ci/fresh_install_os_matrix_release_gate.sh
3839:   run_gate ./scripts/ci/phase10_gates.sh
3840:   run_gate ./scripts/ci/membership_gates.sh
3841:   run_gate ./scripts/ci/secrets_hygiene_gates.sh
3842:   run_gate ./scripts/ci/role_auth_matrix_gates.sh
3843:   run_gate ./scripts/ci/traversal_adversarial_gates.sh
3844:   run_gate ./scripts/ci/security_regression_gates.sh
3845:   run_gate ./scripts/ci/supply_chain_integrity_gates.sh
3846:   run_gate ./scripts/ci/perf_regression_gate.sh
3847:   printf '\n[%s] FULL GATE SUITE PASS\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" | tee -a "$gate_log"
3848: }

3858: refresh_phase6_linux_parity_probe_from_lab() {
3859:   local target remote_raw_dir remote_probe_path remote_leak_report local_inbox
3860:   local local_leak_report
3861:   target="${EXIT_TARGET:-}"
3862:   if [[ -z "$target" ]]; then
3863:     printf 'phase6 linux parity refresh requires an exit target\n' >&2
3864:     return 1
3865:   fi
3866: 
3867:   remote_raw_dir="/var/tmp/rustynet-phase6-parity"
3868:   remote_probe_path="/tmp/rn-platform-parity-linux.json"
3869:   remote_leak_report="/tmp/rn-phase6-leak_test_report.json"
3870:   local_inbox="$(phase6_linux_parity_inbox_path)"
3871:   local_leak_report="${ROOT_DIR}/artifacts/phase10/leak_test_report.json"
3872: 
3873:   if [[ ! -f "$local_leak_report" ]]; then
3874:     printf 'phase6 linux parity refresh requires local leak report: %s\n' "$local_leak_report" >&2
3875:     return 1
3876:   fi
3877: 
3878:   mkdir -p "$(phase6_parity_inbox_dir)"
3879:   if ! live_lab_scp_to "$local_leak_report" "$target" "$remote_leak_report"; then
3880:     return 1
3881:   fi
3882:   if ! live_lab_run_root "$target" "root install -d -m 0700 '${remote_raw_dir}' && root env RUSTYNET_PHASE6_PARITY_RAW_DIR='${remote_raw_dir}' RUSTYNET_PHASE6_PLATFORM_OVERRIDE='linux' RUSTYNET_PHASE6_LEAK_REPORT_LINUX='${remote_leak_report}' rustynet ops collect-platform-probe && root install -m 0644 '${remote_raw_dir}/platform_parity_linux.json' '${remote_probe_path}'"; then
3883:     live_lab_run_root "$target" "root rm -f '${remote_probe_path}' '${remote_leak_report}' '${remote_raw_dir}/platform_parity_linux.json' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; root rmdir '${remote_raw_dir}' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
3884:     return 1
3885:   fi
3886: 
3887:   if ! live_lab_scp_from "$target" "$remote_probe_path" "$local_inbox"; then
3888:     live_lab_run_root "$target" "root rm -f '${remote_probe_path}' '${remote_leak_report}' '${remote_raw_dir}/platform_parity_linux.json' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; root rmdir '${remote_raw_dir}' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
3889:     return 1
3890:   fi
3891: 
3892:   live_lab_run_root "$target" "root rustynet ops secure-remove --path '${remote_probe_path}' >/dev/null 2>&1 || root rm -f '${remote_probe_path}'; root rustynet ops secure-remove --path '${remote_leak_report}' >/dev/null 2>&1 || root rm -f '${remote_leak_report}'; root rustynet ops secure-remove --path '${remote_raw_dir}/platform_parity_linux.json' >/dev/null 2>&1 || root rm -f '${remote_raw_dir}/platform_parity_linux.json'; root rmdir '${remote_raw_dir}' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
3893: 
3894:   cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops check-local-file-mode \
3895:     --path "$local_inbox" \
3896:     --policy no-group-world-write \
3897:     --label 'phase6 linux parity inbox probe' >/dev/null
3898: }

3977: assert_json_report_status_pass() {
3978:   local report_path="$1"
3979:   local label="$2"
3980:   local status
3981:   if [[ ! -f "$report_path" ]]; then
3982:     printf '%s report missing: %s\n' "$label" "$report_path" >&2
3983:     return 1
3984:   fi
3985:   status="$(cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops read-cross-network-report-fields \
3986:     --report-path "$report_path" \
3987:     --include-status \
3988:     --default-value fail)"
3989:   status="$(printf '%s' "$status" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
3990:   if [[ "$status" != "pass" ]]; then
3991:     printf '%s report status is not pass: %s\n' "$label" "$status" >&2
3992:     return 1
3993:   fi
3994: }

3996: assert_log_absent_patterns() {
3997:   local log_path="$1"
3998:   local label="$2"
3999:   shift 2
4000:   local pattern
4001:   if [[ ! -f "$log_path" ]]; then
4002:     printf '%s log missing: %s\n' "$label" "$log_path" >&2
4003:     return 1
4004:   fi
4005:   for pattern in "$@"; do
4006:     if rg -n -- "$pattern" "$log_path" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
4007:       printf '%s log contains forbidden pattern (%s): %s\n' "$label" "$pattern" "$log_path" >&2
4008:       rg -n -- "$pattern" "$log_path" >&2 || true
4009:       return 1
4010:     fi
4011:   done
4012: }
4013: 
4014: assert_log_contains_pattern() {
4015:   local log_path="$1"
4016:   local label="$2"
4017:   local pattern="$3"
4018:   if [[ ! -f "$log_path" ]]; then
4019:     printf '%s log missing: %s\n' "$label" "$log_path" >&2
4020:     return 1
4021:   fi
4022:   if ! rg -n -- "$pattern" "$log_path" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
4023:     printf '%s log missing required pattern (%s): %s\n' "$label" "$pattern" "$log_path" >&2
4024:     return 1
4025:   fi
4026: }

4028: assert_text_contains() {
4029:   local text="$1"
4030:   local label="$2"
4031:   local pattern="$3"
4032:   if [[ "$text" != *"$pattern"* ]]; then
4033:     printf '%s missing required text (%s)\n' "$label" "$pattern" >&2
4034:     return 1
4035:   fi
4036: }

4038: assert_text_absent() {
4039:   local text="$1"

4041:   local pattern="$3"
4042:   if [[ "$text" == *"$pattern"* ]]; then
4043:     printf '%s contains forbidden text (%s)\n' "$label" "$pattern" >&2
4044:     return 1
4045:   fi
4046: }

4048: snapshot_section_text() {
4049:   local snapshot="$1"
4050:   local section_name="$2"
4051:   local begin_marker end_marker
4052:   if [[ "$section_name" == RNLAB_* ]]; then
4053:     begin_marker="__${section_name}_BEGIN__"
4054:     end_marker="__${section_name}_END__"
4055:   else
4056:     begin_marker="__RNLAB_${section_name}_BEGIN__"
4057:     end_marker="__RNLAB_${section_name}_END__"
4058:   fi
4059:   awk -v begin="$begin_marker" -v end="$end_marker" '
4060:     $0 == begin {
4061:       capture = 1
4062:       next
4063:     }
4064:     $0 == end {
4065:       capture = 0
4066:       next
4067:     }
4068:     capture {
4069:       print
4070:     }
4071:   ' <<<"$snapshot"
4072: }
4073: 
4074: snapshot_section_or_self_text() {
4075:   local snapshot="$1"
4076:   local section_name="$2"
4077:   local section
4078:   section="$(snapshot_section_text "$snapshot" "$section_name")"
4079:   if [[ -n "$section" ]]; then
4080:     printf '%s' "$section"
4081:     return 0
4082:   fi
4083:   printf '%s' "$snapshot"
4084: }
4085: 
4086: snapshot_named_block_text() {
4087:   local snapshot="$1"
4088:   local block_name="$2"
4089:   awk -v begin="${block_name}_begin" -v end="${block_name}_end" '
4090:     $0 == begin {
4091:       capture = 1
4092:       next
4093:     }
4094:     $0 == end {
4095:       capture = 0
4096:       next
4097:     }
4098:     capture {
4099:       print
4100:     }
4101:   ' <<<"$snapshot"
4102: }
4103: 
4104: snapshot_field_value() {
4105:   local snapshot="$1"
4106:   local key="$2"
4107:   awk -v key="$key" '
4108:     index($0, key "=") == 1 {
4109:       print substr($0, length(key) + 2)
4110:       exit
4111:     }
4112:   ' <<<"$snapshot"
4113: }
4114: 
4115: snapshot_keyed_block_text() {
4116:   local snapshot="$1"
4117:   local begin_marker="$2"
4118:   local end_marker="$3"
4119:   local selector_key="$4"
4120:   local selector_value="$5"
4121:   awk \
4122:     -v begin="$begin_marker" \
4123:     -v end="$end_marker" \
4124:     -v selector_key="$selector_key" \
4125:     -v selector_value="$selector_value" '
4126:       $0 == begin {
4127:         capture = 1
4128:         matches = 0
4129:         block = ""
4130:         next
4131:       }
4132:       $0 == end {
4133:         if (capture && matches) {
4134:           printf "%s", block
4135:           exit
4136:         }
4137:         capture = 0
4138:         matches = 0
4139:         block = ""
4140:         next
4141:       }
4142:       capture {
4143:         block = block $0 ORS
4144:         if (index($0, selector_key "=") == 1 && substr($0, length(selector_key) + 2) == selector_value) {
4145:           matches = 1
4146:         }
4147:       }
4148:     ' <<<"$snapshot"
4149: }
4150: 
4151: permissions_fact_text() {
4152:   local snapshot="$1"
4153:   local path="$2"
4154:   snapshot_keyed_block_text "$snapshot" "permissions_fact_begin" "permissions_fact_end" "path" "$path"
4155: }
4156: 
4157: socket_fact_text() {
4158:   local snapshot="$1"
4159:   local fact_name="$2"
4160:   snapshot_keyed_block_text "$snapshot" "socket_fact_begin" "socket_fact_end" "name" "$fact_name"
4161: }

4163: mode_world_digit() {
4164:   local mode="$1"
4165:   if [[ ! "$mode" =~ ^[0-7]{3,4}$ ]]; then
4166:     return 1
4167:   fi
4168:   printf '%s' "$((10#$mode % 10))"
4169: }
4170: 
4171: assert_mode_not_world_accessible() {
4172:   local mode="$1"
4173:   local label="$2"
4174:   local path="$3"
4175:   local world_digit
4176:   world_digit="$(mode_world_digit "$mode")" || {
4177:     printf '%s has invalid mode for %s: %s\n' "$label" "$path" "${mode:-missing}" >&2
4178:     return 1
4179:   }
4180:   if [[ "$world_digit" != "0" ]]; then
4181:     printf '%s has world-accessible mode for %s: %s\n' "$label" "$path" "$mode" >&2
4182:     return 1
4183:   fi
4184: }
4185: 
4186: permissions_fact_require() {
4187:   local permissions_snapshot="$1"
4188:   local path="$2"
4189:   local label="$3"
4190:   local mode_pattern="$4"
4191:   local owner_pattern="$5"
4192:   local group_pattern="$6"
4193:   local type_pattern="$7"
4194:   local fact present mode owner group kind
4195: 
4196:   fact="$(permissions_fact_text "$permissions_snapshot" "$path")"
4197:   if [[ -z "$fact" ]]; then
4198:     printf '%s missing permissions fact for %s\n' "$label" "$path" >&2
4199:     return 1
4200:   fi
4201:   present="$(snapshot_field_value "$fact" "present")"
4202:   mode="$(snapshot_field_value "$fact" "mode")"
4203:   owner="$(snapshot_field_value "$fact" "owner")"
4204:   group="$(snapshot_field_value "$fact" "group")"
4205:   kind="$(snapshot_field_value "$fact" "type")"
4206:   if [[ "$present" != "1" ]]; then
4207:     printf '%s missing required path %s\n' "$label" "$path" >&2
4208:     return 1
4209:   fi
4210:   if ! [[ "$mode" =~ $mode_pattern ]]; then
4211:     printf '%s unexpected mode for %s: %s\n' "$label" "$path" "${mode:-missing}" >&2
4212:     return 1
4213:   fi
4214:   if ! [[ "$owner" =~ $owner_pattern ]]; then
4215:     printf '%s unexpected owner for %s: %s\n' "$label" "$path" "${owner:-missing}" >&2
4216:     return 1
4217:   fi
4218:   if ! [[ "$group" =~ $group_pattern ]]; then
4219:     printf '%s unexpected group for %s: %s\n' "$label" "$path" "${group:-missing}" >&2
4220:     return 1
4221:   fi
4222:   if ! [[ "$kind" =~ $type_pattern ]]; then
4223:     printf '%s unexpected type for %s: %s\n' "$label" "$path" "${kind:-missing}" >&2
4224:     return 1
4225:   fi
4226: }
4227: 
4228: permissions_fact_require_if_present() {
4229:   local permissions_snapshot="$1"
4230:   local path="$2"
4231:   local label="$3"
4232:   local mode_pattern="$4"
4233:   local owner_pattern="$5"
4234:   local group_pattern="$6"
4235:   local type_pattern="$7"
4236:   local fact present
4237: 
4238:   fact="$(permissions_fact_text "$permissions_snapshot" "$path")"
4239:   if [[ -z "$fact" ]]; then
4240:     printf '%s missing permissions fact for %s\n' "$label" "$path" >&2
4241:     return 1
4242:   fi
4243:   present="$(snapshot_field_value "$fact" "present")"
4244:   if [[ "$present" == "0" ]]; then
4245:     return 0
4246:   fi
4247:   permissions_fact_require "$permissions_snapshot" "$path" "$label" "$mode_pattern" "$owner_pattern" "$group_pattern" "$type_pattern"
4248: }
4249: 
4250: permissions_fact_require_absent() {
4251:   local permissions_snapshot="$1"

4253:   local label="$3"

4255: 
4256:   fact="$(permissions_fact_text "$permissions_snapshot" "$path")"
4257:   if [[ -z "$fact" ]]; then
4258:     printf '%s missing permissions fact for %s\n' "$label" "$path" >&2
4259:     return 1
4260:   fi
4261:   present="$(snapshot_field_value "$fact" "present")"
4262:   if [[ "$present" != "0" ]]; then
4263:     printf '%s expected plaintext path to be absent: %s\n' "$label" "$path" >&2
4264:     return 1
4265:   fi
4266: }

4268: live_lab_assert_time_sync() {
4269:   local snapshot="$1"
4270:   local node_id="$2"
4271:   local target="$3"
4272:   local time_snapshot time_label
4273:   local reference_unix max_clock_skew_secs remote_unix_now clock_skew_secs
4274:   local sync_evidence_present sync_source_kind time_sync_observability system_clock_synchronized timedatectl_available
4275: 
4276:   time_label="time sync (${node_id})"
4277:   if [[ "$snapshot" == *"time_target="* ]]; then
4278:     assert_text_contains "$snapshot" "time snapshot (${node_id})" "time_target=${target}"
4279:   fi
4280:   if [[ "$snapshot" == *"time_node_id="* ]]; then
4281:     assert_text_contains "$snapshot" "time snapshot (${node_id})" "time_node_id=${node_id}"
4282:   fi
4283:   time_snapshot="$(snapshot_section_or_self_text "$snapshot" "RNLAB_TIME")"
4284:   assert_text_contains "$time_snapshot" "$time_label" "time_snapshot_version=2"
4285: 
4286:   reference_unix="$(snapshot_field_value "$time_snapshot" "reference_unix")"
4287:   max_clock_skew_secs="$(snapshot_field_value "$time_snapshot" "max_clock_skew_secs")"
4288:   remote_unix_now="$(snapshot_field_value "$time_snapshot" "remote_unix_now")"
4289:   clock_skew_secs="$(snapshot_field_value "$time_snapshot" "clock_skew_secs")"
4290:   sync_evidence_present="$(snapshot_field_value "$time_snapshot" "sync_evidence_present")"
4291:   sync_source_kind="$(snapshot_field_value "$time_snapshot" "sync_source_kind")"
4292:   time_sync_observability="$(snapshot_field_value "$time_snapshot" "time_sync_observability")"
4293:   system_clock_synchronized="$(snapshot_field_value "$time_snapshot" "system_clock_synchronized")"
4294:   timedatectl_available="$(snapshot_field_value "$time_snapshot" "timedatectl_available")"
4295: 
4296:   if [[ ! "$reference_unix" =~ ^[0-9]+$ || ! "$max_clock_skew_secs" =~ ^[0-9]+$ || ! "$remote_unix_now" =~ ^[0-9]+$ || ! "$clock_skew_secs" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
4297:     printf '%s missing numeric skew evidence\n' "$time_label" >&2
4298:     return 1
4299:   fi
4300:   if (( clock_skew_secs > max_clock_skew_secs )); then
4301:     printf '%s exceeds skew bound: skew=%s max=%s\n' "$time_label" "$clock_skew_secs" "$max_clock_skew_secs" >&2
4302:     return 1
4303:   fi
4304:   if [[ "$sync_evidence_present" != "1" ]]; then
4305:     printf '%s missing credible synchronization source evidence\n' "$time_label" >&2
4306:     return 1
4307:   fi
4308:   if [[ -z "$sync_source_kind" || "$sync_source_kind" == "none" ]]; then
4309:     printf '%s missing synchronization source classification\n' "$time_label" >&2
4310:     return 1
4311:   fi
4312:   if [[ "$time_sync_observability" != "full" ]]; then
4313:     printf '%s missing full time-sync observability\n' "$time_label" >&2
4314:     return 1
4315:   fi
4316:   if [[ "$timedatectl_available" == "1" && "$system_clock_synchronized" != "yes" ]]; then
4317:     printf '%s expected timedatectl synchronized=yes, got %s\n' "$time_label" "${system_clock_synchronized:-missing}" >&2
4318:     return 1
4319:   fi
4320: }

4322: live_lab_assert_process_health() {
4323:   local snapshot="$1"
4324:   local node_id="$2"
4325:   local target="$3"
4326:   local process_snapshot process_label
4327:   local daemon_process_count helper_process_count managed_dns_process_count systemd_resolved_process_count
4328:   local unexpected_rustynetd_process_count rustynetd_active_state rustynetd_sub_state rustynetd_main_pid
4329:   local helper_active_state helper_sub_state helper_main_pid managed_dns_active_state managed_dns_sub_state
4330:   local systemd_resolved_active_state
4331: 
4332:   process_label="process health (${node_id})"
4333:   if [[ "$snapshot" == *"process_target="* ]]; then
4334:     assert_text_contains "$snapshot" "process snapshot (${node_id})" "process_target=${target}"
4335:   fi
4336:   if [[ "$snapshot" == *"process_node_id="* ]]; then
4337:     assert_text_contains "$snapshot" "process snapshot (${node_id})" "process_node_id=${node_id}"
4338:   fi
4339:   process_snapshot="$(snapshot_section_or_self_text "$snapshot" "RNLAB_PROCESS")"
4340:   assert_text_contains "$process_snapshot" "$process_label" "process_snapshot_version=2"
4341: 
4342:   daemon_process_count="$(snapshot_field_value "$process_snapshot" "daemon_process_count")"
4343:   helper_process_count="$(snapshot_field_value "$process_snapshot" "helper_process_count")"
4344:   managed_dns_process_count="$(snapshot_field_value "$process_snapshot" "managed_dns_process_count")"
4345:   systemd_resolved_process_count="$(snapshot_field_value "$process_snapshot" "systemd_resolved_process_count")"
4346:   unexpected_rustynetd_process_count="$(snapshot_field_value "$process_snapshot" "unexpected_rustynetd_process_count")"
4347:   rustynetd_active_state="$(snapshot_field_value "$process_snapshot" "rustynetd_active_state")"
4348:   rustynetd_sub_state="$(snapshot_field_value "$process_snapshot" "rustynetd_sub_state")"
4349:   rustynetd_main_pid="$(snapshot_field_value "$process_snapshot" "rustynetd_main_pid")"
4350:   helper_active_state="$(snapshot_field_value "$process_snapshot" "helper_active_state")"
4351:   helper_sub_state="$(snapshot_field_value "$process_snapshot" "helper_sub_state")"
4352:   helper_main_pid="$(snapshot_field_value "$process_snapshot" "helper_main_pid")"
4353:   managed_dns_active_state="$(snapshot_field_value "$process_snapshot" "managed_dns_active_state")"
4354:   managed_dns_sub_state="$(snapshot_field_value "$process_snapshot" "managed_dns_sub_state")"
4355:   systemd_resolved_active_state="$(snapshot_field_value "$process_snapshot" "systemd_resolved_active_state")"
4356: 
4357:   if [[ "$daemon_process_count" != "1" || "$helper_process_count" != "1" || "$unexpected_rustynetd_process_count" != "0" ]]; then
4358:     printf '%s unexpected daemon/helper process counts\n' "$process_label" >&2
4359:     return 1
4360:   fi
4361:   if [[ ! "$rustynetd_main_pid" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ || ! "$helper_main_pid" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]; then
4362:     printf '%s missing active main PID evidence\n' "$process_label" >&2
4363:     return 1
4364:   fi
4365:   if [[ "$rustynetd_active_state" != "active" || "$rustynetd_sub_state" != "running" ]]; then
4366:     printf '%s rustynetd.service not active/running\n' "$process_label" >&2
4367:     return 1
4368:   fi
4369:   if [[ "$helper_active_state" != "active" || "$helper_sub_state" != "running" ]]; then
4370:     printf '%s rustynetd-privileged-helper.service not active/running\n' "$process_label" >&2
4371:     return 1
4372:   fi
4373:   if [[ "$managed_dns_active_state" != "active" || ( "$managed_dns_sub_state" != "exited" && "$managed_dns_sub_state" != "running" ) ]]; then
4374:     printf '%s rustynetd-managed-dns.service not active/exited\n' "$process_label" >&2
4375:     return 1
4376:   fi
4377:   if [[ "$managed_dns_process_count" != "0" ]]; then
4378:     printf '%s unexpected persistent managed-DNS process count: %s\n' "$process_label" "${managed_dns_process_count:-missing}" >&2
4379:     return 1
4380:   fi
4381:   if [[ "$systemd_resolved_active_state" != "active" || ! "$systemd_resolved_process_count" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]; then
4382:     printf '%s systemd-resolved is not active with a live process\n' "$process_label" >&2
4383:     return 1
4384:   fi
4385: }

4471:     return 1

4496:   run_fact="$(permissions_fact_text "$permissions_snapshot" "/run/rustynet")"

4498:   permissions_fact_require "$permissions_snapshot" "/etc/rustynet/credentials/wg_key_passphrase.cred" "$permissions_label" '^600$' '^root$' '^root$' '^regular file$' || return 1

4554: live_lab_assert_dns_health() {
4555:   local snapshot="$1"
4556:   local node_id="$2"
4557:   local target="$3"
4558:   local dns_state dns_label
4559:   local resolv_conf_target systemd_resolved_service managed_dns_service resolvectl_available probe_count
4560: 
4561:   dns_label="dns health (${node_id})"
4562:   if [[ "$snapshot" == *"dns_state_target="* ]]; then
4563:     assert_text_contains "$snapshot" "dns snapshot (${node_id})" "dns_state_target=${target}"
4564:   fi
4565:   if [[ "$snapshot" == *"dns_state_collected_at_utc="* ]]; then
4566:     assert_text_contains "$snapshot" "dns snapshot (${node_id})" "dns_state_collected_at_utc="
4567:   fi
4568: 
4569:   dns_state="$(snapshot_section_or_self_text "$snapshot" "RNLAB_DNS_STATE")"
4570:   assert_text_contains "$dns_state" "$dns_label" "dns_state_version=1"
4571:   assert_text_contains "$dns_state" "$dns_label" "resolv_conf_begin"
4572:   assert_text_contains "$dns_state" "$dns_label" "resolvectl_status_begin"
4573:   assert_text_contains "$dns_state" "$dns_label" "systemd_resolved_service=active"
4574:   assert_text_contains "$dns_state" "$dns_label" "managed_dns_service=active"
4575:   assert_text_contains "$dns_state" "$dns_label" "resolvectl_available=1"
4576: 
4577:   resolv_conf_target="$(snapshot_field_value "$dns_state" "resolv_conf_target")"
4578:   systemd_resolved_service="$(snapshot_field_value "$dns_state" "systemd_resolved_service")"
4579:   managed_dns_service="$(snapshot_field_value "$dns_state" "managed_dns_service")"
4580:   resolvectl_available="$(snapshot_field_value "$dns_state" "resolvectl_available")"
4581:   probe_count="$(snapshot_field_value "$dns_state" "probe_count")"
4582: 
4583:   if [[ -z "$resolv_conf_target" ]]; then
4584:     printf '%s missing resolv_conf_target\n' "$dns_label" >&2
4585:     return 1
4586:   fi
4587:   if [[ "$systemd_resolved_service" != "active" ]]; then
4588:     printf '%s expected systemd-resolved active, got %s\n' "$dns_label" "${systemd_resolved_service:-missing}" >&2
4589:     return 1
4590:   fi
4591:   if [[ "$managed_dns_service" != "active" ]]; then
4592:     printf '%s expected rustynetd-managed-dns active, got %s\n' "$dns_label" "${managed_dns_service:-missing}" >&2
4593:     return 1
4594:   fi
4595:   if [[ "$resolvectl_available" != "1" ]]; then
4596:     printf '%s expected resolvectl availability, got %s\n' "$dns_label" "${resolvectl_available:-missing}" >&2
4597:     return 1
4598:   fi
4599:   if [[ ! "$probe_count" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || (( probe_count < 1 )); then
4600:     printf '%s expected at least one DNS probe, got %s\n' "$dns_label" "${probe_count:-missing}" >&2
4601:     return 1
4602:   fi
4603: }
4604: 
4605: live_lab_wait_for_dns_convergence() {
4606:   local target="$1"
4607:   local node_id="$2"
4608:   local attempts="${3:-20}"
4609:   local sleep_secs="${4:-3}"
4610:   local attempt snapshot
4611: 
4612:   for ((attempt = 1; attempt <= attempts; attempt++)); do
4613:     snapshot="$(live_lab_collect_dns_snapshot "$target")" || snapshot=""
4614:     if [[ -n "$snapshot" ]] && live_lab_assert_dns_health \
4615:       "$snapshot" \
4616:       "$node_id" \
4617:       "$target" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
4618:       printf '%s' "$snapshot"
4619:       return 0
4620:     fi
4621:     if [[ "$attempt" -lt "$attempts" ]]; then
4622:       sleep "$sleep_secs"
4623:     fi
4624:   done
4625: 
4626:   snapshot="$(live_lab_collect_dns_snapshot "$target")" || snapshot=""
4627:   printf '%s' "$snapshot"
4628:   return 1
4629: }

4636: 
4637:   signed_label="signed state (${node_id})"
4638:   if [[ "$snapshot" == *"signed_state_target="* ]]; then
4639:     assert_text_contains "$snapshot" "signed state snapshot (${node_id})" "signed_state_target=${target}"
4640:   fi
4641:   if [[ "$snapshot" == *"signed_state_node_id="* ]]; then
4642:     assert_text_contains "$snapshot" "signed state snapshot (${node_id})" "signed_state_node_id=${node_id}"
4643:   fi
4644:   if [[ "$snapshot" == *"signed_state_collected_at_utc="* ]]; then
4645:     assert_text_contains "$snapshot" "signed state snapshot (${node_id})" "signed_state_collected_at_utc="
4646:   fi
4647: 
4648:   signed_state="$(snapshot_section_or_self_text "$snapshot" "RNLAB_SIGNED_STATE")"
4649:   assert_text_contains "$signed_state" "$signed_label" "signed_state_snapshot_version=1"
4650:   assert_text_contains "$signed_state" "$signed_label" "signed_state_node_id=${node_id}"
4651:   assert_text_contains "$signed_state" "$signed_label" "artifact_chain_result=pass"
4652:   assert_text_contains "$signed_state" "$signed_label" "signed_state_health=pass"
4653:   assert_text_contains "$signed_state" "$signed_label" "signed_artifact_chain_status=pass"

4656:   assert_text_contains "$signed_state" "$signed_label" "assignment_verify_rc=0"

4659:   assert_text_contains "$signed_state" "$signed_label" "dns_zone_verify_rc=0"

4663:   assert_text_absent "$netcheck_text" "$signed_label" "traversal_alarm_state=critical"
4664:   assert_text_absent "$netcheck_text" "$signed_label" "traversal_alarm_state=error"
4665:   assert_text_absent "$netcheck_text" "$signed_label" "traversal_alarm_state=missing"
4666:   assert_text_absent "$netcheck_text" "$signed_label" "dns_alarm_state=critical"
4667:   assert_text_absent "$netcheck_text" "$signed_label" "dns_alarm_state=error"
4668:   assert_text_absent "$netcheck_text" "$signed_label" "dns_alarm_state=missing"
4669: }

4701: live_lab_assert_dns_zone_health() {
4702:   local snapshot="$1"
4703:   local node_id="$2"
4704:   local target="$3"
4705:   local dns_zone dns_label status_text inspect_text
4706:   local status_rc dns_inspect_rc dns_zone_verify_rc
4707:   local dns_zone_bundle_present dns_zone_verifier_present dns_zone_watermark_present
4708: 
4709:   dns_label="dns zone (${node_id})"
4710:   if [[ "$snapshot" == *"dns_zone_target="* ]]; then
4711:     assert_text_contains "$snapshot" "dns zone snapshot (${node_id})" "dns_zone_target=${target}"
4712:   fi
4713:   if [[ "$snapshot" == *"dns_zone_node_id="* ]]; then
4714:     assert_text_contains "$snapshot" "dns zone snapshot (${node_id})" "dns_zone_node_id=${node_id}"
4715:   fi
4716:   if [[ "$snapshot" == *"dns_zone_collected_at_utc="* ]]; then
4717:     assert_text_contains "$snapshot" "dns zone snapshot (${node_id})" "dns_zone_collected_at_utc="
4718:   fi
4719: 
4720:   dns_zone="$(snapshot_section_or_self_text "$snapshot" "RNLAB_DNS_ZONE")"
4721:   assert_text_contains "$dns_zone" "$dns_label" "dns_zone_snapshot_version=1"
4722:   assert_text_contains "$dns_zone" "$dns_label" "dns_zone_node_id=${node_id}"
4723:   assert_text_contains "$dns_zone" "$dns_label" "dns_zone_bundle_present=1"
4724:   assert_text_contains "$dns_zone" "$dns_label" "dns_zone_verifier_present=1"
4725:   assert_text_contains "$dns_zone" "$dns_label" "dns_zone_watermark_present=1"
4726: 
4727:   status_rc="$(snapshot_field_value "$dns_zone" "status_rc")"
4728:   dns_inspect_rc="$(snapshot_field_value "$dns_zone" "dns_inspect_rc")"
4729:   dns_zone_verify_rc="$(snapshot_field_value "$dns_zone" "dns_zone_verify_rc")"
4730:   dns_zone_bundle_present="$(snapshot_field_value "$dns_zone" "dns_zone_bundle_present")"
4731:   dns_zone_verifier_present="$(snapshot_field_value "$dns_zone" "dns_zone_verifier_present")"
4732:   dns_zone_watermark_present="$(snapshot_field_value "$dns_zone" "dns_zone_watermark_present")"
4733: 
4734:   if [[ "$status_rc" != "0" ]]; then
4735:     printf '%s expected rustynet status rc=0, got %s\n' "$dns_label" "${status_rc:-missing}" >&2
4736:     return 1
4737:   fi
4738:   if [[ "$dns_inspect_rc" != "0" ]]; then
4739:     printf '%s expected dns inspect rc=0, got %s\n' "$dns_label" "${dns_inspect_rc:-missing}" >&2
4740:     return 1
4741:   fi
4742:   if [[ "$dns_zone_verify_rc" != "0" ]]; then
4743:     printf '%s expected dns zone verify rc=0, got %s\n' "$dns_label" "${dns_zone_verify_rc:-missing}" >&2
4744:     return 1
4745:   fi
4746:   if [[ "$dns_zone_bundle_present" != "1" || "$dns_zone_verifier_present" != "1" || "$dns_zone_watermark_present" != "1" ]]; then
4747:     printf '%s expected bundle, verifier, and watermark presence\n' "$dns_label" >&2
4748:     return 1
4749:   fi
4750: 
4751:   status_text="$(snapshot_named_block_text "$dns_zone" "status")"
4752:   inspect_text="$(snapshot_named_block_text "$dns_zone" "dns_inspect")"
4753:   assert_text_contains "$status_text" "$dns_label" "node_id=${node_id}"
4754:   assert_text_contains "$status_text" "$dns_label" "dns_zone_state=valid"
4755:   assert_text_contains "$status_text" "$dns_label" "dns_zone_error=none"
4756:   assert_text_contains "$status_text" "$dns_label" "dns_alarm_state=ok"
4757:   assert_text_contains "$inspect_text" "$dns_label" "dns inspect: state=valid"
4758: }

4787: live_lab_assert_firewall_policy() {
4788:   local snapshot="$1"
4789:   local node_id="$2"
4790:   local target="$3"
4791:   local role="$4"
4792:   local firewall firewall_label firewall_ruleset
4793:   local nft_tables_rc nft_ruleset_rc
4794: 
4795:   firewall_label="firewall policy (${node_id})"
4796:   if [[ "$snapshot" == *"firewall_target="* ]]; then
4797:     assert_text_contains "$snapshot" "firewall snapshot (${node_id})" "firewall_target=${target}"
4798:   fi
4799:   if [[ "$snapshot" == *"firewall_node_id="* ]]; then
4800:     assert_text_contains "$snapshot" "firewall snapshot (${node_id})" "firewall_node_id=${node_id}"
4801:   fi
4802:   if [[ -n "$role" && "$snapshot" == *"firewall_role="* ]]; then
4803:     assert_text_contains "$snapshot" "firewall snapshot (${node_id})" "firewall_role=${role}"
4804:   fi
4805: 
4806:   firewall="$(snapshot_section_or_self_text "$snapshot" "RNLAB_FIREWALL")"
4807:   assert_text_contains "$firewall" "$firewall_label" "firewall_snapshot_version=1"
4808:   assert_text_contains "$firewall" "$firewall_label" "firewall_health=pass"
4809:   assert_text_contains "$firewall" "$firewall_label" "firewall_status=pass"
4810: 
4811:   nft_tables_rc="$(snapshot_field_value "$firewall" "nft_tables_rc")"
4812:   nft_ruleset_rc="$(snapshot_field_value "$firewall" "nft_ruleset_rc")"
4813:   if [[ "$nft_tables_rc" != "0" ]]; then
4814:     printf '%s expected nft list tables rc=0, got %s\n' "$firewall_label" "${nft_tables_rc:-missing}" >&2
4815:     return 1
4816:   fi
4817:   if [[ "$nft_ruleset_rc" != "0" ]]; then
4818:     printf '%s expected nft list ruleset rc=0, got %s\n' "$firewall_label" "${nft_ruleset_rc:-missing}" >&2
4819:     return 1
4820:   fi
4821: 
4822:   firewall_ruleset="$(snapshot_named_block_text "$firewall" "nft_ruleset")"
4823:   if [[ -z "$(printf '%s' "$firewall_ruleset" | tr -d '[:space:]')" ]]; then
4824:     printf '%s missing nft ruleset output\n' "$firewall_label" >&2
4825:     return 1
4826:   fi
4827:   if ! grep -Eq 'table[[:space:]]+inet[[:space:]]+rustynet_g[0-9]+' <<<"$firewall_ruleset"; then
4828:     printf '%s missing rustynet inet firewall table\n' "$firewall_label" >&2
4829:     return 1
4830:   fi
4831:   if ! grep -Eq 'chain[[:space:]]+killswitch' <<<"$firewall_ruleset"; then
4832:     printf '%s missing killswitch chain\n' "$firewall_label" >&2
4833:     return 1
4834:   fi
4835:   if ! grep -Eq 'hook[[:space:]]+output' <<<"$firewall_ruleset"; then
4836:     printf '%s missing output hook\n' "$firewall_label" >&2
4837:     return 1
4838:   fi
4839:   if ! grep -Eq 'policy[[:space:]]+drop' <<<"$firewall_ruleset"; then
4840:     printf '%s missing drop policy\n' "$firewall_label" >&2
4841:     return 1
4842:   fi
4843:   if ! grep -Eq 'udp[[:space:]]+dport[[:space:]]+53.*oifname[[:space:]]+!=[[:space:]]+"?rustynet0"?[[:space:]]+drop' <<<"$firewall_ruleset"; then
4844:     printf '%s missing UDP DNS fail-closed rule\n' "$firewall_label" >&2
4845:     return 1
4846:   fi
4847:   if ! grep -Eq 'tcp[[:space:]]+dport[[:space:]]+53.*oifname[[:space:]]+!=[[:space:]]+"?rustynet0"?[[:space:]]+drop' <<<"$firewall_ruleset"; then
4848:     printf '%s missing TCP DNS fail-closed rule\n' "$firewall_label" >&2
4849:     return 1
4850:   fi
4851:   if ! grep -Eq 'udp[[:space:]]+dport[[:space:]]+53[[:space:]]+accept' <<<"$firewall_ruleset"; then
4852:     printf '%s missing UDP DNS allow rule\n' "$firewall_label" >&2
4853:     return 1
4854:   fi
4855:   if ! grep -Eq 'tcp[[:space:]]+dport[[:space:]]+53[[:space:]]+accept' <<<"$firewall_ruleset"; then
4856:     printf '%s missing TCP DNS allow rule\n' "$firewall_label" >&2
4857:     return 1
4858:   fi
4859: 
4860:   if [[ "$role" == "exit" || "$role" == "admin" ]]; then
4861:     if ! grep -Eq 'table[[:space:]]+ip[[:space:]]+rustynet_nat_g[0-9]+' <<<"$firewall_ruleset"; then
4862:       printf '%s missing rustynet NAT table for exit role\n' "$firewall_label" >&2
4863:       return 1
4864:     fi
4865:     if ! grep -Eq 'chain[[:space:]]+forward' <<<"$firewall_ruleset"; then
4866:       printf '%s missing forward chain for exit role\n' "$firewall_label" >&2
4867:       return 1
4868:     fi
4869:     if ! grep -Eq 'iifname[[:space:]]+"?rustynet0"?[[:space:]]+oifname[[:space:]]+[^ ]+[[:space:]]+accept' <<<"$firewall_ruleset"; then
4870:       printf '%s missing rustynet forward accept rule for exit role\n' "$firewall_label" >&2
4871:       return 1
4872:     fi
4873:     if ! grep -Eq 'chain[[:space:]]+postrouting' <<<"$firewall_ruleset"; then
4874:       printf '%s missing postrouting chain for exit role\n' "$firewall_label" >&2
4875:       return 1
4876:     fi
4877:     if ! grep -Eq 'masquerade' <<<"$firewall_ruleset"; then
4878:       printf '%s missing masquerade rule for exit role\n' "$firewall_label" >&2
4879:       return 1
4880:     fi
4881:   fi
4882: }

4884: live_lab_assert_runtime_spec() {
4885:   local snapshot="$1"
4886:   local node_id="$2"
4887:   local target="$3"
4888:   local role="$4"
4889:   local expected_membership_nodes="$5"
4890:   local exit_node_id="$6"
4891:   local status route_check secret_hygiene
4892:   local status_label route_label hygiene_label
4893: 
4894:   status_label="baseline status (${node_id})"
4895:   route_label="route check (${node_id})"
4896:   hygiene_label="plaintext check (${node_id})"
4897: 
4898:   assert_text_contains "$snapshot" "runtime snapshot (${node_id})" "node_snapshot_version=1"
4899:   assert_text_contains "$snapshot" "runtime snapshot (${node_id})" "target=${target}"
4900:   assert_text_contains "$snapshot" "runtime snapshot (${node_id})" "node_id=${node_id}"
4901:   assert_text_contains "$snapshot" "runtime snapshot (${node_id})" "role=${role}"
4902: 
4903:   status="$(snapshot_section_text "$snapshot" "RNLAB_STATUS")"
4904:   route_check="$(snapshot_section_text "$snapshot" "RNLAB_ROUTE_POLICY")"
4905:   secret_hygiene="$(snapshot_section_text "$snapshot" "RNLAB_SECRET_HYGIENE")"
4906: 
4907:   assert_text_contains "$status" "$status_label" "transport_socket_identity_state=authoritative_backend_shared_transport"
4908:   assert_text_contains "$status" "$status_label" "transport_socket_identity_error=none"
4909:   assert_text_contains "$status" "$status_label" "encrypted_key_store=true"
4910:   assert_text_contains "$status" "$status_label" "auto_tunnel_enforce=true"
4911:   assert_text_contains "$status" "$status_label" "membership_active_nodes=${expected_membership_nodes}"
4912:   assert_text_absent "$status" "$status_label" "does not yet implement route application"
4913:   assert_text_absent "$status" "$status_label" "does not yet implement exit mode"
4914: 
4915:   assert_text_contains "$route_check" "$route_label" "route_policy_version=1"
4916:   assert_text_contains "$secret_hygiene" "$hygiene_label" "daemon_socket=present"
4917:   assert_text_contains "$secret_hygiene" "$hygiene_label" "result=no-plaintext-passphrase-files"
4918: 
4919:   if [[ "$role" == "client" ]]; then
4920:     assert_text_contains "$status" "$status_label" "exit_node=${exit_node_id}"
4921:     assert_text_contains "$route_check" "$route_label" "actual_route_device=rustynet0"
4922:     assert_text_contains "$route_check" "$route_label" "actual_route_table=51820"
4923:     assert_text_contains "$route_check" "$route_label" "expected_next_hop_match=pass"
4924:   fi
4925: }

4944:   stage_log="$REPORT_DIR/live_linux_managed_dns.log"
4945:   local -a cmd=(

4950:     --signer-node-id "$(node_id_for_label exit)"

4952:     --client-node-id "$(node_id_for_label client)"

4967:   assert_no_managed_dns_service_errors "$stage_log" "live managed DNS" || return 1
4968:   mkdir -p "$(dirname "$canonical_report")" || return 1
4969:   cp "$stage_report" "$canonical_report" || return 1
4970:   cp "$stage_log" "$canonical_log" || return 1
4971: }

5014: assert_client_dns_zone_valid_in_log() {
5015:   local log_path="$1"
5016:   local label="$2"
5017:   local client_node_id
5018:   client_node_id="$(node_id_for_label client)"
5019:   if [[ ! -f "$log_path" ]]; then
5020:     printf '%s log missing: %s\n' "$label" "$log_path" >&2
5021:     return 1
5022:   fi
5023:   if ! awk -v node_id="$client_node_id" '
5024:     index($0, "node_id=" node_id) && index($0, "dns_zone_state=valid") && index($0, "dns_zone_error=none") { found=1; exit }
5025:     END { exit(found ? 0 : 1) }
5026:   ' "$log_path"; then
5027:     printf '%s log missing required client DNS validity fields on one line (node_id=%s, dns_zone_state=valid, dns_zone_error=none): %s\n' "$label" "$client_node_id" "$log_path" >&2
5028:     rg -n -- "node_id=${client_node_id}" "$log_path" >&2 || true
5029:     return 1
5030:   fi
5031: }

5033: soak_sleep_with_backoff_jitter() {
5034:   local attempt="$1"
5035:   local base_sleep_secs="${2:-1}"
5036:   local max_sleep_secs="${3:-8}"
5037:   local sleep_secs jitter_millis sleep_for
5038: 
5039:   sleep_secs=$(( base_sleep_secs << (attempt - 1) ))
5040:   if (( sleep_secs > max_sleep_secs )); then
5041:     sleep_secs="$max_sleep_secs"
5042:   fi
5043:   jitter_millis=$(( RANDOM % 1000 ))
5044:   printf -v sleep_for '%d.%03d' "$sleep_secs" "$jitter_millis"
5045:   sleep "$sleep_for"
5046: }
5047: 
5048: soak_wait_for_node_security_convergence() {
5049:   local label="$1"
5050:   local stage_label="$2"
5051:   local attempts="${SOAK_SECURITY_MAX_ATTEMPTS:-8}"
5052:   local base_sleep_secs="${SOAK_SECURITY_BASE_SLEEP_SECS:-1}"
5053:   local max_sleep_secs="${SOAK_SECURITY_MAX_SLEEP_SECS:-8}"
5054:   local zone_name="${RUSTYNET_DNS_ZONE_NAME:-rustynet}"
5055:   local signed_max_age_secs="${CROSS_NETWORK_SIGNED_ARTIFACT_MAX_AGE_SECS:-900}"
5056:   local max_clock_skew_secs="${CROSS_NETWORK_MAX_TIME_SKEW_SECS:-2}"
5057:   local target node_id role
5058:   local attempt dns_zone_snapshot signed_state_snapshot
5059: 
5060:   if ! has_label "$label"; then
5061:     return 0
5062:   fi
5063:   target="$(node_target_for_label "$label")"
5064:   node_id="$(node_id_for_label "$label")"
5065:   role="$(node_role_for_label "$label")"
5066: 
5067:   for ((attempt = 1; attempt <= attempts; attempt++)); do
5068:     dns_zone_snapshot="$(live_lab_collect_dns_zone_snapshot "$target" "$node_id" "$zone_name" || true)"
5069:     signed_state_snapshot="$(live_lab_collect_signed_state_snapshot "$target" "$node_id" "$role" "$zone_name" "$signed_max_age_secs" "$max_clock_skew_secs" || true)"
5070:     if [[ -n "$dns_zone_snapshot" ]] && live_lab_assert_dns_zone_health \
5071:       "$dns_zone_snapshot" \
5072:       "$node_id" \
5073:       "$target" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
5074:       && [[ -n "$signed_state_snapshot" ]] && live_lab_assert_signed_state_health \
5075:       "$signed_state_snapshot" \
5076:       "$node_id" \
5077:       "$target" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
5078:       return 0
5079:     fi
5080:     if (( attempt < attempts )); then
5081:       soak_sleep_with_backoff_jitter "$attempt" "$base_sleep_secs" "$max_sleep_secs"
5082:     fi
5083:   done
5084: 
5085:   printf '%s security convergence did not complete for %s (%s)\n' "$stage_label" "$label" "$target" >&2
5086:   if [[ -n "$dns_zone_snapshot" ]]; then
5087:     printf '%s\n' "$dns_zone_snapshot" >&2
5088:   fi
5089:   if [[ -n "$signed_state_snapshot" ]]; then
5090:     printf '%s\n' "$signed_state_snapshot" >&2
5091:   fi
5092:   return 1
5093: }
5094: 
5095: assert_soak_cluster_security_convergence() {
5096:   local stage_label="$1"
5097:   shift
5098:   local label
5099:   for label in "$@"; do
5100:     soak_wait_for_node_security_convergence "$label" "$stage_label" || return 1
5101:   done
5102: }

5247:     --client-node-id "$(node_id_for_label client)" \
5248:     --exit-node-id "$(node_id_for_label exit)" \
5249:     --client-network-id "$(cross_network_network_id_for_label client)" \
5250:     --exit-network-id "$(cross_network_network_id_for_label exit)" \
5251:     --client-underlay-ip "$client_underlay_ip" \
5252:     --exit-underlay-ip "$exit_underlay_ip" \
5253:     --nat-profile "$nat_profile" \
5254:     --impairment-profile "$CROSS_NETWORK_IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE" \
5255:     --ssh-allow-cidrs "$SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS" \
5256:     --report-path "$report_path" \
5257:     --log-path "$log_path"
5258:   )
5259:   run_cross_network_stage_with_impairment dns "${cmd[@]}"
5260: }

5356: cross_network_preflight_worker() {
5357:   local label="$1"
5358:   local target="$2"
5359:   local node_id="$3"
5360:   local _role="$4"
5361:   local stage_dir capability_path
5362:   local remote_unix local_unix skew
5363:   local cmd
5364:   local required_user_cmds=(rustynet rustynetd wg systemctl ss ip nft journalctl)
5365:   local required_root_cmds=(wg systemctl ss ip nft journalctl)
5366:   local time_snapshot time_rc time_path time_section
5367:   local process_snapshot process_rc process_path
5368:   local socket_snapshot socket_rc socket_path
5369:   local permissions_snapshot permissions_rc permissions_path
5370:   local signed_state_snapshot signed_state_rc signed_state_path route_snapshot endpoint_snapshot
5371:   local route_policy_snapshot route_policy_rc route_policy_path
5372:   local dns_state_snapshot dns_state_rc dns_state_path
5373:   local dns_zone_snapshot dns_zone_rc dns_zone_path
5374:   local node_snapshot node_snapshot_rc
5375:   local global_ipv4 hostname_resolution_snapshot plaintext_snapshot
5376:   local remote_src discovery_script_path discovery_remote_path discovery_local_path discovery_validation_path
5377:   local discovery_hash
5378: 
5379:   stage_dir="$(parallel_stage_dir cross_network_preflight)"
5380:   capability_path="${stage_dir}/capabilities-${label}.txt"
5381:   : > "$capability_path"
5382: 
5383:   live_lab_push_sudo_password "$target"
5384:   live_lab_wait_for_daemon_socket "$target"
5385:   set +e
5386:   dns_state_snapshot="$(live_lab_wait_for_dns_convergence "$target" "$node_id")"
5387:   dns_state_rc=$?
5388:   set -e
5389:   dns_state_path="$(stage_worker_write_artifact "$label" "dns_state.txt" "$(printf 'capture_rc=%s\n%s\n' "$dns_state_rc" "$dns_state_snapshot")")" || return 1
5390:   if [[ "$dns_state_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
5391:     printf 'dns health did not converge for %s (%s)\n' "$label" "$target" >&2
5392:     return "$dns_state_rc"
5393:   fi
5394:   local_unix="${CROSS_NETWORK_PREFLIGHT_REFERENCE_UNIX:-0}"
5395:   if [[ ! "$local_unix" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || (( local_unix <= 0 )); then
5396:     printf 'invalid preflight local unix reference for %s (%s): %s\n' "$label" "$target" "$local_unix" >&2
5397:     return 1
5398:   fi
5399:   set +e
5400:   time_snapshot="$(live_lab_collect_time_snapshot "$target" "$node_id" "$_role" "$local_unix" "$CROSS_NETWORK_MAX_TIME_SKEW_SECS" 2>&1)"
5401:   time_rc=$?
5402:   set -e
5403:   time_path="$(stage_worker_write_artifact "$label" "time.txt" "$(printf 'capture_rc=%s\n%s\n' "$time_rc" "$time_snapshot")")" || return 1
5404:   if [[ "$time_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
5405:     printf 'time snapshot capture failed for %s (%s)\n' "$label" "$target" >&2
5406:     return "$time_rc"
5407:   fi
5408:   live_lab_assert_time_sync "$time_snapshot" "$node_id" "$target" || return 1
5409:   time_section="$(snapshot_section_or_self_text "$time_snapshot" "RNLAB_TIME")"
5410:   remote_unix="$(snapshot_field_value "$time_section" "remote_unix_now")"
5411:   skew="$(snapshot_field_value "$time_section" "clock_skew_secs")"
5412:   if [[ ! "$remote_unix" =~ ^[0-9]+$ || ! "$skew" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
5413:     printf 'time snapshot missing parsed skew data for %s (%s)\n' "$label" "$target" >&2
5414:     return 1
5415:   fi
5416: 
5417:   set +e
5418:   process_snapshot="$(live_lab_collect_process_snapshot "$target" "$node_id" "$_role" 2>&1)"
5419:   process_rc=$?
5420:   set -e
5421:   process_path="$(stage_worker_write_artifact "$label" "process.txt" "$(printf 'capture_rc=%s\n%s\n' "$process_rc" "$process_snapshot")")" || return 1
5422:   [[ "$process_rc" -eq 0 ]] || return "$process_rc"
5423:   live_lab_assert_process_health "$process_snapshot" "$node_id" "$target" "$_role" || return 1
5424: 
5425:   set +e
5426:   socket_snapshot="$(live_lab_collect_socket_snapshot "$target" "$node_id" "$_role" 2>&1)"
5427:   socket_rc=$?
5428:   set -e
5429:   socket_path="$(stage_worker_write_artifact "$label" "socket.txt" "$(printf 'capture_rc=%s\n%s\n' "$socket_rc" "$socket_snapshot")")" || return 1
5430:   [[ "$socket_rc" -eq 0 ]] || return "$socket_rc"
5431:   live_lab_assert_socket_health "$socket_snapshot" "$node_id" "$target" "$_role" || return 1
5432: 
5433:   set +e
5434:   permissions_snapshot="$(live_lab_collect_permissions_snapshot "$target" "$node_id" "$_role" 2>&1)"
5435:   permissions_rc=$?
5436:   set -e
5437:   permissions_path="$(stage_worker_write_artifact "$label" "permissions.txt" "$(printf 'capture_rc=%s\n%s\n' "$permissions_rc" "$permissions_snapshot")")" || return 1
5438:   [[ "$permissions_rc" -eq 0 ]] || return "$permissions_rc"
5439:   live_lab_assert_permissions_hardening "$permissions_snapshot" "$node_id" "$target" "$_role" || return 1
5440: 
5441:   if [[ "$CROSS_NETWORK_IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE" != "none" ]]; then
5442:     required_user_cmds+=(tc)
5443:     required_root_cmds+=(tc)
5444:   fi
5445: 
5446:   for cmd in "${required_user_cmds[@]}"; do
5447:     if ! live_lab_capture "$target" "command -v '$cmd'" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
5448:       printf 'missing required user command on %s (%s): %s\n' "$label" "$target" "$cmd" >&2
5449:       return 1
5450:     fi
5451:   done
5452:   for cmd in "${required_root_cmds[@]}"; do
5453:     if ! live_lab_run_root "$target" "root command -v '$cmd' >/dev/null"; then
5454:       printf 'missing required root command on %s (%s): %s\n' "$label" "$target" "$cmd" >&2
5455:       return 1
5456:     fi
5457:   done
5458: 
5459:   remote_src="$(live_lab_remote_src_dir "$target")"
5460:   discovery_script_path="${remote_src}/scripts/operations/collect_network_discovery_info.sh"
5461:   if ! live_lab_run_root "$target" "root test -f '$discovery_script_path'"; then
5462:     printf 'missing discovery script on %s (%s): %s\n' "$label" "$target" "$discovery_script_path" >&2
5463:     return 1
5464:   fi
5465:   if [[ "$CROSS_NETWORK_IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE" != "none" ]]; then
5466:     if ! live_lab_run_root "$target" "root test -f '${remote_src}/scripts/e2e/apply_cross_network_impairment_profile.sh'"; then
5467:       printf 'missing impairment profile script on %s (%s)\n' "$label" "$target" >&2
5468:       return 1
5469:     fi
5470:   fi
5471: 
5472:   global_ipv4="$(live_lab_capture "$target" "ip -4 -o addr show up scope global | awk '{print \$4; exit}' | cut -d/ -f1" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
5473:   if [[ -z "$global_ipv4" ]]; then
5474:     printf 'missing global IPv4 address on %s (%s)\n' "$label" "$target" >&2
5475:     return 1
5476:   fi
5477:   if ! live_lab_capture "$target" "ip -4 route show default | awk '/^default/{found=1} END{exit(found?0:1)}'" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
5478:     printf 'missing default IPv4 route on %s (%s)\n' "$label" "$target" >&2
5479:     return 1
5480:   fi
5481:   hostname_resolution_snapshot="$(live_lab_capture "$target" 'current_hostname="$(hostname)"; getent hosts "$current_hostname" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 || true')"
5482:   if [[ -z "$(printf '%s' "$hostname_resolution_snapshot" | tr -d '[:space:]')" ]]; then
5483:     printf 'hostname does not resolve locally on %s (%s); fix /etc/hosts or local resolver\n' "$label" "$target" >&2
5484:     return 1
5485:   fi
5486: 
5487:   set +e
5488:   dns_zone_snapshot="$(live_lab_wait_for_dns_zone_convergence "$target" "$node_id")"
5489:   dns_zone_rc=$?
5490:   set -e
5491:   dns_zone_path="$(stage_worker_write_artifact "$label" "dns_zone.txt" "$(printf 'capture_rc=%s\n%s\n' "$dns_zone_rc" "$dns_zone_snapshot")")" || return 1
5492:   if [[ "$dns_zone_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
5493:     printf 'dns zone health did not converge for %s (%s)\n' "$label" "$target" >&2
5494:     return "$dns_zone_rc"
5495:   fi
5496: 
5497:   set +e
5498:   signed_state_snapshot="$(live_lab_wait_for_signed_state_convergence "$target" "$node_id" "$_role")"
5499:   signed_state_rc=$?
5500:   set -e
5501:   signed_state_path="$(stage_worker_write_artifact "$label" "signed_state.txt" "$(printf 'capture_rc=%s\n%s\n' "$signed_state_rc" "$signed_state_snapshot")")" || return 1
5502:   if [[ "$signed_state_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
5503:     printf 'signed state did not converge for %s (%s)\n' "$label" "$target" >&2
5504:     return "$signed_state_rc"
5505:   fi
5506: 
5507:   live_lab_run_root "$target" "root test -S /run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock"
5508:   live_lab_run_root "$target" "root systemctl is-active --quiet rustynetd.service"
5509:   live_lab_run_root "$target" "root systemctl is-active --quiet rustynetd-privileged-helper.service"
5510:   plaintext_snapshot="$(live_lab_no_plaintext_passphrase_check "$target" || true)"
5511:   if [[ "$plaintext_snapshot" != *"no-plaintext-passphrase-files"* ]]; then
5512:     printf 'plaintext passphrase files detected on %s (%s)\n' "$label" "$target" >&2
5513:     return 1
5514:   fi
5515: 
5516:   discovery_remote_path="/tmp/rn-cross-network-discovery-${label}.json"
5517:   discovery_local_path="${stage_dir}/discovery-${label}.json"
5518:   discovery_validation_path="${stage_dir}/discovery-${label}.md"
5519:   live_lab_run_root "$target" "root bash '$discovery_script_path' --quiet --output '$discovery_remote_path'"
5520:   live_lab_scp_from "$target" "$discovery_remote_path" "$discovery_local_path"
5521:   live_lab_run_root "$target" "root rustynet ops secure-remove --path '$discovery_remote_path' >/dev/null 2>&1 || root rm -f '$discovery_remote_path'" || true
5522:   cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops validate-network-discovery-bundle \
5523:     --bundle "$discovery_local_path" \
5524:     --max-age-seconds "$CROSS_NETWORK_DISCOVERY_MAX_AGE_SECS" \
5525:     --require-verifier-keys \
5526:     --require-daemon-active \
5527:     --require-socket-present \
5528:     --output "$discovery_validation_path"
5529:   discovery_hash="$(cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops sha256-file --path "$discovery_local_path")"
5530: 
5531:   set +e
5532:   route_policy_snapshot="$(live_lab_collect_route_policy "$target" 2>&1)"
5533:   route_policy_rc=$?
5534:   set -e
5535:   [[ "$route_policy_rc" -eq 0 ]] || return "$route_policy_rc"
5536:   [[ "$dns_state_rc" -eq 0 ]] || return "$dns_state_rc"
5537:   set +e
5538:   node_snapshot="$(live_lab_collect_node_snapshot "$target" "$node_id" "$_role" 2>&1)"
5539:   node_snapshot_rc=$?
5540:   set -e
5541:   [[ "$node_snapshot_rc" -eq 0 ]] || return "$node_snapshot_rc"
5542:   stage_worker_write_artifact "$label" "snapshot.txt" "$(printf 'capture_rc=%s\n%s\n' "$node_snapshot_rc" "$node_snapshot")" >/dev/null || return 1
5543:   route_policy_path="$(stage_worker_write_artifact "$label" "route_policy.txt" "$(printf 'capture_rc=%s\n%s\n' "$route_policy_rc" "$route_policy_snapshot")")" || return 1
5544:   route_snapshot="$(awk '
5545:     /route_get_begin/ { capture=1; next }
5546:     /route_get_end/ { capture=0; next }
5547:     capture { print }
5548:   ' <<<"$route_policy_snapshot" | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ';')"
5549:   endpoint_snapshot="$(live_lab_capture_root "$target" "root wg show rustynet0 endpoints || true" || true)"
5550: 
5551:   printf 'label=%s\n' "$label" >> "$capability_path"
5552:   printf 'target=%s\n' "$target" >> "$capability_path"
5553:   printf 'node_id=%s\n' "$node_id" >> "$capability_path"
5554:   printf 'local_unix=%s\n' "$local_unix" >> "$capability_path"
5555:   printf 'remote_unix=%s\n' "$remote_unix" >> "$capability_path"
5556:   printf 'clock_skew_secs=%s\n' "$skew" >> "$capability_path"
5557:   printf 'max_clock_skew_secs=%s\n' "$CROSS_NETWORK_MAX_TIME_SKEW_SECS" >> "$capability_path"
5558:   printf 'time_path=%s\n' "$time_path" >> "$capability_path"
5559:   printf 'process_path=%s\n' "$process_path" >> "$capability_path"
5560:   printf 'socket_path=%s\n' "$socket_path" >> "$capability_path"
5561:   printf 'permissions_path=%s\n' "$permissions_path" >> "$capability_path"
5562:   printf 'signed_artifact_max_age_secs=%s\n' "$CROSS_NETWORK_SIGNED_ARTIFACT_MAX_AGE_SECS" >> "$capability_path"
5563:   printf 'discovery_bundle_max_age_secs=%s\n' "$CROSS_NETWORK_DISCOVERY_MAX_AGE_SECS" >> "$capability_path"
5564:   printf 'global_ipv4=%s\n' "$global_ipv4" >> "$capability_path"
5565:   printf 'discovery_bundle_path=%s\n' "$discovery_local_path" >> "$capability_path"
5566:   printf 'discovery_bundle_sha256=%s\n' "$discovery_hash" >> "$capability_path"
5567:   printf 'discovery_validation_report=%s\n' "$discovery_validation_path" >> "$capability_path"
5568:   printf 'hostname_resolution_snapshot=%s\n' "$(printf '%s' "$hostname_resolution_snapshot" | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ';')" >> "$capability_path"
5569:   printf 'dns_zone_snapshot=%s\n' "$(printf '%s' "$dns_zone_snapshot" | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ';')" >> "$capability_path"
5570:   printf 'dns_zone_path=%s\n' "$dns_zone_path" >> "$capability_path"
5571:   printf 'signed_state_snapshot=%s\n' "$(printf '%s' "$signed_state_snapshot" | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ';')" >> "$capability_path"
5572:   printf 'signed_state_path=%s\n' "$signed_state_path" >> "$capability_path"
5573:   printf 'plaintext_snapshot=%s\n' "$(printf '%s' "$plaintext_snapshot" | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ';')" >> "$capability_path"
5574:   printf 'route_snapshot=%s\n' "$(printf '%s' "$route_snapshot" | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ';')" >> "$capability_path"
5575:   printf 'route_policy_path=%s\n' "$route_policy_path" >> "$capability_path"
5576:   printf 'dns_state_path=%s\n' "$dns_state_path" >> "$capability_path"
5577:   printf 'endpoint_snapshot=%s\n' "$(printf '%s' "$endpoint_snapshot" | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ';')" >> "$capability_path"
5578: }

5580: stage_run_cross_network_preflight() {
5581:   local stage_dir report_path
5582:   CROSS_NETWORK_PREFLIGHT_REFERENCE_UNIX="$(date +%s)"
5583:   export CROSS_NETWORK_PREFLIGHT_REFERENCE_UNIX
5584:   run_parallel_node_stage cross_network_preflight cross_network_preflight_worker
5585: 
5586:   stage_dir="$(parallel_stage_dir cross_network_preflight)"
5587:   report_path="$REPORT_DIR/cross_network_preflight_report.json"
5588:   cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops write-cross-network-preflight-report \
5589:     --nodes-tsv "$NODES_TSV" \
5590:     --stage-dir "$stage_dir" \
5591:     --output "$report_path" \
5592:     --reference-unix "$CROSS_NETWORK_PREFLIGHT_REFERENCE_UNIX" \
5593:     --max-clock-skew-secs "$CROSS_NETWORK_MAX_TIME_SKEW_SECS" \
5594:     --discovery-max-age-secs "$CROSS_NETWORK_DISCOVERY_MAX_AGE_SECS" \
5595:     --signed-artifact-max-age-secs "$CROSS_NETWORK_SIGNED_ARTIFACT_MAX_AGE_SECS" >/dev/null
5596: }

5598: stage_run_cross_network_nat_matrix() {
5599:   local output_path="$REPORT_DIR/cross_network_remote_exit_nat_matrix_validation.md"

5608: stage_generate_fresh_install_os_matrix_report() {
5609:   local commit_short role_report canonical_report canonical_source_dir
5610:   local canonical_bootstrap_log canonical_baseline_log canonical_two_hop_report
5611:   local canonical_role_switch_report canonical_lan_toggle_report canonical_exit_handoff_report
5612:   local required_path
5613:   if ! has_five_node_release_gate_topology; then
5614:     printf 'fresh install OS matrix report generation requires the full five-node topology (entry, aux, and extra targets)\n' >&2
5615:     return 1
5616:   fi
5617:   commit_short="$(current_run_git_commit_short)"
5618:   role_report="$REPORT_DIR/role_switch_matrix_report_${commit_short}.json"
5619:   canonical_report="$ROOT_DIR/artifacts/phase10/fresh_install_os_matrix_report.json"
5620:   canonical_source_dir="$ROOT_DIR/artifacts/phase10/source/fresh_install_os_matrix"
5621:   cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops rebind-linux-fresh-install-os-matrix-inputs \
5622:     --dest-dir "$canonical_source_dir" \
5623:     --bootstrap-log "$LOG_DIR/bootstrap_hosts.log" \
5624:     --baseline-log "$LOG_DIR/validate_baseline_runtime.log" \
5625:     --two-hop-report "$REPORT_DIR/live_linux_two_hop_report.json" \
5626:     --role-switch-report "$role_report" \
5627:     --lan-toggle-report "$REPORT_DIR/live_linux_lan_toggle_report.json" \
5628:     --exit-handoff-report "$REPORT_DIR/live_linux_exit_handoff_report.json" >/dev/null || return 1
5629:   canonical_bootstrap_log="$canonical_source_dir/bootstrap_hosts.log"
5630:   canonical_baseline_log="$canonical_source_dir/validate_baseline_runtime.log"
5631:   canonical_two_hop_report="$canonical_source_dir/live_linux_two_hop_report.json"
5632:   canonical_role_switch_report="$canonical_source_dir/$(basename "$role_report")"
5633:   canonical_lan_toggle_report="$canonical_source_dir/live_linux_lan_toggle_report.json"
5634:   canonical_exit_handoff_report="$canonical_source_dir/live_linux_exit_handoff_report.json"
5635:   for required_path in \
5636:     "$canonical_bootstrap_log" \
5637:     "$canonical_baseline_log" \
5638:     "$canonical_two_hop_report" \
5639:     "$canonical_role_switch_report" \
5640:     "$canonical_lan_toggle_report" \
5641:     "$canonical_exit_handoff_report"; do
5642:     if [[ ! -f "$required_path" ]]; then
5643:       printf 'fresh install OS matrix canonicalized input missing: %s\n' "$required_path" >&2
5644:       return 1
5645:     fi
5646:   done
5647:   cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops generate-linux-fresh-install-os-matrix-report \
5648:     --output "$canonical_report" \
5649:     --environment "linux-live-lab-orchestrator:${NETWORK_ID}" \
5650:     --source-mode "$SOURCE_MODE" \
5651:     --expected-git-commit-file "$STATE_DIR/git_head.txt" \
5652:     --git-status-file "$STATE_DIR/git_status.txt" \
5653:     --bootstrap-log "$canonical_bootstrap_log" \
5654:     --baseline-log "$canonical_baseline_log" \
5655:     --two-hop-report "$canonical_two_hop_report" \
5656:     --role-switch-report "$canonical_role_switch_report" \
5657:     --lan-toggle-report "$canonical_lan_toggle_report" \
5658:     --exit-handoff-report "$canonical_exit_handoff_report" \
5659:     --exit-node-id "$(node_id_for_label exit)" \
5660:     --client-node-id "$(node_id_for_label client)" \
5661:     --ubuntu-node-id "$(node_id_for_label entry)" \
5662:     --fedora-node-id "$(node_id_for_label aux)" \
5663:     --mint-node-id "$(node_id_for_label extra)" || return 1
5664:   cp "$canonical_report" "$REPORT_DIR/fresh_install_os_matrix_report.json" || return 1
5665: }
5666: 
5667: ssh_wait_for_host() {
5668:   local target="$1"
5669:   # Freshly restarted UTM guests can take several minutes before SSH is ready.
5670:   # Keep the wait bounded, but long enough to cover a cold boot without
5671:   # treating transient startup lag as a hard failure.
5672:   local attempts="${2:-240}"
5673:   local sleep_secs="${3:-5}"
5674:   local attempt
5675:   local rc
5676:   local last_error=""
5677:   local error_log
5678:   error_log="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/rn-ssh-wait.XXXXXX")" || return 1
5679:   for ((attempt = 1; attempt <= attempts; attempt++)); do
5680:     : > "$error_log"
5681:     if live_lab_can_use_ssh_transport; then
5682:       if live_lab_ssh_via_ssh "$target" "true" 15 >"$error_log" 2>&1; then
5683:         rm -f "$error_log"
5684:         return 0
5685:       fi
5686:       rc=$?
5687:     else
5688:       if live_lab_ssh "$target" "true" 15 >"$error_log" 2>&1; then
5689:         rm -f "$error_log"
5690:         return 0
5691:       fi
5692:       rc=$?
5693:     fi
5694:     last_error="$(cat "$error_log")"
5695:     if [[ "$rc" -ne 255 ]]; then
5696:       if [[ -n "$last_error" ]]; then
5697:         printf '%s\n' "$last_error" >&2
5698:       fi
5699:       rm -f "$error_log"
5700:       return "$rc"
5701:     fi
5702:     if [[ "$attempt" -lt "$attempts" ]]; then
5703:       sleep "$sleep_secs"
5704:     fi
5705:   done
5706:   if [[ -n "$last_error" ]]; then
5707:     printf '%s\n' "$last_error" >&2
5708:   fi
5709:   rm -f "$error_log"
5710:   return 1
5711: }
5712: 
5713: capture_boot_id() {
5714:   local target="$1"
5715:   live_lab_capture "$target" "cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id" | tr -d '[:space:]'
5716: }
5717: 
5718: capture_boot_id_with_retry() {
5719:   local target="$1"
5720:   local attempts="${2:-24}"
5721:   local sleep_secs="${3:-2}"
5722:   local attempt boot_id
5723:   for ((attempt = 1; attempt <= attempts; attempt++)); do
5724:     boot_id="$(capture_boot_id "$target" || true)"
5725:     if [[ "$boot_id" =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]]; then
5726:       printf '%s' "$boot_id"
5727:       return 0
5728:     fi
5729:     sleep "$sleep_secs"
5730:   done
5731:   return 1
5732: }
5733: 
5734: run_host_reboot() {
5735:   local target="$1"
5736:   live_lab_push_sudo_password "$target"
5737:   live_lab_ssh "$target" "sudo -n systemctl reboot" 20 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
5738: }
