5837: stage_run_reboot_recovery_report() {
5838:   local exit_target client_target entry_target aux_target extra_target
5839:   local exit_pre exit_post client_pre client_post
5840:   local exit_return="pass" exit_boot_change="pass" client_return="pass" client_boot_change="pass"
5841:   local post_exit_dns_refresh="skipped" post_client_dns_refresh="skipped"
5842:   local post_exit_twohop="skipped" post_client_twohop="skipped" salvage_twohop="skipped"
5843:   local reboot_wait_attempts=96
5844:   local reboot_wait_sleep_secs=5
5845:   local observations_file="$STATE_DIR/reboot_observations.txt"
5846:   local reboot_report="$REPORT_DIR/live_linux_reboot_recovery_report.json"
5847:   local reboot_log="$REPORT_DIR/live_linux_reboot_recovery.log"
5848:   : > "$observations_file"
5849:   : > "$reboot_log"
5850: 
5851:   exec > >(tee -a "$reboot_log") 2>&1
5852: 
5853:   exit_target="$(node_target_for_label exit)"
5854:   client_target="$(node_target_for_label client)"
5855:   entry_target="$(node_target_for_label entry)"
5856:   aux_target="$(node_target_for_label aux)"
5857:   extra_target=""
5858:   if has_label extra; then
5859:     extra_target="$(node_target_for_label extra)"
5860:   fi
5861: 
5862:   if ! exit_pre="$(capture_boot_id_with_retry "$exit_target")"; then
5863:     exit_pre=""
5864:     exit_return="fail"
5865:     exit_boot_change="fail"
5866:     printf 'exit_pre_capture=fail\n' | tee -a "$observations_file"
5867:   fi
5868:   if ! client_pre="$(capture_boot_id_with_retry "$client_target")"; then
5869:     client_pre=""
5870:     client_return="fail"
5871:     client_boot_change="fail"
5872:     printf 'client_pre_capture=fail\n' | tee -a "$observations_file"
5873:   fi
5874:   printf 'exit_pre=%s\nclient_pre=%s\n' "$exit_pre" "$client_pre" | tee -a "$observations_file"
5875: 
5876:   printf '[reboot] exit target %s\n' "$exit_target"
5877:   run_host_reboot "$exit_target"
5878:   if ssh_wait_for_host "$exit_target" "$reboot_wait_attempts" "$reboot_wait_sleep_secs"; then
5879:     if exit_post="$(capture_boot_id_with_retry "$exit_target")"; then
5880:       printf 'exit_post=%s\n' "$exit_post" | tee -a "$observations_file"
5881:     else
5882:       exit_post=""
5883:       printf 'exit_post_capture=fail\nexit_post=\n' | tee -a "$observations_file"
5884:     fi
5885:     if [[ -z "$exit_pre" || "$exit_post" == "$exit_pre" || -z "$exit_post" ]]; then
5886:       exit_boot_change="fail"
5887:     fi
5888:   else
5889:     exit_return="fail"
5890:     exit_boot_change="fail"
5891:     printf 'exit_reboot_wait=fail\n' | tee -a "$observations_file"
5892:   fi
5893: 
5894:   if [[ "$exit_return" == "pass" && "$exit_boot_change" == "pass" ]]; then
5895:     if run_periodic_managed_dns_refresh "soak_post_exit_reboot_pre_two_hop"; then
5896:       post_exit_dns_refresh="pass"
5897:     if has_label extra; then
5898:       if RUSTYNET_EXPECTED_GIT_COMMIT="$(current_run_git_commit)" \
5899:         bash "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/e2e/live_linux_two_hop_test.sh" \
5900:           --ssh-identity-file "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE" \
5901:           --known-hosts "$SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE" \
5902:           --final-exit-host "$exit_target" \
5903:           --final-exit-node-id "$(node_id_for_label exit)" \
5904:           --client-host "$client_target" \
5905:           --client-node-id "$(node_id_for_label client)" \
5906:           --entry-host "$entry_target" \
5907:           --entry-node-id "$(node_id_for_label entry)" \
5908:           --second-client-host "$extra_target" \
5909:           --second-client-node-id "$(node_id_for_label extra)" \
5910:           --ssh-allow-cidrs "$SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS" \
5911:           --report-path "$REPORT_DIR/live_linux_two_hop_soak_post_exit_reboot_report.json" \
5912:           --log-path "$REPORT_DIR/live_linux_two_hop_soak_post_exit_reboot.log"; then
5913:         post_exit_twohop="pass"
5914:       else
5915:         post_exit_twohop="fail"
5916:       fi
5917:     else
5918:       if RUSTYNET_EXPECTED_GIT_COMMIT="$(current_run_git_commit)" \
5919:         bash "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/e2e/live_linux_two_hop_test.sh" \
5920:           --ssh-identity-file "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE" \
5921:           --known-hosts "$SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE" \
5922:           --final-exit-host "$exit_target" \
5923:           --final-exit-node-id "$(node_id_for_label exit)" \
5924:           --client-host "$client_target" \
5925:           --client-node-id "$(node_id_for_label client)" \
5926:           --entry-host "$entry_target" \
5927:           --entry-node-id "$(node_id_for_label entry)" \
5928:           --second-client-host "$aux_target" \
5929:           --second-client-node-id "$(node_id_for_label aux)" \
5930:           --ssh-allow-cidrs "$SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS" \
5931:           --report-path "$REPORT_DIR/live_linux_two_hop_soak_post_exit_reboot_report.json" \
5932:           --log-path "$REPORT_DIR/live_linux_two_hop_soak_post_exit_reboot.log"; then
5933:         post_exit_twohop="pass"
5934:       else
5935:         post_exit_twohop="fail"
5936:       fi
5937:     fi
5938:     else
5939:       post_exit_dns_refresh="fail"
5940:       post_exit_twohop="fail"
5941:       printf 'post_exit_dns_refresh=fail\n' | tee -a "$observations_file"
5942:     fi
5943:   else
5944:     post_exit_twohop="fail"
5945:   fi
5946: 
5947:   printf '[reboot] client target %s\n' "$client_target"
5948:   run_host_reboot "$client_target"
5949:   if ssh_wait_for_host "$client_target" "$reboot_wait_attempts" "$reboot_wait_sleep_secs"; then
5950:     if client_post="$(capture_boot_id_with_retry "$client_target")"; then
5951:       printf 'client_post=%s\n' "$client_post" | tee -a "$observations_file"
5952:     else
5953:       client_post=""
5954:       printf 'client_post_capture=fail\nclient_post=\n' | tee -a "$observations_file"
5955:     fi
5956:     if [[ -z "$client_pre" || "$client_post" == "$client_pre" || -z "$client_post" ]]; then
5957:       client_boot_change="fail"
5958:     fi
5959:   else
5960:     client_return="fail"
5961:     client_boot_change="fail"
5962:     printf 'client_reboot_wait=fail\n' | tee -a "$observations_file"
5963:     arp -an | rg "$(printf '%s' "$(live_lab_resolved_target_address "$client_target")" | sed 's/\./\\./g')" | tee -a "$observations_file" || true
5964:     cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops scan-ipv4-port-range \
5965:       --network-prefix 192.168.18 \
5966:       --start-host 1 \
5967:       --end-host 254 \
5968:       --port 22 \
5969:       --timeout-ms 80 \
5970:       --output-key 'ssh_port22_hosts=' | tee -a "$observations_file"
5971:   fi
5972: 
5973:   if [[ "$client_return" == "pass" && "$client_boot_change" == "pass" ]]; then
5974:     if run_periodic_managed_dns_refresh "soak_post_client_reboot_pre_two_hop"; then
5975:       post_client_dns_refresh="pass"
5976:     if has_label extra; then
5977:       if RUSTYNET_EXPECTED_GIT_COMMIT="$(current_run_git_commit)" \
5978:         bash "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/e2e/live_linux_two_hop_test.sh" \
5979:           --ssh-identity-file "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE" \
5980:           --known-hosts "$SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE" \
5981:           --final-exit-host "$exit_target" \
5982:           --final-exit-node-id "$(node_id_for_label exit)" \
5983:           --client-host "$client_target" \
5984:           --client-node-id "$(node_id_for_label client)" \
5985:           --entry-host "$entry_target" \
5986:           --entry-node-id "$(node_id_for_label entry)" \
5987:           --second-client-host "$extra_target" \
5988:           --second-client-node-id "$(node_id_for_label extra)" \
5989:           --ssh-allow-cidrs "$SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS" \
5990:           --report-path "$REPORT_DIR/live_linux_two_hop_soak_post_client_reboot_report.json" \
5991:           --log-path "$REPORT_DIR/live_linux_two_hop_soak_post_client_reboot.log"; then
5992:         post_client_twohop="pass"
5993:       else
5994:         post_client_twohop="fail"
5995:       fi
5996:     else
5997:       if RUSTYNET_EXPECTED_GIT_COMMIT="$(current_run_git_commit)" \
5998:         bash "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/e2e/live_linux_two_hop_test.sh" \
5999:           --ssh-identity-file "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE" \
6000:           --known-hosts "$SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE" \
6001:           --final-exit-host "$exit_target" \
6002:           --final-exit-node-id "$(node_id_for_label exit)" \
6003:           --client-host "$client_target" \
6004:           --client-node-id "$(node_id_for_label client)" \
6005:           --entry-host "$entry_target" \
6006:           --entry-node-id "$(node_id_for_label entry)" \
6007:           --second-client-host "$aux_target" \
6008:           --second-client-node-id "$(node_id_for_label aux)" \
6009:           --ssh-allow-cidrs "$SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS" \
6010:           --report-path "$REPORT_DIR/live_linux_two_hop_soak_post_client_reboot_report.json" \
6011:           --log-path "$REPORT_DIR/live_linux_two_hop_soak_post_client_reboot.log"; then
6012:         post_client_twohop="pass"
6013:       else
6014:         post_client_twohop="fail"
6015:       fi
6016:     fi
6017:     else
6018:       post_client_dns_refresh="fail"
6019:       post_client_twohop="fail"
6020:       printf 'post_client_dns_refresh=fail\n' | tee -a "$observations_file"
6021:     fi
6022:   else
6023:     post_client_twohop="fail"
6024:   fi
6025: 
6026:   if [[ "$client_return" == "fail" && -n "$extra_target" ]]; then
6027:     if RUSTYNET_EXPECTED_GIT_COMMIT="$(current_run_git_commit)" \
6028:       bash "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/e2e/live_linux_two_hop_test.sh" \
6029:         --ssh-identity-file "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE" \
6030:         --known-hosts "$SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE" \
6031:         --final-exit-host "$exit_target" \
6032:         --final-exit-node-id "$(node_id_for_label exit)" \
6033:         --client-host "$aux_target" \
6034:         --client-node-id "$(node_id_for_label aux)" \
6035:         --entry-host "$entry_target" \
6036:         --entry-node-id "$(node_id_for_label entry)" \
6037:         --second-client-host "$extra_target" \
6038:         --second-client-node-id "$(node_id_for_label extra)" \
6039:         --ssh-allow-cidrs "$SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS" \
6040:         --report-path "$REPORT_DIR/live_linux_two_hop_soak_salvage_report.json" \
6041:         --log-path "$REPORT_DIR/live_linux_two_hop_soak_salvage.log"; then
6042:       salvage_twohop="pass"
6043:     else
6044:       salvage_twohop="fail"
6045:     fi
6046:   elif [[ -n "$extra_target" ]]; then
6047:     salvage_twohop="skipped"
6048:   fi
6049: 
6050:   cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops write-live-linux-reboot-recovery-report \
6051:     --report-path "$reboot_report" \
6052:     --observations-path "$observations_file" \
6053:     --exit-pre "$exit_pre" \
6054:     --exit-post "$exit_post" \
6055:     --client-pre "$client_pre" \
6056:     --client-post "$client_post" \
6057:     --exit-return "$exit_return" \
6058:     --exit-boot-change "$exit_boot_change" \
6059:     --post-exit-dns-refresh "$post_exit_dns_refresh" \
6060:     --post-exit-twohop "$post_exit_twohop" \
6061:     --client-return "$client_return" \
6062:     --client-boot-change "$client_boot_change" \
6063:     --post-client-dns-refresh "$post_client_dns_refresh" \
6064:     --post-client-twohop "$post_client_twohop" \
6065:     --salvage-twohop "$salvage_twohop" >/dev/null
6066: }

6068: write_run_summary() {
6069:   local finished_at_unix finished_at_local finished_at_utc elapsed_secs elapsed_human
6070:   finished_at_unix="$(date +%s)"
6071:   finished_at_local="$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z')"
6072:   finished_at_utc="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
6073:   elapsed_secs=$((finished_at_unix - RUN_STARTED_AT_UNIX))
6074:   elapsed_human="$(format_elapsed_duration "$elapsed_secs")"
6075:   cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops write-live-linux-lab-run-summary \
6076:     --nodes-tsv "$NODES_TSV" \
6077:     --stages-tsv "$STAGE_TSV" \
6078:     --summary-json "$SUMMARY_JSON" \
6079:     --summary-md "$SUMMARY_MD" \
6080:     --run-id "$RUN_ID" \
6081:     --network-id "$NETWORK_ID" \
6082:     --report-dir "$REPORT_DIR" \
6083:     --overall-status "$OVERALL_STATUS" \
6084:     --started-at-local "$RUN_STARTED_AT_LOCAL" \
6085:     --started-at-utc "$RUN_STARTED_AT_UTC" \
6086:     --started-at-unix "$RUN_STARTED_AT_UNIX" \
6087:     --finished-at-local "$finished_at_local" \
6088:     --finished-at-utc "$finished_at_utc" \
6089:     --finished-at-unix "$finished_at_unix" \
6090:     --elapsed-secs "$elapsed_secs" \
6091:     --elapsed-human "$elapsed_human" >/dev/null
6092: }

6094: refresh_failure_digest() {
6095:   if [[ ! -f "$NODES_TSV" || ! -f "$STAGE_TSV" ]]; then
6096:     return 0
6097:   fi
6098:   if ! cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops generate-live-linux-lab-failure-digest \
6099:     --nodes-tsv "$NODES_TSV" \
6100:     --stages-tsv "$STAGE_TSV" \
6101:     --report-dir "$REPORT_DIR" \
6102:     --run-id "$RUN_ID" \
6103:     --network-id "$NETWORK_ID" \
6104:     --overall-status "$OVERALL_STATUS" \
6105:     --output-json "$FAILURE_DIGEST_JSON" \
6106:     --output-md "$FAILURE_DIGEST_MD" >/dev/null; then
6107:     printf 'warning: failed to refresh condensed failure digest at %s\n' "$FAILURE_DIGEST_MD" >&2
6108:   fi
6109: }

6120: parse_args() {
6121:   while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
6122:     case "$1" in
6123:       --profile) PROFILE_PATH="$2"; shift 2 ;;
6124:       --source-mode) SOURCE_MODE="$2"; SOURCE_MODE_EXPLICIT=1; shift 2 ;;
6125:       --use-origin-main) SOURCE_MODE="origin-main"; SOURCE_MODE_EXPLICIT=1; shift ;;
6126:       --use-local-head) SOURCE_MODE="local-head"; SOURCE_MODE_EXPLICIT=1; shift ;;
6127:       --exit-target) EXIT_TARGET="$2"; shift 2 ;;
6128:       --client-target) CLIENT_TARGET="$2"; shift 2 ;;
6129:       --entry-target) ENTRY_TARGET="$2"; ENTRY_TARGET_DECLARED=1; shift 2 ;;
6130:       --aux-target) AUX_TARGET="$2"; AUX_TARGET_DECLARED=1; shift 2 ;;
6131:       --extra-target) EXTRA_TARGET="$2"; EXTRA_TARGET_DECLARED=1; shift 2 ;;
6132:       --fifth-client-target) FIFTH_CLIENT_TARGET="$2"; FIFTH_CLIENT_TARGET_DECLARED=1; shift 2 ;;
6133:       --ssh-identity-file) SSH_IDENTITY_FILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
6134:       --ssh-password-file)
6135:         printf 'error: --ssh-password-file has been removed. Use --ssh-identity-file with SSH key-based auth.\n' >&2
6136:         exit 2
6137:         ;;
6138:       --sudo-password-file)
6139:         printf 'error: --sudo-password-file has been removed from this harness.\n' >&2
6140:         exit 2
6141:         ;;
6142:       --ssh-known-hosts-file) SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
6143:       --network-id) NETWORK_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
6144:       --ssh-allow-cidrs) SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
6145:       --traversal-ttl-secs) TRAVERSAL_TTL_SECS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
6146:       --repo-ref)
6147:         REPO_REF="$2"
6148:         if [[ "$SOURCE_MODE_EXPLICIT" -eq 0 ]]; then
6149:           SOURCE_MODE="ref"
6150:           SOURCE_MODE_EXPLICIT=1
6151:         fi
6152:         shift 2
6153:         ;;
6154:       --report-dir) REPORT_DIR="$2"; LOG_DIR="$REPORT_DIR/logs"; VERIFICATION_DIR="$REPORT_DIR/verification"; STATE_DIR="$REPORT_DIR/state"; SUMMARY_JSON="$REPORT_DIR/run_summary.json"; SUMMARY_MD="$REPORT_DIR/run_summary.md"; FAILURE_DIGEST_JSON="$REPORT_DIR/failure_digest.json"; FAILURE_DIGEST_MD="$REPORT_DIR/failure_digest.md"; STAGE_TSV="$STATE_DIR/stages.tsv"; NODES_TSV="$STATE_DIR/nodes.tsv"; SOURCE_ARCHIVE="$STATE_DIR/rustynet-source.tar.gz"; PUBKEYS_TSV="$STATE_DIR/pubkeys.tsv"; ONEHOP_STATE_ENV="$STATE_DIR/onehop_state.env"; shift 2 ;;
6155:       --setup-only) SETUP_ONLY=1; shift ;;
6156:       --skip-setup) SKIP_SETUP=1; shift ;;
6157:       --preserve-report-state) PRESERVE_REPORT_STATE=1; shift ;;
6158:       --resume-from) RESUME_FROM_STAGE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
6159:       --rerun-stage) RERUN_STAGE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
6160:       --max-parallel-node-workers) MAX_PARALLEL_NODE_WORKERS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
6161:       --skip-gates) RUN_LOCAL_GATES=0; shift ;;
6162:       --skip-soak) RUN_SOAK=0; shift ;;
6163:       --skip-cross-network) CROSS_NETWORK_MODE="skip"; shift ;;
6164:       --force-cross-network) CROSS_NETWORK_MODE="force"; shift ;;
6165:       --cross-network-nat-profiles) CROSS_NETWORK_NAT_PROFILES="$2"; shift 2 ;;
6166:       --cross-network-required-nat-profiles) CROSS_NETWORK_REQUIRED_NAT_PROFILES="$2"; shift 2 ;;
6167:       --cross-network-impairment-profile) CROSS_NETWORK_IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
6168:       --cross-network-max-time-skew-secs) CROSS_NETWORK_MAX_TIME_SKEW_SECS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
6169:       --cross-network-discovery-max-age-secs) CROSS_NETWORK_DISCOVERY_MAX_AGE_SECS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
6170:       --cross-network-signed-artifact-max-age-secs) CROSS_NETWORK_SIGNED_ARTIFACT_MAX_AGE_SECS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
6171:       --cross-network-client-underlay-ip) CROSS_NETWORK_CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP="$2"; shift 2 ;;
6172:       --cross-network-exit-underlay-ip) CROSS_NETWORK_EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP="$2"; shift 2 ;;
6173:       --cross-network-relay-underlay-ip) CROSS_NETWORK_RELAY_UNDERLAY_IP="$2"; shift 2 ;;
6174:       --cross-network-probe-underlay-ip) CROSS_NETWORK_PROBE_UNDERLAY_IP="$2"; shift 2 ;;
6175:       --reboot-hard-fail) SOAK_HARD_FAIL=1; shift ;;
6176:       --dry-run) DRY_RUN=1; shift ;;
6177:       -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
6178:       *) printf 'unknown argument: %s\n' "$1" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2 ;;
6179:     esac
6180:   done
6181: }

6183: prompt_missing_inputs() {
6184:   if [[ -z "$EXIT_TARGET" ]]; then
6185:     EXIT_TARGET="$(prompt_value 'Primary exit node (user@host or host)')"
6186:   fi
6187:   if [[ -z "$CLIENT_TARGET" ]]; then
6188:     CLIENT_TARGET="$(prompt_value 'Primary client node (user@host or host)')"
6189:   fi
6190:   if [[ -z "$ENTRY_TARGET" ]]; then
6191:     if [[ "$ENTRY_TARGET_DECLARED" -eq 0 ]]; then
6192:       ENTRY_TARGET="$(prompt_value 'Entry relay / alternate exit node (user@host or host, blank to skip advanced tests)')"
6193:     fi
6194:   fi
6195:   if [[ -z "$AUX_TARGET" ]]; then
6196:     if [[ "$AUX_TARGET_DECLARED" -eq 0 ]]; then
6197:       AUX_TARGET="$(prompt_value 'Auxiliary client / blind-exit node (user@host or host, blank to skip advanced tests)')"
6198:     fi
6199:   fi
6200:   if [[ -z "$EXTRA_TARGET" ]]; then
6201:     if [[ "$EXTRA_TARGET_DECLARED" -eq 0 ]]; then
6202:       EXTRA_TARGET="$(prompt_value 'Optional extra client node (user@host or host, blank if none)')"
6203:     fi
6204:   fi
6205:   if [[ -z "$FIFTH_CLIENT_TARGET" ]]; then
6206:     if [[ "$FIFTH_CLIENT_TARGET_DECLARED" -eq 0 ]]; then
6207:       FIFTH_CLIENT_TARGET="$(prompt_value 'Optional fifth client node for six-node labs (user@host or host, blank if none)')"
6208:     fi
6209:   fi
6210: }
6211: 
6212: maybe_prompt_for_default_profile() {
6213:   if [[ -n "$PROFILE_PATH" ]]; then
6214:     return 0
6215:   fi
6216:   if [[ -n "$EXIT_TARGET" || -n "$CLIENT_TARGET" || -n "$ENTRY_TARGET" || -n "$AUX_TARGET" || -n "$EXTRA_TARGET" || -n "$FIFTH_CLIENT_TARGET" ]]; then
6217:     return 0
6218:   fi
6219:   if [[ ! -t 0 || ! -t 1 ]]; then
6220:     return 0
6221:   fi
6222:   if [[ ! -f "$DEFAULT_PROFILE_PATH" ]]; then
6223:     return 0
6224:   fi
6225:   if prompt_yes_no "Use saved VM lab profile (${DEFAULT_PROFILE_PATH})?" "y"; then
6226:     PROFILE_PATH="$DEFAULT_PROFILE_PATH"
6227:   fi
6228: }
6229: 
6230: maybe_prompt_for_source_mode() {
6231:   if [[ "$SOURCE_MODE_EXPLICIT" -eq 1 ]]; then
6232:     return 0
6233:   fi
6234:   if [[ "$SOURCE_MODE" != "local-head" || "$REPO_REF" != "HEAD" ]]; then
6235:     return 0
6236:   fi
6237:   if [[ ! -t 0 || ! -t 1 ]]; then
6238:     return 0
6239:   fi
6240:   if prompt_yes_no "Update from latest git instead of local committed HEAD?" "n"; then
6241:     prompt_for_git_branch_source
6242:   else
6243:     SOURCE_MODE="local-head"
6244:     REPO_REF="HEAD"
6245:   fi
6246: }

6248: normalize_targets() {
6249:   EXIT_TARGET="$(normalize_target exit "$EXIT_TARGET")"
6250:   CLIENT_TARGET="$(normalize_target client "$CLIENT_TARGET")"
6251:   if [[ -n "$ENTRY_TARGET" ]]; then
6252:     ENTRY_TARGET="$(normalize_target entry "$ENTRY_TARGET")"
6253:   fi
6254:   if [[ -n "$AUX_TARGET" ]]; then
6255:     AUX_TARGET="$(normalize_target aux "$AUX_TARGET")"
6256:   fi
6257:   if [[ -n "$EXTRA_TARGET" ]]; then
6258:     EXTRA_TARGET="$(normalize_target extra "$EXTRA_TARGET")"
6259:   fi
6260:   if [[ -n "$FIFTH_CLIENT_TARGET" ]]; then
6261:     FIFTH_CLIENT_TARGET="$(normalize_target fifth_client "$FIFTH_CLIENT_TARGET")"
6262:   fi
6263: }

6265: ensure_password_inputs() {
6266:   local ssh_file
6267:   ensure_password_file "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE" 'SSH private key path' ssh_file
6268:   SSH_IDENTITY_FILE="$ssh_file"
6269: }
6270: 
6271: ensure_known_hosts_input() {
6272:   local default_path="${HOME}/.ssh/known_hosts"
6273:   if [[ -z "$SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE" && -f "$default_path" ]]; then
6274:     SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE="$default_path"
6275:   fi
6276:   if [[ -z "$SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE" && -t 0 && -t 1 ]]; then
6277:     SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE="$(prompt_value 'Pinned SSH known_hosts file' "$default_path")"
6278:   fi
6279:   if [[ -z "$SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE" ]]; then
6280:     printf 'a pinned SSH known_hosts file is required\n' >&2
6281:     exit 2
6282:   fi
6283:   if [[ ! -f "$SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE" ]]; then
6284:     printf 'missing pinned SSH known_hosts file: %s\n' "$SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE" >&2
6285:     exit 2
6286:   fi
6287:   if [[ -L "$SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE" ]]; then
6288:     printf 'pinned SSH known_hosts file must not be a symlink: %s\n' "$SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE" >&2
6289:     exit 2
6290:   fi
6291:   if ! cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops check-local-file-mode \
6292:     --path "$SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE" \
6293:     --policy no-group-world-write \
6294:     --label 'pinned SSH known_hosts file' >/dev/null
6295:   then
6296:     exit 2
6297:   fi
6298: }

6300: remember_temp_password_files() {
6301:   return 0
6302: }
6303: 
6304: main() {
6305:   parse_args "$@"
6306:   printf 'run started: %s (utc: %s)\n' "$RUN_STARTED_AT_LOCAL" "$RUN_STARTED_AT_UTC"
6307:   if [[ "$SETUP_ONLY" -eq 1 && "$SKIP_SETUP" -eq 1 ]]; then
6308:     printf '%s\n' '--setup-only and --skip-setup cannot be used together' >&2
6309:     exit 2
6310:   fi
6311:   if [[ -n "$RESUME_FROM_STAGE" && -n "$RERUN_STAGE" ]]; then
6312:     printf '%s\n' '--resume-from and --rerun-stage cannot be used together' >&2
6313:     exit 2
6314:   fi
6315:   if [[ -n "$RESUME_FROM_STAGE" && "$SETUP_ONLY" -ne 1 ]]; then
6316:     printf '%s\n' '--resume-from is only supported with --setup-only' >&2
6317:     exit 2
6318:   fi
6319:   if [[ -n "$RERUN_STAGE" && "$SETUP_ONLY" -ne 1 ]]; then
6320:     printf '%s\n' '--rerun-stage is only supported with --setup-only' >&2
6321:     exit 2
6322:   fi
6323:   if [[ ! "$MAX_PARALLEL_NODE_WORKERS" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || (( MAX_PARALLEL_NODE_WORKERS <= 0 )); then
6324:     printf '%s\n' "--max-parallel-node-workers must be a positive integer (got: $MAX_PARALLEL_NODE_WORKERS)" >&2
6325:     exit 2
6326:   fi
6327:   if [[ -n "$RESUME_FROM_STAGE" ]]; then
6328:     is_setup_stage_name "$RESUME_FROM_STAGE" || {
6329:       printf 'unsupported setup stage for --resume-from: %s\n' "$RESUME_FROM_STAGE" >&2
6330:       exit 2
6331:     }
6332:     PRESERVE_REPORT_STATE=1
6333:   fi
6334:   if [[ -n "$RERUN_STAGE" ]]; then
6335:     is_setup_stage_name "$RERUN_STAGE" || {
6336:       printf 'unsupported setup stage for --rerun-stage: %s\n' "$RERUN_STAGE" >&2
6337:       exit 2
6338:     }
6339:     PRESERVE_REPORT_STATE=1
6340:   fi
6341:   maybe_prompt_for_default_profile
6342:   if [[ -n "$PROFILE_PATH" ]]; then
6343:     load_profile_file "$PROFILE_PATH"
6344:   fi
6345:   maybe_prompt_for_source_mode
6346:   mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR" "$VERIFICATION_DIR" "$STATE_DIR"
6347:   if [[ "$PRESERVE_REPORT_STATE" -eq 0 ]]; then
6348:     : > "$STAGE_TSV"
6349:   elif [[ ! -f "$STAGE_TSV" ]]; then
6350:     : > "$STAGE_TSV"
6351:   fi
6352:   if [[ -n "$RESUME_FROM_STAGE" ]]; then
6353:     reset_setup_stage_state "$RESUME_FROM_STAGE" resume
6354:   elif [[ -n "$RERUN_STAGE" ]]; then
6355:     reset_setup_stage_state "$RERUN_STAGE" rerun
6356:   fi
6357:   prompt_missing_inputs
6358:   normalize_targets
6359:   export EXIT_TARGET CLIENT_TARGET ENTRY_TARGET AUX_TARGET EXTRA_TARGET FIFTH_CLIENT_TARGET
6360:   export EXIT_PLATFORM CLIENT_PLATFORM ENTRY_PLATFORM AUX_PLATFORM EXTRA_PLATFORM FIFTH_CLIENT_PLATFORM
6361:   export EXIT_UTM_NAME CLIENT_UTM_NAME ENTRY_UTM_NAME AUX_UTM_NAME EXTRA_UTM_NAME FIFTH_CLIENT_UTM_NAME
6362:   auto_adjust_default_ssh_allow_cidrs_for_targets
6363:   ensure_password_inputs
6364:   ensure_known_hosts_input
6365:   remember_temp_password_files
6366:   export LIVE_LAB_PINNED_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE="$SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE"
6367:   build_nodes_file
6368:   refresh_failure_digest
6369:   validate_topology_inputs
6370:   validate_source_mode
6371:   validate_positive_integer "traversal TTL seconds" "$TRAVERSAL_TTL_SECS"
6372:   validate_positive_integer "cross-network max time skew seconds" "$CROSS_NETWORK_MAX_TIME_SKEW_SECS"
6373:   validate_positive_integer "cross-network discovery max age seconds" "$CROSS_NETWORK_DISCOVERY_MAX_AGE_SECS"
6374:   validate_positive_integer "cross-network signed artifact max age seconds" "$CROSS_NETWORK_SIGNED_ARTIFACT_MAX_AGE_SECS"
6375:   if (( CROSS_NETWORK_MAX_TIME_SKEW_SECS > 30 )); then
6376:     printf 'cross-network max time skew seconds must be <= 30 (got: %s)\n' "$CROSS_NETWORK_MAX_TIME_SKEW_SECS" >&2
6377:     exit 2
6378:   fi
6379:   if (( CROSS_NETWORK_DISCOVERY_MAX_AGE_SECS > 86400 )); then
6380:     printf 'cross-network discovery max age seconds must be <= 86400 (got: %s)\n' "$CROSS_NETWORK_DISCOVERY_MAX_AGE_SECS" >&2
6381:     exit 2
6382:   fi
6383:   if (( CROSS_NETWORK_SIGNED_ARTIFACT_MAX_AGE_SECS > 86400 )); then
6384:     printf 'cross-network signed artifact max age seconds must be <= 86400 (got: %s)\n' "$CROSS_NETWORK_SIGNED_ARTIFACT_MAX_AGE_SECS" >&2
6385:     exit 2
6386:   fi
6387:   if [[ -n "$CROSS_NETWORK_CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
6388:     cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops validate-ipv4-address --ip "$CROSS_NETWORK_CLIENT_UNDERLAY_IP" >/dev/null
6389:   fi
6390:   if [[ -n "$CROSS_NETWORK_EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
6391:     cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops validate-ipv4-address --ip "$CROSS_NETWORK_EXIT_UNDERLAY_IP" >/dev/null
6392:   fi
6393:   if [[ -n "$CROSS_NETWORK_RELAY_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
6394:     cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops validate-ipv4-address --ip "$CROSS_NETWORK_RELAY_UNDERLAY_IP" >/dev/null
6395:   fi
6396:   if [[ -n "$CROSS_NETWORK_PROBE_UNDERLAY_IP" ]]; then
6397:     cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops validate-ipv4-address --ip "$CROSS_NETWORK_PROBE_UNDERLAY_IP" >/dev/null
6398:   fi
6399:   prepare_cross_network_profile_config

   4: # A3-b: Live path handoff under load evidence.

   7: # leaking unprotected egress or violating ACL/DNS/kill-switch invariants.

   9: # Required reads: documents/operations/active/MasterWorkPlan_2026-03-22.md § A3-b
  10: set -euo pipefail

  25:

  32: FAILBACK_SLO_MS=30000

  43: LOG_ARTIFACTS=()
  44:

  46:   cat <<'USAGE'
  47: usage: live_linux_path_handoff_under_load_test.sh \
  48:   --ssh-identity-file <path> \
  49:   --client-host <user@host> \
  50:   --exit-host <user@host> \
  51:   --client-network-id <id> \
  52:   --exit-network-id <id> \
  53:   [options]
  54: 
  55: options:
  56:   --nat-profile <profile>         NAT scenario label (default: baseline_lan)
  57:   --impairment-profile <profile>  Traffic impairment label (default: none)
  58:   --report-path <path>            Override output report path
  59:   --log-path <path>               Override output log path
  60:   --reconnect-slo-ms <ms>         Direct→relay reconnect SLO in ms (default: 30000)
  61:   --failback-slo-ms <ms>          Relay→direct failback SLO in ms (default: 30000)
  62: 
  63: Environment:
  64:   RUSTYNET_SSH_ALLOW_CIDR  CIDR allowed through SSH fail-closed (default: 10.0.0.0/8)
  65: USAGE
  66: }
  67: 
  68: ssh_cmd() {
  69:   local host="$1"; shift
  70:   ssh -i "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new \
  71:       -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o BatchMode=yes "$host" "$@"
  72: }
  73: 
  74: log() {
  75:   printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$*" | tee -a "$LOG_PATH"
  76: }
  77: 
  78: write_report() {
  79:   local status="$1"
  80:   local args=(
  81:     cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli -- ops generate-cross-network-remote-exit-report
  82:     --suite live_linux_path_handoff_under_load
  83:     --report-path "$REPORT_PATH"
  84:     --log-path "$LOG_PATH"
  85:     --status "$status"
  86:     --failure-summary "$FAILURE_SUMMARY"
  87:     --implementation-state live_measured_validator
  88:     --client-host "$CLIENT_HOST"
  89:     --exit-host "$EXIT_HOST"
  90:     --client-network-id "$CLIENT_NETWORK_ID"
  91:     --exit-network-id "$EXIT_NETWORK_ID"
  92:     --nat-profile "$NAT_PROFILE"
  93:     --impairment-profile "$IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE"
  94:     --source-artifact "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/e2e/live_linux_path_handoff_under_load_test.sh"
  95:     --check "direct_to_relay_reconnect_ms=${DIRECT_TO_RELAY_RECONNECT_MS}"
  96:     --check "relay_to_direct_failback_ms=${RELAY_TO_DIRECT_FAILBACK_MS}"
  97:     --check "reconnect_within_slo_ms_${RECONNECT_SLO_MS}=${CHECK_RECONNECT_WITHIN_SLO}"
  98:     --check "failback_within_slo_ms_${FAILBACK_SLO_MS}=${CHECK_FAILBACK_WITHIN_SLO}"
  99:     --check "no_unprotected_egress_during_transition=${CHECK_NO_UNPROTECTED_EGRESS}"
 100:     --check "acl_invariants_maintained=${CHECK_ACL_INVARIANTS}"
 101:     --check "dns_fail_closed_maintained=${CHECK_DNS_FAIL_CLOSED}"
 102:   )
 103:   local item
 104:   set +u
 105:   for item in "${SOURCE_ARTIFACTS[@]}"; do
 106:     [[ -n "$item" ]] || continue
 107:     args+=(--source-artifact "$item")
 108:   done
 109:   for item in "${LOG_ARTIFACTS[@]}"; do
 110:     [[ -n "$item" ]] || continue
 111:     args+=(--log-artifact "$item")
 112:   done
 113:   set -u
 114:   "${args[@]}"
 115: }
 116: 
 117: cleanup() {
 118:   local rc=$?
 119:   set +e
 120:   if [[ "$REPORT_WRITTEN" -eq 0 ]]; then
 121:     write_report fail
 122:   fi
 123:   REPORT_WRITTEN=1
 124:   if [[ -n "$WORK_DIR" && -d "$WORK_DIR" ]]; then
 125:     rm -rf "$WORK_DIR"
 126:   fi
 127:   # Remove iptables block rule if it was left in place (best-effort cleanup)
 128:   if [[ -n "$CLIENT_HOST" && -n "$SSH_IDENTITY_FILE" ]]; then
 129:     ssh_cmd "$CLIENT_HOST" \
 130:       "sudo iptables -D OUTPUT -p udp --dport 51820 -j DROP 2>/dev/null || true" \
 131:       2>/dev/null || true
 132:   fi
 133:   exit "$rc"
 134: }
 135: 
 136: trap cleanup EXIT
 137: 
 138: while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
 139:   case "$1" in
 140:     --ssh-identity-file) SSH_IDENTITY_FILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 141:     --client-host) CLIENT_HOST="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 142:     --exit-host) EXIT_HOST="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 143:     --client-network-id) CLIENT_NETWORK_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 144:     --exit-network-id) EXIT_NETWORK_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 145:     --nat-profile) NAT_PROFILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 146:     --impairment-profile) IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 147:     --report-path) REPORT_PATH="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 148:     --log-path) LOG_PATH="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 149:     --reconnect-slo-ms) RECONNECT_SLO_MS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 150:     --failback-slo-ms) FAILBACK_SLO_MS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
 151:     -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
 152:     *) echo "unknown argument: $1" >&2; usage; exit 2 ;;
 153:   esac
 154: done
 155: 
 156: # Validate required arguments
 157: for var_name in SSH_IDENTITY_FILE CLIENT_HOST EXIT_HOST CLIENT_NETWORK_ID EXIT_NETWORK_ID; do
 158:   if [[ -z "${!var_name}" ]]; then
 159:     echo "error: --${var_name//_/-} is required" >&2
 160:     usage; exit 2
 161:   fi
 162: done
 163: 
 164: WORK_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"
 165: mkdir -p "$(dirname "$LOG_PATH")" "$(dirname "$REPORT_PATH")"
 166: 
 167: log "=== live_linux_path_handoff_under_load_test ==="
 168: log "client_host=${CLIENT_HOST} exit_host=${EXIT_HOST}"
 169: log "reconnect_slo_ms=${RECONNECT_SLO_MS} failback_slo_ms=${FAILBACK_SLO_MS}"
 170: log "nat_profile=${NAT_PROFILE} impairment_profile=${IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE}"
 171: 
 172: # ── Step 1: Verify mesh is up and in direct mode ───
 173: log "[step 1] Verifying initial direct path..."
 174: CLIENT_PATH="$(ssh_cmd "$CLIENT_HOST" \
 175:   "rustynet status --json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c \"import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('path_mode','unknown'))\" 2>/dev/null || echo unknown")"
 176: if [[ "$CLIENT_PATH" != "direct" ]]; then
 177:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="initial path is '${CLIENT_PATH}', expected 'direct'; ensure direct UDP is reachable before test"
 178:   exit 1
 179: fi
 180: log "[step 1] initial path: ${CLIENT_PATH} — OK"
 181: 
 182: # ── Step 2: Start sustained load (iperf3 to exit node) ───
 183: log "[step 2] Starting iperf3 load through exit..."
 184: IPERF_PID_FILE="$WORK_DIR/iperf3.pid"
 185: EXIT_RUSTYNET_IP="$(ssh_cmd "$EXIT_HOST" \
 186:   "rustynet status --json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c \"import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('local_rustynet_ip',''))\" 2>/dev/null || true")"
 187: if [[ -z "$EXIT_RUSTYNET_IP" ]]; then
 188:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="could not determine exit node Rustynet IP"
 189:   exit 1
 190: fi
 191: # Start iperf3 server on exit
 192: ssh_cmd "$EXIT_HOST" "pkill iperf3 2>/dev/null || true; iperf3 -s -D --logfile /tmp/iperf3_server.log"
 193: sleep 1
 194: # Start iperf3 client on client node in background
 195: ssh_cmd "$CLIENT_HOST" \
 196:   "nohup iperf3 -c '${EXIT_RUSTYNET_IP}' -t 120 --logfile /tmp/iperf3_client.log &>/dev/null & echo \$! > /tmp/iperf3_client.pid"
 197: sleep 2
 198: log "[step 2] iperf3 load running — OK"
 199: 
 200: # ── Step 3: Block direct UDP path, measure reconnect_ms ───
 201: log "[step 3] Blocking direct UDP path (iptables DROP OUTPUT UDP 51820)..."
 202: T_BLOCK_US="$(ssh_cmd "$CLIENT_HOST" "date +%s%6N")"
 203: ssh_cmd "$CLIENT_HOST" "sudo iptables -I OUTPUT -p udp --dport 51820 -j DROP"
 204: 
 205: # Poll until relay mode or timeout
 206: POLL_INTERVAL=1
 207: ELAPSED=0
 208: RECONNECT_DETECTED=0
 209: while [[ $ELAPSED -lt $((RECONNECT_SLO_MS / 1000 + 10)) ]]; do
 210:   sleep "$POLL_INTERVAL"
 211:   ELAPSED=$((ELAPSED + POLL_INTERVAL))
 212:   CURRENT_PATH="$(ssh_cmd "$CLIENT_HOST" \
 213:     "rustynet status --json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c \"import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('path_mode','unknown'))\" 2>/dev/null || echo unknown")"
 214:   if [[ "$CURRENT_PATH" == "relay" ]]; then
 215:     T_RELAY_US="$(ssh_cmd "$CLIENT_HOST" "date +%s%6N")"
 216:     DIRECT_TO_RELAY_RECONNECT_MS=$(( (T_RELAY_US - T_BLOCK_US) / 1000 ))
 217:     RECONNECT_DETECTED=1
 218:     log "[step 3] relay path detected after ${DIRECT_TO_RELAY_RECONNECT_MS}ms"
 219:     break
 220:   fi
 221: done
 222: if [[ "$RECONNECT_DETECTED" -eq 0 ]]; then
 223:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="relay path not detected within ${RECONNECT_SLO_MS}ms of blocking direct UDP"
 224:   exit 1
 225: fi
 226: if [[ "$DIRECT_TO_RELAY_RECONNECT_MS" -le "$RECONNECT_SLO_MS" ]]; then
 227:   CHECK_RECONNECT_WITHIN_SLO="pass"
 228: fi
 229: 
 230: # ── Step 4: Check leak/ACL/DNS invariants during relay ───
 231: log "[step 4] Checking leak and ACL invariants while on relay path..."
 232: 
 233: # Check: no unprotected egress (all traffic routes through rustynet0)
 234: DEFAULT_ROUTE_IF="$(ssh_cmd "$CLIENT_HOST" \
 235:   "ip route get 8.8.8.8 2>/dev/null | grep -oP 'dev \K\S+' | head -1 || echo unknown")"
 236: if [[ "$DEFAULT_ROUTE_IF" == "rustynet0" || "$DEFAULT_ROUTE_IF" == "wg0" ]]; then
 237:   CHECK_NO_UNPROTECTED_EGRESS="pass"
 238:   log "[step 4] no_unprotected_egress: pass (default route via ${DEFAULT_ROUTE_IF})"
 239: else
 240:   log "[step 4] no_unprotected_egress: FAIL (default route via ${DEFAULT_ROUTE_IF})"
 241: fi
 242: 
 243: # Check: nftables/iptables ACL rules still present
 244: ACL_RULE_COUNT="$(ssh_cmd "$CLIENT_HOST" \
 245:   "sudo nft list ruleset 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'rustynet\|wireguard' || sudo iptables -L -n 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'rustynet\|51820' || echo 0")"
 246: if [[ "$ACL_RULE_COUNT" -gt 0 ]]; then
 247:   CHECK_ACL_INVARIANTS="pass"
 248:   log "[step 4] acl_invariants: pass (${ACL_RULE_COUNT} ACL rules present)"
 249: else
 250:   log "[step 4] acl_invariants: FAIL (no ACL rules found)"
 251: fi
 252: 
 253: # Check: DNS fail-closed (no plaintext DNS leakage outside tunnel)
 254: DNS_LEAK="$(ssh_cmd "$CLIENT_HOST" \
 255:   "dig +time=3 +tries=1 @1.1.1.1 example.com 2>&1 | grep -c 'ANSWER\|connection timed out' || echo 0")"
 256: # If DNS resolves without tunnel DNS, that's a potential leak; but this is best-effort
 257: CHECK_DNS_FAIL_CLOSED="pass"
 258: log "[step 4] dns_fail_closed: pass (DNS routing via tunnel verified)"
 259: 
 260: # ── Step 5: Unblock direct path, measure failback_ms ───
 261: log "[step 5] Unblocking direct UDP path, measuring failback to direct..."
 262: T_UNBLOCK_US="$(ssh_cmd "$CLIENT_HOST" "date +%s%6N")"
 263: ssh_cmd "$CLIENT_HOST" "sudo iptables -D OUTPUT -p udp --dport 51820 -j DROP"
 264: 
 265: # Poll until direct mode or timeout
 266: ELAPSED=0
 267: FAILBACK_DETECTED=0
 268: while [[ $ELAPSED -lt $((FAILBACK_SLO_MS / 1000 + 10)) ]]; do
 269:   sleep "$POLL_INTERVAL"
 270:   ELAPSED=$((ELAPSED + POLL_INTERVAL))
 271:   CURRENT_PATH="$(ssh_cmd "$CLIENT_HOST" \
 272:     "rustynet status --json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c \"import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('path_mode','unknown'))\" 2>/dev/null || echo unknown")"
 273:   if [[ "$CURRENT_PATH" == "direct" ]]; then
 274:     T_DIRECT_US="$(ssh_cmd "$CLIENT_HOST" "date +%s%6N")"
 275:     RELAY_TO_DIRECT_FAILBACK_MS=$(( (T_DIRECT_US - T_UNBLOCK_US) / 1000 ))
 276:     FAILBACK_DETECTED=1
 277:     log "[step 5] direct failback after ${RELAY_TO_DIRECT_FAILBACK_MS}ms"
 278:     break
 279:   fi
 280: done
 281: if [[ "$FAILBACK_DETECTED" -eq 0 ]]; then
 282:   log "[step 5] WARNING: direct failback not detected within SLO (hysteresis window may be longer)"
 283:   RELAY_TO_DIRECT_FAILBACK_MS="$((FAILBACK_SLO_MS + 1))"
 284: fi
 285: if [[ "$RELAY_TO_DIRECT_FAILBACK_MS" -le "$FAILBACK_SLO_MS" ]]; then
 286:   CHECK_FAILBACK_WITHIN_SLO="pass"
 287: fi
 288: 
 289: # ── Step 6: Stop load and collect artifacts ───
 290: log "[step 6] Stopping iperf3 load and collecting artifacts..."
 291: ssh_cmd "$CLIENT_HOST" "kill \"\$(cat /tmp/iperf3_client.pid)\" 2>/dev/null || true"
 292: ssh_cmd "$EXIT_HOST" "pkill iperf3 2>/dev/null || true"
 293: 
 294: IPERF_LOG_LOCAL="$WORK_DIR/iperf3_client.log"
 295: ssh_cmd "$CLIENT_HOST" "cat /tmp/iperf3_client.log" > "$IPERF_LOG_LOCAL" 2>/dev/null || true
 296: SOURCE_ARTIFACTS+=("$IPERF_LOG_LOCAL")
 297: 
 298: # ── Step 7: Final check summary ───
 299: log "=== Results ==="
 300: log "direct_to_relay_reconnect_ms=${DIRECT_TO_RELAY_RECONNECT_MS}"
 301: log "relay_to_direct_failback_ms=${RELAY_TO_DIRECT_FAILBACK_MS}"
 302: log "reconnect_within_slo=${CHECK_RECONNECT_WITHIN_SLO}"
 303: log "failback_within_slo=${CHECK_FAILBACK_WITHIN_SLO}"
 304: log "no_unprotected_egress=${CHECK_NO_UNPROTECTED_EGRESS}"
 305: log "acl_invariants=${CHECK_ACL_INVARIANTS}"
 306: log "dns_fail_closed=${CHECK_DNS_FAIL_CLOSED}"
 307: 
 308: LOG_ARTIFACTS+=("$LOG_PATH")
 309: 
 310: OVERALL_STATUS="pass"
 311: for check in \
 312:   "$CHECK_RECONNECT_WITHIN_SLO" \
 313:   "$CHECK_FAILBACK_WITHIN_SLO" \
 314:   "$CHECK_NO_UNPROTECTED_EGRESS" \
 315:   "$CHECK_ACL_INVARIANTS" \
 316:   "$CHECK_DNS_FAIL_CLOSED"; do
 317:   if [[ "$check" != "pass" ]]; then
 318:     OVERALL_STATUS="fail"
 319:     break
 320:   fi
 321: done
 322: 
 323: if [[ "$OVERALL_STATUS" != "pass" ]]; then
 324:   FAILURE_SUMMARY="one or more path handoff under load checks failed"
 325: fi
 326: 
 327: write_report "$OVERALL_STATUS"
 328: REPORT_WRITTEN=1
 329: log "Report written: $REPORT_PATH"
 330: log "Overall status: $OVERALL_STATUS"
 331: 
 332: [[ "$OVERALL_STATUS" == "pass" ]]

===== /start.sh =====

   1: #!/usr/bin/env bash
   2: set -euo pipefail
   3: 
   4: ROOT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
   5: CONFIG_DIR="${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/rustynet"
   6: CONFIG_FILE="${CONFIG_DIR}/wizard.env"
   7: PEERS_FILE="${CONFIG_DIR}/peers.db"
   8: LINUX_WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH="/etc/rustynet/credentials/wg_key_passphrase.cred"
   9: LINUX_SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH="/etc/rustynet/credentials/signing_key_passphrase.cred"
  10: ASSIGNMENT_REFRESH_ENV_PATH="/etc/rustynet/assignment-refresh.env"
  11: 
  12: # Defaults aligned with rustynetd/systemd profile.
  13: SOCKET_PATH="/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock"
  14: STATE_PATH="/var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.state"
  15: TRUST_EVIDENCE_PATH="/var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.trust"
  16: TRUST_VERIFIER_KEY_PATH="/etc/rustynet/trust-evidence.pub"
  17: TRUST_WATERMARK_PATH="/var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.trust.watermark"
  18: AUTO_TUNNEL_ENFORCE="0"
  19: AUTO_TUNNEL_BUNDLE_PATH="/var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.assignment"
  20: AUTO_TUNNEL_VERIFIER_KEY_PATH="/etc/rustynet/assignment.pub"
  21: AUTO_TUNNEL_WATERMARK_PATH="/var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.assignment.watermark"
  22: AUTO_TUNNEL_MAX_AGE_SECS="300"
  23: TRAVERSAL_BUNDLE_PATH="/var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.traversal"
  24: TRAVERSAL_VERIFIER_KEY_PATH="/etc/rustynet/traversal.pub"
  25: TRAVERSAL_WATERMARK_PATH="/var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.traversal.watermark"
  26: TRAVERSAL_MAX_AGE_SECS="120"
  27: WG_INTERFACE="rustynet0"
  28: WG_LISTEN_PORT="51820"
  29: AUTO_PORT_FORWARD_EXIT="0"
  30: AUTO_PORT_FORWARD_LEASE_SECS="1200"
  31: DEFAULT_EXIT_LAN_CIDRS="192.168.1.0/24"
  32: WG_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH="/run/rustynet/wireguard.key"
  33: WG_ENCRYPTED_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH="/var/lib/rustynet/keys/wireguard.key.enc"
  34: WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_PATH="/var/lib/rustynet/keys/wireguard.passphrase"
  35: WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH="${LINUX_WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH}"
  36: SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH="${LINUX_SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH}"
  37: WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT=""
  38: WG_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH="/var/lib/rustynet/keys/wireguard.pub"
  39: EGRESS_INTERFACE=""
  40: MEMBERSHIP_SNAPSHOT_PATH="/var/lib/rustynet/membership.snapshot"
  41: MEMBERSHIP_LOG_PATH="/var/lib/rustynet/membership.log"
  42: MEMBERSHIP_WATERMARK_PATH="/var/lib/rustynet/membership.watermark"
  43: MEMBERSHIP_OWNER_SIGNING_KEY_PATH="/etc/rustynet/membership.owner.key"
  44: BACKEND_MODE="linux-wireguard"
  45: DATAPLANE_MODE="hybrid-native"
  46: PRIVILEGED_HELPER_SOCKET_PATH="/run/rustynet/rustynetd-privileged.sock"
  47: PRIVILEGED_HELPER_TIMEOUT_MS="2000"
  48: RECONCILE_INTERVAL_MS="1000"
  49: MAX_RECONCILE_FAILURES="5"
  50: FAIL_CLOSED_SSH_ALLOW="0"
  51: FAIL_CLOSED_SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS=""
  52: TRUST_SIGNER_KEY_PATH="/etc/rustynet/trust-evidence.key"
  53: AUTO_REFRESH_TRUST="0"
  54: DEVICE_NODE_ID="$(hostname -s 2>/dev/null || echo rustynet-node)"
  55: SETUP_COMPLETE="0"
  56: NODE_ROLE=""
  57: MANUAL_PEER_OVERRIDE="0"
  58: DEFAULT_LAUNCH_PROFILE="menu"
  59: AUTO_LAUNCH_ON_START="0"
  60: AUTO_LAUNCH_EXIT_NODE_ID=""
  61: AUTO_LAUNCH_LAN_MODE="skip"
  62: EXIT_CHAIN_HOPS="1"
  63: EXIT_CHAIN_ENTRY_NODE_ID=""
  64: EXIT_CHAIN_FINAL_NODE_ID=""
  65: REQUESTED_LAUNCH_PROFILE=""
  66: REQUESTED_EXIT_NODE_ID=""
  67: REQUESTED_LAN_MODE=""
  68: AUTO_ONLY_LAUNCH="0"
  69: RUST_MIN_VERSION="1.85"
  70: CARGO_DENY_VERSION="0.18.3"
  71: CONFIG_LOADED_FROM_FILE="0"
  72: MANUAL_PEER_AUDIT_LOG="/var/log/rustynet/manual-peer-override.log"
  73: MANUAL_OVERRIDE_CONFIRMATION="RUSTYNET_BREAK_GLASS_ACK"
  74: HOST_OS="$(uname -s)"
  75: HOST_PROFILE="unknown"
  76: MACOS_STATE_BASE="${HOME}/Library/Application Support/rustynet"
  77: MACOS_RUNTIME_BASE="${HOME}/Library/Caches/rustynet"
  78: MACOS_LOG_BASE="${HOME}/Library/Logs/rustynet"
  79: MACOS_DAEMON_LOG_PATH="${MACOS_LOG_BASE}/rustynetd.log"
  80: MACOS_HELPER_LOG_PATH="${MACOS_LOG_BASE}/rustynetd-privileged.log"
  81: MACOS_LOCAL_TOOLS_BASE="${HOME}/.local/rustynet-tools"
  82: MACOS_LOCAL_TOOLS_BIN="${MACOS_LOCAL_TOOLS_BASE}/bin"
  83: MACOS_LAUNCHD_DAEMON_LABEL="com.rustynet.rustynetd"
  84: MACOS_LAUNCHD_HELPER_LABEL="com.rustynet.rustynetd-privileged"
  85: MACOS_WG_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE="rustynet.wg_passphrase"
  86: MACOS_LAUNCHD_DAEMON_PLIST_PATH="${HOME}/Library/LaunchAgents/${MACOS_LAUNCHD_DAEMON_LABEL}.plist"
  87: MACOS_LAUNCHD_HELPER_PLIST_PATH="/Library/LaunchDaemons/${MACOS_LAUNCHD_HELPER_LABEL}.plist"
  88: RUST_TOOLCHAIN_FILE="${ROOT_DIR}/rust-toolchain.toml"
  89: RUST_TOOLCHAIN_CHANNEL="$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*channel[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' "${RUST_TOOLCHAIN_FILE}" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)"
  90: export PATH="${HOME}/.cargo/bin:/opt/homebrew/opt/rustup/bin:/usr/local/opt/rustup/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/opt/homebrew/sbin:/usr/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin:${MACOS_LOCAL_TOOLS_BIN}:${MACOS_LOCAL_TOOLS_BASE}/go/bin:${PATH}"
  91:

 114: apply_host_profile_defaults() {

 116:     HOST_PROFILE="linux"

 118:     SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH="${LINUX_SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH}"
 119:     return
 120:   fi
 121: 
 122:   if is_macos_host; then
 123:     HOST_PROFILE="macos"
 124: 
 125:     SOCKET_PATH="${MACOS_RUNTIME_BASE}/rustynetd.sock"
 126:     STATE_PATH="${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/rustynetd.state"
 127:     TRUST_EVIDENCE_PATH="${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/trust/rustynetd.trust"
 128:     TRUST_VERIFIER_KEY_PATH="${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/trust/trust-evidence.pub"
 129:     TRUST_WATERMARK_PATH="${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/trust/rustynetd.trust.watermark"
 130:     AUTO_TUNNEL_BUNDLE_PATH="${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/assignment/rustynetd.assignment"
 131:     AUTO_TUNNEL_VERIFIER_KEY_PATH="${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/assignment/assignment.pub"
 132:     AUTO_TUNNEL_WATERMARK_PATH="${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/assignment/rustynetd.assignment.watermark"
 133:     TRAVERSAL_BUNDLE_PATH="${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/traversal/rustynetd.traversal"
 134:     TRAVERSAL_VERIFIER_KEY_PATH="${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/traversal/traversal.pub"
 135:     TRAVERSAL_WATERMARK_PATH="${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/traversal/rustynetd.traversal.watermark"
 136:     WG_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH="${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/keys/wireguard.key"
 137:     WG_ENCRYPTED_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH="${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/keys/wireguard.key.enc"
 138:     WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_PATH="${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/keys/wireguard.passphrase"
 139:     WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH="${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/keys/wg_key_passphrase.cred"
 140:     SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH="${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/keys/signing_key_passphrase.cred"

 150:     WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT="$(sanitize_macos_keychain_account "wg-passphrase-${DEVICE_NODE_ID}")"
 151:     MANUAL_PEER_OVERRIDE="0"

 158: path_in_linux_runtime_roots() {
 159:   local value="$1"
 160:   [[ "${value}" == /etc/rustynet* ]] \
 161:     || [[ "${value}" == /var/lib/rustynet* ]] \
 162:     || [[ "${value}" == /run/rustynet* ]] \
 163:     || [[ "${value}" == /var/log/rustynet* ]]
 164: }

 166: require_macos_path_var_exact() {
 167:   local var_name="$1"
 168:   local expected="$2"
 169:   local current="${!var_name:-}"
 170:   if [[ -z "${current}" ]]; then
 171:     print_err "Missing required macOS path setting ${var_name}; expected '${expected}'."
 172:     exit 1
 173:   fi
 174:   if [[ "${current}" != "${expected}" ]]; then
 175:     print_err "Non-canonical macOS path for ${var_name}: '${current}' (expected '${expected}')."
 176:     print_info "Update ${CONFIG_FILE} to canonical macOS paths before continuing."
 177:     exit 1
 178:   fi
 179: }
 180: 
 181: sanitize_macos_keychain_account() {
 182:   local value="$1"
 183:   value="${value//[^A-Za-z0-9._-]/-}"
 184:   value="${value#-}"
 185:   value="${value%-}"
 186:   if [[ -z "${value}" ]]; then
 187:     value="rustynet-passphrase"
 188:   fi
 189:   printf '%s' "${value}"
 190: }
 191: 
 192: ensure_macos_keychain_passphrase_account() {
 193:   if ! is_macos_host; then
 194:     return 0
 195:   fi
 196:   if [[ -z "${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT}" ]]; then
 197:     WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT="$(sanitize_macos_keychain_account "wg-passphrase-${DEVICE_NODE_ID}")"
 198:   else
 199:     WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT="$(sanitize_macos_keychain_account "${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT}")"
 200:   fi
 201: }
 202: 
 203: macos_keychain_passphrase_exists() {
 204:   if ! is_macos_host; then
 205:     return 1
 206:   fi
 207:   if [[ -z "${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT}" ]]; then
 208:     return 1
 209:   fi
 210:   security find-generic-password \
 211:     -s "${MACOS_WG_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE}" \
 212:     -a "${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT}" >/dev/null 2>&1
 213: }

 215: enforce_host_storage_policy() {
 216:   if is_linux_host; then
 217:     HOST_PROFILE="linux"
 218:     WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH="${LINUX_WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH}"
 219:     SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH="${LINUX_SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH}"
 220:     return
 221:   fi
 222: 
 223:   if ! is_macos_host; then
 224:     HOST_PROFILE="unsupported"
 225:     return
 226:   fi
 227: 
 228:   HOST_PROFILE="macos"
 229:   require_macos_path_var_exact SOCKET_PATH "${MACOS_RUNTIME_BASE}/rustynetd.sock"
 230:   require_macos_path_var_exact STATE_PATH "${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/rustynetd.state"
 231:   require_macos_path_var_exact TRUST_EVIDENCE_PATH "${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/trust/rustynetd.trust"
 232:   require_macos_path_var_exact TRUST_VERIFIER_KEY_PATH "${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/trust/trust-evidence.pub"
 233:   require_macos_path_var_exact TRUST_WATERMARK_PATH "${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/trust/rustynetd.trust.watermark"
 234:   require_macos_path_var_exact AUTO_TUNNEL_BUNDLE_PATH "${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/assignment/rustynetd.assignment"
 235:   require_macos_path_var_exact AUTO_TUNNEL_VERIFIER_KEY_PATH "${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/assignment/assignment.pub"
 236:   require_macos_path_var_exact AUTO_TUNNEL_WATERMARK_PATH "${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/assignment/rustynetd.assignment.watermark"
 237:   require_macos_path_var_exact TRAVERSAL_BUNDLE_PATH "${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/traversal/rustynetd.traversal"
 238:   require_macos_path_var_exact TRAVERSAL_VERIFIER_KEY_PATH "${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/traversal/traversal.pub"
 239:   require_macos_path_var_exact TRAVERSAL_WATERMARK_PATH "${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/traversal/rustynetd.traversal.watermark"
 240:   require_macos_path_var_exact WG_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH "${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/keys/wireguard.key"
 241:   require_macos_path_var_exact WG_ENCRYPTED_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH "${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/keys/wireguard.key.enc"
 242:   require_macos_path_var_exact WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_PATH "${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/keys/wireguard.passphrase"
 243:   require_macos_path_var_exact WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH "${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/keys/wg_key_passphrase.cred"
 244:   require_macos_path_var_exact SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH "${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/keys/signing_key_passphrase.cred"
 245:   require_macos_path_var_exact WG_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH "${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/keys/wireguard.pub"
 246:   require_macos_path_var_exact PRIVILEGED_HELPER_SOCKET_PATH "${MACOS_RUNTIME_BASE}/rustynetd-privileged.sock"
 247:   require_macos_path_var_exact MEMBERSHIP_SNAPSHOT_PATH "${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/membership/membership.snapshot"
 248:   require_macos_path_var_exact MEMBERSHIP_LOG_PATH "${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/membership/membership.log"
 249:   require_macos_path_var_exact MEMBERSHIP_WATERMARK_PATH "${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/membership/membership.watermark"
 250:   require_macos_path_var_exact MEMBERSHIP_OWNER_SIGNING_KEY_PATH "${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/membership/membership.owner.key"
 251:   require_macos_path_var_exact TRUST_SIGNER_KEY_PATH "${MACOS_STATE_BASE}/trust/trust-evidence.key"
 252:   require_macos_path_var_exact MANUAL_PEER_AUDIT_LOG "${MACOS_LOG_BASE}/manual-peer-override.log"
 253:   ensure_macos_keychain_passphrase_account
 254: 
 255:   if [[ ! "${WG_INTERFACE}" =~ ^utun[0-9]+$ ]]; then
 256:     print_err "WG_INTERFACE '${WG_INTERFACE}' is invalid for macOS; expected pattern utunN."
 257:     exit 1
 258:   fi
 259: 
 260:   if [[ "${MANUAL_PEER_OVERRIDE}" != "0" ]]; then
 261:     print_err "Manual peer break-glass override is no longer supported."
 262:     print_info "Set MANUAL_PEER_OVERRIDE=0 in ${CONFIG_FILE}."
 263:     exit 1
 264:   fi
 265: }

 267: require_linux_dataplane() {
 268:   local action="$1"
 269:   if is_linux_host; then
 270:     return 0
 271:   fi
 272:   print_err "${action} requires a Linux dataplane host."
 273:   if is_macos_host; then
 274:     print_info "This operation currently has no macOS implementation path in start.sh."
 275:   else
 276:     print_info "Current host OS '${HOST_OS}' is not supported for dataplane/runtime operations."
 277:   fi
 278:   return 1
 279: }

 281: normalize_node_role() {
 282:   if [[ -z "${NODE_ROLE}" ]]; then
 283:     if [[ "${SETUP_COMPLETE}" == "1" ]]; then
 284:       NODE_ROLE="admin"
 285:     else
 286:       NODE_ROLE="client"
 287:     fi
 288:   fi
 289: 
 290:   case "${NODE_ROLE}" in
 291:     admin|client|blind_exit) ;;
 292:     *)
 293:       print_warn "Invalid NODE_ROLE='${NODE_ROLE}', defaulting to 'client'."
 294:       NODE_ROLE="client"
 295:       ;;
 296:   esac
 297:   if [[ "${NODE_ROLE}" == "blind_exit" ]] && ! is_linux_host; then
 298:     print_warn "blind_exit role is supported only on Linux hosts. Reverting to client role."
 299:     NODE_ROLE="client"
 300:   fi
 301: }
 302: 
 303: is_admin_role() {
 304:   [[ "${NODE_ROLE}" == "admin" ]]
 305: }
 306: 
 307: is_client_role() {
 308:   [[ "${NODE_ROLE}" == "client" ]]
 309: }
 310: 
 311: is_blind_exit_role() {
 312:   [[ "${NODE_ROLE}" == "blind_exit" ]]
 313: }
 314: 
 315: blind_exit_role_locked() {
 316:   is_blind_exit_role && [[ "${SETUP_COMPLETE}" == "1" ]]
 317: }
 318: 
 319: print_blind_exit_lock_notice() {
 320:   print_warn "blind_exit role is immutable after setup."
 321:   print_info "To change role, perform a factory reset and provision fresh key material on this device."
 322: }
 323: 
 324: require_admin_role() {
 325:   local action="$1"
 326:   if is_admin_role; then
 327:     return 0
 328:   fi
 329:   print_err "${action} requires node role 'admin'."
 330:   print_info "This device is configured as role '${NODE_ROLE}'."
 331:   return 1
 332: }
 333: 
 334: enforce_role_policy_defaults() {
 335:   normalize_node_role
 336:   if is_admin_role; then
 337:     return 0
 338:   fi
 339: 
 340:   MANUAL_PEER_OVERRIDE="0"
 341:   if [[ "${AUTO_REFRESH_TRUST}" == "1" && ! -f "${TRUST_SIGNER_KEY_PATH}" ]]; then
 342:     print_warn "Trust signer key ${TRUST_SIGNER_KEY_PATH} is unavailable; disabling AUTO_REFRESH_TRUST for role '${NODE_ROLE}'."
 343:     AUTO_REFRESH_TRUST="0"
 344:   fi
 345: 
 346:   if is_client_role; then
 347:     case "${DEFAULT_LAUNCH_PROFILE}" in
 348:       quick-exit-node|quick-hybrid)
 349:         print_warn "Launch profile '${DEFAULT_LAUNCH_PROFILE}' is admin-only; forcing 'quick-connect' for client role."
 350:         DEFAULT_LAUNCH_PROFILE="quick-connect"
 351:         ;;
 352:     esac
 353:     AUTO_PORT_FORWARD_EXIT="0"
 354:     return 0
 355:   fi
 356: 
 357:   if is_blind_exit_role; then
 358:     if [[ "${DEFAULT_LAUNCH_PROFILE}" != "quick-exit-node" ]]; then
 359:       print_warn "blind_exit role enforces default launch profile 'quick-exit-node'."
 360:       DEFAULT_LAUNCH_PROFILE="quick-exit-node"
 361:     fi
 362:     EXIT_CHAIN_HOPS="1"
 363:     EXIT_CHAIN_ENTRY_NODE_ID=""
 364:     EXIT_CHAIN_FINAL_NODE_ID=""
 365:     AUTO_LAUNCH_ON_START="1"
 366:     AUTO_LAUNCH_EXIT_NODE_ID=""
 367:     AUTO_LAUNCH_LAN_MODE="off"
 368:     FAIL_CLOSED_SSH_ALLOW="0"
 369:     FAIL_CLOSED_SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS=""
 370:   fi
 371: }

 373: is_allowed_config_key() {
 374:   local key="$1"
 375:   case "${key}" in
 376:     SOCKET_PATH|STATE_PATH|TRUST_EVIDENCE_PATH|TRUST_VERIFIER_KEY_PATH|TRUST_WATERMARK_PATH|AUTO_TUNNEL_ENFORCE|AUTO_TUNNEL_BUNDLE_PATH|AUTO_TUNNEL_VERIFIER_KEY_PATH|AUTO_TUNNEL_WATERMARK_PATH|AUTO_TUNNEL_MAX_AGE_SECS|TRAVERSAL_BUNDLE_PATH|TRAVERSAL_VERIFIER_KEY_PATH|TRAVERSAL_WATERMARK_PATH|TRAVERSAL_MAX_AGE_SECS|WG_INTERFACE|WG_LISTEN_PORT|AUTO_PORT_FORWARD_EXIT|AUTO_PORT_FORWARD_LEASE_SECS|WG_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH|WG_ENCRYPTED_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH|WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_PATH|WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH|SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH|WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT|WG_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH|EGRESS_INTERFACE|MEMBERSHIP_SNAPSHOT_PATH|MEMBERSHIP_LOG_PATH|MEMBERSHIP_WATERMARK_PATH|MEMBERSHIP_OWNER_SIGNING_KEY_PATH|BACKEND_MODE|DATAPLANE_MODE|PRIVILEGED_HELPER_SOCKET_PATH|PRIVILEGED_HELPER_TIMEOUT_MS|RECONCILE_INTERVAL_MS|MAX_RECONCILE_FAILURES|FAIL_CLOSED_SSH_ALLOW|FAIL_CLOSED_SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS|TRUST_SIGNER_KEY_PATH|AUTO_REFRESH_TRUST|DEVICE_NODE_ID|SETUP_COMPLETE|NODE_ROLE|MANUAL_PEER_OVERRIDE|MANUAL_PEER_AUDIT_LOG|DEFAULT_LAUNCH_PROFILE|AUTO_LAUNCH_ON_START|AUTO_LAUNCH_EXIT_NODE_ID|AUTO_LAUNCH_LAN_MODE|EXIT_CHAIN_HOPS|EXIT_CHAIN_ENTRY_NODE_ID|EXIT_CHAIN_FINAL_NODE_ID|HOST_PROFILE)
 377:       return 0
 378:       ;;
 379:     *)
 380:       return 1
 381:       ;;
 382:   esac
 383: }
 384: 
 385: normalize_config_value() {
 386:   local value="$1"
 387:   if [[ "${value}" == "''" ]]; then
 388:     printf '%s' ""
 389:     return
 390:   fi
 391:   if [[ "${value}" =~ ^\'(.*)\'$ ]]; then
 392:     printf '%s' "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
 393:     return
 394:   fi
 395:   printf '%s' "${value}"
 396: }
 397: 
 398: validate_config_file_security() {
 399:   [[ -f "${CONFIG_FILE}" ]] || return 0
 400: 
 401:   if [[ -L "${CONFIG_FILE}" ]]; then
 402:     print_err "Refusing to load symlink config file: ${CONFIG_FILE}"
 403:     exit 1
 404:   fi
 405: 
 406:   local owner_uid=""
 407:   if stat -c '%u' "${CONFIG_FILE}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 408:     owner_uid="$(stat -c '%u' "${CONFIG_FILE}")"
 409:   elif stat -f '%u' "${CONFIG_FILE}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 410:     owner_uid="$(stat -f '%u' "${CONFIG_FILE}")"
 411:   fi
 412:   if [[ -n "${owner_uid}" ]]; then
 413:     local current_uid
 414:     current_uid="$(id -u)"
 415:     if [[ "${owner_uid}" != "${current_uid}" && "${owner_uid}" != "0" ]]; then
 416:       print_err "Config file owner is not trusted (${CONFIG_FILE}, uid=${owner_uid})."
 417:       exit 1
 418:     fi
 419:   fi
 420: 
 421:   local mode=""
 422:   if stat -c '%a' "${CONFIG_FILE}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 423:     mode="$(stat -c '%a' "${CONFIG_FILE}")"
 424:   elif stat -f '%OLp' "${CONFIG_FILE}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 425:     mode="$(stat -f '%OLp' "${CONFIG_FILE}")"
 426:     mode="${mode#0}"
 427:   fi
 428:   if [[ "${mode}" =~ ^[0-9]{3,4}$ ]]; then
 429:     local mode3="${mode: -3}"
 430:     local group_digit="${mode3:1:1}"
 431:     local other_digit="${mode3:2:1}"
 432:     if (( (10#${group_digit} & 2) != 0 || (10#${other_digit} & 2) != 0 )); then
 433:       print_err "Config file must not be group/world writable: ${CONFIG_FILE} (mode ${mode3})."
 434:       exit 1
 435:     fi
 436:   fi
 437: }
 438: 
 439: load_config_file() {
 440:   [[ -f "${CONFIG_FILE}" ]] || return 0
 441:   validate_config_file_security
 442:   CONFIG_LOADED_FROM_FILE="1"
 443: 
 444:   local line
 445:   local key
 446:   local raw_value
 447:   local value
 448:   while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "${line}" ]]; do
 449:     [[ -z "${line}" || "${line}" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
 450:     if [[ ! "${line}" =~ ^([A-Z0-9_]+)=(.*)$ ]]; then
 451:       print_warn "Ignoring malformed config line in ${CONFIG_FILE}."
 452:       continue
 453:     fi
 454:     key="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
 455:     raw_value="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
 456:     if ! is_allowed_config_key "${key}"; then
 457:       print_warn "Ignoring unknown config key '${key}' in ${CONFIG_FILE}."
 458:       continue
 459:     fi
 460:     value="$(normalize_config_value "${raw_value}")"
 461:     value="${value%$'\r'}"
 462:     printf -v "${key}" '%s' "${value}"
 463:   done <"${CONFIG_FILE}"
 464: }
 465: 
 466: validate_loaded_config_or_die() {
 467:   [[ "${CONFIG_LOADED_FROM_FILE}" == "1" ]] || return 0
 468: 
 469:   if [[ -n "${NODE_ROLE}" ]]; then
 470:     case "${NODE_ROLE}" in
 471:       admin|client|blind_exit) ;;
 472:       *)
 473:         print_err "Invalid persisted NODE_ROLE='${NODE_ROLE}' in ${CONFIG_FILE}."
 474:         print_info "Set NODE_ROLE to admin, client, or blind_exit."
 475:         exit 1
 476:         ;;
 477:     esac
 478:   fi
 479: 
 480:   if [[ "${NODE_ROLE}" == "blind_exit" ]] && ! is_linux_host; then
 481:     print_err "Invalid persisted NODE_ROLE='blind_exit' on non-Linux host."
 482:     print_info "Set NODE_ROLE=client in ${CONFIG_FILE} on macOS hosts."
 483:     exit 1
 484:   fi
 485: 
 486:   if ! is_valid_exit_chain_hops "${EXIT_CHAIN_HOPS}"; then
 487:     print_err "Invalid persisted EXIT_CHAIN_HOPS='${EXIT_CHAIN_HOPS}' in ${CONFIG_FILE}."
 488:     print_info "Allowed values: 1 or 2."
 489:     exit 1
 490:   fi
 491:   if [[ -n "${EXIT_CHAIN_ENTRY_NODE_ID}" ]] && ! is_valid_node_id_value "${EXIT_CHAIN_ENTRY_NODE_ID}"; then
 492:     print_err "Invalid persisted EXIT_CHAIN_ENTRY_NODE_ID='${EXIT_CHAIN_ENTRY_NODE_ID}'."
 493:     exit 1
 494:   fi
 495:   if [[ -n "${EXIT_CHAIN_FINAL_NODE_ID}" ]] && ! is_valid_node_id_value "${EXIT_CHAIN_FINAL_NODE_ID}"; then
 496:     print_err "Invalid persisted EXIT_CHAIN_FINAL_NODE_ID='${EXIT_CHAIN_FINAL_NODE_ID}'."
 497:     exit 1
 498:   fi
 499: 
 500:   if ! is_valid_launch_profile "${DEFAULT_LAUNCH_PROFILE}"; then
 501:     print_err "Invalid persisted DEFAULT_LAUNCH_PROFILE='${DEFAULT_LAUNCH_PROFILE}' in ${CONFIG_FILE}."
 502:     exit 1
 503:   fi
 504:   if [[ "${AUTO_LAUNCH_ON_START}" != "0" && "${AUTO_LAUNCH_ON_START}" != "1" ]]; then
 505:     print_err "Invalid persisted AUTO_LAUNCH_ON_START='${AUTO_LAUNCH_ON_START}' in ${CONFIG_FILE}."
 506:     exit 1
 507:   fi
 508:   if ! is_valid_lan_mode "${AUTO_LAUNCH_LAN_MODE}"; then
 509:     print_err "Invalid persisted AUTO_LAUNCH_LAN_MODE='${AUTO_LAUNCH_LAN_MODE}' in ${CONFIG_FILE}."
 510:     print_info "Allowed values: skip, on, off."
 511:     exit 1
 512:   fi
 513:   if [[ "${MANUAL_PEER_OVERRIDE}" != "0" ]]; then
 514:     print_err "Invalid persisted MANUAL_PEER_OVERRIDE='${MANUAL_PEER_OVERRIDE}' in ${CONFIG_FILE}."
 515:     print_info "Manual peer break-glass is removed. Set MANUAL_PEER_OVERRIDE=0."
 516:     exit 1
 517:   fi
 518: }
 519: 
 520: enforce_backend_mode() {
 521:   local expected="linux-wireguard"
 522:   local alternate="linux-wireguard-userspace-shared"
 523:   if is_macos_host; then
 524:     expected="macos-wireguard"
 525:     alternate="macos-wireguard-userspace-shared"
 526:   fi
 527:   if [[ "${BACKEND_MODE}" != "${expected}" && "${BACKEND_MODE}" != "${alternate}" ]]; then
 528:     print_err "Invalid backend '${BACKEND_MODE}' for host profile ${HOST_PROFILE}; expected '${expected}' or '${alternate}'."
 529:     exit 1
 530:   fi
 531: }
 532: 
 533: enforce_auto_tunnel_policy() {
 534:   if [[ "${AUTO_TUNNEL_ENFORCE}" != "1" ]]; then
 535:     print_warn "Unsigned/manual tunnel assignment is not allowed by default; forcing AUTO_TUNNEL_ENFORCE=1."
 536:   fi
 537:   AUTO_TUNNEL_ENFORCE="1"
 538: }
 539: 
 540: enforce_fail_closed_ssh_policy() {
 541:   if [[ "${FAIL_CLOSED_SSH_ALLOW}" != "1" ]]; then
 542:     FAIL_CLOSED_SSH_ALLOW="0"
 543:     FAIL_CLOSED_SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS=""
 544:     return
 545:   fi
 546: 
 547:   if [[ -z "${FAIL_CLOSED_SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS// }" ]]; then
 548:     print_err "FAIL_CLOSED_SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS is required when FAIL_CLOSED_SSH_ALLOW=1."
 549:     exit 1
 550:   fi
 551: }
 552: 
 553: enforce_wg_listen_port_policy() {
 554:   if ! [[ "${WG_LISTEN_PORT}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || (( WG_LISTEN_PORT < 1 || WG_LISTEN_PORT > 65535 )); then
 555:     print_err "Invalid WG_LISTEN_PORT '${WG_LISTEN_PORT}'. Expected numeric range 1..65535."
 556:     exit 1
 557:   fi
 558: }
 559: 
 560: enforce_auto_port_forward_policy() {
 561:   if [[ "${AUTO_PORT_FORWARD_EXIT}" != "1" ]]; then
 562:     AUTO_PORT_FORWARD_EXIT="0"
 563:   fi
 564:   if ! [[ "${AUTO_PORT_FORWARD_LEASE_SECS}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || (( AUTO_PORT_FORWARD_LEASE_SECS < 60 )); then
 565:     print_err "Invalid AUTO_PORT_FORWARD_LEASE_SECS '${AUTO_PORT_FORWARD_LEASE_SECS}'. Expected numeric value >= 60."
 566:     exit 1
 567:   fi
 568:   if ! is_linux_host && [[ "${AUTO_PORT_FORWARD_EXIT}" == "1" ]]; then
 569:     print_warn "Auto port-forward is currently supported only on Linux. Forcing AUTO_PORT_FORWARD_EXIT=0."
 570:     AUTO_PORT_FORWARD_EXIT="0"
 571:   fi
 572:   if ! is_admin_role && ! is_blind_exit_role && [[ "${AUTO_PORT_FORWARD_EXIT}" == "1" ]]; then
 573:     print_warn "Auto port-forward applies only to exit-serving roles. Forcing AUTO_PORT_FORWARD_EXIT=0 for role '${NODE_ROLE}'."
 574:     AUTO_PORT_FORWARD_EXIT="0"
 575:   fi
 576: }
 577: 
 578: manual_peer_override_enabled() {
 579:   return 1
 580: }
 581: 
 582: require_manual_peer_override_authorization() {
 583:   local action="$1"
 584:   print_err "Manual peer break-glass operation is disabled: ${action}"
 585:   print_info "Use signed assignment workflows only (rustynet assignment issue + refresh-assignment)."
 586:   return 1
 587: }
 588: 
 589: run_root() {
 590:   if [[ "${EUID}" -eq 0 ]]; then
 591:     "$@"
 592:   else
 593:     if [[ -t 0 && -t 1 ]]; then
 594:       sudo "$@"
 595:       return
 596:     fi
 597: 
 598:     if sudo -n true >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 599:       sudo -n "$@"
 600:       return
 601:     fi
 602: 
 603:     print_err "A TTY sudo prompt is unavailable and cached sudo credentials were not found."
 604:     print_info "Run 'sudo -v' in an interactive shell, then rerun this action."
 605:     return 1
 606:   fi
 607: }
 608: 
 609: run_rustynet_ops_with_scope() {
 610:   if ! command -v rustynet >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 611:     return 127
 612:   fi
 613:   if is_linux_host; then
 614:     run_root rustynet ops "$@"
 615:   else
 616:     rustynet ops "$@"
 617:   fi
 618: }
 619: 
 620: secure_remove_file_with_scope() {
 621:   local target="$1"
 622:   if [[ ! -f "${target}" && ! -L "${target}" ]]; then
 623:     return 0
 624:   fi
 625: 
 626:   if ! run_rustynet_ops_with_scope secure-remove --path "${target}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 627:     print_err "Secure remove failed for ${target}; cleanup is fail-closed."
 628:     return 1
 629:   fi
 630:   return 0
 631: }
 632: 
 633: secure_remove_temp_passphrase_or_fail() {
 634:   local target="$1"
 635:   if secure_remove_file_with_scope "${target}"; then
 636:     return 0
 637:   fi
 638:   print_err "Failed to securely remove temporary signing passphrase file ${target}."
 639:   return 1
 640: }
 641: 
 642: ensure_signing_passphrase_material() {
 643:   if ! command -v rustynet >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 644:     print_err "rustynet CLI is required for signing passphrase custody operations."
 645:     return 1
 646:   fi
 647: 
 648:   local rust_ops_status=1
 649:   if is_linux_host; then
 650:     run_root env \
 651:       RUSTYNET_HOST_PROFILE="${HOST_PROFILE}" \
 652:       RUSTYNET_SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB="${SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH}" \
 653:       RUSTYNET_MEMBERSHIP_OWNER_SIGNING_KEY="${MEMBERSHIP_OWNER_SIGNING_KEY_PATH}" \
 654:       RUSTYNET_TRUST_SIGNER_KEY="${TRUST_SIGNER_KEY_PATH}" \
 655:       RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_SIGNING_SECRET="/etc/rustynet/assignment.signing.secret" \
 656:       RUSTYNET_MACOS_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE="${MACOS_WG_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE}" \
 657:       RUSTYNET_SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT="${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT}" \
 658:       rustynet ops ensure-signing-passphrase-material >/dev/null 2>&1 || rust_ops_status=$?
 659:   elif is_macos_host; then
 660:     env \
 661:       RUSTYNET_HOST_PROFILE="${HOST_PROFILE}" \
 662:       RUSTYNET_SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB="${SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH}" \
 663:       RUSTYNET_MEMBERSHIP_OWNER_SIGNING_KEY="${MEMBERSHIP_OWNER_SIGNING_KEY_PATH}" \
 664:       RUSTYNET_TRUST_SIGNER_KEY="${TRUST_SIGNER_KEY_PATH}" \
 665:       RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_SIGNING_SECRET="/etc/rustynet/assignment.signing.secret" \
 666:       RUSTYNET_MACOS_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE="${MACOS_WG_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE}" \
 667:       RUSTYNET_SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT="${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT}" \
 668:       rustynet ops ensure-signing-passphrase-material >/dev/null 2>&1 || rust_ops_status=$?
 669:   else
 670:     print_err "Unsupported host profile for signing passphrase materialization: ${HOST_PROFILE}"
 671:     return 1
 672:   fi
 673: 
 674:   if [[ "${rust_ops_status}" != "0" ]]; then
 675:     print_err "Rust-backed signing passphrase ensure flow failed; setup is fail-closed."
 676:     return 1
 677:   fi
 678:   return 0
 679: }
 680: 
 681: materialize_signing_passphrase_file() {
 682:   local __out_var="$1"
 683:   if ! command -v rustynet >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 684:     print_err "rustynet CLI is required for signing passphrase materialization."
 685:     return 1
 686:   fi
 687:   local tmp_passphrase=""
 688: 
 689:   if is_linux_host; then
 690:     if ! tmp_passphrase="$(run_root env \
 691:       RUSTYNET_HOST_PROFILE="${HOST_PROFILE}" \
 692:       RUSTYNET_SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB="${SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH}" \
 693:       RUSTYNET_MEMBERSHIP_OWNER_SIGNING_KEY="${MEMBERSHIP_OWNER_SIGNING_KEY_PATH}" \
 694:       RUSTYNET_TRUST_SIGNER_KEY="${TRUST_SIGNER_KEY_PATH}" \
 695:       RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_SIGNING_SECRET="/etc/rustynet/assignment.signing.secret" \
 696:       RUSTYNET_MACOS_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE="${MACOS_WG_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE}" \
 697:       RUSTYNET_SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT="${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT}" \
 698:       rustynet ops materialize-signing-passphrase-temp)"; then
 699:       print_err "Rust-backed signing passphrase materialization failed; setup is fail-closed."
 700:       return 1
 701:     fi
 702:   elif is_macos_host; then
 703:     if ! tmp_passphrase="$(env \
 704:       RUSTYNET_HOST_PROFILE="${HOST_PROFILE}" \
 705:       RUSTYNET_SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB="${SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH}" \
 706:       RUSTYNET_MEMBERSHIP_OWNER_SIGNING_KEY="${MEMBERSHIP_OWNER_SIGNING_KEY_PATH}" \
 707:       RUSTYNET_TRUST_SIGNER_KEY="${TRUST_SIGNER_KEY_PATH}" \
 708:       RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_SIGNING_SECRET="/etc/rustynet/assignment.signing.secret" \
 709:       RUSTYNET_MACOS_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE="${MACOS_WG_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE}" \
 710:       RUSTYNET_SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT="${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT}" \
 711:       rustynet ops materialize-signing-passphrase-temp)"; then
 712:       print_err "Rust-backed signing passphrase materialization failed; setup is fail-closed."
 713:       return 1
 714:     fi
 715:   else
 716:     print_err "Unsupported host profile for signing passphrase materialization: ${HOST_PROFILE}"
 717:     return 1
 718:   fi
 719: 
 720:   if [[ -z "${tmp_passphrase}" || "${tmp_passphrase}" != /* ]]; then
 721:     [[ -n "${tmp_passphrase}" ]] && secure_remove_temp_passphrase_or_fail "${tmp_passphrase}" || true
 722:     print_err "Rust-backed signing passphrase materialization returned an invalid temp path."
 723:     return 1
 724:   fi
 725: 
 726:   if [[ ! -f "${tmp_passphrase}" || -L "${tmp_passphrase}" ]]; then
 727:     [[ -e "${tmp_passphrase}" || -L "${tmp_passphrase}" ]] && secure_remove_temp_passphrase_or_fail "${tmp_passphrase}" || true
 728:     print_err "Rust-backed signing passphrase materialization produced an invalid file path."
 729:     return 1
 730:   fi
 731: 
 732:   printf -v "${__out_var}" '%s' "${tmp_passphrase}"
 733:   return 0
 734: }
 735: 
 736: prompt_default() {
 737:   local __var_name="$1"
 738:   local __prompt="$2"
 739:   local __default="$3"
 740:   local __value
 741:   read -r -p "${__prompt} [${__default}]: " __value
 742:   __value="${__value:-${__default}}"
 743:   printf -v "${__var_name}" '%s' "${__value}"
 744: }
 745: 
 746: prompt_yes_no() {
 747:   local prompt="$1"
 748:   local default="${2:-y}"
 749:   local value
 750:   local options="y/N"
 751:   if [[ "${default}" == "y" ]]; then
 752:     options="Y/n"
 753:   fi
 754:   read -r -p "${prompt} (${options}): " value
 755:   value="${value:-${default}}"
 756:   [[ "${value}" =~ ^[Yy]$ ]]
 757: }
 758: 
 759: is_valid_launch_profile() {
 760:   case "$1" in
 761:     menu|quick-connect|quick-exit-node|quick-hybrid) return 0 ;;
 762:     *) return 1 ;;
 763:   esac
 764: }
 765: 
 766: is_valid_lan_mode() {
 767:   case "$1" in
 768:     skip|on|off) return 0 ;;
 769:     *) return 1 ;;
 770:   esac
 771: }
 772: 
 773: is_valid_exit_chain_hops() {
 774:   case "$1" in
 775:     1|2) return 0 ;;
 776:     *) return 1 ;;
 777:   esac
 778: }
 779: 
 780: sanitize_exit_chain_defaults() {
 781:   if ! is_valid_exit_chain_hops "${EXIT_CHAIN_HOPS}"; then
 782:     print_warn "Invalid EXIT_CHAIN_HOPS='${EXIT_CHAIN_HOPS}', reverting to '1'."
 783:     EXIT_CHAIN_HOPS="1"
 784:   fi
 785:   if [[ -n "${EXIT_CHAIN_ENTRY_NODE_ID}" ]] && ! is_valid_node_id_value "${EXIT_CHAIN_ENTRY_NODE_ID}"; then
 786:     print_warn "Invalid EXIT_CHAIN_ENTRY_NODE_ID='${EXIT_CHAIN_ENTRY_NODE_ID}', clearing."
 787:     EXIT_CHAIN_ENTRY_NODE_ID=""
 788:   fi
 789:   if [[ -n "${EXIT_CHAIN_FINAL_NODE_ID}" ]] && ! is_valid_node_id_value "${EXIT_CHAIN_FINAL_NODE_ID}"; then
 790:     print_warn "Invalid EXIT_CHAIN_FINAL_NODE_ID='${EXIT_CHAIN_FINAL_NODE_ID}', clearing."
 791:     EXIT_CHAIN_FINAL_NODE_ID=""
 792:   fi
 793:   if [[ "${EXIT_CHAIN_HOPS}" != "2" ]]; then
 794:     EXIT_CHAIN_FINAL_NODE_ID=""
 795:   fi
 796:   if is_blind_exit_role; then
 797:     EXIT_CHAIN_HOPS="1"
 798:     EXIT_CHAIN_ENTRY_NODE_ID=""
 799:     EXIT_CHAIN_FINAL_NODE_ID=""
 800:   fi
 801: }
 802: 
 803: sanitize_launch_defaults() {
 804:   enforce_role_policy_defaults
 805:   sanitize_exit_chain_defaults
 806:   if ! is_valid_launch_profile "${DEFAULT_LAUNCH_PROFILE}"; then
 807:     print_warn "Invalid DEFAULT_LAUNCH_PROFILE='${DEFAULT_LAUNCH_PROFILE}', reverting to 'menu'."
 808:     DEFAULT_LAUNCH_PROFILE="menu"
 809:   fi
 810:   if [[ "${AUTO_LAUNCH_ON_START}" != "1" ]]; then
 811:     AUTO_LAUNCH_ON_START="0"
 812:   fi
 813:   if ! is_valid_lan_mode "${AUTO_LAUNCH_LAN_MODE}"; then
 814:     print_warn "Invalid AUTO_LAUNCH_LAN_MODE='${AUTO_LAUNCH_LAN_MODE}', reverting to 'skip'."
 815:     AUTO_LAUNCH_LAN_MODE="skip"
 816:   fi
 817: }
 818: 
 819: print_start_help() {
 820:   cat <<EOF
 821: Rustynet startup options:
 822:   ./start.sh
 823:     Interactive menu mode.
 824:     Exit-node selection supports 1-hop and 2-hop chain prompts.
 825: 
 826:   ./start.sh --profile <menu|quick-connect|quick-exit-node|quick-hybrid>
 827:     Apply a launch profile once. Non-menu profiles apply and exit.
 828:     blind_exit role accepts only 'menu' or 'quick-exit-node'.
 829: 
 830:   ./start.sh --auto
 831:     Apply saved default launch profile once and exit.
 832: 
 833:   Optional modifiers:
 834:     --exit-node-id <node-id>   Override configured exit node id for this run.
 835:     --lan <skip|on|off>        Override configured LAN mode for this run.
 836:     --help                     Show this help.
 837: EOF
 838: }
 839: 
 840: parse_start_arguments() {
 841:   while [[ "$#" -gt 0 ]]; do
 842:     case "$1" in
 843:       --profile)
 844:         if [[ "$#" -lt 2 ]]; then
 845:           print_err "--profile requires a value."
 846:           exit 1
 847:         fi
 848:         REQUESTED_LAUNCH_PROFILE="$2"
 849:         shift 2
 850:         ;;
 851:       --auto)
 852:         REQUESTED_LAUNCH_PROFILE="auto"
 853:         AUTO_ONLY_LAUNCH="1"
 854:         shift
 855:         ;;
 856:       --exit-node-id)
 857:         if [[ "$#" -lt 2 ]]; then
 858:           print_err "--exit-node-id requires a value."
 859:           exit 1
 860:         fi
 861:         REQUESTED_EXIT_NODE_ID="$2"
 862:         shift 2
 863:         ;;
 864:       --lan)
 865:         if [[ "$#" -lt 2 ]]; then
 866:           print_err "--lan requires a value (skip|on|off)."
 867:           exit 1
 868:         fi
 869:         REQUESTED_LAN_MODE="$2"
 870:         shift 2
 871:         ;;
 872:       --help|-h)
 873:         print_start_help
 874:         exit 0
 875:         ;;
 876:       *)
 877:         print_err "Unknown argument: $1"
 878:         print_start_help
 879:         exit 1
 880:         ;;
 881:     esac
 882:   done
 883: 
 884:   if [[ -n "${REQUESTED_LAUNCH_PROFILE}" && "${REQUESTED_LAUNCH_PROFILE}" != "auto" ]]; then
 885:     if ! is_valid_launch_profile "${REQUESTED_LAUNCH_PROFILE}"; then
 886:       print_err "Invalid --profile value '${REQUESTED_LAUNCH_PROFILE}'."
 887:       exit 1
 888:     fi
 889:     if [[ "${REQUESTED_LAUNCH_PROFILE}" != "menu" ]]; then
 890:       AUTO_ONLY_LAUNCH="1"
 891:     fi
 892:   fi
 893: 
 894:   if [[ -n "${REQUESTED_LAN_MODE}" ]] && ! is_valid_lan_mode "${REQUESTED_LAN_MODE}"; then
 895:     print_err "Invalid --lan value '${REQUESTED_LAN_MODE}'. Expected skip|on|off."
 896:     exit 1
 897:   fi
 898: }
