 949:     printf 'AUTO_LAUNCH_ON_START=%s\n' "${AUTO_LAUNCH_ON_START}"
 950:     printf 'AUTO_LAUNCH_EXIT_NODE_ID=%s\n' "${AUTO_LAUNCH_EXIT_NODE_ID}"
 951:     printf 'AUTO_LAUNCH_LAN_MODE=%s\n' "${AUTO_LAUNCH_LAN_MODE}"
 952:     printf 'EXIT_CHAIN_HOPS=%s\n' "${EXIT_CHAIN_HOPS}"
 953:     printf 'EXIT_CHAIN_ENTRY_NODE_ID=%s\n' "${EXIT_CHAIN_ENTRY_NODE_ID}"
 954:     printf 'EXIT_CHAIN_FINAL_NODE_ID=%s\n' "${EXIT_CHAIN_FINAL_NODE_ID}"
 955:   } >"${CONFIG_FILE}"
 956:   chmod 600 "${CONFIG_FILE}"
 957: }
 958: 
 959: detect_default_egress() {
 960:   if is_linux_host; then
 961:     ip -o -4 route show to default 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==1 { print $5 }'
 962:     return
 963:   fi
 964:   if is_macos_host; then
 965:     route -n get default 2>/dev/null | awk '/interface:/{print $2; exit}'
 966:     return
 967:   fi
 968: }
 969: 
 970: effective_selected_exit_node_for_egress() {
 971:   if [[ "${EXIT_CHAIN_HOPS}" == "2" && "${EXIT_CHAIN_ENTRY_NODE_ID}" == "${DEVICE_NODE_ID}" ]]; then
 972:     printf '%s' "${EXIT_CHAIN_FINAL_NODE_ID}"
 973:     return
 974:   fi
 975:   printf '%s' "${EXIT_CHAIN_ENTRY_NODE_ID}"
 976: }
 977: 
 978: endpoint_host_from_value() {
 979:   local endpoint="$1"
 980:   if [[ "${endpoint}" =~ ^\[([0-9A-Fa-f:.]+)\]:[0-9]+$ ]]; then
 981:     printf '%s' "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
 982:     return 0
 983:   fi
 984:   if [[ "${endpoint}" =~ ^([0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+):[0-9]+$ ]]; then
 985:     printf '%s' "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
 986:     return 0
 987:   fi
 988:   return 1
 989: }
 990: 
 991: route_interface_for_host() {
 992:   local host="$1"
 993:   if [[ -z "${host}" ]]; then
 994:     return 1
 995:   fi
 996:   if [[ "${host}" == *:* ]]; then
 997:     ip -o -6 route get "${host}" 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==1 { for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) if ($i == "dev") { print $(i + 1); exit } }'
 998:     return
 999:   fi
1000:   ip -o -4 route get "${host}" 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==1 { for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) if ($i == "dev") { print $(i + 1); exit } }'
1001: }
1002: 
1003: derive_selected_exit_route_egress_interface() {
1004:   local selected_exit record endpoint endpoint_host derived
1005:   selected_exit="$(effective_selected_exit_node_for_egress)"
1006:   if [[ -z "${selected_exit}" ]]; then
1007:     return 1
1008:   fi
1009:   record="$(find_peer_record_by_node_id "${selected_exit}" || true)"
1010:   if [[ -z "${record}" ]]; then
1011:     return 1
1012:   fi
1013:   IFS='|' read -r _name _node_id _public_key endpoint _cidr _role _rest <<<"${record}"
1014:   if [[ -z "${endpoint}" ]]; then
1015:     return 1
1016:   fi
1017:   if ! endpoint_host="$(endpoint_host_from_value "${endpoint}")"; then
1018:     return 1
1019:   fi
1020:   derived="$(route_interface_for_host "${endpoint_host}" || true)"
1021:   if [[ -z "${derived}" ]]; then
1022:     return 1
1023:   fi
1024:   printf '%s' "${derived}"
1025: }
1026: 
1027: sync_egress_interface_with_selected_exit_route() {
1028:   local selected_exit derived detected_egress
1029:   if ! is_linux_host; then
1030:     return 0
1031:   fi
1032: 
1033:   selected_exit="$(effective_selected_exit_node_for_egress)"
1034:   if [[ -n "${selected_exit}" ]]; then
1035:     derived="$(derive_selected_exit_route_egress_interface || true)"
1036:     if [[ -z "${derived}" ]]; then
1037:       print_err "Unable to derive egress interface for selected exit node '${selected_exit}'."
1038:       print_info "Verify the selected exit endpoint is present and routable in local peer records."
1039:       return 1
1040:     fi
1041:     if [[ "${EGRESS_INTERFACE}" != "${derived}" ]]; then
1042:       if [[ -n "${EGRESS_INTERFACE}" ]]; then
1043:         print_warn "Overriding configured egress interface '${EGRESS_INTERFACE}' with route-derived '${derived}' for selected exit '${selected_exit}'."
1044:       else
1045:         print_info "Setting egress interface to route-derived '${derived}' for selected exit '${selected_exit}'."
1046:       fi
1047:       EGRESS_INTERFACE="${derived}"
1048:     fi
1049:     return 0
1050:   fi
1051: 
1052:   if [[ -z "${EGRESS_INTERFACE}" ]]; then
1053:     detected_egress="$(detect_default_egress)"
1054:     if [[ -z "${detected_egress}" ]]; then
1055:       print_err "Unable to detect default egress interface."
1056:       return 1
1057:     fi
1058:     EGRESS_INTERFACE="${detected_egress}"
1059:   fi
1060:   return 0
1061: }

1063: package_manager() {
1064:   if is_macos_host; then
1065:     add_macos_homebrew_to_path
1066:     if command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1067:       echo brew
1068:     else
1069:       echo unknown
1070:     fi
1071:     return
1072:   fi
1073:   if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1074:     echo apt
1075:     return
1076:   fi
1077:   if command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1078:     echo dnf
1079:     return
1080:   fi
1081:   if command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1082:     echo pacman
1083:     return
1084:   fi
1085:   if command -v zypper >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1086:     echo zypper
1087:     return
1088:   fi
1089:   echo unknown
1090: }

1092: add_macos_homebrew_to_path() {
1093:   if ! is_macos_host; then
1094:     return 0
1095:   fi
1096:   if [[ -x /opt/homebrew/bin/brew ]]; then
1097:     export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/opt/homebrew/sbin:${PATH}"
1098:     return 0
1099:   fi
1100:   if [[ -x /usr/local/bin/brew ]]; then
1101:     export PATH="/usr/local/bin:/usr/local/sbin:${PATH}"
1102:     return 0
1103:   fi
1104: }
1105: 
1106: add_rustup_to_path() {
1107:   if [[ -d "${HOME}/.cargo/bin" ]]; then
1108:     export PATH="${HOME}/.cargo/bin:${PATH}"
1109:   fi
1110:   if is_macos_host; then
1111:     if [[ -d /opt/homebrew/opt/rustup/bin ]]; then
1112:       export PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/rustup/bin:${PATH}"
1113:     fi
1114:     if [[ -d /usr/local/opt/rustup/bin ]]; then
1115:       export PATH="/usr/local/opt/rustup/bin:${PATH}"
1116:     fi
1117:   fi
1118: }

1120: is_macos_admin_user() {
1121:   if ! is_macos_host; then
1122:     return 1
1123:   fi
1124:   id -Gn 2>/dev/null | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -qx 'admin'
1125: }

1127: ensure_macos_command_line_tools() {
1128:   if ! is_macos_host; then
1129:     return 0
1130:   fi
1131:   if xcode-select -p >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1132:     return 0
1133:   fi
1134: 
1135:   print_warn "Xcode Command Line Tools are required on macOS and are not installed."
1136:   if ! prompt_yes_no "Install Command Line Tools now (softwareupdate)?" "y"; then
1137:     print_err "Cannot continue without Xcode Command Line Tools."
1138:     exit 1
1139:   fi
1140: 
1141:   if ! command -v softwareupdate >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1142:     print_err "softwareupdate is unavailable; cannot automate Command Line Tools install."
1143:     print_info "Run 'xcode-select --install' and rerun ./start.sh."
1144:     exit 1
1145:   fi
1146: 
1147:   local clt_label=""
1148:   clt_label="$(softwareupdate --list 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/^\\* Label: //p' | grep '^Command Line Tools for Xcode' | tail -n 1)"
1149:   if [[ -z "${clt_label}" ]]; then
1150:     print_err "No Command Line Tools update label detected via softwareupdate."
1151:     print_info "Install with 'xcode-select --install' and rerun ./start.sh."
1152:     exit 1
1153:   fi
1154: 
1155:   print_info "Installing '${clt_label}' (this may take several minutes)."
1156:   run_root softwareupdate --install "${clt_label}" --verbose
1157:   if ! xcode-select -p >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1158:     print_err "Command Line Tools installation did not complete successfully."
1159:     exit 1
1160:   fi
1161: }
1162: 
1163: ensure_macos_homebrew() {
1164:   if ! is_macos_host; then
1165:     return 0
1166:   fi
1167: 
1168:   add_macos_homebrew_to_path
1169:   if command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1170:     return 0
1171:   fi
1172: 
1173:   print_err "Homebrew is required on macOS for managed dependency installation."
1174:   print_info "Install Homebrew from https://brew.sh using your approved process, then rerun ./start.sh."
1175:   exit 1
1176: }

1178: map_package() {
1179:   local pm="$1"
1180:   local cmd="$2"
1181:   case "${cmd}" in
1182:     wg)
1183:       if [[ "${pm}" == "brew" ]]; then
1184:         echo "wireguard-tools"
1185:       else
1186:         echo "wireguard-tools"
1187:       fi
1188:       ;;
1189:     wireguard-go)
1190:       if [[ "${pm}" == "brew" ]]; then
1191:         echo "wireguard-go"
1192:       else
1193:         echo ""
1194:       fi
1195:       ;;
1196:     ip)
1197:       if [[ "${pm}" == "dnf" ]]; then
1198:         echo "iproute"
1199:       elif [[ "${pm}" == "brew" ]]; then
1200:         echo ""
1201:       else
1202:         echo "iproute2"
1203:       fi
1204:       ;;
1205:     nft)
1206:       if [[ "${pm}" == "brew" ]]; then
1207:         echo ""
1208:       else
1209:         echo "nftables"
1210:       fi
1211:       ;;
1212:     openssl)
1213:       if [[ "${pm}" == "brew" ]]; then
1214:         echo "openssl@3"
1215:       else
1216:         echo "openssl"
1217:       fi
1218:       ;;
1219:     systemctl)
1220:       if [[ "${pm}" == "brew" ]]; then
1221:         echo ""
1222:       else
1223:         echo "systemd"
1224:       fi
1225:       ;;
1226:     xxd)
1227:       if [[ "${pm}" == "brew" ]]; then
1228:         echo "vim"
1229:       elif [[ "${pm}" == "apt" ]]; then
1230:         echo "xxd"
1231:       else
1232:         echo "vim-common"
1233:       fi
1234:       ;;
1235:     rg) echo "ripgrep" ;;
1236:     curl) echo "curl" ;;
1237:     cargo)
1238:       if [[ "${pm}" == "apt" ]]; then
1239:         echo "cargo"
1240:       elif [[ "${pm}" == "dnf" ]]; then
1241:         echo "cargo"
1242:       elif [[ "${pm}" == "brew" ]]; then
1243:         echo "rust"
1244:       elif [[ "${pm}" == "pacman" ]]; then
1245:         echo "rust"
1246:       else
1247:         echo "cargo"
1248:       fi
1249:       ;;
1250:     rustc)
1251:       if [[ "${pm}" == "brew" ]]; then
1252:         echo "rust"
1253:       elif [[ "${pm}" == "pacman" ]]; then
1254:         echo "rust"
1255:       else
1256:         echo "rustc"
1257:       fi
1258:       ;;
1259:     *) echo "" ;;
1260:   esac
1261: }

1263: require_rust_toolchain_channel() {
1264:   if [[ -n "${RUST_TOOLCHAIN_CHANNEL}" ]]; then
1265:     return 0
1266:   fi
1267:   print_err "Unable to determine required Rust toolchain channel from ${RUST_TOOLCHAIN_FILE}."
1268:   exit 1
1269: }

1271: check_rust_min_version() {
1272:   require_rust_toolchain_channel
1273:   add_rustup_to_path
1274:   if ! command -v rustup >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1275:     return 1
1276:   fi
1277:   rustup run "${RUST_TOOLCHAIN_CHANNEL}" rustc --version >/dev/null 2>&1
1278: }

1280: install_rustup_package() {
1281:   local pm
1282:   pm="$(package_manager)"
1283:   if [[ "${pm}" == "unknown" ]]; then
1284:     print_err "No supported package manager found. Install rustup and toolchain ${RUST_TOOLCHAIN_CHANNEL} manually, then rerun ./start.sh."
1285:     return 1
1286:   fi
1287: 
1288:   print_info "Installing rustup via ${pm}."
1289:   case "${pm}" in
1290:     apt)
1291:       run_root apt-get update
1292:       run_root apt-get install -y rustup
1293:       ;;
1294:     dnf)
1295:       run_root dnf install -y rustup
1296:       ;;
1297:     pacman)
1298:       run_root pacman -Sy --noconfirm rustup
1299:       ;;
1300:     zypper)
1301:       run_root zypper --non-interactive install rustup
1302:       ;;
1303:     brew)
1304:       brew install rustup
1305:       ;;
1306:   esac
1307: }
1308: 
1309: ensure_rustup_available() {
1310:   require_rust_toolchain_channel
1311:   add_rustup_to_path
1312:   if command -v rustup >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1313:     return 0
1314:   fi
1315: 
1316:   install_rustup_package || return 1
1317:   add_rustup_to_path
1318:   if ! command -v rustup >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1319:     print_err "rustup is required but was not found after installation."
1320:     return 1
1321:   fi
1322: }
1323: 
1324: install_pinned_cargo_deny() {
1325:   require_rust_toolchain_channel
1326:   print_info "Installing pinned cargo-deny version ${CARGO_DENY_VERSION}."
1327:   cargo +"${RUST_TOOLCHAIN_CHANNEL}" install --locked cargo-deny --version "${CARGO_DENY_VERSION}"
1328: }
1329: 
1330: ensure_rust_components() {
1331:   require_rust_toolchain_channel
1332:   ensure_rustup_available || return 1
1333: 
1334:   local missing=()
1335:   if ! rustup component list --toolchain "${RUST_TOOLCHAIN_CHANNEL}" --installed | grep -q '^rustfmt'; then
1336:     missing+=("rustfmt")
1337:   fi
1338:   if ! rustup component list --toolchain "${RUST_TOOLCHAIN_CHANNEL}" --installed | grep -q '^clippy'; then
1339:     missing+=("clippy")
1340:   fi
1341:   if [[ "${#missing[@]}" -eq 0 ]]; then
1342:     return 0
1343:   fi
1344: 
1345:   print_info "Installing Rust components for ${RUST_TOOLCHAIN_CHANNEL}: ${missing[*]}"
1346:   rustup component add --toolchain "${RUST_TOOLCHAIN_CHANNEL}" "${missing[@]}"
1347: }
1348: 
1349: ensure_ci_security_tools() {
1350:   require_rust_toolchain_channel
1351:   local missing_bins=()
1352:   if ! command -v cargo-audit >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1353:     missing_bins+=("cargo-audit")
1354:   fi
1355:   if ! command -v cargo-deny >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1356:     missing_bins+=("cargo-deny")
1357:   fi
1358:   if [[ "${#missing_bins[@]}" -eq 0 ]]; then
1359:     return 0
1360:   fi
1361: 
1362:   print_warn "Missing CI security tools: ${missing_bins[*]}"
1363:   if ! prompt_yes_no "Install missing CI security tools with cargo install --locked?" "y"; then
1364:     print_warn "Skipping CI security tool installation."
1365:     return 0
1366:   fi
1367: 
1368:   local tool
1369:   for tool in "${missing_bins[@]}"; do
1370:     if [[ "${tool}" == "cargo-deny" ]]; then
1371:       install_pinned_cargo_deny
1372:     else
1373:       cargo +"${RUST_TOOLCHAIN_CHANNEL}" install --locked "${tool}"
1374:     fi
1375:   done
1376: }
1377: 
1378: ensure_rust_toolchain() {
1379:   require_rust_toolchain_channel
1380:   ensure_rustup_available || return 1
1381: 
1382:   if check_rust_min_version; then
1383:     print_info "Rust toolchain $(rustup run "${RUST_TOOLCHAIN_CHANNEL}" rustc --version 2>/dev/null) is present and pinned."
1384:     ensure_rust_components
1385:     rustup default "${RUST_TOOLCHAIN_CHANNEL}" >/dev/null
1386:     add_rustup_to_path
1387:     hash -r
1388:     return 0
1389:   fi
1390: 
1391:   print_info "Installing pinned Rust toolchain ${RUST_TOOLCHAIN_CHANNEL} via rustup."
1392:   rustup set profile minimal
1393:   rustup toolchain install "${RUST_TOOLCHAIN_CHANNEL}" --profile minimal --component rustfmt --component clippy
1394:   rustup default "${RUST_TOOLCHAIN_CHANNEL}"
1395:   add_rustup_to_path
1396:   hash -r
1397: 
1398:   if ! check_rust_min_version; then
1399:     print_err "Rust toolchain ${RUST_TOOLCHAIN_CHANNEL} did not install successfully."
1400:     return 1
1401:   fi
1402: 
1403:   print_info "Rust toolchain $(rustup run "${RUST_TOOLCHAIN_CHANNEL}" rustc --version 2>/dev/null) installed successfully."
1404:   ensure_rust_components
1405: }

1407: install_runtime_dependencies() {
1408:   if is_macos_host; then
1409:     ensure_macos_command_line_tools
1410:     add_macos_homebrew_to_path
1411:   fi
1412: 
1413:   local required=(openssl xxd curl awk sed grep rg)
1414:   if is_linux_host; then
1415:     required+=(wg ip nft systemctl)
1416:   elif is_macos_host; then
1417:     required+=(wg wireguard-go)
1418:   fi
1419:   local missing=()
1420:   local cmd
1421:   for cmd in "${required[@]}"; do
1422:     if ! command -v "${cmd}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1423:       missing+=("${cmd}")
1424:     fi
1425:   done
1426: 
1427:   if [[ "${#missing[@]}" -eq 0 ]]; then
1428:     return
1429:   fi
1430: 
1431:   print_warn "Missing commands: ${missing[*]}"
1432:   if ! prompt_yes_no "Install missing runtime dependencies now?" "y"; then
1433:     print_err "Cannot continue without required dependencies."
1434:     exit 1
1435:   fi
1436: 
1437:   local pm
1438:   pm="$(package_manager)"
1439:   if is_macos_host && [[ "${pm}" == "unknown" ]]; then
1440:     local requires_wireguard_tools=0
1441:     for cmd in "${missing[@]}"; do
1442:       if [[ "${cmd}" == "wg" || "${cmd}" == "wireguard-go" ]]; then
1443:         requires_wireguard_tools=1
1444:       fi
1445:     done
1446: 
1447:     if [[ "${requires_wireguard_tools}" == "1" ]] && ! is_macos_admin_user; then
1448:       print_err "Homebrew is unavailable and current user is not in the macOS admin group."
1449:       print_info "Admin privileges are required to install root-owned wg/wireguard-go binaries."
1450:       print_info "Ask an admin to install Homebrew and wireguard-tools, then rerun ./start.sh."
1451:       exit 1
1452:     fi
1453: 
1454:     ensure_macos_homebrew
1455:     pm="$(package_manager)"
1456:   fi
1457:   if [[ "${pm}" == "unknown" ]]; then
1458:     print_err "No supported package manager found. Install manually: ${missing[*]}"
1459:     exit 1
1460:   fi
1461: 
1462:   local packages=()
1463:   local package
1464:   for cmd in "${missing[@]}"; do
1465:     package="$(map_package "${pm}" "${cmd}")"
1466:     if [[ -n "${package}" ]] && [[ ! " ${packages[*]} " =~ " ${package} " ]]; then
1467:       packages+=("${package}")
1468:     fi
1469:   done
1470: 
1471:   if [[ "${#packages[@]}" -eq 0 ]]; then
1472:     print_err "Could not map missing commands to installable packages."
1473:     exit 1
1474:   fi
1475: 
1476:   print_info "Installing packages: ${packages[*]}"
1477:   case "${pm}" in
1478:     apt)
1479:       run_root apt-get update
1480:       run_root apt-get install -y "${packages[@]}"
1481:       ;;
1482:     dnf)
1483:       run_root dnf install -y "${packages[@]}"
1484:       ;;
1485:     pacman)
1486:       run_root pacman -Sy --noconfirm "${packages[@]}"
1487:       ;;
1488:     zypper)
1489:       run_root zypper --non-interactive install "${packages[@]}"
1490:       ;;
1491:     brew)
1492:       brew install "${packages[@]}"
1493:       ;;
1494:   esac
1495: }

1497: ensure_binaries_available() {
1498:   if command -v rustynetd >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v rustynet >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1499:     return
1500:   fi
1501: 
1502:   if [[ "${EUID}" -eq 0 ]]; then
1503:     print_err "Refusing to compile Rustynet from a root-owned shell in the repository workspace."
1504:     print_info "Run ./start.sh as a normal user; it will invoke sudo only for privileged installation steps."
1505:     print_info "Set RUSTYNET_ALLOW_ROOT_BUILD=1 to override this guard."
1506:     if [[ "${RUSTYNET_ALLOW_ROOT_BUILD:-0}" != "1" ]]; then
1507:       exit 1
1508:     fi
1509:   fi
1510: 
1511:   print_warn "rustynet binaries are not installed in PATH."
1512:   if ! check_rust_min_version; then
1513:     ensure_rust_toolchain
1514:   fi
1515: 
1516:   if ! command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1517:     print_err "cargo is required to build rustynet binaries."
1518:     exit 1
1519:   fi
1520: 
1521:   if ! prompt_yes_no "Build and install rustynet binaries to /usr/local/bin now?" "y"; then
1522:     print_err "Cannot continue without rustynet binaries."
1523:     exit 1
1524:   fi
1525: 
1526:   (cd "${ROOT_DIR}" && cargo +"${RUST_TOOLCHAIN_CHANNEL}" build --release -p rustynetd -p rustynet-cli)
1527:   local install_dir="/usr/local/bin"
1528:   if is_macos_host && ! test -w "${install_dir}"; then
1529:     if is_macos_admin_user; then
1530:       run_root install -d -m 0755 "${install_dir}"
1531:       run_root install -m 0755 "${ROOT_DIR}/target/release/rustynetd" "${install_dir}/rustynetd"
1532:       run_root install -m 0755 "${ROOT_DIR}/target/release/rustynet-cli" "${install_dir}/rustynet"
1533:       return
1534:     fi
1535:     print_err "No admin write access to /usr/local/bin on macOS."
1536:     print_info "Admin privileges are required so rustynetd can remain root-owned for privileged-helper launchd service."
1537:     exit 1
1538:   fi
1539: 
1540:   run_root install -d -m 0755 "${install_dir}"
1541:   run_root install -m 0755 "${ROOT_DIR}/target/release/rustynetd" "${install_dir}/rustynetd"
1542:   run_root install -m 0755 "${ROOT_DIR}/target/release/rustynet-cli" "${install_dir}/rustynet"
1543: }
1544: 
1545: stat_mode() {
1546:   local path="$1"
1547:   stat -c %a "${path}" 2>/dev/null || stat -f %Lp "${path}" 2>/dev/null || true
1548: }
1549: 
1550: doctor_preflight() {
1551:   local failures=0
1552:   local warnings=0
1553: 
1554:   doctor_ok() {
1555:     printf '[ok] %s\n' "$1"
1556:   }
1557:   doctor_warn() {
1558:     warnings=$((warnings + 1))
1559:     printf '[warn] %s\n' "$1"
1560:   }
1561:   doctor_fail() {
1562:     failures=$((failures + 1))
1563:     printf '[error] %s\n' "$1" >&2
1564:   }
1565:   doctor_require_cmd() {
1566:     local cmd="$1"
1567:     local label="$2"
1568:     if command -v "${cmd}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1569:       doctor_ok "${label}: ${cmd} present"
1570:     else
1571:       doctor_fail "${label}: ${cmd} missing"
1572:     fi
1573:   }
1574:   doctor_check_mode() {
1575:     local path="$1"
1576:     local expected="$2"
1577:     local label="$3"
1578:     if [[ ! -e "${path}" ]]; then
1579:       doctor_fail "${label}: ${path} missing"
1580:       return
1581:     fi
1582:     local mode
1583:     mode="$(stat_mode "${path}")"
1584:     if [[ "${mode}" == "${expected}" ]]; then
1585:       doctor_ok "${label}: ${path} mode ${mode}"
1586:     else
1587:       doctor_fail "${label}: ${path} mode ${mode:-unknown} (expected ${expected})"
1588:     fi
1589:   }
1590:   doctor_check_owner_uid() {
1591:     local path="$1"
1592:     local expected_uid="$2"
1593:     local label="$3"
1594:     if [[ ! -e "${path}" ]]; then
1595:       doctor_fail "${label}: ${path} missing"
1596:       return
1597:     fi
1598:     local owner_uid=""
1599:     if stat -c '%u' "${path}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1600:       owner_uid="$(stat -c '%u' "${path}")"
1601:     elif stat -f '%u' "${path}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1602:       owner_uid="$(stat -f '%u' "${path}")"
1603:     fi
1604:     if [[ -z "${owner_uid}" ]]; then
1605:       doctor_fail "${label}: unable to determine owner for ${path}"
1606:     elif [[ "${owner_uid}" == "${expected_uid}" ]]; then
1607:       doctor_ok "${label}: ${path} owner uid ${owner_uid}"
1608:     else
1609:       doctor_fail "${label}: ${path} owner uid ${owner_uid} (expected ${expected_uid})"
1610:     fi
1611:   }
1612: 
1613:   print_info "Running Rustynet preflight doctor..."
1614:   doctor_require_cmd rustynetd "binary"
1615:   doctor_require_cmd rustynet "binary"
1616:   doctor_require_cmd rustup "toolchain manager"
1617:   doctor_require_cmd cargo "toolchain"
1618:   doctor_require_cmd openssl "crypto runtime"
1619:   doctor_require_cmd curl "network runtime"
1620:   doctor_require_cmd awk "shell runtime"
1621:   doctor_require_cmd sed "shell runtime"
1622:   doctor_require_cmd grep "shell runtime"
1623:   doctor_require_cmd rg "shell runtime"
1624: 
1625:   if check_rust_min_version; then
1626:     doctor_ok "rust toolchain ${RUST_TOOLCHAIN_CHANNEL} is installed"
1627:   else
1628:     doctor_fail "rust toolchain ${RUST_TOOLCHAIN_CHANNEL:-unknown} missing; run first-run bootstrap"
1629:   fi
1630: 
1631:   if [[ -f "${CONFIG_FILE}" ]]; then
1632:     local cfg_mode
1633:     cfg_mode="$(stat_mode "${CONFIG_FILE}")"
1634:     if [[ "${cfg_mode}" == "600" ]]; then
1635:       doctor_ok "config permissions are strict (${cfg_mode})"
1636:     else
1637:       doctor_fail "config permissions are ${cfg_mode:-unknown}; expected 600"
1638:     fi
1639:   else
1640:     doctor_warn "config file not present yet (${CONFIG_FILE})"
1641:   fi
1642: 
1643:   if is_linux_host; then
1644:     doctor_require_cmd wg "linux dataplane"
1645:     doctor_require_cmd ip "linux dataplane"
1646:     doctor_require_cmd nft "linux dataplane"
1647:     doctor_require_cmd systemctl "linux service"
1648:     doctor_require_cmd systemd-creds "encrypted credential provisioning"
1649:     doctor_require_cmd python3 "linux e2e/runtime"
1650:     if [[ "${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH}" != "${LINUX_WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH}" ]]; then
1651:       doctor_fail "credential blob path must be ${LINUX_WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH} on Linux"
1652:     else
1653:       doctor_ok "credential blob path pinned (${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH})"
1654:     fi
1655:     if [[ "${SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH}" != "${LINUX_SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH}" ]]; then
1656:       doctor_fail "signing credential blob path must be ${LINUX_SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH} on Linux"
1657:     else
1658:       doctor_ok "signing credential blob path pinned (${SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH})"
1659:     fi
1660: 
1661:     if [[ "${SETUP_COMPLETE}" == "1" ]]; then
1662:       doctor_check_mode "${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH}" "600" "encrypted passphrase credential blob"
1663:       doctor_check_mode "${SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH}" "600" "encrypted signing passphrase credential blob"
1664:       if [[ -f "${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_PATH}" ]]; then
1665:         doctor_fail "plaintext passphrase file still present (${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_PATH}); remove it"
1666:       else
1667:         doctor_ok "no plaintext passphrase file present"
1668:       fi
1669:       doctor_check_mode "${WG_ENCRYPTED_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH}" "600" "encrypted private key"
1670:       if [[ -f "${WG_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH}" ]]; then
1671:         doctor_check_mode "${WG_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH}" "600" "runtime private key"
1672:       else
1673:         doctor_warn "runtime private key not present (${WG_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH}); it will be derived at daemon startup"
1674:       fi
1675:       if [[ ! -e "${TRUST_EVIDENCE_PATH}" ]]; then
1676:         doctor_fail "trust evidence: ${TRUST_EVIDENCE_PATH} missing"
1677:       else
1678:         local trust_mode trust_group daemon_group
1679:         trust_mode="$(stat_mode "${TRUST_EVIDENCE_PATH}")"
1680:         daemon_group="${RUSTYNET_DAEMON_GROUP:-rustynetd}"
1681:         trust_group=""
1682:         if stat -c '%G' "${TRUST_EVIDENCE_PATH}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1683:           trust_group="$(stat -c '%G' "${TRUST_EVIDENCE_PATH}")"
1684:         elif stat -f '%Sg' "${TRUST_EVIDENCE_PATH}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1685:           trust_group="$(stat -f '%Sg' "${TRUST_EVIDENCE_PATH}")"
1686:         fi
1687:         if [[ "${trust_mode}" == "600" ]]; then
1688:           doctor_ok "trust evidence: ${TRUST_EVIDENCE_PATH} mode ${trust_mode}"
1689:         elif [[ "${trust_mode}" == "640" && "${trust_group}" == "${daemon_group}" ]]; then
1690:           doctor_ok "trust evidence: ${TRUST_EVIDENCE_PATH} mode ${trust_mode} group ${trust_group}"
1691:         else
1692:           doctor_fail "trust evidence: ${TRUST_EVIDENCE_PATH} mode ${trust_mode:-unknown} group ${trust_group:-unknown} (expected 600 or 640 with group ${daemon_group})"
1693:         fi
1694:       fi
1695:       doctor_check_mode "${TRUST_WATERMARK_PATH}" "600" "trust watermark"
1696:       if [[ -S "${SOCKET_PATH}" ]]; then
1697:         doctor_ok "daemon IPC socket present (${SOCKET_PATH})"
1698:       else
1699:         doctor_warn "daemon IPC socket not present (${SOCKET_PATH}); service may be stopped"
1700:       fi
1701:     else
1702:       doctor_warn "setup not marked complete; run first-run setup"
1703:     fi
1704:   elif is_macos_host; then
1705:     doctor_require_cmd wg "macOS dataplane"
1706:     doctor_require_cmd wireguard-go "macOS dataplane"
1707:     doctor_require_cmd ifconfig "macOS dataplane"
1708:     doctor_require_cmd route "macOS dataplane"
1709:     doctor_require_cmd pfctl "macOS dataplane"
1710:     doctor_require_cmd launchctl "macOS service manager"
1711:     doctor_require_cmd security "macOS keychain custody"
1712:     if command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1713:       doctor_ok "homebrew present for macOS dependency management"
1714:     else
1715:       doctor_warn "homebrew missing; dependency upgrades must be managed manually"
1716:     fi
1717:     if path_in_linux_runtime_roots "${SOCKET_PATH}" \
1718:       || path_in_linux_runtime_roots "${STATE_PATH}" \
1719:       || path_in_linux_runtime_roots "${TRUST_EVIDENCE_PATH}" \
1720:       || path_in_linux_runtime_roots "${WG_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH}"; then
1721:       doctor_fail "macOS path policy violation detected (Linux runtime roots in config); rerun setup to normalize paths"
1722:     else
1723:       doctor_ok "macOS path policy enforced (no Linux runtime roots)"
1724:     fi
1725:     if [[ "${SETUP_COMPLETE}" == "1" ]]; then
1726:       if [[ -z "${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT}" ]]; then
1727:         doctor_fail "macOS keychain account for passphrase custody is empty"
1728:       elif ! [[ "${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT}" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ ]]; then
1729:         doctor_fail "macOS keychain account has invalid characters (${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT})"
1730:       elif ! macos_keychain_passphrase_exists; then
1731:         doctor_fail "macOS keychain passphrase item missing (service=${MACOS_WG_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE}, account=${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT})"
1732:       else
1733:         doctor_ok "macOS keychain passphrase source configured (service=${MACOS_WG_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE}, account=${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT})"
1734:       fi
1735:       if [[ -f "${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_PATH}" ]]; then
1736:         doctor_fail "persistent plaintext passphrase file is present on macOS (${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_PATH})"
1737:       else
1738:         doctor_ok "no persistent plaintext passphrase file present on macOS"
1739:       fi
1740:       if [[ -f "${MACOS_LAUNCHD_DAEMON_PLIST_PATH}" ]]; then
1741:         doctor_check_mode "${MACOS_LAUNCHD_DAEMON_PLIST_PATH}" "644" "launchd daemon plist"
1742:         doctor_check_owner_uid "${MACOS_LAUNCHD_DAEMON_PLIST_PATH}" "$(id -u)" "launchd daemon plist"
1743:       else
1744:         doctor_warn "launchd daemon plist missing (${MACOS_LAUNCHD_DAEMON_PLIST_PATH}); start will reinstall it"
1745:       fi
1746:       if [[ -f "${MACOS_LAUNCHD_HELPER_PLIST_PATH}" ]]; then
1747:         doctor_check_mode "${MACOS_LAUNCHD_HELPER_PLIST_PATH}" "644" "launchd privileged helper plist"
1748:         doctor_check_owner_uid "${MACOS_LAUNCHD_HELPER_PLIST_PATH}" "0" "launchd privileged helper plist"
1749:       else
1750:         doctor_warn "launchd privileged helper plist missing (${MACOS_LAUNCHD_HELPER_PLIST_PATH}); start will reinstall it"
1751:       fi
1752:       doctor_check_mode "${WG_ENCRYPTED_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH}" "600" "encrypted private key"
1753:       if [[ -f "${WG_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH}" ]]; then
1754:         doctor_check_mode "${WG_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH}" "600" "runtime private key"
1755:       else
1756:         doctor_warn "runtime private key not present (${WG_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH}); it will be derived at daemon startup"
1757:       fi
1758:       doctor_check_mode "${TRUST_EVIDENCE_PATH}" "600" "trust evidence"
1759:       doctor_check_mode "${TRUST_WATERMARK_PATH}" "600" "trust watermark"
1760:       if [[ -S "${SOCKET_PATH}" ]]; then
1761:         doctor_ok "daemon IPC socket present (${SOCKET_PATH})"
1762:       else
1763:         doctor_warn "daemon IPC socket not present (${SOCKET_PATH}); daemon may be stopped"
1764:       fi
1765:     else
1766:       doctor_warn "setup not marked complete; run first-run setup"
1767:     fi
1768:   else
1769:     doctor_fail "unsupported host OS ${HOST_OS}"
1770:   fi
1771: 
1772:   if (( failures > 0 )); then
1773:     print_err "Preflight doctor failed with ${failures} error(s) and ${warnings} warning(s)."
1774:     return 1
1775:   fi
1776: 
1777:   print_info "Preflight doctor passed with ${warnings} warning(s)."
1778:   return 0
1779: }

1781: prepare_system_directories() {
1782:   if ! command -v rustynet >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1783:     print_err "rustynet CLI is required for system directory preparation."
1784:     return 1
1785:   fi
1786: 
1787:   local rust_ops_status=1
1788:   if is_linux_host; then
1789:     run_root env \
1790:       RUSTYNET_HOST_PROFILE="${HOST_PROFILE}" \
1791:       RUSTYNET_STATE="${STATE_PATH}" \
1792:       RUSTYNET_TRUST_EVIDENCE="${TRUST_EVIDENCE_PATH}" \
1793:       RUSTYNET_TRUST_VERIFIER_KEY="${TRUST_VERIFIER_KEY_PATH}" \
1794:       RUSTYNET_TRUST_WATERMARK="${TRUST_WATERMARK_PATH}" \
1795:       RUSTYNET_AUTO_TUNNEL_BUNDLE="${AUTO_TUNNEL_BUNDLE_PATH}" \
1796:       RUSTYNET_AUTO_TUNNEL_VERIFIER_KEY="${AUTO_TUNNEL_VERIFIER_KEY_PATH}" \
1797:       RUSTYNET_AUTO_TUNNEL_WATERMARK="${AUTO_TUNNEL_WATERMARK_PATH}" \
1798:       RUSTYNET_TRAVERSAL_BUNDLE="${TRAVERSAL_BUNDLE_PATH}" \
1799:       RUSTYNET_TRAVERSAL_VERIFIER_KEY="${TRAVERSAL_VERIFIER_KEY_PATH}" \
1800:       RUSTYNET_TRAVERSAL_WATERMARK="${TRAVERSAL_WATERMARK_PATH}" \
1801:       RUSTYNET_WG_PRIVATE_KEY="${WG_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH}" \
1802:       RUSTYNET_WG_ENCRYPTED_PRIVATE_KEY="${WG_ENCRYPTED_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH}" \
1803:       RUSTYNET_WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB="${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH}" \
1804:       RUSTYNET_SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB="${SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH}" \
1805:       RUSTYNET_WG_PUBLIC_KEY="${WG_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH}" \
1806:       RUSTYNET_MEMBERSHIP_SNAPSHOT="${MEMBERSHIP_SNAPSHOT_PATH}" \
1807:       RUSTYNET_MEMBERSHIP_LOG="${MEMBERSHIP_LOG_PATH}" \
1808:       RUSTYNET_MEMBERSHIP_WATERMARK="${MEMBERSHIP_WATERMARK_PATH}" \
1809:       RUSTYNET_MEMBERSHIP_OWNER_SIGNING_KEY="${MEMBERSHIP_OWNER_SIGNING_KEY_PATH}" \
1810:       RUSTYNET_PRIVILEGED_HELPER_SOCKET="${PRIVILEGED_HELPER_SOCKET_PATH}" \
1811:       rustynet ops prepare-system-dirs >/dev/null 2>&1 || rust_ops_status=$?
1812:   elif is_macos_host; then
1813:     env \
1814:       RUSTYNET_HOST_PROFILE="${HOST_PROFILE}" \
1815:       RUSTYNET_MACOS_STATE_BASE="${MACOS_STATE_BASE}" \
1816:       RUSTYNET_MACOS_RUNTIME_BASE="${MACOS_RUNTIME_BASE}" \
1817:       RUSTYNET_MACOS_LOG_BASE="${MACOS_LOG_BASE}" \
1818:       RUSTYNET_STATE="${STATE_PATH}" \
1819:       RUSTYNET_TRUST_EVIDENCE="${TRUST_EVIDENCE_PATH}" \
1820:       RUSTYNET_TRUST_VERIFIER_KEY="${TRUST_VERIFIER_KEY_PATH}" \
1821:       RUSTYNET_TRUST_WATERMARK="${TRUST_WATERMARK_PATH}" \
1822:       RUSTYNET_AUTO_TUNNEL_BUNDLE="${AUTO_TUNNEL_BUNDLE_PATH}" \
1823:       RUSTYNET_AUTO_TUNNEL_VERIFIER_KEY="${AUTO_TUNNEL_VERIFIER_KEY_PATH}" \
1824:       RUSTYNET_AUTO_TUNNEL_WATERMARK="${AUTO_TUNNEL_WATERMARK_PATH}" \
1825:       RUSTYNET_TRAVERSAL_BUNDLE="${TRAVERSAL_BUNDLE_PATH}" \
1826:       RUSTYNET_TRAVERSAL_VERIFIER_KEY="${TRAVERSAL_VERIFIER_KEY_PATH}" \
1827:       RUSTYNET_TRAVERSAL_WATERMARK="${TRAVERSAL_WATERMARK_PATH}" \
1828:       RUSTYNET_WG_PRIVATE_KEY="${WG_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH}" \
1829:       RUSTYNET_WG_ENCRYPTED_PRIVATE_KEY="${WG_ENCRYPTED_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH}" \
1830:       RUSTYNET_WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE="${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_PATH}" \
1831:       RUSTYNET_WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB="${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH}" \
1832:       RUSTYNET_SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB="${SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH}" \
1833:       RUSTYNET_WG_PUBLIC_KEY="${WG_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH}" \
1834:       RUSTYNET_MEMBERSHIP_SNAPSHOT="${MEMBERSHIP_SNAPSHOT_PATH}" \
1835:       RUSTYNET_MEMBERSHIP_LOG="${MEMBERSHIP_LOG_PATH}" \
1836:       RUSTYNET_MEMBERSHIP_WATERMARK="${MEMBERSHIP_WATERMARK_PATH}" \
1837:       RUSTYNET_MEMBERSHIP_OWNER_SIGNING_KEY="${MEMBERSHIP_OWNER_SIGNING_KEY_PATH}" \
1838:       RUSTYNET_PRIVILEGED_HELPER_SOCKET="${PRIVILEGED_HELPER_SOCKET_PATH}" \
1839:       rustynet ops prepare-system-dirs >/dev/null 2>&1 || rust_ops_status=$?
1840:   else
1841:     require_linux_dataplane "prepare_system_directories" || return 0
1842:     return 1
1843:   fi
1844: 
1845:   if [[ "${rust_ops_status}" -ne 0 ]]; then
1846:     print_err "Rust-backed directory preparation failed; setup is fail-closed."
1847:     return 1
1848:   fi
1849:   return 0
1850: }

1852: ensure_wireguard_keys() {
1853:   run_with_scope() {
1854:     if is_linux_host; then
1855:       run_root "$@"
1856:     else
1857:       "$@"
1858:     fi
1859:   }
1860: 
1861:   local legacy_linux_passphrase_path="/etc/rustynet/wireguard.passphrase"
1862:   local wg_init_prompt_approved="0"
1863:   local wg_init_required="0"
1864: 
1865:   if is_linux_host; then
1866:     if [[ -f "${WG_ENCRYPTED_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH}" && -f "${WG_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH}" && -f "${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH}" ]]; then
1867:       wg_init_required="0"
1868:     elif [[ -f "${WG_ENCRYPTED_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH}" && ! -f "${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH}" ]]; then
1869:       wg_init_required="0"
1870:     else
1871:       wg_init_required="1"
1872:     fi
1873:   elif is_macos_host; then
1874:     if [[ -f "${WG_ENCRYPTED_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH}" && -f "${WG_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH}" ]]; then
1875:       wg_init_required="0"
1876:     else
1877:       wg_init_required="1"
1878:     fi
1879:   fi
1880: 
1881:   if [[ "${wg_init_required}" == "1" ]]; then
1882:     if ! prompt_yes_no "Encrypted WireGuard key material is missing. Initialize now?" "y"; then
1883:       print_err "Encrypted WireGuard key material is required."
1884:       unset -f run_with_scope >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
1885:       exit 1
1886:     fi
1887:     wg_init_prompt_approved="1"
1888:   fi
1889: 
1890:   if is_macos_host; then
1891:     ensure_macos_keychain_passphrase_account
1892:     if ! command -v security >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1893:       print_err "macOS keychain tooling is missing ('security' command not found)."
1894:       unset -f run_with_scope >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
1895:       exit 1
1896:     fi
1897:   fi
1898: 
1899:   if ! command -v rustynet >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1900:     print_err "rustynet CLI is required for WireGuard custody bootstrap."
1901:     unset -f run_with_scope >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
1902:     exit 1
1903:   fi
1904: 
1905:   local rust_wg_bootstrap_output=""
1906:   local rust_allow_init="false"
1907:   if [[ "${wg_init_prompt_approved}" == "1" ]]; then
1908:     rust_allow_init="true"
1909:   fi
1910: 
1911:   if ! rust_wg_bootstrap_output="$(run_with_scope env \
1912:     RUSTYNET_HOST_PROFILE="${HOST_PROFILE}" \
1913:     RUSTYNET_WG_PRIVATE_KEY="${WG_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH}" \
1914:     RUSTYNET_WG_ENCRYPTED_PRIVATE_KEY="${WG_ENCRYPTED_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH}" \
1915:     RUSTYNET_WG_PUBLIC_KEY="${WG_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH}" \
1916:     RUSTYNET_WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE="${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_PATH}" \
1917:     RUSTYNET_WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB="${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH}" \
1918:     RUSTYNET_WG_CUSTODY_ALLOW_INIT="${rust_allow_init}" \
1919:     RUSTYNET_MACOS_WG_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE="${MACOS_WG_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE}" \
1920:     RUSTYNET_WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT="${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT}" \
1921:     rustynet ops bootstrap-wireguard-custody 2>&1)"; then
1922:     print_err "Rust-backed WireGuard custody bootstrap failed; setup is fail-closed."
1923:     [[ -n "${rust_wg_bootstrap_output}" ]] && print_err "${rust_wg_bootstrap_output}"
1924:     unset -f run_with_scope >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
1925:     exit 1
1926:   fi
1927: 
1928:   [[ -n "${rust_wg_bootstrap_output}" ]] && print_info "${rust_wg_bootstrap_output}"
1929: 
1930:   if is_linux_host; then
1931:     secure_remove_file_with_scope "${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_PATH}" || {
1932:       unset -f run_with_scope >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
1933:       exit 1
1934:     }
1935:     secure_remove_file_with_scope "${legacy_linux_passphrase_path}" || {
1936:       unset -f run_with_scope >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
1937:       exit 1
1938:     }
1939:   elif is_macos_host; then
1940:     secure_remove_file_with_scope "${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_PATH}" || {
1941:       unset -f run_with_scope >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
1942:       exit 1
1943:     }
1944:   fi
1945: 
1946:   unset -f run_with_scope >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
1947:   return 0
1948: }

1950: ensure_membership_files() {
1951:   if ! command -v rustynet >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1952:     print_err "rustynet CLI is required for membership initialization."
1953:     return 1
1954:   fi
1955: 
1956:   local rust_ops_status=1
1957:   if is_linux_host; then
1958:     run_root env \
1959:       RUSTYNET_HOST_PROFILE="${HOST_PROFILE}" \
1960:       RUSTYNET_NODE_ROLE="${NODE_ROLE}" \
1961:       RUSTYNET_NODE_ID="${DEVICE_NODE_ID}" \
1962:       RUSTYNET_NETWORK_ID="local-net" \
1963:       RUSTYNET_MEMBERSHIP_SNAPSHOT="${MEMBERSHIP_SNAPSHOT_PATH}" \
1964:       RUSTYNET_MEMBERSHIP_LOG="${MEMBERSHIP_LOG_PATH}" \

1989:   else

1991:     return 1
1992:   fi
1993:

2001:     print_info "Removed local membership owner signing key for blind_exit least-knowledge role."
2002:   fi
2003:   return 0

2072: refresh_signed_trust_evidence() {
2073:   if ! is_admin_role && ! is_blind_exit_role; then

2080:     return 1
2081:   fi

2084:     print_err "rustynet CLI is required for signed trust refresh."
2085:     return 1

2107:     if ! rust_refresh_output="$(env \
2108:       RUSTYNET_HOST_PROFILE="${HOST_PROFILE}" \
2109:       RUSTYNET_NODE_ROLE="${NODE_ROLE}" \

2113:       RUSTYNET_SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB="${SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB_PATH}" \
2114:       RUSTYNET_MEMBERSHIP_OWNER_SIGNING_KEY="${MEMBERSHIP_OWNER_SIGNING_KEY_PATH}" \

2117:       RUSTYNET_SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT="${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT}" \
2118:       rustynet ops refresh-signed-trust 2>&1)"; then
2119:       print_err "Rust-backed signed trust refresh failed; setup is fail-closed."
2120:       [[ -n "${rust_refresh_output}" ]] && print_err "${rust_refresh_output}"

2125:     return 1
2126:   fi
2127:   [[ -n "${rust_refresh_output}" ]] && print_info "${rust_refresh_output}"

2132: configure_trust_material() {
2133:   install_trust_material_with_rust() {
2134:     local verifier_source="$1"
2135:     local trust_source="$2"
2136:     local rust_install_output=""
2137:     if ! rust_install_output="$(
2138:       run_rustynet_ops_with_scope install-trust-material \
2139:         --verifier-source "${verifier_source}" \
2140:         --trust-source "${trust_source}" \
2141:         --verifier-dest "${TRUST_VERIFIER_KEY_PATH}" \
2142:         --trust-dest "${TRUST_EVIDENCE_PATH}" \
2143:         --daemon-group "${RUSTYNET_DAEMON_GROUP:-rustynetd}" 2>&1
2144:     )"; then
2145:       print_err "Rust-backed trust material install failed; setup is fail-closed."
2146:       [[ -n "${rust_install_output}" ]] && print_err "${rust_install_output}"
2147:       return 1
2148:     fi
2149:     [[ -n "${rust_install_output}" ]] && print_info "${rust_install_output}"
2150:     return 0
2151:   }
2152: 
2153:   if is_blind_exit_role; then
2154:     print_info "blind_exit role detected: provisioning local trust material for unattended operation."
2155:     local signing_passphrase_file=""
2156:     if ! materialize_signing_passphrase_file signing_passphrase_file; then
2157:       return 1
2158:     fi
2159:     if ! ensure_local_trust_material_with_rust "${signing_passphrase_file}"; then
2160:       secure_remove_file_with_scope "${signing_passphrase_file}" || return 1
2161:       return 1
2162:     fi
2163:     secure_remove_file_with_scope "${signing_passphrase_file}"
2164:     refresh_signed_trust_evidence
2165:     AUTO_REFRESH_TRUST="1"
2166:     return 0
2167:   fi
2168: 
2169:   if is_client_role; then
2170:     print_info "Client role detected: trust signer operations are disabled."
2171:     local source_verifier
2172:     local source_trust
2173:     prompt_default source_verifier "Path to verifier key (32-byte hex line)" "${TRUST_VERIFIER_KEY_PATH}"
2174:     prompt_default source_trust "Path to signed trust evidence file" "${TRUST_EVIDENCE_PATH}"
2175:     if ! install_trust_material_with_rust "${source_verifier}" "${source_trust}"; then
2176:       return 1
2177:     fi
2178:     AUTO_REFRESH_TRUST="0"
2179:     return 0
2180:   fi
2181:   print_info "Trust material setup:"
2182:   echo "  1) Lab mode (generate local signer key and auto-refresh trust evidence)"
2183:   echo "  2) Bring externally signed trust evidence + verifier key"
2184:   local choice
2185:   read -r -p "Choose mode [1/2, default 2]: " choice
2186:   choice="${choice:-2}"
2187:   if [[ "${choice}" != "1" && "${choice}" != "2" ]]; then
2188:     print_err "Invalid trust mode '${choice}'. Expected 1 or 2."
2189:     return 1
2190:   fi
2191: 
2192:   if [[ "${choice}" == "1" ]]; then
2193:     local lab_ack
2194:     print_warn "Lab mode reduces trust separation and is intended for local development only."
2195:     read -r -p "Type 'LAB_MODE_ACK' to continue in lab mode: " lab_ack
2196:     if [[ "${lab_ack}" != "LAB_MODE_ACK" ]]; then
2197:       print_err "Lab mode confirmation mismatch."
2198:       return 1
2199:     fi
2200:     local signing_passphrase_file=""
2201:     if ! materialize_signing_passphrase_file signing_passphrase_file; then
2202:       return 1
2203:     fi
2204:     if ! ensure_local_trust_material_with_rust "${signing_passphrase_file}"; then
2205:       secure_remove_file_with_scope "${signing_passphrase_file}" || return 1
2206:       return 1
2207:     fi
2208:     secure_remove_file_with_scope "${signing_passphrase_file}"
2209:     refresh_signed_trust_evidence
2210:     AUTO_REFRESH_TRUST="1"
2211:     return
2212:   fi
2213: 
2214:   local source_verifier
2215:   local source_trust
2216:   prompt_default source_verifier "Path to verifier key (32-byte hex line)" "${TRUST_VERIFIER_KEY_PATH}"
2217:   prompt_default source_trust "Path to signed trust evidence file" "${TRUST_EVIDENCE_PATH}"
2218:   if ! install_trust_material_with_rust "${source_verifier}" "${source_trust}"; then
2219:     return 1
2220:   fi
2221: 
2222:   if prompt_yes_no "Do you also have signer key access for auto-refresh?" "n"; then
2223:     prompt_default TRUST_SIGNER_KEY_PATH "Signer key path" "${TRUST_SIGNER_KEY_PATH}"
2224:     AUTO_REFRESH_TRUST="1"
2225:   else
2226:     AUTO_REFRESH_TRUST="0"
2227:   fi
2228: }

2257: macos_wait_for_socket() {
2258:   local socket_path="$1"
2259:   local attempts=50
2260:   while (( attempts > 0 )); do
2261:     if [[ -S "${socket_path}" ]]; then
2262:       return 0
2263:     fi
2264:     sleep 0.1
2265:     attempts=$((attempts - 1))
2266:   done
2267:   return 1
2268: }

2270: resolve_absolute_command_path() {
2271:   local cmd_name="$1"
2272:   local resolved
2273:   resolved="$(command -v "${cmd_name}" 2>/dev/null || true)"
2274:   if [[ -n "${resolved}" && "${resolved}" != /* ]]; then
2275:     resolved="$(type -P "${cmd_name}" 2>/dev/null || true)"
2276:   fi
2277:   if [[ -z "${resolved}" || "${resolved}" != /* ]]; then
2278:     return 1
2279:   fi
2280:   printf '%s' "${resolved}"
2281: }
2282: 
2283: require_root_owned_binary_path() {
2284:   local binary_path="$1"
2285:   local label="$2"
2286:   local owner_uid=""
2287:   if stat -c '%u' "${binary_path}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2288:     owner_uid="$(stat -c '%u' "${binary_path}")"
2289:   elif stat -f '%u' "${binary_path}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2290:     owner_uid="$(stat -f '%u' "${binary_path}")"
2291:   fi
2292:   if [[ -z "${owner_uid}" ]]; then
2293:     print_err "Unable to determine owner for ${label} binary at ${binary_path}"
2294:     return 1
2295:   fi
2296:   if [[ "${owner_uid}" != "0" ]]; then
2297:     print_err "${label} binary must be root-owned for privileged runtime safety: ${binary_path}"
2298:     return 1
2299:   fi
2300: }

2302: validate_macos_passphrase_source_contract() {
2303:   if ! is_macos_host; then
2304:     return 0
2305:   fi
2306:   ensure_macos_keychain_passphrase_account
2307:   if [[ -z "${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT}" ]]; then
2308:     print_err "macOS keychain account for passphrase custody is empty."
2309:     return 1
2310:   fi
2311:   if ! [[ "${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT}" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ ]]; then
2312:     print_err "macOS keychain account has invalid characters: ${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT}"
2313:     return 1
2314:   fi
2315:   if [[ "${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_PATH}" != /* ]]; then
2316:     print_err "macOS passphrase placeholder path must be absolute: ${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_PATH}"
2317:     return 1
2318:   fi
2319:   if ! command -v security >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2320:     print_err "macOS keychain tooling is unavailable: security command not found."
2321:     return 1
2322:   fi
2323:   if [[ -f "${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_PATH}" ]]; then
2324:     print_err "Persistent plaintext passphrase file is not allowed on macOS: ${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_PATH}"
2325:     print_info "Delete the file and rerun setup to keep passphrase custody in Keychain only."
2326:     return 1
2327:   fi
2328:   if ! macos_keychain_passphrase_exists; then
2329:     print_err "macOS keychain passphrase item is missing (service=${MACOS_WG_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE}, account=${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT})."
2330:     print_info "Run first-run setup to provision Keychain-backed passphrase custody."
2331:     return 1
2332:   fi
2333:   return 0
2334: }

2385:   export RUSTYNET_PFCTL_BINARY_PATH="${pfctl_bin}"

2390: macos_restart_runtime_service_rust_only() {
2391:   local invocation_context="${1:-macOS runtime service restart}"
2392:   if ! is_macos_host; then
2393:     print_err "${invocation_context} is only supported on macOS hosts."
2394:     return 1
2395:   fi
2396:   if ! command -v rustynet >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2397:     print_err "rustynet CLI is required for macOS runtime service restart."
2398:     return 1
2399:   fi
2400:   if ! configure_macos_binary_path_env; then
2401:     print_err "Failed to resolve macOS privileged binary paths."
2402:     return 1
2403:   fi
2404:   if ! validate_macos_passphrase_source_contract; then
2405:     print_err "macOS passphrase source contract failed; refusing daemon restart."
2406:     return 1
2407:   fi
2408: 
2409:   local auto_tunnel_enforce_bool fail_closed_ssh_allow_bool
2410:   auto_tunnel_enforce_bool="false"
2411:   fail_closed_ssh_allow_bool="false"
2412:   if [[ "${AUTO_TUNNEL_ENFORCE}" == "1" ]]; then
2413:     auto_tunnel_enforce_bool="true"
2414:   fi
2415:   if [[ "${FAIL_CLOSED_SSH_ALLOW}" == "1" ]]; then
2416:     fail_closed_ssh_allow_bool="true"
2417:   fi
2418: 
2419:   local rust_restart_output=""
2420:   if ! rust_restart_output="$(run_root env \

2483: macos_stop_runtime_service_rust_only() {
2484:   local invocation_context="${1:-macOS runtime service stop}"

2487:     return 1

2490:     print_err "rustynet CLI is required for macOS runtime service stop."

2492:   fi
2493:   local rust_stop_output=""

2495:     RUSTYNET_MACOS_DAEMON_UID="$(id -u)" \

2500:     RUSTYNET_SOCKET="${SOCKET_PATH}" \
2501:     RUSTYNET_PRIVILEGED_HELPER_SOCKET="${PRIVILEGED_HELPER_SOCKET_PATH}" \
2502:     rustynet ops stop-runtime-service 2>&1)"; then
2503:     print_err "Rust-backed macOS runtime stop failed (${invocation_context})."
2504:     [[ -n "${rust_stop_output}" ]] && print_err "${rust_stop_output}"

2526: start_or_restart_service() {
2527:   if ! doctor_preflight; then
2528:     print_err "Refusing to start service until preflight doctor passes."
2529:     return 1
2530:   fi
2531:   if is_blind_exit_role; then
2532:     lockdown_blind_exit_local_material || return 1
2533:   fi
2534:   write_daemon_environment
2535:   if [[ "${AUTO_REFRESH_TRUST}" == "1" && -f "${TRUST_SIGNER_KEY_PATH}" ]]; then
2536:     if ! refresh_signed_trust_evidence; then
2537:       print_err "Failed to refresh trust evidence before start; refusing daemon start."
2538:       return 1
2539:     fi
2540:   fi
2541: 
2542:   if is_linux_host; then
2543:     if ! command -v rustynet >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2544:       print_err "rustynet CLI is required for Linux runtime service status."
2545:       return 1
2546:     fi
2547:     local rust_runtime_status_output=""
2548:     if ! rust_runtime_status_output="$(run_root rustynet ops show-runtime-service-status 2>&1)"; then
2549:       print_warn "Unable to read rustynetd.service status after Rust-backed restart."
2550:       [[ -n "${rust_runtime_status_output}" ]] && print_warn "${rust_runtime_status_output}"
2551:     elif [[ -n "${rust_runtime_status_output}" ]]; then
2552:       printf '%s\n' "${rust_runtime_status_output}"
2553:     fi
2554:     return
2555:   fi
2556: 
2557:   if is_macos_host; then
2558:     if ! macos_restart_runtime_service_rust_only "start_or_restart_service"; then
2559:       return 1
2560:     fi
2561:     show_service_status
2562:     return
2563:   fi
2564: 
2565:   require_linux_dataplane "start_or_restart_service" || return 0
2566: }
2567: 
2568: stop_service() {
2569:   if is_linux_host; then
2570:     if ! command -v rustynet >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2571:       print_err "rustynet CLI is required for Linux runtime service stop."
2572:       return 1
2573:     fi
2574:     local rust_stop_output=""
2575:     if ! rust_stop_output="$(run_root rustynet ops stop-runtime-service 2>&1)"; then
2576:       print_err "Rust-backed runtime stop failed."
2577:       [[ -n "${rust_stop_output}" ]] && print_err "${rust_stop_output}"
2578:       return 1
2579:     fi
2580:     [[ -n "${rust_stop_output}" ]] && print_info "${rust_stop_output}"
2581:     return
2582:   fi
2583:   if is_macos_host; then
2584:     if ! macos_stop_runtime_service_rust_only "stop_service"; then
2585:       return 1
2586:     fi
2587:     return
2588:   fi
2589:   require_linux_dataplane "stop_service" || return 0
2590: }

2592: disconnect_vpn() {
2593:   if is_macos_host; then
2594:     local had_error=0
2595:     print_info "Disabling exit-node mode before shutdown..."
2596:     if [[ -S "${SOCKET_PATH}" ]]; then
2597:       if ! disable_exit_selection >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2598:         print_err "Failed to disable exit-node mode before disconnect."
2599:         had_error=1
2600:       fi
2601:     else
2602:       print_info "Daemon socket not present; skipping exit-node disable."
2603:     fi
2604:     if ! command -v rustynet >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2605:       print_err "rustynet CLI is required for macOS disconnect cleanup."
2606:       return 1
2607:     fi
2608:     local rust_disconnect_output=""
2609:     if ! rust_disconnect_output="$(run_root env \
2610:       RUSTYNET_WG_INTERFACE="${WG_INTERFACE}" \
2611:       RUSTYNET_MACOS_DAEMON_UID="$(id -u)" \
2612:       RUSTYNET_MACOS_LAUNCHD_DAEMON_LABEL="${MACOS_LAUNCHD_DAEMON_LABEL}" \
2613:       RUSTYNET_MACOS_LAUNCHD_HELPER_LABEL="${MACOS_LAUNCHD_HELPER_LABEL}" \
2614:       RUSTYNET_MACOS_LAUNCHD_DAEMON_PLIST="${MACOS_LAUNCHD_DAEMON_PLIST_PATH}" \
2615:       RUSTYNET_MACOS_LAUNCHD_HELPER_PLIST="${MACOS_LAUNCHD_HELPER_PLIST_PATH}" \
2616:       RUSTYNET_SOCKET="${SOCKET_PATH}" \
2617:       RUSTYNET_PRIVILEGED_HELPER_SOCKET="${PRIVILEGED_HELPER_SOCKET_PATH}" \
2618:       rustynet ops disconnect-cleanup 2>&1)"; then
2619:       print_err "Rust-backed macOS disconnect cleanup failed."
2620:       [[ -n "${rust_disconnect_output}" ]] && print_err "${rust_disconnect_output}"
2621:       had_error=1
2622:     elif [[ -n "${rust_disconnect_output}" ]]; then
2623:       print_info "${rust_disconnect_output}"
2624:     fi
2625:     if [[ "${had_error}" -ne 0 ]]; then
2626:       print_err "Rustynet disconnect completed with residual-state errors."
2627:       return 1
2628:     fi
2629:     print_info "Rustynet VPN disconnected."
2630:     return
2631:   fi
2632: 
2633:   require_linux_dataplane "disconnect_vpn" || return 0
2634:   if ! command -v rustynet >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2635:     print_err "rustynet CLI is required for Linux disconnect cleanup."
2636:     return 1
2637:   fi
2638: 
2639:   local rust_disconnect_output=""
2640:   if ! rust_disconnect_output="$(run_root env \
2641:     RUSTYNET_WG_INTERFACE="${WG_INTERFACE}" \
2642:     rustynet ops disconnect-cleanup 2>&1)"; then
2643:     print_err "Rust-backed disconnect cleanup failed; operation is fail-closed."
2644:     [[ -n "${rust_disconnect_output}" ]] && print_err "${rust_disconnect_output}"
2645:     return 1
2646:   fi
2647:   [[ -n "${rust_disconnect_output}" ]] && print_info "${rust_disconnect_output}"
2648:   print_info "Rustynet VPN disconnected. Device is now using normal internet connectivity."
2649: }

2661:       return

2664:     return
2665:   fi
2666:   if is_macos_host; then
2667:     if ! command -v rustynet >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2668:       print_warn "rustynet CLI is required to inspect macOS runtime service status."
2669:       return
2670:     fi
2671:     local rust_runtime_status_output=""
2672:     if ! rust_runtime_status_output="$(run_root env \
2673:       RUSTYNET_MACOS_DAEMON_UID="$(id -u)" \
2674:       RUSTYNET_MACOS_LAUNCHD_DAEMON_LABEL="${MACOS_LAUNCHD_DAEMON_LABEL}" \
2675:       RUSTYNET_MACOS_LAUNCHD_HELPER_LABEL="${MACOS_LAUNCHD_HELPER_LABEL}" \
2676:       RUSTYNET_MACOS_LAUNCHD_DAEMON_PLIST="${MACOS_LAUNCHD_DAEMON_PLIST_PATH}" \
2677:       RUSTYNET_MACOS_LAUNCHD_HELPER_PLIST="${MACOS_LAUNCHD_HELPER_PLIST_PATH}" \
2678:       RUSTYNET_SOCKET="${SOCKET_PATH}" \
2679:       RUSTYNET_PRIVILEGED_HELPER_SOCKET="${PRIVILEGED_HELPER_SOCKET_PATH}" \
2680:       rustynet ops show-runtime-service-status 2>&1)"; then
2681:       print_warn "Unable to read macOS runtime service status."
2682:       [[ -n "${rust_runtime_status_output}" ]] && print_warn "${rust_runtime_status_output}"

2686:     return

2691: ensure_peer_store() {
2692:   local output=""
2693:   if ! output="$(run_rustynet_cli ops peer-store-validate --config-dir "${CONFIG_DIR}" --peers-file "${PEERS_FILE}" 2>&1)"; then
2694:     print_err "Peer-store validation failed."
2695:     if [[ -n "${output}" ]]; then
2696:       print_err "${output}"
2697:     fi
2698:     return 1
2699:   fi
2700: }

2702: peer_store_list_records() {
2703:   local role_filter="${1:-}"
2704:   local node_id_filter="${2:-}"
2705:   local args=(ops peer-store-list --config-dir "${CONFIG_DIR}" --peers-file "${PEERS_FILE}")
2706:   if [[ -n "${role_filter}" ]]; then
2707:     args+=(--role "${role_filter}")
2708:   fi
2709:   if [[ -n "${node_id_filter}" ]]; then
2710:     args+=(--node-id "${node_id_filter}")
2711:   fi
2712:   run_rustynet_cli "${args[@]}"
2713: }
2714: 
2715: peer_endpoint_host() {
2716:   local endpoint="$1"
2717:   if [[ -z "${endpoint}" ]]; then
2718:     return 1
2719:   fi
2720:   if [[ "${endpoint}" =~ ^\[([^]]+)\]:[0-9]+$ ]]; then
2721:     printf '%s' "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
2722:     return 0
2723:   fi
2724:   if [[ "${endpoint}" =~ ^([^:]+):[0-9]+$ ]]; then
2725:     printf '%s' "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
2726:     return 0
2727:   fi
2728:   printf '%s' "${endpoint}"
2729: }
2730: 
2731: probe_peer_online_status() {
2732:   local endpoint="$1"
2733:   local host
2734:   if ! host="$(peer_endpoint_host "${endpoint}")"; then
2735:     printf 'unknown'
2736:     return 0
2737:   fi
2738:   if [[ -z "${host}" ]]; then
2739:     printf 'unknown'
2740:     return 0
2741:   fi
2742:   if ! command -v ping >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2743:     printf 'unknown'
2744:     return 0
2745:   fi
2746:   if is_linux_host; then
2747:     if ping -n -c 1 -W 1 "${host}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2748:       printf 'online'
2749:     else
2750:       printf 'offline'
2751:     fi
2752:     return 0
2753:   fi
2754:   if is_macos_host; then
2755:     if ping -n -c 1 -W 1000 "${host}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2756:       printf 'online'
2757:     else
2758:       printf 'offline'
2759:     fi
2760:     return 0
2761:   fi
2762:   if ping -n -c 1 "${host}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2763:     printf 'online'
2764:   else
2765:     printf 'offline'
2766:   fi
2767: }
2768: 
2769: print_saved_peers() {
2770:   local records_output name node_id public_key endpoint cidr role status
2771:   if ! records_output="$(peer_store_list_records 2>&1)"; then
2772:     print_err "Unable to read peer store."
2773:     print_err "${records_output}"
2774:     return 1
2775:   fi
2776:   while IFS='|' read -r name node_id public_key endpoint cidr role _rest; do
2777:     if [[ "${name}" == \#* || -z "${name}" ]]; then
2778:       continue
2779:     fi
2780:     if [[ -z "${node_id}" || -z "${endpoint}" || -z "${cidr}" ]]; then
2781:       continue
2782:     fi
2783:     if [[ -z "${role}" ]]; then
2784:       role="unknown"
2785:     fi
2786:     status="$(probe_peer_online_status "${endpoint}")"
2787:     printf '  - %s (node=%s endpoint=%s cidr=%s role=%s status=%s)\n' \
2788:       "${name}" "${node_id}" "${endpoint}" "${cidr}" "${role}" "${status}"
2789:   done <<< "${records_output}"
2790: }
2791: 
2792: print_saved_admin_peers() {
2793:   local records_output name node_id public_key endpoint cidr role
2794:   if ! records_output="$(peer_store_list_records "admin" 2>&1)"; then
2795:     print_err "Unable to read admin peer records."
2796:     print_err "${records_output}"
2797:     return 1
2798:   fi
2799:   while IFS='|' read -r name node_id public_key endpoint cidr role _rest; do
2800:     if [[ -z "${name}" || -z "${node_id}" || -z "${endpoint}" || -z "${cidr}" ]]; then
2801:       continue
2802:     fi
2803:     printf '  - %s (node=%s endpoint=%s cidr=%s)\n' \
2804:       "${name}" "${node_id}" "${endpoint}" "${cidr}"
2805:   done <<< "${records_output}"
2806: }

2808: find_peer_record_by_node_id() {
2809:   local node_id="$1"
2810:   local records_output line
2811:   if [[ -z "${node_id}" ]]; then
2812:     return 0
2813:   fi
2814:   if ! records_output="$(peer_store_list_records "" "${node_id}" 2>/dev/null)"; then
2815:     return 1
2816:   fi
2817:   while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "${line}" ]]; do
2818:     if [[ -n "${line}" ]]; then
2819:       printf '%s\n' "${line}"
2820:       break
2821:     fi
2822:   done <<< "${records_output}"
2823: }

2825: run_rustynet_cli() {
2826:   if ! command -v rustynet >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2827:     print_err "rustynet CLI not found in PATH."
2828:     return 1
2829:   fi
2830:   RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET="${SOCKET_PATH}" rustynet "$@"
2831: }

2833: wait_for_daemon_socket_ready() {
2834:   local attempts="${1:-20}"
2835:   if [[ -z "${SOCKET_PATH}" ]]; then
2836:     return 1
2837:   fi
2838:   while (( attempts > 0 )); do
2839:     if [[ -S "${SOCKET_PATH}" ]]; then
2840:       return 0
2841:     fi
2842:     sleep 1
2843:     attempts=$((attempts - 1))
2844:   done
2845:   return 1
2846: }

2849:   local node_id="$1"
2850:   [[ "${node_id}" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ ]]
2851: }

2853: local_assignment_refresh_available() {

2858:     return 1
2859:   fi
2860:   run_root env \
2861:     RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_REFRESH_ENV_PATH="${ASSIGNMENT_REFRESH_ENV_PATH}" \
2862:     rustynet ops check-assignment-refresh-availability >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
2863:   return 0
2864: }

2866: set_local_assignment_refresh_exit_node() {
2867:   local exit_node_id="${1:-}"
2868: 
2869:   if ! is_linux_host; then
2870:     return 0
2871:   fi
2872:   if ! local_assignment_refresh_available; then
2873:     print_warn "Assignment refresh is not configured locally; skipping persisted exit-node update."
2874:     return 1
2875:   fi
2876:   if [[ -n "${exit_node_id}" ]] && ! is_valid_node_id_value "${exit_node_id}"; then
2877:     print_err "Invalid exit node id '${exit_node_id}'. Allowed characters: letters, numbers, dot, underscore, hyphen."
2878:     return 1
2879:   fi
2880: 
2881:   if ! command -v rustynet >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2882:     print_err "rustynet CLI is required for assignment refresh env updates."
2883:     return 1
2884:   fi
2885: 
2886:   if [[ -n "${exit_node_id}" ]]; then
2887:     if ! run_root rustynet ops set-assignment-refresh-exit-node \
2888:       --env-path "${ASSIGNMENT_REFRESH_ENV_PATH}" \
2889:       --exit-node-id "${exit_node_id}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2890:       print_err "Rust-backed assignment refresh env update failed; setup is fail-closed."
2891:       return 1
2892:     fi
2893:   else
2894:     if ! run_root rustynet ops set-assignment-refresh-exit-node \
2895:       --env-path "${ASSIGNMENT_REFRESH_ENV_PATH}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2896:       print_err "Rust-backed assignment refresh env update failed; setup is fail-closed."
2897:       return 1
2898:     fi
2899:   fi
2900: 
2901:   if [[ -n "${exit_node_id}" ]]; then
2902:     print_info "Persisted preferred exit node in ${ASSIGNMENT_REFRESH_ENV_PATH}: ${exit_node_id}"
2903:   else
2904:     print_info "Cleared preferred exit node from ${ASSIGNMENT_REFRESH_ENV_PATH}."
2905:   fi
2906:   return 0
2907: }

2909: force_local_assignment_refresh_now() {
2910:   if ! is_linux_host; then
2911:     return 0
2912:   fi
2913:   if ! local_assignment_refresh_available; then
2914:     print_warn "Assignment refresh service is unavailable; skipping forced local assignment refresh."
2915:     return 1
2916:   fi
2917: 
2918:   print_info "Forcing local assignment bundle refresh (signed) to apply role/exit changes immediately."
2919:   if ! command -v rustynet >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2920:     print_warn "rustynet CLI is required to run forced local assignment refresh."
2921:     return 1
2922:   fi
2923:   local rust_assignment_refresh_output=""
2924:   if ! rust_assignment_refresh_output="$(run_root env \
2925:     RUSTYNET_AUTO_TUNNEL_BUNDLE="${AUTO_TUNNEL_BUNDLE_PATH}" \

2929:     print_warn "Rust-backed forced local assignment refresh failed."
2930:     [[ -n "${rust_assignment_refresh_output}" ]] && print_warn "${rust_assignment_refresh_output}"
2931:     return 1

2937: switch_node_role_mode() {
2938:   local previous_role target_role preferred_exit_node enable_exit_advertise
2939:   local enable_exit_advertise_bool
2940:   local role_confirm_default
2941: 
2942:   normalize_node_role
2943:   if blind_exit_role_locked; then
2944:     print_blind_exit_lock_notice
2945:     return 1
2946:   fi
2947:   previous_role="${NODE_ROLE}"
2948:   print_info "Current node role: ${previous_role}"
2949:   prompt_default target_role "Target node role (admin|client)" "${NODE_ROLE}"
2950: 
2951:   case "${target_role}" in
2952:     admin|client) ;;
2953:     *)
2954:       print_err "Unsupported role '${target_role}'. Expected 'admin' or 'client'."
2955:       return 1
2956:       ;;
2957:   esac
2958: 
2959:   if [[ "${target_role}" == "${previous_role}" ]]; then
2960:     print_info "Node is already configured as '${target_role}'."
2961:     return 0
2962:   fi
2963: 
2964:   preferred_exit_node=""
2965:   enable_exit_advertise="0"
2966:   if [[ "${target_role}" == "admin" ]]; then
2967:     role_confirm_default="n"
2968:     if [[ "${previous_role}" == "admin" ]]; then
2969:       role_confirm_default="y"
2970:     fi
2971:     if ! prompt_yes_no "Confirm switch to admin role (full control-plane privileges)" "${role_confirm_default}"; then
2972:       print_info "Role switch cancelled."
2973:       return 0
2974:     fi
2975:     if prompt_yes_no "Enable exit serving now (advertise 0.0.0.0/0 after switch)?" "y"; then
2976:       enable_exit_advertise="1"
2977:     fi
2978:   else
2979:     prompt_default preferred_exit_node "Preferred exit node id after switch (blank for none)" ""
2980:     if [[ -n "${preferred_exit_node}" ]] && ! is_valid_node_id_value "${preferred_exit_node}"; then
2981:       print_err "Invalid exit node id '${preferred_exit_node}'. Allowed characters: letters, numbers, dot, underscore, hyphen."
2982:       return 1
2983:     fi
2984:   fi
2985: 
2986:   NODE_ROLE="${target_role}"
2987:   enforce_role_policy_defaults
2988:   save_config
2989: 
2990:   if [[ "${SETUP_COMPLETE}" != "1" ]]; then
2991:     print_warn "Setup is not complete; role updated in config only."
2992:     return 0
2993:   fi
2994: 
2995:   write_daemon_environment
2996:   if ! start_or_restart_service; then
2997:     print_err "Role switch aborted because service restart failed."
2998:     return 1
2999:   fi
3000:   if ! wait_for_daemon_socket_ready 20; then
3001:     print_warn "Daemon socket did not become ready after role switch; deferred actions may fail."
3002:   fi
3003: 
3004:   if is_linux_host; then
3005:     enable_exit_advertise_bool="false"
3006:     if [[ "${enable_exit_advertise}" == "1" ]]; then
3007:       enable_exit_advertise_bool="true"
3008:     fi
3009:     if ! command -v rustynet >/dev/null 2>&1; then
3010:       print_err "rustynet CLI is required for role-coupling operations."
3011:       return 1
3012:     fi
3013:     local role_coupling_cmd=(rustynet ops apply-role-coupling \
3014:       --target-role "${target_role}" \
3015:       --enable-exit-advertise "${enable_exit_advertise_bool}" \
3016:       --env-path "${ASSIGNMENT_REFRESH_ENV_PATH}")
3017:     if [[ -n "${preferred_exit_node}" ]]; then
3018:       role_coupling_cmd+=(--preferred-exit-node-id "${preferred_exit_node}")
3019:     fi
3020:     if ! run_root env \
3021:       RUSTYNET_SOCKET="${SOCKET_PATH}" \
3022:       RUSTYNET_AUTO_TUNNEL_BUNDLE="${AUTO_TUNNEL_BUNDLE_PATH}" \
3023:       RUSTYNET_AUTO_TUNNEL_WATERMARK="${AUTO_TUNNEL_WATERMARK_PATH}" \
3024:       "${role_coupling_cmd[@]}"; then
3025:       print_err "Rust-backed role coupling failed; setup is fail-closed."
3026:       return 1
3027:     fi
3028:   else
3029:     if [[ "${target_role}" == "client" && -n "${preferred_exit_node}" ]]; then
3030:       if ! apply_exit_selection_change "${preferred_exit_node}"; then
3031:         print_err "Failed to select exit node '${preferred_exit_node}' during role switch."
3032:         return 1
3033:       fi
3034:     elif [[ "${target_role}" == "admin" && "${enable_exit_advertise}" == "1" ]]; then
3035:       if ! offer_device_as_exit_node; then
3036:         print_err "Failed to advertise device as exit node during role switch."
3037:         return 1
3038:       fi
3039:     fi
3040:   fi
3041: 
3042:   refresh_menu_runtime_status
3043:   print_info "Node role switched: ${previous_role} -> ${target_role}"
3044:   if [[ "${target_role}" == "admin" ]]; then
3045:     print_warn "Peers can route through this node only when signed assignments include this node and allow rules."
3046:   fi
3047: }

3049: restore_exit_selection() {
3050:   local original_exit_node="$1"
3051:   if [[ -n "${original_exit_node}" && "${original_exit_node}" != "none" ]]; then
3052:     if ! apply_exit_selection_change "${original_exit_node}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
3053:       print_err "Failed to restore exit node selection '${original_exit_node}' after readiness probe."
3054:       return 1
3055:     fi
3056:   else
3057:     if ! apply_exit_selection_change "" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
3058:       print_err "Failed to clear temporary exit node selection after readiness probe."
3059:       return 1
3060:     fi
3061:   fi
3062:   return 0
3063: }

3065: extract_status_field() {
3066:   local status_line="$1"
3067:   local key="$2"
3068:   awk -v key="${key}" '{
3069:     for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) {
3070:       if (index($i, key "=") == 1) {
3071:         print substr($i, length(key) + 2)
3072:         exit
3073:       }
3074:     }
3075:   }' <<<"${status_line}"
3076: }

3078: current_exit_node_from_status() {
3079:   local status_line
3080:   status_line="$(run_rustynet_cli status 2>/dev/null || true)"
3081:   local current_exit
3082:   current_exit="$(extract_status_field "${status_line}" "exit_node")"
3083:   if [[ "${current_exit}" == "none" ]]; then
3084:     current_exit=""
3085:   fi
3086:   printf '%s' "${current_exit}"
3087: }
3088: 
3089: wait_for_exit_node_state() {
3090:   local expected_node="$1"
3091:   local attempts="${2:-12}"
3092:   local current
3093:   while (( attempts > 0 )); do
3094:     current="$(current_exit_node_from_status)"
3095:     if [[ "${current}" == "${expected_node}" ]]; then
3096:       return 0
3097:     fi
3098:     sleep 1
3099:     attempts=$((attempts - 1))
3100:   done
3101:   return 1
3102: }
3103: 
3104: apply_exit_selection_change() {
3105:   local target_node="${1:-}"
3106:   if [[ -n "${target_node}" ]] && ! is_valid_node_id_value "${target_node}"; then
3107:     print_err "Invalid exit node id '${target_node}'. Allowed characters: letters, numbers, dot, underscore, hyphen."
3108:     return 1
3109:   fi
3110: 
3111:   if is_linux_host; then
3112:     if ! local_assignment_refresh_available; then
3113:       print_err "Signed assignment refresh is required for exit-node changes on Linux; local assignment refresh is unavailable."
3114:       return 1
3115:     fi
3116:     set_local_assignment_refresh_exit_node "${target_node}" || return 1
3117:     force_local_assignment_refresh_now || return 1
3118:     if ! wait_for_exit_node_state "${target_node}" 12; then
3119:       if [[ -n "${target_node}" ]]; then
3120:         print_warn "Daemon did not report exit node '${target_node}' after signed assignment refresh."
3121:       else
3122:         print_warn "Daemon did not report cleared exit selection after signed assignment refresh."
3123:       fi
3124:     fi
3125:     return 0
3126:   fi
3127: 
3128:   if is_macos_host; then
3129:     if [[ -n "${target_node}" ]]; then
3130:       run_rustynet_cli exit-node select "${target_node}"
3131:     else
3132:       run_rustynet_cli exit-node off
3133:     fi
3134:     return $?
3135:   fi
3136: 
3137:   print_err "Exit-node changes are unsupported on this host profile."
3138:   return 1
3139: }

3185: exit_chain_label() {
3186:   if [[ "${EXIT_CHAIN_HOPS}" == "2" && -n "${EXIT_CHAIN_ENTRY_NODE_ID}" && -n "${EXIT_CHAIN_FINAL_NODE_ID}" ]]; then
3187:     printf '2-hop(%s->%s)' "${EXIT_CHAIN_ENTRY_NODE_ID}" "${EXIT_CHAIN_FINAL_NODE_ID}"
3188:     return
3189:   fi
3190:   if [[ -n "${EXIT_CHAIN_ENTRY_NODE_ID}" ]]; then
3191:     printf '1-hop(%s)' "${EXIT_CHAIN_ENTRY_NODE_ID}"
3192:     return
3193:   fi
3194:   printf 'none'

3197: refresh_menu_runtime_status() {
3198:   MENU_NETWORK_STATE="unknown"
3199:   MENU_NETWORK_CONNECTED="unknown"
3200:   MENU_NODE_ROLE="${NODE_ROLE}"
3201:   MENU_EXIT_ROLE="off"
3202:   MENU_EXIT_SELECTED_NODE="none"
3203:   MENU_EXIT_SERVING="false"
3204: 
3205:   if ! is_linux_host && ! is_macos_host; then
3206:     MENU_NETWORK_STATE="unsupported-host"
3207:     MENU_NETWORK_CONNECTED="n/a"
3208:     MENU_NODE_ROLE="${NODE_ROLE}"
3209:     MENU_EXIT_ROLE="n/a"
3210:     return
3211:   fi
3212: 
3213:   if ! command -v rustynet >/dev/null 2>&1; then
3214:     MENU_NETWORK_STATE="cli-missing"
3215:     MENU_NETWORK_CONNECTED="no"
3216:     MENU_NODE_ROLE="${NODE_ROLE}"
3217:     MENU_EXIT_ROLE="unknown"
3218:     return
3219:   fi
3220: 
3221:   local status_line
3222:   if ! status_line="$(RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET="${SOCKET_PATH}" rustynet status 2>/dev/null)"; then
3223:     MENU_NETWORK_STATE="daemon-unreachable"
3224:     MENU_NETWORK_CONNECTED="no"
3225:     MENU_NODE_ROLE="${NODE_ROLE}"
3226:     MENU_EXIT_ROLE="off"
3227:     return
3228:   fi
3229: 
3230:   MENU_NODE_ROLE="$(extract_status_field "${status_line}" "node_role")"
3231:   if [[ -z "${MENU_NODE_ROLE}" ]]; then
3232:     MENU_NODE_ROLE="${NODE_ROLE}"
3233:   fi
3234:   MENU_NETWORK_STATE="$(extract_status_field "${status_line}" "state")"
3235:   MENU_EXIT_SELECTED_NODE="$(extract_status_field "${status_line}" "exit_node")"
3236:   MENU_EXIT_SERVING="$(extract_status_field "${status_line}" "serving_exit_node")"
3237: 
3238:   case "${MENU_NETWORK_STATE}" in
3239:     ControlTrusted|DataplaneApplied|ExitActive) MENU_NETWORK_CONNECTED="yes" ;;
3240:     Init|FailClosed|"") MENU_NETWORK_CONNECTED="no" ;;
3241:     *) MENU_NETWORK_CONNECTED="unknown" ;;
3242:   esac
3243: 
3244:   if [[ "${MENU_EXIT_SERVING}" == "true" && "${MENU_EXIT_SELECTED_NODE}" != "none" && -n "${MENU_EXIT_SELECTED_NODE}" ]]; then
3245:     MENU_EXIT_ROLE="serving+using(${MENU_EXIT_SELECTED_NODE})"
3246:   elif [[ "${MENU_EXIT_SERVING}" == "true" ]]; then
3247:     MENU_EXIT_ROLE="serving"
3248:   elif [[ "${MENU_EXIT_SELECTED_NODE}" != "none" && -n "${MENU_EXIT_SELECTED_NODE}" ]]; then
3249:     MENU_EXIT_ROLE="using(${MENU_EXIT_SELECTED_NODE})"
3250:   else
3251:     MENU_EXIT_ROLE="off"
3252:   fi
3253: }

3358: configure_values() {

3362:   if [[ -z "${EGRESS_INTERFACE}" ]]; then

3365:       print_info "Set EGRESS_INTERFACE explicitly in configuration before continuing."
3366:       return 1
3367:     fi
3368:     EGRESS_INTERFACE="${detected_egress}"
3369:   fi
3370: 
3371:   normalize_node_role
3372:   previous_role="${NODE_ROLE}"
3373:   if blind_exit_role_locked; then
3374:     print_blind_exit_lock_notice
3375:     return 1
3376:   fi
3377:   prompt_default DEVICE_NODE_ID "Local device node id (used for display)" "${DEVICE_NODE_ID}"
3378:   role_prompt="Node role (admin|client)"
3379:   if [[ "${SETUP_COMPLETE}" != "1" ]]; then
3380:     role_prompt="Node role (admin|client|blind_exit)"
3381:   fi
3382:   prompt_default selected_role "${role_prompt}" "${NODE_ROLE}"
3383:   case "${selected_role}" in
3384:     admin|client|blind_exit) ;;
3385:     *)
3386:       print_err "Unsupported node role '${selected_role}'. Expected admin, client, or blind_exit."
3387:       return 1
3388:       ;;
3389:   esac
3390:   if [[ "${selected_role}" == "blind_exit" ]] && ! is_linux_host; then
3391:     print_err "blind_exit role is supported only on Linux hosts."
3392:     return 1
3393:   fi
3394:   if [[ "${SETUP_COMPLETE}" == "1" && "${selected_role}" != "${previous_role}" ]]; then
3395:     if [[ "${selected_role}" == "blind_exit" || "${previous_role}" == "blind_exit" ]]; then
3396:       print_blind_exit_lock_notice
3397:       return 1
3398:     fi
3399:     print_warn "Role changes after setup must use 'Switch node role (guided client/admin transition)'."
3400:     selected_role="${previous_role}"
3401:   fi
3402:   NODE_ROLE="${selected_role}"
3403:   normalize_node_role
3404:   if is_admin_role; then
3405:     confirm_default="n"
3406:     if [[ "${previous_role}" == "admin" ]]; then
3407:       confirm_default="y"
3408:     fi
3409:     if ! prompt_yes_no "Confirm admin role for this node (full control-plane privileges)" "${confirm_default}"; then
3410:       print_warn "Admin role confirmation declined. Reverting to client role."
3411:       NODE_ROLE="client"
3412:     fi
3413:   elif is_blind_exit_role && [[ "${SETUP_COMPLETE}" != "1" ]]; then
3414:     if ! prompt_yes_no "Confirm blind_exit role (immutable after setup; least-knowledge mode)" "n"; then
3415:       print_warn "Blind-exit role confirmation declined. Reverting to client role."
3416:       NODE_ROLE="client"
3417:     fi
